description.fr: Au matin de sa vie, la graine sur son dos lui fournit les éléments dont il a besoin pour grandir.
description.en: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
description.es: Una rara semilla le fue plantada en el lomo al nacer. La planta brota y crece con este Pokémon.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon trägt von Geburt an einen Samen auf dem Rücken, der mit ihm keimt und wächst.
description.it: Alla nascita gli è stato piantato sulla schiena un seme raro. La pianta sboccia e cresce con lui.
description.pt-BR: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
description.ru: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
description.ja: 生まれたときから　背中に 不思議な　タネが　植えてあって 体と　ともに　育つという。

description.fr: Lorsque le bourgeon sur son dos éclot, il répand un doux parfum pour célébrer sa floraison.
description.en: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
description.es: Este Pokémon tiene un bulbo en el lomo. Dicen que, al absorber nutrientes, el bulbo se transforma en una flor grande.
description.de: Es trägt eine Knospe auf seinem Rücken. Nimmt es Nahrung zu sich, soll aus der Knospe eine große blühende Blume werden.
description.it: Dopo aver assorbito sufficienti sostanze nutrienti, il bulbo sulla schiena sboccia in un magnifico fiore.
description.pt-BR: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
description.ru: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
description.ja: つぼみが　背中に　ついていて 養分を　吸収していくと 大きな　花が　咲くという。

description.fr: Le parfum de sa fleur se fait plus pénétrant les lendemains de pluie. Cela appâte les autres Pokémon.
description.en: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
description.es: Llena su cuerpo de energía con los rayos solares que captan los anchos pétalos de su flor.
description.de: Es spreizt die breiten Blätter seiner Blüte, um seinen Körper mit Sonnenenergie zu durchfluten.
description.it: Si riempie di energia grazie ai grandi petali del fiore, che spalanca catturando i raggi solari.
description.pt-BR: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
description.ru: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
description.ja: 大きな　花びらを　広げ 太陽の　光を　浴びていると 体に　元気が　みなぎっていく。

description.fr: La flamme de sa queue symbolise sa vitalité. Elle est intense quand il est en bonne santé.
description.en: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
description.es: La llama de su cola indica la fuerza vital de Charmander. Será brillante si está sano.
description.de: Die Flamme auf seiner Schweifspitze zeigt die Lebensenergie an. Ist es gesund, leuchtet sie hell.
description.it: La fiamma che Charmander ha sulla coda indica la sua forza vitale. Se è in forma, la fiamma è vivace.
description.pt-BR: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
description.ru: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
description.ja: 尻尾の　炎は ヒトカゲの　生命力の　証。 元気だと　さかんに　燃えさかる。

description.fr: La nuit, la queue ardente du Reptincel brille comme une étoile dans son repaire montagneux.
description.en: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
description.es: Suele usar la cola para derribar a su rival. Cuando lo tira, se vale de sus afiladas garras para acabar con él.
description.de: Es schlägt im Kampf mit seinem Schwanz nach seinen Gegnern. Anschließend zerfetzt es die Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen.
description.it: Fa cadere a terra il nemico colpendolo con la coda, per poi finirlo con gli artigli affilati.
description.pt-BR: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
description.ru: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
description.ja: 尻尾を　振り回して 相手を　なぎ倒し　鋭い　ツメで ズタズタに　ひきさいてしまう。

description.fr: On raconte que la flamme du Dracaufeu s’intensifie après un combat difficile.
description.en: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
description.es: Cuando lanza una descarga de fuego supercaliente, la roja llama de su cola brilla más intensamente.
description.de: Wenn dieses Pokémon einen Strahl glühenden Feuers speit, leuchtet seine Schwanzspitze auf.
description.it: Quando emette le sue lingue di fuoco, la fiamma rossa sulla punta della coda brucia più intensamente.
description.pt-BR: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
description.ru: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
description.ja: 口から　灼熱の　炎を　吐き出すとき 尻尾の　先は より　赤く　激しく　燃え上がる。

description.fr: Il se réfugie dans sa carapace et réplique en éclaboussant l’ennemi à la première occasion.
description.en: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
description.es: Se protege con su caparazón y luego contraataca lanzando agua a presión cuando tiene oportunidad.
description.de: Es zieht sich in seinen Panzer zurück und greift dann mit Wasserstrahlen seine Gegner an.
description.it: Si ritira nel suo guscio e, alla prima occasione, contrattacca colpendo il nemico con spruzzi d’acqua.
description.pt-BR: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
description.ru: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
description.ja: 甲羅に　閉じこもり　身を　守る。 相手の　すきを　見逃さず 水を　噴き出して　反撃する。

description.fr: On prétend qu’il vit 10 000 ans. Sa queue duveteuse est un symbole de longévité populaire.
description.en: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
description.es: Si es golpeado, esconderá su cabeza. Aun así, su cola puede seguir golpeando.
description.de: Bei Gefahr zieht dieses Pokémon seinen Kopf ein. Die Schwanzspitze ragt jedoch aus dem Panzer heraus.
description.it: Quando si sente minacciato ritira la testa nella corazza, mentre la coda sporge sempre un po’.
description.pt-BR: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
description.ru: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
description.ja: ポカンと　頭を　たたかれるとき 甲羅に　引っこんで　避ける。でも ちょっとだけ　尻尾が　出ているよ。

description.fr: Les trombes d’eau projetées par les canons de sa carapace peuvent percer le métal le plus résistant.
description.en: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
description.es: Para acabar con su enemigo, lo aplasta con el peso de su cuerpo. En momentos de apuro, se esconde en el caparazón.
description.de: Es begräbt seine Gegner mit seinem enormen Körpergewicht. Wenn es in einer aussichtslosen Lage steckt, zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück.
description.it: Mette KO gli avversari schiacciandoli sotto il corpo possente. Se è in difficoltà, può ritrarsi nella corazza.
description.pt-BR: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
description.ru: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
description.ja: 体が　重たく　のしかかって 相手を　気絶させる。 ピンチのときは　殻に　隠れる。

description.fr: Ses antennes rouges libèrent une puanteur qui repousse l’ennemi. Il grandit par mues régulières.
description.en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.es: Para protegerse despide un hedor horrible de sus antenas, con el que repele a sus enemigos.
description.de: Als Schutz vor Feinden sondert es einen übel riechenden Gestank mit seinen Antennen ab.
description.it: Per proteggersi emette un puzzo terribile dall’antenna sul capo, tenendo lontani i nemici.
description.pt-BR: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.ru: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description.ja: 頭の　触覚から 強烈な　においを　出して 敵を　追い払い　身を守る。

description.fr: Son corps frêle est protégé par sa carapace d’acier. Il encaisse les coups durs en attendant d’évoluer.
description.en: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description.es: Su frágil cuerpo está recubierto de una coraza dura como el acero. Permanece quieto en su desarrollo.
description.de: Der stahlharte Panzer schützt seinen zarten Körper. Es wartet geduldig auf seine Entwicklung.
description.it: Ha una corazza dura come l’acciaio che protegge il suo fragile corpo. Attende immobile di evolversi.
description.pt-BR: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description.ru: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description.ja: 鋼鉄のように　硬い　殻で やわらかい　中身を　守っている。 進化するまで　じっと　耐えている。

description.fr: Il raffole du nectar des fleurs. Il est capable de repérer la plus petite quantité de pollen.
description.en: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description.es: Adora el néctar de las flores. Puede localizar hasta las más pequeñas cantidades de polen.
description.de: Es liebt Blütenhonig. Es findet selbst Blumen, die sehr wenig Pollen haben.
description.it: Adora il nettare dei fiori e riesce a localizzare i campi in cui si trova anche una minima quantità di polline.
description.pt-BR: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description.ru: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description.ja: 花の　ミツが　大好物。 わずかな　花粉で　花畑の 場所を　探し出すことが　できる。

description.fr: Il mange chaque jour son poids en feuilles. Il utilise l’aiguillon sur sa tête pour repousser l’ennemi.
description.en: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description.es: Suele habitar bosques y praderas. Tiene un afilado y venenoso aguijón de unos 5 cm encima de la cabeza.
description.de: Es lebt bevorzugt in Wäldern und in hohem Gras. Auf dem Kopf trägt es einen circa 5 cm langen, spitzen, giftigen Stachel.
description.it: Vive soprattutto nei boschi e nei prati. Sul capo ha un affilato e velenoso pungiglione lungo 5 cm.
description.pt-BR: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description.ru: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description.ja: 森や　草地に　多く　生息。 頭の　先に　５センチぐらいの 小さく　鋭い　毒針を持つ。

description.fr: Il se cache sous les feuilles et les branches pour fuir les prédateurs en attendant d’évoluer.
description.en: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description.es: Casi incapaz de moverse, este Pokémon solo puede endurecer su caparazón para protegerse.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kann sich kaum bewegen. Bei drohender Gefahr verhärtet es seinen Panzer.
description.it: Quasi incapace di muoversi, questo Pokémon può solo indurire il proprio guscio per proteggersi.
description.pt-BR: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description.ru: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description.ja: 自分では　ほとんど　動けないが 危ないときは　硬くなって 身を守っているようだ。

description.fr: Il virevolte rapidement autour de l’ennemi et frappe de son dard empoisonné avant de décamper.
description.en: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description.es: Tiene 3 aguijones venenosos en sus patas y cola. Suelen pinchar a sus enemigos repetidas veces.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon verfügt über drei Giftstachel. Es kann seine Gegner damit wiederholt stechen.
description.it: Possiede tre aculei velenosi sulle zampe anteriori e sull’addome con cui punge i nemici ripetutamente.
description.pt-BR: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description.ru: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description.ja: 両手と　お尻にある　３本の　毒針で 相手を　刺して　刺して 刺しまくって　攻撃する。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon docile préfère éviter le combat. Toutefois, il se montre très féroce quand on l’agresse.
description.en: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description.es: Muy común en bosques y selvas. Aletea al nivel del suelo para levantar la gravilla.
description.de: Ein vorwiegend in Wäldern lebendes Pokémon, das zur Verteidigung mit den Flügeln Sand aufwirbelt.
description.it: Molto comune in boschi e foreste, sbatte le ali a livello del suolo per sollevare sabbia accecante.
description.pt-BR: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description.ru: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description.ja: 森や　林に　多く　分布。 地上でも　激しく　はばたいて 砂を　かけたりする。

description.fr: Il survole son vaste territoire en quête d’une proie avant de fondre sur elle toutes griffes en avant.
description.en: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description.es: Tiene unas garras desarrolladas. Puede atrapar un Exeggcute y transportarlo desde una distancia de casi 100 km.
description.de: Die Krallen an seinen Füßen sind sehr ausgeprägt. Es kann sogar ein Owei zu seinem Nest in 100 km Entfernung tragen.
description.it: Grazie ai potenti artigli può trasportare una preda delle dimensioni di un Exeggcute per oltre 100 km.
description.pt-BR: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description.ru: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description.ja: 足の　ツメが　発達している。 エサの　タマタマを　つかんで １００キロ先の　巣まで　運ぶ。

description.fr: En battant des ailes de toutes ses forces, Roucarnage génère une rafale à en déraciner les arbres.
description.en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description.es: Cuando caza, vuela muy deprisa a ras del agua y sorprende a inocentes presas como Magikarp.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon schnellt bei der Jagd blitzschnell unter Wasser, um seine ahnungslose Beute zu fangen.
description.it: Quando caccia, vola velocissimo sul pelo dell’acqua e cattura ignare prede come Magikarp.
description.pt-BR: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description.ru: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description.ja: エサを　探すとき　水面　すれすれを 滑るように　飛んで コイキングなどを　わしづかみにする。

description.fr: D’une prudence extrême, sa nature robuste lui permet de s’adapter à tous les terrains.
description.en: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description.es: Vive allí donde haya comida disponible. Busca todo el día, sin descanso, algo comestible.
description.de: Es baut sein Nest, wo es Futter findet. Es ist den ganzen Tag auf der Suche nach etwas Essbarem.
description.it: Vive ovunque si trovi del cibo, cercando incessantemente qualsiasi cosa sia commestibile.
description.pt-BR: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description.ru: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description.ja: 食べるものが　あるところなら どこにだって　生息する。 １日中　エサを　探している。

description.fr: Il grignote sans cesse pour apaiser la poussée de ses crocs. Il peut transpercer un mur de parpaings.
description.en: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description.es: Lima sus colmillos royendo objetos duros. Con ellos puede destruir incluso paredes de hormigón.
description.de: Es wetzt seine ständig wachsenden Zähne an harten Dingen. Es kann Wände aus Beton zernagen.
description.it: Si affila le zanne in perenne crescita rosicchiando cose dure. Riesce a frantumare persino i muri.
description.pt-BR: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description.ru: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description.ja: 伸び続ける　前歯を　削るため 硬い　ものを　かじる　習性。 ブロック塀も　かじって　壊す。

description.fr: Il fait battre vigoureusement ses petites ailes pour voler et cherche à manger dans l’herbe avec le bec.
description.en: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description.es: Muy protector de su territorio, mueve sus cortas alas sin descanso para lanzarse a toda velocidad.
description.de: Es beschützt sein Gebiet stets vor Eindringlingen. Daher fliegt es ständig wild umher.
description.it: Molto geloso del suo territorio, svolazza in giro a gran velocità battendo le ali continuamente.
description.pt-BR: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description.ru: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description.ja: 自分の　テリトリーを　守るため 短い　羽を　はばたかせて 忙しく　飛び回っている。

description.fr: Il a assez d’énergie pour voler toute la journée avec ses grandes ailes. Il frappe de son bec acéré.
description.en: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description.es: Con sus enormes y magníficas alas, puede seguir volando sin tener que aterrizar para descansar.
description.de: Mit seinen riesigen Flügeln kann dieses Pokémon nahezu pausenlos in der Luft bleiben.
description.it: Con le sue enormi e magnifiche ali, è in grado di volare senza mai atterrare per riposarsi.
description.pt-BR: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description.ru: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description.ja: 大きな　翼で　大空を 飛び続けることが　できる。 １回も　降りなくても　平気だ。

description.fr: Il se faufile dans l’herbe sans un bruit et frappe dans le dos quand sa proie s’y attend le moins.
description.en: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description.es: Cuanto más viejo, más crece este Pokémon. Por la noche, descansa en las ramas de los árboles.
description.de: Mit dem Alter wird der Körper dieses Pokémon immer länger. Es schläft um Äste gewickelt.
description.it: Con il tempo si fa sempre più lungo. La notte avvolge il suo corpo attorno a qualche ramo per dormire.
description.pt-BR: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description.ru: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description.ja: 育つほどに　どんどん　長くなる。 そして　夜中は　木の枝に グルグルと　絡まって　休む。

description.fr: Il utilise la marque sur son ventre pour intimider l’ennemi. Il étouffe l’ennemi pétrifié par la peur.
description.en: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description.es: El dibujo que tiene en la panza aterroriza. Los rivales más débiles salen huyendo al verlo.
description.de: Das Muster auf seinem Bauch ähnelt einer Fratze. Schwache Gegner nehmen bereits beim Anblick Reißaus.
description.it: Il disegno sulla pancia rappresenta una faccia spaventosa, capace di far fuggire i nemici più pavidi.
description.pt-BR: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description.ru: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description.ja: お腹の　模様が　怖い　顔に　見える。 弱い　敵は　その模様を 見ただけで　逃げ出してしまう。

description.fr: Il lui arrive de remettre d’aplomb un Pikachu allié en lui envoyant une décharge électrique.
description.en: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description.es: Levanta su cola para vigilar los alrededores. A veces, puede ser alcanzado por un rayo en esa pose.
description.de: Es streckt seinen Schweif nach oben, um seine Umgebung zu prüfen. Häufig fährt ein Blitz hinein.
description.it: Solleva la coda per esaminare l’ambiente circostante. A volte la coda è colpita da un fulmine quando è in questa posizione.
description.pt-BR: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description.ru: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description.ja: 尻尾を　立てて　まわりの　様子を 探っていると　ときどき 雷が　尻尾に　落ちてくる。

description.fr: Il se protège des décharges grâce à sa queue qui dissipe l’électricité dans le sol.
description.en: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description.es: Cuando se carga de electricidad, sus músculos se tensan y se vuelve más agresivo de lo normal.
description.de: Wenn es sich auflädt, zucken seine Muskeln und es wird aggressiver und kampflustiger.
description.it: Se l’elettricità aumenta, i muscoli sono sollecitati e diventa più aggressivo del solito.
description.pt-BR: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description.ru: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description.ja: 電気が　たまってくると 筋肉が　刺激され いつもより　攻撃的に　なってしまう。

description.fr: Il vit sur des terres arides épargnées par la pluie. Il se roule en boule pour se protéger.
description.en: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
description.es: Este Pokémon permanece bajo tierra. Si se siente amenazado, se enrosca para defenderse.
description.de: Es gräbt und lebt im Erdboden. Bei Gefahr rollt es sich zum Schutz zu einem Ball zusammen.
description.it: Vive sottoterra, scavando buche. Se minacciato, si protegge raggomitolandosi.
description.pt-BR: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
description.ru: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
description.ja: 地面に　穴を　掘って　住む。 自分に　危険が　迫ると まるくなって　身を　守る。

description.fr: Il se met en boule pour percuter l’ennemi. Ses épines aiguisées font beaucoup de dégâts.
description.en: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
description.es: Si cava a gran velocidad, puede que se le caigan las garras y púas. Vuelven a crecerle en un día.
description.de: Wenn es schnell gräbt, können seine Stacheln und Krallen abbrechen. Sie wachsen binnen eines Tages nach.
description.it: Se scava molto velocemente gli si consumano le punte e gli artigli, ma gli ricrescono in un giorno.
description.pt-BR: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
description.ru: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
description.ja: すごい　勢いで　地面を掘ると トゲや　ツメが　折れてしまうが 次の日には　生えそろっている。

description.fr: Bien qu’il rechigne à se battre, une goutte du poison sécrété par ses piquants peut s’avérer fatale.
description.en: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description.es: Aunque pequeñas, sus venenosas púas son muy peligrosas. Tienen un cuerno más pequeño que los machos.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist sehr klein, verfügt aber über starke Gifte. Das Weibchen hat ein kleineres Horn.
description.it: Sebbene piccolo, i suoi baffi velenosi sono molto pericolosi. La femmina ha un corno più minuto.
description.pt-BR: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description.ru: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description.ja: 体は　小さくても　毒針を 持つため　注意が　必要だ。 メスのほうが　ツノが　小さい。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon dresse ses piquants en cas de danger. Ils poussent moins vite que ceux de Nidorino.
description.en: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description.es: Tiene un carácter afable. Emite ondas ultrasónicas para confundir al enemigo.
description.de: Das Weibchen ist ausgeglichener. Es stößt Schreie im Ultraschallwellenbereich aus, die den Gegner verwirren können.
description.it: La femmina ha un temperamento mite. Lancia ultrasuoni capaci di incantare i nemici.
description.pt-BR: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description.ru: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description.ja: メスなので　性格は　温厚。 口から　出す　超音波は 相手を　まどわす　力がある。

description.fr: Son corps est recouvert d’écailles solides. Il donnera sa vie pour secourir les petits de son terrier.
description.en: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description.es: Usa su cuerpo duro y escamoso para sellar la entrada a su madriguera y protegerse de los depredadores.
description.de: Es benutzt seinen schuppigen Körper, um den Höhleneingang als Schutz für seine Jungen zu sperren.
description.it: Con il suo corpo robusto e squamoso sbarra l’accesso alla tana e protegge i piccoli dai predatori.
description.pt-BR: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description.ru: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description.ja: ウロコで　覆われた　頑丈な　体で 巣穴の　入り口を　ふさぎ 敵から　子供たちを　守る。

description.fr: Il jauge le terrain en laissant ses oreilles dépasser de l’herbe. Il se défend avec sa corne toxique.
description.en: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
description.es: Saca las orejas por encima de la hierba para explorar el territorio. Le protege su cuerno venenoso.
description.de: Es untersucht die Umgebung, indem es die Ohren spitzt und lauscht. Sein giftiges Horn schützt es.
description.it: Esamina l’ambiente circostante tendendo le orecchie fuori dall’erba. Si protegge con il corno velenoso.
description.pt-BR: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
description.ru: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
description.ja: 草むらの　上に　耳だけ　出して まわりの　気配を　探る。 猛毒の　ツノで　身を　守る。

description.fr: D’un tempérament violent, il empale l’ennemi sur sa corne qui distille un poison puissant.
description.en: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description.es: Levanta sus grandes orejas para vigilar. Si detecta algo, atacará de inmediato.
description.de: Es überwacht mit seinen riesigen Ohren die Umgebung. Registriert es eine Bewegung, greift es an.
description.it: Rizza le grandi orecchie per esaminare la zona. Se avverte qualcosa, attacca immediatamente.
description.pt-BR: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description.ru: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description.ja: 発達した　耳を　立てて まわりの　気配を　探る。 なにかあると　すぐに　飛びかかる。

description.fr: Un coup de sa puissante queue peut briser un poteau téléphonique comme une allumette.
description.en: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description.es: Es fácil reconocerlo por tener una dura piel y un gran cuerno lleno de peligrosísimo veneno.
description.de: Seine steinharte Haut und sein ausgeprägtes Horn sind seine Markenzeichen. Achte auf das Horn, denn es enthält Gift.
description.it: Lo si riconosce dalla pelle durissima e dal corno particolarmente allungato, che contiene sostanze velenose.
description.pt-BR: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description.ru: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description.ja: 石のように　硬い　皮膚と 長く　伸びた　ツノが　特徴。 ツノには　毒も　あるので　注意。

description.fr: On dit que ceux qui voient danser un groupe de Mélofée sous la pleine lune connaîtront un grand bonheur.
description.en: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description.es: Se dice que la felicidad llegará a quien vea a un grupo de Clefairy bailando a la luz de la luna llena.
description.de: Eine Ansammlung von Piepi bei Vollmond tanzen zu sehen, soll Freude verheißen.
description.it: Si dice che vedere un gruppo di Clefairy ballare con la luna piena sia di ottimo auspicio.
description.pt-BR: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description.ru: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description.ja: 満月の夜　ピッピが　集まって ダンスを　踊る様子を　見ると 幸せに　なれると　言われている。

description.fr: Il est très farouche et se laisse rarement approcher. De plus, il détecte les sons à plus d’1 km.
description.en: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description.es: Su oído es tan agudo que puede oír una aguja caer a 1 km. Vive en montañas solitarias.
description.de: Es kann eine Nadel hören, die in 1 km Entfernung zu Boden fällt. Es lebt in der Stille der Berge.
description.it: Ha un udito tanto acuto da sentire la caduta di uno spillo a 1 km di distanza. Vive su monti quieti.
description.pt-BR: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description.ru: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description.ja: １キロ先で　落ちた　針の　音も 聞き分ける　優れた　耳を　持つ。 静かな　山奥に　住んでいる。

description.fr: Il envoie des boules de feu. Avec l’âge, ses six queues en forment de nouvelles.
description.en: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description.es: Cuando nace solo tiene una cola, pero a medida que crece, esta se va dividiendo desde la punta.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon hat bei seiner Geburt nur einen Schweif, der sich mit zunehmendem Alter aufspaltet.
description.it: Alla nascita ha solo una coda, che con il passare del tempo sviluppa diverse diramazioni.
description.pt-BR: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description.ru: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description.ja: 生まれたとき　尻尾は　真っ白で １本しかない。育つと　やがて 先が　分かれて　尻尾が　増える。

description.fr: On raconte que ses neuf queues détiennent un pouvoir mystique. Il peut vivre pendant mille ans.
description.en: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description.es: Tiene nueve colas y un pelaje de color dorado. Dicen que este Pokémon llega a vivir 1000 años.
description.de: Es hat neun lange Schweife und sein Fell glänzt gülden. Man sagt, es soll 1 000 Jahre alt werden.
description.it: Dotato di nove code e di una pelliccia dorata, si dice che viva 1000 anni.
description.pt-BR: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description.ru: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description.ja: 黄金に　輝く　体毛と ９本の　長い　尻尾を　持つ。 １０００年は　生きると　言われる。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il roule ses grands yeux ronds, il entonne une berceuse qui endort son auditoire.
description.en: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description.es: Cautiva con la mirada a su enemigo y hace que se quede profundamente dormido mientras entona una dulce melodía.
description.de: Es fesselt die Gegner mit seinen großen, runden Augen und versetzt sie in Schlaf, indem es eine beruhigende Melodie singt.
description.it: Cattura l’attenzione dei nemici grazie agli enormi occhi rotondi, per poi farli addormentare con una dolce ninnananna.
description.pt-BR: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description.ru: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description.ja: まるくて　大きい　瞳で　誘いこみ 心地よい　歌を　歌い 相手を　眠らせる。

description.fr: Sa fourrure est d’une douceur incomparable au toucher. Il peut gonfler en aspirant de l’air.
description.en: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description.es: Su piel es tan suave que si dos de ellos se acurrucan juntos, no querrán separarse nunca.
description.de: Sein Fell ist so flauschig, dass, wenn zwei zusammenstehen, sie nicht getrennt werden möchten.
description.it: Hanno un pelo così morbido che se due di loro si abbracciano non vogliono più separarsi.
description.pt-BR: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description.ru: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description.ja: ２匹　寄り添いあうと　お互いの 毛皮が　気持ち良すぎて 離れられなく　なってしまう。

description.fr: Il se repère dans l’espace grâce aux ultrasons émis par sa gueule.
description.en: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description.es: Aunque carezca de ojos, puede detectar obstáculos con las ondas ultrasónicas que emite su boca.
description.de: Obwohl es keine Augen hat, kann es Hindernisse mithilfe von Ultraschallwellen wahrnehmen.
description.it: Non ha occhi, ma avverte gli ostacoli con le onde ultrasoniche che emette dalla bocca.
description.pt-BR: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description.ru: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description.ja: 口から　出す　超音波で 両目が　なくても まわりの　障害物を　察知できる。

description.fr: Ses crocs acérés et creux peuvent pénétrer la plus épaisse des peaux et sucer le sang de la victime.
description.en: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
description.es: Cuando ataque, seguirá chupando energía de su víctima, aunque pese tanto que ya no pueda volar.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon saugt dem Gegner selbst dann noch Energie ab, wenn es zu schwer zum Fliegen wird.
description.it: Quando attacca, non smette di succhiare l’energia della vittima, fino a diventare troppo pesante per volare.
description.pt-BR: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
description.ru: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
description.ja: かみついたら　最後。死ぬほど 血を　吸いまくるので　重たくなって 自分で　飛べなくなることもある。

description.fr: En journée, il plante ses pieds-racines dans le sol. La nuit, il se promène en semant des graines.
description.en: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description.es: Durante el día, se agazapa en el frío subsuelo huyendo del sol. La luz de la luna le hace crecer mucho.
description.de: Tagsüber versteckt es sich in der kalten Erde, um die Sonne zu meiden. Es wächst im Mondschein.
description.it: Di giorno vive nel freddo sottosuolo, per evitare la luce del sole. Cresce assorbendo la luce lunare.
description.pt-BR: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description.ru: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description.ja: 昼間は　太陽を　避けるため 冷たい　地面に　潜っている。 月の　光を　浴びて　育つ。

description.fr: L’odeur du nectar de sa bouche est si répugnante qu’elle agresse les narines à deux kilomètres.
description.en: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description.es: ¡Huele bastante mal! De todas formas, una de cada mil personas aprecian su fétido olor.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon sondert einen übelriechenden Geruch ab. Trotzdem halten einige Leute es im Haus.
description.it: Puzza da levare il fiato! Tuttavia circa una persona su mille adora annusarne il fetido lezzo.
description.pt-BR: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description.ru: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description.ja: 猛烈な　クサさ！　それなのに １０００人に　１人ぐらい これを　好んで　かぐ　人がいる。

description.fr: Ses pétales sont les plus grands du monde. Il marche en répandant un pollen extrêmement allergène.
description.en: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description.es: Cuanto mayores son sus pétalos, más tóxico es su polen. Le pesa la cabeza y le cuesta mantenerla erguida.
description.de: Je größer die Blütenblätter, desto mehr giftige Pollen sind in der Blüte enthalten.
description.it: Più grandi sono i petali, maggiore è la quantità di polline tossico che contengono. La testa è molto pesante.
description.pt-BR: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description.ru: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description.ja: 花びらが　大きいほど たくさん　花粉を　出すが 頭が　重たくて　疲れてしまうという。

description.fr: Des champignons appelés “tochukaso” poussent sur son dos. Ils évoluent avec le Paras hôte.
description.en: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description.es: Lleva en el lomo dos setas parásitas llamadas tochukaso, que crecen con él.
description.de: Auf seinem Rücken wachsen Pilze, die man Tochukaso nennt. Die Pilze wachsen mit ihrem Wirt.
description.it: Sul dorso di questo Pokémon nascono funghi chiamati tochukaso, che crescono insieme a lui.
description.pt-BR: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description.ru: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description.ja: 虫の　背中に　生えているのは 冬虫夏草　という　キノコ。 育つと　キノコも　大きくなる。

description.fr: Un champignon parasite plus gros que Parasect contrôle son corps. Il répand des spores empoisonnées.
description.en: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description.es: Parasect está dominado por una seta parásita mayor que él. Dispersa esporas venenosas.
description.de: Parasek wird von einem Pilz, der größer als das Pokémon ist, kontrolliert. Er gibt Giftsporen ab.
description.it: Parasect è controllato da un fungo ancora più grosso del suo corpo. Diffonde spore velenose.
description.pt-BR: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description.ru: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description.ja: 体よりも　大きな　キノコが パラセクトを　操っている。 毒の　胞子を　ばらまく。

description.fr: Ses grands yeux sont en fait des amas d’yeux minuscules. La nuit, il est attiré par la lumière.
description.en: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description.es: Sus grandes ojos son en realidad grupos de ojos diminutos. Por la noche se siente atraído por la luz.
description.de: Seine großen Augen bestehen aus vielen kleinen Augen. Nachts wird es von Licht angezogen.
description.it: I suoi grandi occhi sono in realtà un insieme di tanti piccoli occhi. Di notte, è attirato dalla luce.
description.pt-BR: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description.ru: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description.ja: 小さな　目が　たくさん　集まって 大きな　目に　なっている。 夜になると　明かりに　集まる。

description.fr: Il répand ses écailles poudreuses en battant des ailes. Elles sont toxiques au toucher.
description.en: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description.es: Lanza unas escamas que paralizan a cualquiera. Quien las toque, no podrá ni ponerse de pie.
description.de: Wer die von ihm verstreuten Schuppen berührt, wird gelähmt und muss sich setzen.
description.it: Sparge scaglie che paralizzano chiunque le tocchi, rendendolo incapace di stare in piedi.
description.pt-BR: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description.ru: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description.ja: ばらまかれた　りんぷんに　触れると 体の　感覚が　おかしくなって まっすぐ　立っていられなくなる。

description.fr: Un Pokémon qui vit sous terre. Habitué aux souterrains, il fuit la lumière du jour.
description.en: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description.es: Vive un metro por debajo del suelo, donde se alimenta de raíces. También aparece en la superficie.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon lebt 1 m unter der Erde. Es frisst Wurzeln und kommt selten an die Oberfläche.
description.it: Vive un metro sotto terra, dove si nutre di radici. Talvolta compare in superficie.
description.pt-BR: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description.ru: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description.ja: 地下１メートルくらいを　掘りすすみ 木の根っこなどを　かじって　生きる。 たまに　地上に　顔を出す。

description.fr: Ses trois têtes creusent le sol à tour de rôle. Il peut atteindre des profondeurs de 100 kilomètres.
description.en: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description.es: En combate, cava la tierra, se esconde y sale de repente para golpear a su rival. Nunca se sabe por dónde puede aparecer.
description.de: Im Kampf gräbt es sich ein und attackiert den Gegner aus einer unvorhersehbaren Richtung.
description.it: Nella lotta, scava tunnel nel terreno per sorprendere il nemico attaccandolo da una direzione imprevedibile.
description.pt-BR: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description.ru: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description.ja: 地中を　掘りすすんで 相手が　油断しているところを 別の　場所から　攻撃する。

description.fr: Son regard s’anime à la vue d’un objet brillant. C’est un Pokémon nocturne.
description.en: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description.es: Es de naturaleza nocturna. Le atraen los objetos brillantes.
description.de: Ein nachtaktives Pokémon. Sieht es etwas Schimmerndes, fangen seine Augen an zu glänzen.
description.it: È un Pokémon attivo di notte. Se nota qualcosa di luccicante, i suoi occhi cominciano a brillare.
description.pt-BR: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description.ru: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description.ja: 夜中に　行動する　習性。 キラキラ　光るものを　見つけると 負けないくらい　瞳が　輝く。

description.fr: Un Pokémon très snob. La taille du joyau qui orne son front alimente bien des débats parmi ses fans.
description.en: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description.es: Aunque es muy admirado por el pelo, es difícil de entrenar como mascota, porque es un poco travieso.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon hat sehr schönes Fell. Es ist jedoch ein schwer erziehbares Haustier.
description.it: Sebbene molto amato per il suo pelo, è difficile addomesticarlo per la volubile crudeltà.
description.pt-BR: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description.ru: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description.ja: 毛並みが　美しく ペットにしたがる　人も　多いが　すぐ ひっかいたり　するので　手強いぞ。

description.fr: Ses pouvoirs déconcertants et mystérieux lui font subir de constantes migraines.
description.en: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description.es: Padece continuamente dolores de cabeza. Cuando son muy fuertes, empieza a usar misteriosos poderes.
description.de: Es wird permanent von Kopfschmerzen geplagt. Wird der Schmerz stärker, setzt es geheimnisvolle Kräfte ein.
description.it: È costantemente tormentato dal mal di testa che, quando si fa particolarmente intenso, gli conferisce strani poteri.
description.pt-BR: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description.ru: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description.ja: いつも　頭痛に　悩まされている。 この　頭痛が　激しくなると 不思議な　力を　使いはじめる。

description.fr: Ses membres palmés et son corps parfaitement adapté font de lui un nageur exceptionnel.
description.en: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description.es: Aparece en ríos al anochecer. Puede usar poderes telequinéticos si su frente brilla misteriosamente.
description.de: Es taucht bei Sonnenuntergang am Wasser auf. Leuchtet seine Stirn, setzt es telekinetische Kräfte ein.
description.it: Appare presso i corsi d’acqua col buio. Acquisisce poteri telecinetici se la sua fronte diventa incandescente.
description.pt-BR: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description.ru: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description.ja: 夕暮れ　水辺に　姿をみせる。 額が　あやしく　光るとき 神通力を　使いこなすという。

description.fr: Ils vivent en colonies sylvestres. Quand un Férosinge s’énerve, toute la colonie suit son exemple.
description.en: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description.es: Es peligroso acercarse si se enfada sin razón aparente, ya que no distingue entre amigos y enemigos.
description.de: Da es grundlos angreift und nicht zwischen Freund oder Feind unterscheidet, ist es sehr gefährlich.
description.it: Se è tanto arrabbiato da non riuscire più a distinguere gli amici dai nemici, è pericoloso avvicinarsi.
description.pt-BR: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description.ru: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description.ja: 意味もなく　怒って　暴れ出すと 仲間の　区別も　つかなくなるので 近寄るのは　非常に　危険だ。

description.fr: Il grogne quand on le toise, rugit quand on s’enfuit et devient fou de rage quand on le frappe.
description.en: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description.es: Solo se calma cuando nadie está cerca. Llegar a ver ese momento es realmente difícil.
description.de: In ganz seltenen Fällen beruhigt sich dieses sehr jähzornige Pokémon und ist für einen Moment friedlich.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è costantemente furioso e si calma solo nella solitudine più assoluta.
description.pt-BR: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description.ru: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description.ja: まわりに　だれも　いないときだけは 怒るのを　やめている。しかし それを　見るのは　難しい。

description.fr: Un Pokémon très loyal. Il restera immobile jusqu’à ce que son Dresseur lui donne un ordre.
description.en: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description.es: Es muy agradable y leal. Para ahuyentar al enemigo, se pone a ladrar y a dar bocados.
description.de: Es ist sehr freundlich und bleibt den Menschen treu. Durch Bellen und Beißen versucht es, Gegner zu verscheuchen.
description.it: Molto amichevole e fedele verso le persone. Allontana i nemici abbaiando e mordendoli.
description.pt-BR: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description.ru: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description.ja: 人懐こく　誠実な　性格。 敵には　ほえて　かみつき 追い払おうとする。

description.fr: Son port altier et son attitude fière ont depuis longtemps conquis le cœur des hommes.
description.en: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description.es: Un Pokémon muy admirado desde la antigüedad por su belleza. Corre ágilmente como si tuviera alas.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon trägt ein wunderschönes Fell. Es ist obendrein schnell und sehr wendig.
description.it: Da sempre ammirato per la sua bellezza, corre veloce come se avesse le ali.
description.pt-BR: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description.ru: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description.ja: 昔から　多くの　人を 虜にした　美しい　ポケモン。 飛ぶように　軽やかに　走る。

description.fr: Sa peau est si mince qu’on voit ses organes internes. Il tient à peine sur ses nouveaux pieds.
description.en: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description.es: Tiene una piel extraordinaria, fina y húmeda, que deja entrever las vísceras que tiene dispuestas en espiral.
description.de: Seine glatte, schwarze Haut ist dünn und feucht. Teilweise sind seine Innereien als spiralförmige Muster sichtbar.
description.it: Dalla pelle nera, lucida, umida e sottile si intravedono gli organi interni, che formano una spirale.
description.pt-BR: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description.ru: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description.ja: スベスベした　黒い皮膚は　薄く 湿っている。内臓の　一部が 透けて　渦巻状に　見える。

description.fr: La spirale qui orne son ventre ondule doucement. Celui qui la fixe est saisi d’une étrange torpeur.
description.en: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description.es: Capaz de vivir dentro o fuera del agua. Fuera del agua suda para mantener baboso su cuerpo.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kann im Wasser und auch an Land leben. An Land schwitzt es sich den Körper nass.
description.it: Capace di vivere dentro o fuori dall’acqua. Sulla terraferma suda per mantenere il suo corpo unto.
description.pt-BR: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description.ru: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description.ja: 陸でも　水中でも　暮らせる。 地上では　いつも　汗をかき 皮膚を　ぬめぬめ　させている。

description.fr: Il possède de sacrés biscoteaux. Il peut parcourir sans relâche l’Océan Pacifique.
description.en: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description.es: Tiene músculos muy desarrollados. Es capaz de nadar en el océano sin descanso.
description.de: Es hat extrem starke Muskeln und kann durch den Ozean schwimmen, ohne sich ausruhen zu müssen.
description.it: Ha dei muscoli tanto sviluppati da riuscire ad attraversare a nuoto interi oceani senza fermarsi.
description.pt-BR: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description.ru: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description.ja: 強靭な　筋肉を　持つ。 太平洋を　休むことなく 泳ぎ続けることが　できるのだ。

description.fr: L’utilisation de ses pouvoirs mentaux le fatigue tellement qu’il dort 18 heures par jour.
description.en: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description.es: Duerme 18 horas al día y mientras lo hace es capaz de usar una serie de poderes extrasensoriales.
description.de: Es schläft 18 Stunden am Tag. Währenddessen setzt es eine Vielzahl zusätzlicher sensorischer Kräfte ein.
description.it: Dorme 18 ore al giorno. Anche da addormentato utilizza una serie di poteri extrasensoriali.
description.pt-BR: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description.ru: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description.ja: １日　１８時間は　寝ている。 眠ってる　あいだでも さまざまな　超能力を　使う。

description.fr: Il fixe sa cuillère d’argent afin de concentrer son esprit et d’émettre un maximum d’ondes alpha.
description.en: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description.es: Cuando utiliza su poder psíquico, emite poderosas ondas alfa que pueden destruir dispositivos.
description.de: Setzt es seine Psycho-Kräfte ein, sondert es Alphawellen ab, die Präzisionsgeräten schaden können.
description.it: Quando usa i poteri psichici, emette forti onde alfa che possono rovinare strumenti di precisione.
description.pt-BR: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description.ru: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description.ja: 超能力を　発揮すると 強い　アルファ波を　出して 精密機械を　壊してしまう。

description.fr: On dit que les cuillères qu’il tient en permanence ont été créées par la puissance de son esprit.
description.en: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description.es: Sus neuronas se multiplican continuamente durante su vida. Por eso, siempre lo recuerda todo.
description.de: Seine Gehirnzellen vervielfachen sich sein ganzes Leben lang. Daher kann es sich immer an alles erinnern.
description.it: Le sue cellule cerebrali si moltiplicano di continuo. Perciò ricorda qualsiasi cosa gli accada.
description.pt-BR: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description.ru: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description.ja: 脳細胞は　いつも　分裂して 死ぬまで　増え続けるので あらゆることを　覚えておける。

description.fr: Malgré sa petite taille, sa force lui permet de soulever plusieurs Racaillou à la fois.
description.en: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description.es: Levanta un Graveler para mantener sus músculos en forma. Domina todas las artes marciales.
description.de: Es hebt Georok hoch, um seinen Körper zu trainieren. Außerdem übt es sich in jeder Art von Kampfsport.
description.it: Solleva Graveler ripetutamente per mantenersi forte. Conosce ogni tipo di arte marziale.
description.pt-BR: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description.ru: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description.ja: ゴローンを　何度も　上げ下ろしして 全身の　筋肉を　鍛える。 あらゆる　格闘技を　使う。

description.fr: Il soulève les plus lourdes charges avec plaisir et facilité. Il donne un coup de main tout en s’entraînant!
description.en: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description.es: Su musculoso cuerpo es tan fuerte que usa un cinto antifuerza para controlar sus movimientos.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist superstark. Es kann sich nur mit einem Kraft regulierenden Gürtel bewegen.
description.it: Il suo corpo muscoloso è così forte che usa una cintura antiforza per regolare i suoi movimenti.
description.pt-BR: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description.ru: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description.ja: すごく　強靭な　肉体なので パワーセーブ　ベルトを　つけて 強さを　制御している。

description.fr: La puissance et la rapidité de ses quatre bras puissants font des ravages sur ses adversaires.
description.en: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description.es: Tiene cuatro brazos tan bien desarrollados que puede dar una serie de 1000 puñetazos en cuestión de dos segundos.
description.de: Seine markigen Arme können innerhalb von nur zwei Sekunden 1 000 Schläge verteilen.
description.it: Le braccia eccezionalmente sviluppate sono in grado di assestare 1000 pugni in soli 2 secondi.
description.pt-BR: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description.ru: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description.ja: 発達した　４本の　腕は ２秒間に　１０００発の　パンチを 繰り出すことができる。

description.fr: Il préfère les climats chauds et humides. Ses lianes peuvent capturer une proie en un clin d’œil.
description.en: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description.es: Aunque su cuerpo es extremadamente delgado, es muy rápido a la hora de capturar sus presas.
description.de: Obwohl sein Körper sehr schmal ist, schnappt es blitzschnell nach Beute.
description.it: Sebbene abbia un corpo magrissimo, sa essere molto rapido quando si scaglia sulla preda.
description.pt-BR: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description.ru: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description.ja: ひょろっとした　体つきだが 獲物を　捕らえるときの　動きは 目にも　とまらないほど　素早い。

description.fr: Un Pokémon végétal. Il capture les proies étourdies en les endormant à l’aide d’une poudre toxique.
description.en: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description.es: Las hojas que tiene actúan como cuchillas en combate. Otra de sus armas es el corrosivo fluido que expulsa.
description.de: Die Blätter werden eingesetzt, um Gegner aufzuschlitzen. Dieses Pokémon spuckt eine Flüssigkeit, die alles auflöst.
description.it: Si serve delle foglie laterali come lame contro i nemici. Il fluido che secerne dalla bocca scioglie qualsiasi cosa.
description.pt-BR: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description.ru: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description.ja: 葉っぱの　部分は　カッターになって 相手を　切り裂く。口からは なんでも　溶かす　液体を　吐く。

description.fr: Sa bouche sécrète un fluide à l’odeur de miel, qui s’avère être un acide extrêmement corrosif.
description.en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description.es: Dicen que vive en grandes colonias en el interior de las junglas, aunque nadie ha podido verificarlo.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon soll in großen Kolonien tief im Dschungel leben, doch niemand kann dies bestätigen.
description.it: Pare che viva in grandi colonie nel cuore della giungla, ma nessuno è mai tornato da lì per raccontarlo.
description.pt-BR: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description.ru: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description.ja: ジャングルの　奥地に　ウツボット ばかり　いる　地帯が　あって 行ったら　２度と　帰ってこれない。

description.fr: Presque entièrement composé d’eau, son corps a tendance à se dessécher sur la terre ferme.
description.en: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description.es: Su cuerpo se compone casi en exclusiva de agua. Lanza extraños rayos con sus ojos cristalinos.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht aus Wasser. Aus seinen kristallartigen Augen verschießt es eigenartige Strahlen.
description.it: Il suo corpo è quasi interamente composto d’acqua. Emette dei raggi misteriosi dagli occhi cristallini.
description.pt-BR: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description.ru: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description.ja: 体の　ほとんどが　水分。 水晶のような　目玉から 不思議な　ビームを　発射する。

description.fr: Ses 80 tentacules lui permettent d’emprisonner ses adversaires dans un redoutable filet venimeux.
description.en: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description.es: Cuando caza, extiende los cortos tentáculos que tiene para atrapar e inmovilizar a su presa.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kann die Tentakel bei der Jagd ausfahren, um die Beute leichter zu fangen.
description.it: I corti tentacoli si estendono durante la caccia per catturare e immobilizzare la preda.
description.pt-BR: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description.ru: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description.ja: 触手は　普段　短くて 獲物を　刺すときに 長く　伸びて　絡みつくのだ。

description.fr: Au repos, rien ne le distingue d’un vulgaire caillou. Malheur à ceux qui lui marchent dessus par mégarde!
description.en: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description.es: Aparecen en llanos y montañas. Como parecen rocas, la gente se tropieza con ellos o los pisa.
description.de: Wanderer stolpern in den Bergen häufig über dieses Pokémon, da es wie ein Stein aussieht.
description.it: Si trova nei campi e in montagna. Se confuso con una roccia, può succedere di inciamparvi.
description.pt-BR: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description.ru: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description.ja: 草原や　山に　生息する。 石ころに　似ていて　気がつかず 踏んだり　つまずいたりしてしまう。

description.fr: Il dévale les montagnes pour se déplacer. Une fois qu’il a pris tout son élan, dur dur de l’arrêter!
description.en: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description.es: De naturaleza descuidada y libre, no le importa dañarse cuando baja rodando montañas.
description.de: Es ist ihm völlig gleichgültig, wenn Stücke aus ihm herausbrechen, während es Berge hinabrollt.
description.it: Di natura libera e incurante, non si preoccupa se perde dei pezzi mentre si rotola giù dai monti.
description.pt-BR: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description.ru: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description.ja: 山から　転がり　落ちるとき 体の　あちこちが　取れても 気にしない　豪快な　性格。

description.fr: Aucun explosif ne pourrait entamer sa carapace de pierre. Il mue une fois par an.
description.en: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description.es: Se lanza montaña abajo y deja un surco desde la cima hasta el pie. Es mejor mantenerse alejado.
description.de: Sie rollen Berge hinunter und hinterlassen Spurrillen. Halte dich von diesen Rillen fern.
description.it: A furia di rotolare giù dalla cima dei monti, ha formato dei solchi. Meglio evitarli.
description.pt-BR: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description.ru: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description.ja: 山頂から　ふもとまで　続く　溝は ゴローニャが　転がり落ちる 通り道なので　要注意。

description.fr: Chancelantes à la naissance, ses pattes deviennent très vite sûres et solides à force de galoper.
description.en: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description.es: Cuando nace, apenas puede tenerse en pie. Pero va fortaleciendo las patas en cuanto empieza a galopar.
description.de: Neugeboren kann es kaum stehen. Durch das Galoppieren werden seine Beine aber schneller und kräftiger.
description.it: Alla nascita non riesce quasi a reggersi in piedi. Galoppando si rinforza e diventa più veloce.
description.pt-BR: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description.ru: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description.ja: 生まれたばかりでは　立つのがやっと。 だが　走るほどに　足腰は 鍛えられて　速度が　増していく。

description.fr: Au grand galop, sa crinière de feu disperse au vent une myriade d’étincelles ardentes.
description.en: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description.es: Muy competitivo, este Pokémon perseguirá a todo lo que se mueva rápido e intentará salir airoso.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon verfolgt schnelle Objekte in der Hoffnung, ein Wettrennen gegen sie zu gewinnen.
description.it: Pokémon molto competitivo, rincorre tutto ciò che si muove veloce, sperando di superarlo.
description.pt-BR: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description.ru: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description.ja: 速く　動く　物体を　見ると 競争したくなり　猛烈な スピードで　追いかけはじめる。

description.fr: Bien que lent, c’est un pêcheur adroit qui utilise sa queue. Elle est insensible aux morsures.
description.en: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description.es: Está siempre en su mundo, pero nadie sabe en qué piensa. Suele pescar con la cola.
description.de: Es ist stets in Gedanken versunken und niemand weiß, worüber es nachdenkt. Es kann mit seiner Rute gut angeln.
description.it: È sempre assorto, ma nessuno sa a cosa stia pensando. Si serve della coda per pescare.
description.pt-BR: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description.ru: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description.ja: いつも　ボーッとしていて　なにを 考えているか　わからない。 尻尾で　エサを　釣るのが　得意。

description.fr: Ce grand benêt connaît des éclairs de lucidité lorsque le Kokiyas de sa queue se met à mordre.
description.en: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description.es: Tiene una cola tan apetecible, que el Shellder que va enganchado a ella no se soltará por nada del mundo.
description.de: Das Muschas an seiner Rute lässt nicht locker, da ein leckerer Geschmack aus seiner Rute strömt.
description.it: Lo Shellder che gli sta attaccato non si stacca mai a causa del profumo appetitoso della coda.
description.pt-BR: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description.ru: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description.ja: くっついている　シェルダーは 尻尾から　にじみ出る　うま味が 欲しくて　ずっと　離れない。

description.fr: Plus la rotation de ses extrémités est rapide, plus la force du champ magnétique qu’il génère est grande.
description.en: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description.es: Las unidades a los lados de su cuerpo generan energía antigravitatoria para mantenerlo en el aire.
description.de: Die Magneten an seinem Körper erzeugen ein Antigravitationsfeld, um es ständig in der Schwebe zu halten.
description.it: Le unità alle due estremità del corpo producono energia antigravitazionale con cui si mantiene a mezz’aria.
description.pt-BR: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description.ru: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description.ja: 左右の　ユニットから 重力を　さえぎる　力を 出すので　空中に　浮かべる。

description.fr: Des groupes apparaissent si des taches solaires couvrent le soleil. Ils brouillent les télévisions.
description.en: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description.es: Lo constituye un grupo de Magnemite. Descarga potentes ondas magnéticas de alto voltaje.
description.de: Schließen sich mehrere Magnetilo zusammen, entsteht dieses Pokémon. Es entlädt kräftige Hochspannungsmagnetwellen.
description.it: Formato da vari Magnemite, è in grado di lanciare onde magnetiche ad alto voltaggio.
description.pt-BR: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description.ru: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description.ja: 複数の　コイルが　連結して 強力な　磁力線と 高電圧を　放射する。

description.fr: Il ne peut pas vivre sans son légume, c’est pourquoi il le protégera au péril de sa vie.
description.en: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description.es: El puerro que lleva es su mejor arma. Suele usarlo como espada para cortar cosas.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon nutzt eine Lauchstange als Waffe. Es setzt sie wie ein Schwert ein.
description.it: Il verde gambo di porro che brandisce è la sua arma, che usa come spada.
description.pt-BR: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description.ru: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description.ja: 持っている　茎は　大切な 武器でもあり　刀を　振るように いろんな　ものを　切ることができる。

description.fr: Ses deux cerveaux semblent communiquer leurs émotions grâce à un lien télépathique.
description.en: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description.es: Este Pokémon de dos cabezas es el resultado de una mutación. Cuando corre, puede alcanzar casi 100 km por hora.
description.de: Dieses zweiköpfige Pokémon gilt als plötzliche Mutation. Es rennt bis zu 100 km/h schnell.
description.it: Pokémon a due teste, scoperto a seguito di un’improvvisa mutazione. Può correre a 100 km/h.
description.pt-BR: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description.ru: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description.ja: 突然変異で　見つかった ２つの　頭を　持つ　ポケモン。 時速１００キロで　走る。

description.fr: Quand Doduo connaît cette étrange évolution, l’une de ses têtes se dédouble. Il atteint les 60 km/h.
description.en: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description.es: Más vale no perder de vista ninguna de las tres cabezas. De lo contrario, el número de picotazos será enorme.
description.de: Lässt ein Feind auch nur einen der drei Köpfe für nur eine Sekunde aus den Augen, wird er sofort gepickt.
description.it: Occorre fare attenzione a tutte le sue tre teste, altrimenti si rischia d’essere colpiti duramente.
description.pt-BR: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description.ru: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description.ja: ３つの　頭が　見ている前で わずかでも　すきを　見せると クチバシで　激しく　つつかれる。

description.fr: Un habitant des icebergs. En mer, il utilise la corne sur sa tête pour briser la banquise.
description.en: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description.es: Este Pokémon vive en icebergs. Nada en el mar y usa el cuerno de su cabeza para romper el hielo.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon lebt auf Eisbergen. Es schwimmt im Eiswasser und bricht das Eis mithilfe seines Horns.
description.it: Pokémon che vive sugli iceberg. Nuota spaccando il ghiaccio con la punta che ha sulla testa.
description.pt-BR: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description.ru: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description.ja: 氷山で　暮らす　ポケモン。 頭の　とがった　でっぱりで 氷を　割って　海を　泳ぐ。

description.fr: Son corps est couvert d’un grand manteau blanc qui, dans la neige, le dissimule aux yeux des prédateurs.
description.en: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description.es: Está recubierto de un luminoso pelaje blanco. Este Pokémon aumenta su actividad cuando bajan las temperaturas.
description.de: Sein Körper ist mit reinem, weißem Fell überzogen. Je kälter es wird, desto aktiver wird dieses Pokémon.
description.it: Ha il corpo ricoperto da una candida pelliccia bianca. Più fa freddo, più questo Pokémon è attivo.
description.pt-BR: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description.ru: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description.ja: 全身が　真っ白な　毛で 覆われている。寒さに　強く むしろ　寒いほど　元気になる。

description.fr: Il est né d’un torrent de boue exposé aux rayons X de la lune. Il vit dans les ordures.
description.en: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description.es: Nace de lodo alterado al filtrarse en el agua los rayos X reflejados por la Luna. Se alimenta de sustancias desagradables.
description.de: Schlamm, der Röntgenstrahlung vom Mond ausgesetzt war, wurde zu Sleima. Es isst am liebsten dreckige Dinge.
description.it: Grimer è nato da fango esposto ai raggi X provenienti dalla luna. Ama nutrirsi di sostanze sudicie.
description.pt-BR: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description.ru: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description.ja: 月からの　エックス線を　浴びた ヘドロが　ベトベターに　変化した。 汚いものが　大好物。

description.fr: Son corps exsude un fluide toxique qui tue instantanément les plantes et les arbres au contact.
description.en: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description.es: Les encanta reunirse en zonas apestosas donde se acumula el lodo, haciendo su olor más insoportable.
description.de: Sie treffen sich an stinkenden Orten, an denen der Schleim sich türmt. Dies merkt man am Gestank.
description.it: Amano riunirsi vicino a puzzolenti liquami di scolo, rendendo il fetore ancora più intenso.
description.pt-BR: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description.ru: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description.ja: ヘドロが　たまる　くさい　場所を 好んで　集まってくるので あたりは　いっそう　くさくなる。

description.fr: Il nage à reculons en ouvrant et en refermant ses deux coquilles. Il laisse traîner sa large langue.
description.en: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description.es: La concha lo protege de cualquier tipo de ataque. Solo es vulnerable cuando se abre.
description.de: Eine harte Schale schützt dieses Pokémon. Nur wenn es diese öffnet, wird es verwundbar.
description.it: La sua conchiglia dura respinge ogni tipo di attacco. È vulnerabile solo quando apre il guscio.
description.pt-BR: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description.ru: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description.ja: 硬い　殻は　どんな　攻撃も 跳ね返す。開いたときに 中を　攻撃されると　弱い。

description.fr: Il se défend en fermant sa coquille et projette des piquants qui repoussent ses agresseurs.
description.en: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
description.es: A los Cloyster que viven en las fuertes corrientes marinas les crecen largas y afiladas púas en la concha.
description.de: Austos, die im Meer mit starker Strömung leben, werden groß und entwickeln scharfe Stacheln.
description.it: Ai Cloyster che vivono in mari con forti maree crescono grandi aculei affilati sui gusci.
description.pt-BR: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
description.ru: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
description.ja: 潮の　流れが　激しい　海に 生息している　パルシェンの 殻の　トゲは　大きく　鋭い。

description.fr: Son corps composé de gaz toxique pourrait asphyxier n’importe qui en quelques secondes.
description.en: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description.es: Su etéreo cuerpo está hecho de gas. Puede envolver a un oponente de cualquier tamaño hasta ahogarlo.
description.de: Es hat einen gasförmigen Körper. Es kann jeden Gegner mit Giftgas einnebeln und dadurch ersticken.
description.it: Il suo corpo sottile è fatto di gas. Avvolge nemici di ogni dimensione, soffocandoli.
description.pt-BR: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description.ru: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description.ja: ガスでできた　薄い　体は どんな　大きさの　相手も 包みこみ　息の根を　止める。

description.fr: Il adore se tapir dans l’ombre et faire frissonner ses proies en leur touchant l’épaule.
description.en: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description.es: Cuando tienes la sensación de que te están observando, seguro que es porque Haunter está cerca.
description.de: Falls du im Dunkeln das Gefühl hast, beobachtet zu werden und niemand ist zu sehen, ist es bestimmt Alpollo.
description.it: Se da soli, al buio, si ha l’impressione di essere osservati da qualcuno, si tratta di Haunter.
description.pt-BR: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description.ru: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description.ja: 暗闇で　だれもいないのに 見られているような　気がしたら そこに　ゴーストが　いるのだ。

description.fr: Si vous croisez un regard inquiétant qui perce la nuit, c’est sûrement un Ectoplasma.
description.en: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description.es: Se esconde entre las sombras. Se dice que donde Gengar acecha, la temperatura baja 5 °C.
description.de: Es versteckt sich im Schatten. Man sagt, wenn sich ein Gengar versteckt, kühlt es sich um 5 °C ab.
description.it: Si nasconde nell’ombra. Pare che nei luoghi in cui Gengar si cela, la temperatura si abbassi di 5 °C.
description.pt-BR: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description.ru: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description.ja: 物陰に　姿を　隠す。 ゲンガーの　潜んでいる　部屋は 温度が　５度　下がるといわれる。

description.fr: Il se nourrit des pierres qu’il rencontre en creusant le sol. Il peut creuser à 80 km/h!
description.en: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description.es: Cava a gran velocidad en busca de comida. Los túneles que deja son usados por los Diglett.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon gräbt auf seiner Suche nach Futter lange Tunnel, in denen sich später Digda einnisten.
