description.it: Scava veloce nel terreno in cerca di cibo lasciando lunghi cunicoli usati poi come casa dai Diglett.
description.pt-BR: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description.ru: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description.ja: 地中を　ものすごい　勢いで 掘りすすみ　エサを　探す。通った 跡は　ディグダの　住処になる。

description.fr: Son grand nez lui permet de lire les rêves d’autrui. Il adore les songes amusants.
description.en: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description.es: Adormece a sus enemigos y se come sus sueños. A veces se pone enfermo si come pesadillas.
description.de: Traumato versetzt Gegner in den Schlaf und frisst deren Träume. Von Alpträumen wird ihm aber übel.
description.it: Addormenta i suoi nemici e poi si nutre dei loro sogni. A volte fa indigestione di incubi.
description.pt-BR: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description.ru: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description.ja: 眠らせては　夢を　食べるが 悪い　夢ばかり　食べてると お腹を　壊すことが　あるらしい。

description.fr: La vue de son pendule oscillant endort en trois secondes, même quand on vient de se réveiller.
description.en: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description.es: Lleva un péndulo en la mano. Una vez, hizo desaparecer a un niño al que había hipnotizado.
description.de: Es trägt ein Pendel. Man berichtet von einem Vorfall, bei dem es ein Kind mitnahm, das es zuvor hypnotisiert hatte.
description.it: Ha con sé una sorta di pendolo. Una volta, per errore, si è portato via un bambino che aveva ipnotizzato.
description.pt-BR: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description.ru: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description.ja: 振り子のようなものを　持ち歩く。 子供に　催眠術を　かけて どこかへ　連れ去る　事件があった。

description.fr: Il creuse son terrier sur des plages sablonneuses. Ses pinces repoussent si on les brise.
description.en: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description.es: Ante el peligro, se camufla con las burbujas que desprende su boca, para parecer más grande.
description.de: Wittert es Gefahr, hüllt es sich in Blasen aus seinem Maul, um größer zu erscheinen.
description.it: Se si sente in pericolo, si circonda di bolle che produce con la bocca per sembrare più grande.
description.pt-BR: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description.ru: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description.ja: 危険が　迫ると　口から　吐き出す 泡で　全身を　包んで 体を　大きく　みせようとする。

description.fr: Sa grande pince possède une puissance de 10 000 chevaux. Son poids la rend difficile à manier.
description.en: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description.es: La pinza tan grande que tiene posee una fuerza de 10 000 caballos de potencia. Pero, por su gran tamaño, cuesta moverla.
description.de: Die Kraft seiner großen und harten Schere entspricht 10 000 PS. Durch die Größe ist sie aber auch äußerst unhandlich und sperrig.
description.it: La chela più grande sprigiona una potenza di 10.000 CV. Le dimensioni gli rendono difficili gli spostamenti.
description.pt-BR: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description.ru: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description.ja: 硬い　ハサミは　１万馬力の パワーを　持っているが 大きすぎて　動きが　鈍い。

description.fr: Il ressemble à une Poké Ball. Ce Pokémon dangereux peut exploser ou s’électrifier au toucher.
description.en: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description.es: Fue descubierto cuando se crearon las Poké Balls. Se dice que tiene algo que ver con ellas.
description.de: Es wurde entdeckt, als man Pokébälle einführte. Es scheint, als gäbe es da einen Zusammenhang.
description.it: Scoperto all’epoca dell’invenzione delle Poké Ball. Si pensa che i due fatti siano correlati.
description.pt-BR: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description.ru: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description.ja: モンスターボールが　売り出されたのと 同じ　時期に　発見された。 なにか　関係があると　いわれる。

description.fr: Il se laisse porter par les vents lorsque son corps est gonflé d’électricité à en éclater.
description.en: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description.es: Explotan a la mínima. Por eso se les tiene mucho miedo. Estos Pokémon reciben el mote de Bomba Ball.
description.de: Es explodiert schon bei kleinsten Reizen. Sein Spitzname „Die Bombenkugel“ spiegelt die Furcht der Menschen wider.
description.it: Può esplodere anche alla minima provocazione. Lo chiamano “Bomba Ball”.
description.pt-BR: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description.ru: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description.ja: 少しの　刺激に　反応して 爆発する。バクダンボールという あだ名で　怖がられている。

description.fr: Ces six œufs communiquent par télépathie. Ils peuvent se réunir rapidement si on les sépare.
description.en: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
description.es: Estos seis huevos se comunican por telepatía. Si se separan, se pueden reunir rápidamente.
description.de: Die sechs Eier kommunizieren telepathisch. Werden sie getrennt, finden sie sich schnell wieder.
description.it: Queste sei uova comunicano per telepatia. Si riuniscono subito anche se vengono divise.
description.pt-BR: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
description.ru: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
description.ja: テレパシーで　会話をしているため タマタマを　引き離そうとしても すぐに　集まって　６匹になる。

description.fr: On l’appelle “jungle sur pattes”. Si une tête devient trop grosse, elle tombe et produit un Noeunoeuf.
description.en: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
description.es: Sus tres cabezas piensan de forma independiente. Sin embargo, son amigas y no suelen discutir nunca.
description.de: Seine drei Köpfe denken unabhängig voneinander. Dennoch sind sie nett zueinander und streiten nie.
description.it: Ha tre teste che ragionano autonomamente. Ma sono amichevoli e non litigano mai tra di loro.
description.pt-BR: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
description.ru: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
description.ja: ３つの　頭は　考えることは 別々でも　仲良しなので ケンカしたり　しないらしい。

description.fr: Il pleure en pensant à sa mère disparue, et ses larmes résonnent dans son crâne creux.
description.en: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description.es: Lleva puesto el cráneo de su madre. Cuando se siente solo se pone a gritar muy fuerte.
description.de: Es trägt den Schädel seiner verstorbenen Mutter auf seinem Kopf. Fühlt es sich einsam, soll es laut weinen.
description.it: Indossa il teschio della madre morta come un casco. Quando si sente solo lancia urla strazianti.
description.pt-BR: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description.ru: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description.ja: 死に別れた　母親の　骨を 頭に　覆っている。寂しいとき 大声で　泣くという。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon sauvage possède des os depuis sa naissance. Il s’en sert pour combattre avec dextérité.
description.en: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description.es: Es pequeño y siempre ha sido muy débil. Cuando empezó a usar huesos, se volvió más violento.
description.de: Es ist klein und war ursprünglich sehr schwach. Erst als es anfing Knochen einzusetzen, wurde es wild.
description.it: Di piccole dimensioni, un tempo era del tutto innocuo. È diventato più aggressivo brandendo un osso come arma.
description.pt-BR: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description.ru: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description.ja: 体も　小さく　もともと　弱かった。 骨を　使うようになり 性格が　凶暴化した。

description.fr: Ses pattes élastiques s’allongent, ce qui ne manque jamais de surprendre au premier combat.
description.en: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description.es: Encoge y estira las patas a su antojo. Cuando las estira, es capaz de propinar una buena patada al enemigo.
description.de: Die Beine ziehen und strecken sich unabhängig voneinander. Mit seinen dehnbaren Beinen kann es einen entfernten Gegner treffen.
description.it: Le zampe gli si accorciano e allungano a piacere. Con le gambe allungate, con un calcio può colpire anche nemici distanti.
description.pt-BR: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description.ru: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description.ja: 脚が　自由に　伸び縮みして 遠く　離れている　場合でも 相手を　蹴り上げることができる。

description.fr: Même le béton cède sous ses poings dévastateurs. Au combat, il s’essouffle au bout de 3 minutes.
description.en: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
description.es: Los potentes golpes de sus brazos pueden pulverizar el hormigón. Descansa tras luchar tres minutos.
description.de: Die Schläge, die es austeilt, können Beton pulverisieren. Es muss sich im Kampf alle drei Minuten ausruhen.
description.it: Sferra pugni così potenti da polverizzare persino il cemento. Si riposa dopo 3 minuti di lotta.
description.pt-BR: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
description.ru: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
description.ja: 腕を　ねじりながら　繰り出す パンチは　コンクリートも　粉砕。 ３分　戦うと　ひとやすみする。

description.fr: Quand il déploie sa langue de près de deux mètres, sa queue s’agite. Elles seraient reliées entre elles.
description.en: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
description.es: Su larga lengua, recubierta de saliva pegajosa, se pega a todo, por lo que es muy útil.
description.de: Seine Zunge ist mit klebrigem Speichel bedeckt, der überall haftet. Dies ist sehr nützlich.
description.it: La lunga lingua intrisa di saliva appiccicosa si attacca agli oggetti e può diventare molto utile.
description.pt-BR: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
description.ru: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
description.ja: 長い　舌は　ねばねばした だえきで　べっとり。どんなものでも くっついて　とても　便利。

description.fr: Il flotte en retenant des gaz plus légers que l’air. Ceux-ci sont explosifs, en plus d’être fétides.
description.en: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
description.es: Tiene forma de globo y es muy ligero. Está compuesto por gases tóxicos y apesta.
description.de: Sein dünner, ballonartiger Körper ist mit schrecklichem Giftgas gefüllt. Es verbreitet einen heftigen Gestank, wenn es in der Nähe ist.
description.it: Il suo corpo fatto a pallone è pieno di orribili sostanze gassose, che emanano un puzzo disgustoso.
description.pt-BR: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
description.ru: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
description.ja: 薄い　バルーン状の　体に 猛毒の　ガスが　つまっている。 近くに　来ると　くさい。

description.fr: Il grandit en absorbant les gaz des détritus. Des triplés existent, bien qu’ils soient fort rares.
description.en: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
description.es: Si uno de los gemelos Koffing se infla, el otro se desinfla. Mezclan constantemente sus venenosos gases.
description.de: Pumpt sich eines der zwei Smogon auf, lässt das andere Luft ab. So findet ein Giftgasaustausch statt.
description.it: Se un gemello Koffing si sgonfia, l’altro si gonfia. I gas velenosi dei due si mischiano continuamente.
description.pt-BR: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
description.ru: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
description.ja: どちらかが　ふくらむと　片方は しぼむ　双子の　ドガース。いつも 体内の　毒ガスを　混ぜている。

description.fr: Ses puissantes charges pourraient démolir n’importe quel bâtiment. Dommage qu’il soit stupide.
description.en: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description.es: Es muy fuerte, pero no especialmente listo. Es capaz de derribar rascacielos usando Placaje varias veces.
description.de: Stark, aber nicht allzu klug, kann dieses Pokémon sogar Hochhäuser mit seinem Tackle-Angriff zum Einsturz bringen.
description.it: Potente, benché non particolarmente brillante, con Azione può distruggere anche un grattacielo.
description.pt-BR: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description.ru: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description.ja: 頭は　悪いが　力が　強く 高層ビルも　体当たりで コナゴナに　粉砕する。

description.fr: La station debout a libéré ses pattes avant et l’a rendu plus intelligent, mais il est distrait.
description.en: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
description.es: La piel le sirve de escudo protector. Puede vivir en lava líquida a 2000 °C de temperatura.
description.de: Durch seine panzerähnliche Körperhülle kann es in bis zu 2 000 °C heißer Lava leben.
description.it: Protetto da una pelle-armatura, può vivere nella lava liquida a 2000 °C.
description.pt-BR: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
description.ru: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
description.ja: 全身を　よろいのような　皮膚で 守っている。２０００度の マグマの　中でも　生きられる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon très serviable distribue ses œufs hautement nutritifs aux humains et Pokémon blessés.
description.en: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
description.es: Se dice que reparte felicidad. Se caracteriza por su compasión y reparte sus huevos entre la gente herida.
description.de: Man sagt, es bringe Glück. Es ist sehr mitfühlend und teilt seine Eier mit Verletzten.
description.it: Si dice che porti felicità. È molto altruista e condivide le uova con chi è ferito.
description.pt-BR: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
description.ru: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
description.ja: 幸せを　運ぶと　いわれている。 傷ついた　人に　タマゴを 分けてあげる　優しい　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il se cache derrière des lianes bleues recouvertes d’un fin duvet. Il est chatouilleux.
description.en: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
description.es: Se camufla con la multitud de lianas que envuelven su cuerpo y que no dejan de crecer a lo largo de toda su vida.
description.de: Aufgrund der Ranken, die seinen Körper bedecken, kennt keiner seine wahre Form. Die blauen Ranken wachsen immer weiter.
description.it: Una moltitudine di liane brulicanti, in crescita perenne, ne ricopre il corpo celandone la vera forma.
description.pt-BR: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
description.ru: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
description.ja: たくさんの　うごめく　ツルに 覆われて　正体不明。 青いツルは　一生　伸びる。

description.fr: Il élève ses petits dans sa poche ventrale. Il attend d’être en lieu sûr pour les laisser jouer dehors.
description.en: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
description.es: Lleva a su cría en la bolsa de su panza. Solo deja que su cría salga a jugar cuando no siente peligro.
description.de: Sein Nachwuchs wächst in seinem Beutel heran. Nur wenn es sicher ist, darf das Junge aus dem Beutel.
description.it: Tiene il cucciolo nel marsupio che ha sulla pancia e lo lascia uscire solo quando non ci sono pericoli.
description.pt-BR: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
description.ru: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
description.ja: お腹の　袋で　子育てをする。 安全な　ときだけ　子供を 袋から　出して　遊ばせる。

description.fr: Il niche à l’ombre du corail. Quand il se sent menacé, il disparaît dans un nuage d’encre opaque.
description.en: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description.es: Es famoso por derribar a bichos voladores lanzando tinta desde la superficie del agua.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon schießt mit Tinte auf über der Wasseroberfläche fliegende Insekten.
description.it: È noto per i suoi attacchi ai volatili con getti d’inchiostro dalla superficie dell’acqua.
description.pt-BR: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description.ru: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
description.ja: 水面から　勢いよく　墨を　発射して 飛んでいる　虫を 撃ち落とすことがあるという。

description.fr: Son épine dorsale le protège. Ses os et ses nageoires sont très prisés en médecine traditionnelle.
description.en: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
description.es: Las afiladas púas que le recubren el cuerpo se le erizan y pueden causar el debilitamiento con solo tocarlo.
description.de: Sein Körper ist mit scharfen Stacheln gespickt. Wenn man sorglos ist und es berührt, kann man durch die Stacheln bewusstlos werden.
description.it: Ha il corpo ispido di aculei pungenti. Un contatto fortuito può causare uno svenimento.
description.pt-BR: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
description.ru: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
description.ja: うかつに　触ろうとすると 体中に　生える　トゲに　刺されて 気絶することもある。

description.fr: Malgré son élégance quand il nage, ses coups de corne sont redoutables.
description.en: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
description.es: Nada a una velocidad de cinco nudos. Si siente peligro, golpea con su afilado cuerno.
description.de: Es schwimmt mit fünf Knoten. Wird es angegriffen, wehrt es sich mit seinem scharfen Horn.
description.it: Nuota alla velocità di 5 nodi. Se avverte il pericolo, contrattacca con il suo corno aguzzo.
description.pt-BR: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
description.ru: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
description.ja: ５ノットの　スピードで　泳ぐ。 身の　危険を　感じると 鋭い　ツノで　反撃する。

description.fr: En automne, à la saison des amours, il fait des réserves de graisse et arbore des couleurs chatoyantes.
description.en: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.
description.es: En otoño, cuando se reproducen, se les puede ver nadando con energía por ríos y arroyos.
description.de: Im Herbst, zur Paarungszeit, sieht man diese Pokémon kraftvoll Bäche und Flüsse hinaufschwimmen.
description.it: In autunno, quando si riproduce, può essere visto risalire impetuoso fiumi e torrenti.
description.pt-BR: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.
description.ru: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.
description.ja: 秋が　くると　産卵のために 流れに　逆らって　力強く 川を　泳ぐ　姿が　みられる。

description.fr: Même amoché, son corps se régénère tant que le noyau rouge est intact. Le noyau s’illumine à minuit.
description.en: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
description.es: Aunque sus brazos se rompan podrán regenerarse, siempre y cuando su núcleo siga intacto.
description.de: Auch wenn sein Körper nicht mehr intakt ist, kann es sich regenerieren, wenn der Kern leuchtet.
description.it: Anche se il corpo è lacerato, continua a rigenerarsi finché il nucleo ardente centrale rimane intatto.
description.pt-BR: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
description.ru: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
description.ja: 体の　中心で　光る コアが　ある限り 体が　ちぎれても　再生できる。

description.fr: Un noyau rouge trône en son centre. Il envoie des signaux radio mystérieux vers le ciel nocturne.
description.en: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
description.es: Su núcleo central brilla con los colores del arcoíris. Para algunos tiene el valor de una gema.
description.de: Der Kern dieses Pokémon leuchtet in den Farben des Regenbogens. Sein Kern gilt als Edelstein.
description.it: Nel suo nucleo brillano i sette colori dell’arcobaleno. Qualcuno lo considera una pietra preziosa.
description.pt-BR: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
description.ru: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
description.ja: 真ん中の　コアと呼ばれる　部分は 七色に　輝く。これを 宝石にする　人も　いるという。

description.fr: En modifiant les molécules de l’air du bout de ses doigts, il parvient à créer un mur invisible devant lui.
description.en: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
description.es: Para repeler ataques, solidifica el aire y crea muros invisibles con emanaciones de sus dedos.
description.de: Seine Fingerspitzen sondern etwas ab, das die Luft zu einer schützenden Wand werden lässt.
description.it: Con le dita solidifica l’aria e crea pareti invisibili che respingono gli attacchi più violenti.
description.pt-BR: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
description.ru: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
description.ja: 指先から　出す　波動が 空気を　固めて　壁を　作る。 激しい　攻撃も　跳ね返す。

description.fr: À force de trancher des objets solides, les faux de ses bras sont très aiguisées.
description.en: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
description.es: Destroza a su presa con las guadañas que tiene. No es común que use las alas para volar.
description.de: Es zerreißt und zerkleinert seine Beute mit seinen unglaublich scharfen Sicheln. Selten breitet es seine Flügel aus, um zu fliegen.
description.it: Fa a pezzi le prede con gli artigli spaventosamente affilati. Solo raramente spiega le ali per alzarsi in volo.
description.pt-BR: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
description.ru: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
description.ja: 鋭い　カマで　獲物を　切り裂き 息の根を　止める。ごくまれに 羽を　使って　飛ぶ。

description.fr: Son cri ressemble à des paroles humaines. Mais nul n’est jamais parvenu à les comprendre.
description.en: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
description.es: Camina moviendo las caderas de forma llamativa. Puede hacer que la gente baile a su ritmo.
description.de: Der beschwingte Gang dieses Pokémon bezaubert Zuschauer und lässt sie im Takt dazu tanzen.
description.it: Camminando ancheggia in modo seducente. La gente può essere indotta a seguire la sua danza.
description.pt-BR: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
description.ru: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
description.ja: 腰を　振るように　歩いている。 油断をすると　思わず　釣られて 踊ってしまうという。

description.fr: Il fait tournoyer ses bras pour donner de la force à ses coups. Profitez-en pour filer!
description.en: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
description.es: Por la superficie de su piel corre la electricidad. En la oscuridad, su cuerpo se torna blanquecino.
description.de: Elektrizität bedeckt seinen Körper. Im Dunkeln erstrahlt es in einem bläulichen Ton.
description.it: La corrente elettrica attraversa la superficie del suo corpo che al buio riluce di un blu perlato.
description.pt-BR: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
description.ru: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
description.ja: 体の　表面には　電気が 流れている。あたりが　暗いと 全身が　青白く　光るのだ。

description.fr: Quand il respire profondément, des vagues de chaleur émanent de son corps et le rendent difficile à voir.
description.en: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
description.es: A este Pokémon se lo encontraron cerca de un volcán. Esta criatura ígnea tiene una temperatura corporal de unos 1200 °C.
description.de: Es wurde in der Nähe eines Vulkans gefunden. Die Körpertemperatur dieses Feuerspuckers liegt bei fast 1 200 °C.
description.it: È stato trovato presso il cratere di un vulcano. La sua temperatura corporea si aggira sui 1200 °C.
description.pt-BR: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
description.ru: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
description.ja: 火山の　火口近くで　見つかった。 口から　炎を　吐く。 体温は　１２００度もある。

description.fr: Il serre les proies dans ses pinces pour les trancher en deux. S’il n’y arrive pas, il les jette au loin.
description.en: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
description.es: Atrapa presas con sus pinzas hasta que las parte en dos. Lanza lejos lo que no puede quebrar.
description.de: Es hält seine Beute mit seiner Zange fest und teilt sie dann. Was es nicht teilen kann, wirft es fort.
description.it: Afferra la preda con le pinze e non la molla finché non l’ha tranciata. Se non ci riesce, la scaglia via.
description.pt-BR: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
description.ru: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
description.ja: ２本の　ツノで　獲物を　挟んで ちぎれるまで　放さない。ちぎれない ときは　かなたまで　投げ飛ばすのだ。

description.fr: Après avoir choisi sa cible, il fonce dessus tête baissée. Il est réputé pour sa nature violente.
description.en: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
description.es: Después de animarse a luchar fustigándose con sus tres colas, carga a toda velocidad.
description.de: Es kämpft mit vollem Einsatz, nachdem es sich mit seinen drei Schweifen auspeitschte, um sich anzustacheln.
description.it: Prima si frusta con le tre code per caricarsi, poi parte all’attacco a tutta velocità.
description.pt-BR: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
description.ru: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
description.ja: ３本の　尻尾で　自分を　たたき 戦う　気持ちを　高めると 全速力で　突っこんでくる。

description.fr: Un vénérable Magicarpe peut franchir une montagne en utilisant Trempette. Mais c’est tout...
description.en: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description.es: No es precisamente rápido ni fuerte. Es el Pokémon más debilucho y simplón de todos los que hay.
description.de: Es ist nutzlos, was Kraft und Geschwindigkeit angeht. Dieses ist das schwächste und erbärmlichste Pokémon der Welt.
description.it: La sua forza e velocità sono praticamente nulle. Si può tranquillamente definire il più debole e patetico Pokémon del mondo.
description.pt-BR: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description.ru: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
description.ja: 力も　スピードも　ほとんど　ダメ。 世界で　一番　弱くて 情けない　ポケモンだ。

description.fr: Quand il se laisse emporter par la rage, il ne se calme qu’après avoir détruit tout ce qui l’entoure.
description.en: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
description.es: En la literatura antigua se dice que un Gyarados rebosante de violencia arrasó un poblado.
description.de: In alten Schriften wird von einem Garados berichtet, das in einem Wutanfall ein Dorf zerstörte.
description.it: Un antico documento riporta che Gyarados rase al suolo un villaggio in cui dilagava la violenza.
description.pt-BR: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
description.ru: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
description.ja: 争いの　起こった　村を 焼きつくしたという　記録が 古文書に　残されている。

description.fr: Il aime naviguer en portant des humains et des Pokémon sur son dos. Il comprend le langage humain.
description.en: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description.es: Son buenos de corazón. Muchos fueron capturados por ser tan pacíficos. Ahora hay muchos menos.
description.de: Sie sind gutmütig. Da sie selten kämpfen, wurden sie oft gefangen. Ihre Anzahl ist stark reduziert.
description.it: Sono buoni d’animo e lottano di rado, così molti di loro sono facili prede: sono stati decimati.
description.pt-BR: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description.ru: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description.ja: 優しい　心の　持ち主。 めったに　争わないため　たくさん 捕まえられ　数が　減った。

description.fr: Il a la capacité de modifier sa structure cellulaire pour prendre l’apparence de ce qu’il voit.
description.en: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description.es: Puede alterar por completo su estructura celular para emular cualquier objeto que vea.
description.de: Es kann seine Zellstruktur so verändern, dass es sich in alles verwandeln kann, was es sieht.
description.it: Ha la capacità di modificare la sua struttura cellulare per trasformarsi in qualsiasi cosa veda.
description.pt-BR: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description.ru: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description.ja: 全身の　細胞を　組み替えて 見たものの　形　そっくりに 変身する　能力を　持つ。

description.fr: Son ADN particulier lui permet de s’adapter très rapidement à son environnement.
description.en: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description.es: Un extraño Pokémon que se adapta a los entornos más hostiles gracias a sus diferentes evoluciones.
description.de: Ein seltenes Pokémon, das sich seiner Umgebung anpasst, indem es sich in unterschiedliche Formen entwickelt.
description.it: Un Pokémon raro che si adatta agli ambienti più difficili assumendo diverse forme nell’evoluzione.
description.pt-BR: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description.ru: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description.ja: 進化のとき　姿と　能力が 変わることで　きびしい　環境に 対応する　珍しい　ポケモン。

description.fr: Sa composition moléculaire est proche de celle de l’eau, ce qui lui permet de se liquéfier.
description.en: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description.es: Prefiere las bellas costas. Con células parecidas al agua, podría fundirse en la misma.
description.de: Es liebt schöne Ufer. Da seine Zellstruktur Wassermolekülen ähnlich ist, kann es mit Wasser verschmelzen.
description.it: Preferisce stare sulla costa. In acqua le sue cellule simili a molecole acquee si possono scomporre.
description.pt-BR: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description.ru: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description.ja: きれいな　水辺を　好んでいる。 細胞が　水の　分子に　似ており 水に　溶けることもできる。

description.fr: Face au danger, il fait appel à l’électricité pour dresser ses poils et lancer des décharges.
description.en: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description.es: Todos los pelos de su cuerpo se ponen de punta si empieza a cargarse de electricidad.
description.de: Lädt es sich mit Elektrizität auf, steht jedes einzelne seiner Körperhaare steil nach oben.
description.it: Quando inizia a caricarsi di elettricità, gli si rizza ogni pelo del corpo.
description.pt-BR: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description.ru: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description.ja: 体内に　電気が　たまると 全身の　体毛が　全部 鋭く　とがりはじめる。

description.fr: L’air qu’il inspire est chauffé par la glande enflammée de son corps, atteignant les 1 700 °C.
description.en: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description.es: Almacena llamas en su cuerpo, que alcanza una temperatura de 900 °C antes de un combate.
description.de: In seinem Körper befindet sich eine Flamme. Seine Körpertemperatur liegt vor dem Kampf bei 900 °C.
description.it: Nel corpo conserva una tasca ardente. Prima di lottare, la sua temperatura si innalza a 900 °C.
description.pt-BR: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description.ru: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description.ja: 体内に　炎袋を　持つ。 戦いが　はじまる　直前には 体温が　９００度まで　上がる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon créé par des scientifiques peut arpenter librement le cyberespace.
description.en: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description.es: Pokémon creado por el hombre tras muchas investigaciones. Sus habilidades son básicas.
description.de: Ein künstlich produziertes Pokémon, welches das Ergebnis von Forschungen ist. Es ist simpel aufgebaut.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è il risultato di una ricerca umana. Esegue solo i movimenti più elementari.
description.pt-BR: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description.ru: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description.ja: 研究の末　生み出された 人工の　ポケモン。基本的な 動作しか　プログラムされていない。

description.fr: Un Pokémon ramené à la vie par la science à partir d’un fossile. Il peuplait autrefois les mers.
description.en: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description.es: Pokémon prehistórico que vivió en el océano primordial. Para nadar se valía de sus 10 tentáculos.
description.de: Ein prähistorisches Pokémon, das zur Urzeit im Wasser lebte. Es schwimmt, indem es seine zehn Tentakel bewegt.
description.it: Pokémon preistorico, che viveva nel mare primordiale. Nuota facendo oscillare i suoi dieci tentacoli.
description.pt-BR: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description.ru: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description.ja: 大昔　海に　住んでいた 古代ポケモン。１０本の　脚を くねらせて　泳ぐ。

description.fr: On pense que ce Pokémon a disparu parce que sa coquille en spirale était devenue trop grosse.
description.en: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description.es: Tiene los tentáculos tan desarrollados que le sirven de manos y pies. Con ellos atrapa a su presa y le da un bocado.
description.de: Seine Tentakel sind hoch entwickelt und es setzt sie ähnlich Händen und Füßen ein. Sobald es Beute ergriffen hat, beißt es zu.
description.it: Ha tentacoli molto sviluppati, paragonabili ad arti umani. Appena irretisce la preda, la morde.
description.pt-BR: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description.ru: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description.ja: 触手が　手足のように 発達している。しがみつくと 同時に　かみついてくる。

description.fr: On pense qu’il peuplait les plages il y a 300 millions d’années. Il est protégé par une coquille robuste.
description.en: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description.es: Se cree que habitó las playas hace 300 millones de años. Se protege con una dura concha.
description.de: Man geht davon aus, dass dieses Pokémon vor 300 Millionen Jahren die Strände bevölkerte.
description.it: Si ritiene che vivesse sulle spiagge 300 milioni di anni fa. È protetto da una conchiglia robusta.
description.pt-BR: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description.ru: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description.ja: ３億年前の　砂浜で 暮らしていたと　考えられている。 硬い　殻が　身を　守る。

description.fr: On pense que ce Pokémon est venu sur la terre ferme pour suivre l’évolution de ses proies.
description.en: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description.es: Repliega sus extremidades en el agua para hacerse más compacto, y mueve su concha para nadar rápido.
description.de: Im Wasser zieht es seine Beine an und bewegt seinen Panzer, um so schneller schwimmen zu können.
description.it: In acqua raccoglie gli arti per diventare più compatto, agitando il guscio per nuotare veloce.
description.pt-BR: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description.ru: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description.ja: 水中を　移動するとき 手足を　小さく　折りたたみ 甲羅を　くねらせ　速く　泳ぐ。

description.fr: Un Pokémon qui arpentait le ciel au temps des dinosaures. Ses crocs sont pareils à des scies.
description.en: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description.es: Se regeneró a partir de material genético de un dinosaurio encontrado en ámbar. Cuando vuela emite escandalosos alaridos.
description.de: In Bernstein eingeschlossenes genetisches Material eines Dinosauriers war der Ursprung dieses Pokémon. Beim Fliegen schreit es schrill.
description.it: Rigenerato dal materiale organico di un dinosauro ritrovato nell’ambra. Emette versi acuti mentre vola.
description.pt-BR: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description.ru: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description.ja: こはくに　残された　恐竜の 遺伝子から　復活させた。 高い　声で　鳴きながら　飛ぶ。

description.fr: Une fois le ventre plein, il est trop amorphe pour lever le petit doigt. Sautez sur son ventre!
description.en: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description.es: No se encuentra satisfecho hasta que no se come 400 kg de comida cada día. Cuando acaba de comer, se queda dormido.
description.de: Es ist erst satt, wenn es über 400 kg Nahrung am Tag gefressen hat. Ist es mit dem Essen fertig, schläft es sofort ein.
description.it: Dopo aver trangugiato i suoi immancabili 400 kg di cibo quotidiani, cade in un sonno profondo.
description.pt-BR: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description.ru: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description.ja: １日に　食べ物を　４００キロ 食べないと　気がすまない。 食べ終わると　眠ってしまう。

description.fr: Un Pokémon Oiseau légendaire. Il peut provoquer des blizzards en gelant l’humidité de l’air.
description.en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description.es: Legendario Pokémon pájaro capaz de generar ventiscas congelando la humedad del aire.
description.de: Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon. Es kann Blizzards verursachen, indem es Feuchtigkeit gefriert.
description.it: Un Pokémon uccello leggendario. Riesce a creare bufere di neve congelando l’umidità dell’aria.
description.pt-BR: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description.ru: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description.ja: 伝説の　とりポケモン。 空気中の　水分を　凍らせ 吹雪を　作り出すことが　できる。

description.fr: Un Pokémon Oiseau légendaire dont on dit qu’il vit dans les nuages d’orage. Il contrôle la foudre.
description.en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description.es: Es un legendario pájaro Pokémon. Dicen que aparece entre las nubes lanzando enormes rayos brillantes.
description.de: Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon, das im Sturzflug aus den Wolken bricht und Blitze schleudert.
description.it: Uccello leggendario, si dice appaia tra le nuvole scagliando enormi saette.
description.pt-BR: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description.ru: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description.ja: 雲の　上から　巨大な　稲妻を 落としながら　現れる 伝説の　とりポケモンである。

description.fr: L’un des Pokémon Oiseaux légendaires. On dit que sa venue annonce l’arrivée du printemps.
description.en: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description.es: Es más conocido como el legendario pájaro de fuego. Con cada aleteo crea brillantes llamas.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist der Legendäre Feuervogel. Sein Flügelschlag entfacht ein helles Feuermeer.
description.it: Noto come uccello leggendario del fuoco, quando sbatte le ali crea scintillanti lingue infuocate.
description.pt-BR: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description.ru: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description.ja: 昔から　火の鳥伝説として 知られる。羽ばたくたびに　羽が 明るく　燃え上がり　美しい。

description.fr: On l’appelle “Pokémon mirage” en raison de sa rareté. On a découvert sa mue.
description.en: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description.es: Se le llama el Pokémon Espejismo porque son muy pocos los que lo han visto. Se encontró su muda.
description.de: Man nennt es „Illusion-Pokémon“, denn nur wenige haben es gesehen. Nur seine Haut wurde oft gefunden.
description.it: Detto “Pokémon miraggio” perché è stato avvistato da pochi. È facile trovare la sua pelle della muta.
description.pt-BR: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description.ru: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description.ja: 目撃者が　少ないために 幻のポケモンと　呼ばれていた。 脱皮した　皮が　見つかっている。

description.fr: La météo change brusquement quand il est entouré d’une aura. On dit qu’il peuple les mers et les lacs.
description.en: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description.es: Sus cristalinos orbes parecen darle al Pokémon el poder de controlar el clima libremente.
description.de: Die kristallenen Bälle an seinem Schweif ermöglichen es ihm, das Wetter zu beeinflussen.
description.it: Pare che le sfere di cristallo diano a questo Pokémon il pieno controllo sulle condizioni atmosferiche.
description.pt-BR: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description.ru: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description.ja: 水晶のような　玉には 天候を　自由に　操る 能力が　秘められているらしい。

description.fr: On raconte qu’il vit quelque part en mer. Il guide les équipages naufragés jusqu’à la terre ferme.
description.en: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description.es: A pesar del tamaño que tiene y de lo pesado que es, puede volar. Es capaz de dar la vuelta al mundo en solo 16 horas.
description.de: Trotz seines wuchtigen und massiven Körpers kann es fliegen. Es umrundet den Erdball in nur 16 Stunden.
description.it: Nonostante la stazza, è in grado di volare. Può compiere il giro del mondo in 16 ore.
description.pt-BR: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description.ru: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description.ja: 大きな　体格で　空を　飛ぶ。 地球を　約１６時間で １周してしまう。

description.fr: Un Pokémon conçu en réorganisant les gènes de Mew. On raconte qu’il s’agit du Pokémon le plus féroce.
description.en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description.es: Fue creado por un científico tras años de horribles experimentos de ingeniería genética.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist das Resultat eines jahrelangen und skrupellosen Experimentes.
description.it: Creato da uno scienziato dopo anni di orribili esperimenti di ingegneria genetica.
description.pt-BR: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description.ru: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description.ja: １人の　科学者が　何年も 恐ろしい　遺伝子　研究を 続けた　結果　誕生した。

description.fr: Nombre de scientifiques voient en lui l’ancêtre des Pokémon car il maîtrise toutes leurs capacités.
description.en: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description.es: Varios científicos lo consideran el antecesor de los Pokémon porque usa todo tipo de movimientos.
description.de: Es beherrscht alle möglichen Attacken, daher sieht man in ihm den Vorfahren aller Pokémon.
description.it: Poiché sa usare qualsiasi mossa, molti scienziati ritengono che Mew sia l’antenato di tutti i Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description.ru: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description.ja: あらゆる　技を　使うため ポケモンの　先祖と　考える 学者が　たくさん　いる。

description.fr: Il jauge la température et l’humidité grâce à la feuille sur sa tête. Il raffole des bains de soleil.
description.en: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
description.es: Un dulce aroma se desprende de la hoja de su cabeza. Es dócil y le encanta absorber los rayos de sol.
description.de: Ein süßer Duft geht von dem Blatt auf seinem Kopf aus. Es ist ruhig und liegt gerne in der Sonne.
description.it: Un dolce profumo si diffonde dalla sua testa. È docile e ama scaldarsi al sole.
description.pt-BR: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
description.ru: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
description.ja: 頭の　葉っぱから　ほのかに　甘い 香りが　漂う。おとなしくて 日差しを　浴びるのが　大好き。

description.fr: Le collier de bourgeons à son cou répand un arôme épicé qui vous donne du tonus.
description.en: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
description.es: Emana un aroma picante de su cuello. El aroma actúa como estimulante para recuperar salud.
description.de: Ein würziges Aroma geht von seinen Blättern aus. Das Aroma soll gesundheitsfördernd sein.
description.it: Dal suo collo si propaga un profumo vivace. Esso stimola il recupero della salute.
description.pt-BR: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
description.ru: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
description.ja: 首の　まわりから　発散する スパイスのような　香りには 元気を　出させる　効果がある。

description.fr: Son souffle a l’incroyable capacité de ranimer les plantes et les fleurs flétries.
description.en: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description.es: El olor que desprenden sus pétalos contiene una sustancia que calma el instinto agresivo.
description.de: Das Aroma aus seiner Blüte enthält Stoffe, die jegliche Aggressivität schwinden lassen.
description.it: L’aroma che si spande dai suoi petali contiene una sostanza che placa gli istinti aggressivi.
description.pt-BR: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description.ru: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
description.ja: 花びらから　発散される　においには 争う　気持ちを　静める 成分が　含まれる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est un grand timide. Les flammes sur son dos s’intensifient lorsqu’il prend peur.
description.en: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description.es: Es tímido y siempre se enrosca como una pelota. Si es atacado, enciende su lomo para protegerse.
description.de: Es ist ruhig und kugelt sich stets zusammen. Zum Schutz entflammt es seinen Rücken.
description.it: Spesso se ne sta appallottolato giacché timido. Se è attaccato, si difende infuocando il dorso.
description.pt-BR: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description.ru: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
description.ja: 臆病で　いつも　体を　まるめている。 襲われると　背中の　炎を 燃え上がらせて　身を守る。

description.fr: La chaleur de ses flammes intimide l’ennemi. Elles s’intensifient lorsqu’il se prépare à combattre.
description.en: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
description.es: Antes de empezar a luchar, se gira ante su rival para alardear del alcance y la fuerza de sus llamas.
description.de: Vor dem Kampf dreht es dem Feind den Rücken zu, um ihm zu zeigen, wie Furcht erregend sein Feuer lodert.
description.it: Prima di lottare mostra il dorso al nemico per impressionarlo con la potenza delle sue fiamme.
description.pt-BR: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
description.ru: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
description.ja: 戦いの前　背中を　向けて 自分の　炎が　どれくらい すごいかを　相手に　見せつける。

description.fr: Il attaque en projetant des flammes. Il se dissimule derrière les vagues de chaleur qu’il produit.
description.en: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description.es: Si su furia crece, se calienta tanto que cualquier cosa que toque se prenderá al instante.
description.de: Wenn sein Zorn den Zenit übersteigt, wird es so heiß, dass alles, was es berührt, in Flammen aufgeht.
description.it: Quando è davvero arrabbiato diventa così caldo che qualsiasi cosa tocchi va subito a fuoco.
description.pt-BR: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description.ru: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
description.ja: 怒りが　最高潮のとき 触ったもの　すべて　一瞬で 燃え上がらせるほどに　熱い。

description.fr: Il broie tout ce qu’il trouve avec ses mâchoires puissantes. Même son Dresseur doit s’en méfier.
description.en: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
description.es: Es pequeño pero violento. No dudará en morder cualquier cosa que se mueva cerca.
description.de: Es ist klein, aber zäh und stark. Es zögert nicht, jeden anzugreifen, wenn dieser ihm zu nahe kommt.
description.it: Piccolo, ma forte e deciso. Non esita ad avventarsi su qualsiasi cosa si muova.
description.pt-BR: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
description.ru: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
description.ja: 小さいながらも　暴れん坊。 目の前で　動くものが　あれば とにかく　かみついてくる。

description.fr: Quand il mord, il ne lâche pas prise avant que ses crocs se brisent. Ils repoussent par la suite.
description.en: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description.es: Si pierde un colmillo, le crecerá otro en su lugar. Siempre tiene 48 colmillos en su boca.
description.de: Verliert es einen seiner Zähne, wächst ein neuer nach. Es hat immer 48 Zähne in seinem Kiefer.
description.it: Se perde un dente gliene ricresce un altro. La sua bocca contiene sempre 48 denti.
description.pt-BR: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description.ru: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
description.ja: キバは　抜けても　次から　次に 生えてくる。いつも　口の中には ４８本の　キバが　そろっている。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon à l’air pataud est capable d’attaquer à la vitesse de l’éclair pour mordre sa proie.
description.en: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
description.es: Se suele mover lento, pero alcanza velocidades de vértigo al atacar y morder a sus enemigos.
description.de: Eigentlich bewegt es sich langsam, doch seine Beute greift es blitzschnell an.
description.it: Di solito si muove lentamente, ma quando attacca e morde la preda si muove a una velocità incredibile.
description.pt-BR: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
description.ru: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
description.ja: 普段は　ゆっくりとした　動きだが 獲物に　かみつくときは 目にも　止まらない　スピードだ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon très nerveux prend appui sur sa queue pour observer ses alentours.
description.en: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
description.es: Cuando hace de centinela, avisa del peligro a los demás, chillando y dando golpes al suelo con la cola.
description.de: Wenn es Wache hat, warnt es seine Artgenossen, indem es schreit und mit dem Schwanz auf den Boden schlägt.
description.it: La vedetta avverte i suoi compagni del pericolo gridando e battendo la coda sul terreno.
description.pt-BR: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
description.ru: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
description.ja: 見張り役は　鋭く　鳴いたり 尻尾で　地面を　たたいたりして 仲間に　危険を　知らせる。

description.fr: La femelle s’enroule autour des petits pour les bercer. Il accule l’ennemi grâce à sa vitesse.
description.en: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
description.es: Acurruca a sus crías para que duerman. Acorrala a los enemigos con su enorme velocidad.
description.de: Es rollt sich um seine Jungen, wenn diese schlafen sollen. Gegnern begegnet es mit Schnelligkeit.
description.it: Si addormenta avvolto nell’esile corpo della madre. Mette all’angolo i nemici con movimenti rapidi.
description.pt-BR: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
description.ru: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
description.ja: 母親は　細長い　体で 子供を　包みこみ　眠らせる。 速い　動きで　敵を　追いこむ。

description.fr: Il hulule chaque jour à la même heure. Dans certaines cultures, il incarne la sagesse.
description.en: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
description.es: Su percepción del tiempo es exacta. Ocurra lo que ocurra, lleva el ritmo moviendo la cabeza.
description.de: Sein Zeitgefühl ist perfekt. Was auch immer passiert, es behält den Rhythmus, da sein Kopf wackelt.
description.it: Ha un eccezionale senso del ritmo. Tiene il tempo piegando la testa a intervalli regolari.
description.pt-BR: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
description.ru: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
description.ja: 体内の　時間の　間隔は どんなときでも　正確で 決まった　リズムで　首をかしげる。

description.fr: Ses yeux sont capables de voir distinctement même quand il fait très sombre.
description.en: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
description.es: Sus ojos están especialmente adaptados. Concentran la luz para poder ver en la oscuridad.
description.de: Sein Sehvermögen ist hervorragend. Selbst bei schwachem Licht kann es jedes Detail erkennen.
description.it: Ha degli occhi speciali con cui concentra anche la luce più fioca per poter vedere al buio.
description.pt-BR: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
description.ru: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
description.ja: 両目は　特殊な　つくり。 わずかな　光を　集めては 暗闇でも　まわりを　見分ける。

description.fr: Il est si timide qu’il ne se déplace qu’au milieu d’un essaim. Il exprime ses émotions par l’odeur.
description.en: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
description.es: Cuando llega el frío, se reúnen muchos Ledyba de todas partes para darse calor.
description.de: Wird es kalt, versammeln sich viele Ledyba von nah und fern, um sich gegenseitig Wärme zu schenken.
description.it: Quando inizia a far freddo, i Ledyba si riuniscono da ogni luogo per scaldarsi tra loro.
description.pt-BR: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
description.ru: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
description.ja: 寒くなると　あちこちから レディバが　たくさん　集まって 寄り添いあい　温め合う。

description.fr: Il tire sa force de la lumière des étoiles. Plus il y en a et plus ses motifs dorsaux sont grands.
description.en: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
description.es: Cuando parpadean las estrellas en el cielo nocturno, se mece desprendiendo un polvo brillante.
description.de: Leuchten die Sterne am Nachthimmel, schwirrt es umher und verstreut einen strahlenden, leuchtenden Puder.
description.it: Si aggira nella notte stellata lasciando cadere una scia di polvere incandescente.
description.pt-BR: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
description.ru: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
description.ja: 夜空に　星が　瞬くとき 輝く　粉を　振りまきながら ひらひらと　飛んでいく。

description.fr: Il tisse une toile fine mais solide pour poser des pièges et se poste dans l’attente d’une proie.
description.en: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
description.es: Teje su telaraña con hilo fino pero resistente. Espera pacientemente a que caiga su presa.
description.de: Es spinnt ein Netz aus feinem, aber reißfestem Faden. Dann wartet es auf Beute, die im Netz zappelt.
description.it: Tesse la tela con un filo sottile ma resistente. Poi attende paziente che una preda ci finisca dentro.
description.pt-BR: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
description.ru: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
description.ja: 細くて　丈夫な　糸を 張り巡らして　わなを　仕掛けると 獲物が　かかるのを　ひたすら待つ。

description.fr: Il attache un fil à sa proie avant de la libérer. Il s’en servira pour la retrouver, elle et ses amis.
description.en: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
description.es: Teje su telaraña desde atrás y desde su boca. Es muy difícil saber dónde está cada cual.
description.de: Da es Fäden sowohl mit dem Hinterleib als auch mit dem Mund spinnt, verwechselt man die beiden leicht.
description.it: Seguendo il filo che gli esce da dietro, si giunge di certo fino al suo nido.
description.pt-BR: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
description.ru: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
description.ja: お尻からだけでなく　口からも 糸を　出すので　見ただけでは どっちが　頭か　わからない。

description.fr: La transformation de ses pattes en ailes a certes amélioré sa capacité à voler, mais pas à marcher.
description.en: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
description.es: Es tan silencioso cuando vuela en la oscuridad con sus cuatro alas, que cuesta percibirlo cuando se acerca.
description.de: Mit seinen vier Flügeln fliegt es so geräuschlos durch die Nacht, dass man es nicht bemerkt.
description.it: Vola nel buio con le sue quattro ali in modo talmente silenzioso che è difficile notarlo anche se è vicino.
description.pt-BR: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
description.ru: It flies so si­ lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
description.ja: ４枚に　増えた　翼で 暗闇を　静かに　飛んでいく。 となりを　通られても　気づかない。

description.fr: Il envoie des décharges électriques positives et négatives du bout des antennes pour paralyser sa proie.
description.en: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
description.es: En el oscuro fondo del océano, su único modo de comunicarse es emitiendo luces parpadeantes.
description.de: Am Meeresgrund kann es sich nur durch ständiges Flackern seiner Lichter der Umgebung kundtun.
description.it: Negli oscuri fondali oceanici il suo unico mezzo di comunicazione sono le luci sempre lampeggianti.
description.pt-BR: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
description.ru: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
description.ja: 暗い　海底では　いつも 点滅している　触手の 明かり　だけが　通信手段。

description.fr: La lumière de Lanturn surgit des profondeurs. On le surnomme “étoile des profondeurs”.
description.en: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
description.es: La luz de Lanturn se puede ver desde lo más profundo. Se le llama la Estrella de Alta Mar.
description.de: Lanturns Licht kann aus großen Tiefen heraufscheinen. Man nennt es auch „Tiefseestern“.
description.it: La sua luce è visibile anche quando si trova in profondità. È soprannominato “Stella degli abissi”.
description.pt-BR: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
description.ru: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
description.ja: 深海を　泳ぐ　ランターンの 明かりは　水面まで　届く。 深海の星　と　呼ばれている。

description.fr: Les poches électriques de ses joues sont encore petites, mais risquent de l’électrocuter.
description.en: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
description.es: Cuando juegan, se tocan las colas y emiten chispas. Al parecer, es una prueba de valor.
description.de: Sie spielen miteinander, indem sie ihre Schweifspitzen aneinanderhalten und Funken fliegen lassen.
description.it: Quando le code dei Pichu si toccano, fanno scintille. Pare che si tratti di una prova di coraggio.
description.pt-BR: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
description.ru: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
description.ja: 仲間と　尻尾の　先を　あわせて 火花を　飛ばす　遊びをする。 度胸試しを　しているらしい。

description.fr: On dit qu’il se déplace à dos d’étoile filante. Il se montre souvent quand on en voit.
description.en: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
description.es: Por su inusual forma estrellada, la gente cree que procede de un meteorito que cayó a la tierra.
description.de: Aufgrund seiner ungewöhnlichen Sternform sagt man, es sei auf einem Meteor hierhergereist.
description.it: Per il suo aspetto bizzarro, a forma di stella, c’è chi crede che provenga da una meteora.
description.pt-BR: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
description.ru: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
description.ja: お星さまのような　シルエット。 その姿から　流れ星に乗って やって来ると　信じられている。

description.fr: Son corps est doux et élastique. Quand il commence à rebondir, on ne peut plus l’arrêter.
description.en: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
description.es: Para caminar, en lugar de usar los pies que tiene, opta por dar botes con su cuerpo redondo y blandito.
description.de: Anstatt mit seinen kurzen Beinen zu laufen, hüpft es mit seinem weichen und kuscheligen Körper.
description.it: Anziché camminare sulle sue corte zampe, preferisce rimbalzare sul suo corpo soffice e delicato.
description.pt-BR: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
description.ru: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
description.ja: 短い　脚で　歩くより やわらかい　体を　使って 飛び跳ねながら　動き回る。

description.fr: Il transforme les émotions positives des autres en bonheur qu’il stocke dans sa coquille.
description.en: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description.es: El cascarón parece estar lleno de alegría. Dicen que trae buena suerte si es tratado con cariño.
description.de: Seine Schale ist voll von Freude. Es teilt sein Glück, wenn man es freundlich und gut behandelt.
description.it: Il suo guscio sembra ricolmo di gioia. Si dice che porti fortuna se lo si tratta bene.
description.pt-BR: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description.ru: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
description.ja: 殻の中に　幸せが　たくさん つまっているらしく　優しくされると 幸運を　分け与える　という。

description.fr: Il parcourt le monde pour distribuer de la joie aux êtres bons.
description.en: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.
description.es: Si no está con gente amable, se entristece. Puede flotar en el aire sin mover las alas.
description.de: Es wird entmutigt, wenn es unter unfreundlichen Menschen ist. Es kann ohne Flügel niedrig schweben.
description.it: S’intristisce se non si trova con persone gentili. Può restare sospeso in aria senza bisogno di muovere le ali.
description.pt-BR: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.
description.ru: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car­ ing people and shower them with happiness.
description.ja: 優しい人の　そばに　いないと 元気が　出なくなってしまう。 羽を動かさずに　空に浮かべる。

description.fr: Il mange des cactus en prenant soin d’éviter les bourgeons et les épines. Il ne tient pas en place.
description.en: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
description.es: Va dando saltitos porque sus alas no han crecido lo suficiente. Siempre está pendiente de algo.
description.de: Da seine Flügel nicht voll ausgebildet sind, bewegt es sich hüpfend. Es starrt immer etwas an.
description.it: Poiché le sue ali non sono ancora ben sviluppate, deve saltellare. Sembra fissare sempre qualcosa.
description.pt-BR: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
description.ru: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
description.ja: 羽が　育ちきって　おらず 飛び跳ねるようにして　移動する。 いつも　なにかを　見つめている。

description.fr: Cet étrange Pokémon peut voir l’avenir et le passé. Il guette sans cesse la course du soleil.
description.en: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
description.es: Cuando se pone a meditar al amanecer, pierde la noción del tiempo. Puede pasarse así todo el día.
description.de: Wenn es bei Sonnenaufgang anfängt zu meditieren, vergeht der ganze Tag, ehe es sich wieder bewegt.
description.it: Quando, all’alba, inizia a meditare, riesce a rimanere immobile fino alla fine del giorno.
description.pt-BR: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
description.ru: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
description.ja: 朝方　昇る　太陽を じっと　見つめ　祈りを　ささげると ほとんど　動かず　１日を終える。

description.fr: Sa laine fournie enfle lorsqu’il accumule de l’électricité statique. Son contact peut choquer.
description.en: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
description.es: Su pelaje lanudo dobla su volumen al acumular electricidad estática. Tocarlo puede dar calambre.
description.de: Sein weiches Fell wird doppelt so dick, wenn sich Elektrizität aufbaut.
description.it: Se il manto è carico d’elettricità, le sue dimensioni raddoppiano e può dare la scossa.
description.pt-BR: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
description.ru: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
description.ja: ふわふわの　体毛は　静電気が たまると　２倍に　ふくらむ。 触ると　感電してしまう。

description.fr: Sa queue s’allume lorsque sa laine se charge d’électricité. Il projette des poils électrifiés.
description.en: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
description.es: Su esponjosa lana almacena electricidad. Su piel gomosa evita que sea electrocutado.
description.de: Sein flauschiges Fell speichert Elektrizität. Seine Gummihaut schützt es vor Stromstößen.
description.it: La soffice pelliccia raccoglie elettricità. Non resta fulminato grazie a uno strato di pelle gommosa.
description.pt-BR: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
description.ru: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
description.ja: ふかふかの　体毛は　電気を ためやすいが　ゴムのような　皮膚の おかげで　自分は　しびれない。

description.fr: Le bout de sa queue brille avec intensité. Jadis, on s’en servait pour envoyer des signaux.
description.en: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
description.es: La punta de su cola reluce brillantemente y puede ser vista desde lejos. Es usado como faro.
description.de: Seine Schweifspitze ist so hell, dass viele Verschollene es als Orientierungspunkt nutzen.
description.it: La punta molto luminosa della coda è visibile da grandi distanze. Fa da segnale per chi si è perso.
description.pt-BR: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
description.ru: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
description.ja: 尻尾の先が　光り輝く。 光は　はるか　遠くまで　届き 迷った者の　道標となる。

description.fr: À la fin de la saison des pluies, il sort danser en plein air, attiré par la chaleur du soleil.
description.en: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description.es: Los Bellossom suelen reunirse para bailar. Dicen que sus danzas son un ritual para invocar al sol.
description.de: Blubella kommen zusammen, um zu tanzen. Man sagt, dieser Tanz sei ein Ritual, um der Sonne zu huldigen.
description.it: A volte gruppi di Bellossom sembrano danzare. Si dice che sia un rito per invocare il sole.
description.pt-BR: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description.ru: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
description.ja: ときおり　キレイハナが　集まって 踊るような　仕草を　みせる。 太陽を呼ぶ　儀式と　いわれる。

description.fr: Sa queue à l’extrémité remplie d’huile fait office de flotteur et lui permet de ne pas couler.
description.en: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
description.es: Tiene una piel que repele el agua. De hecho, puede pasarse horas jugando en el agua sin mojarse.
description.de: Sein Fell ist von Natur aus wasserabweisend. Es bleibt trocken, auch wenn es im Wasser spielt.
description.it: La pelliccia è idrorepellente. Così, rimane asciutto anche giocando nell’acqua.
description.pt-BR: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
description.ru: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
description.ja: 全身の　体毛は 水を　弾く　性質を　持ち 水浴び　しても　乾いている。

description.fr: Ses poumons peuvent contenir assez d’air pour lui permettre de passer une journée sous l’eau.
description.en: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
description.es: Sus largas orejas son sensores que pueden percibir movimientos de seres vivos en el lecho del río.
description.de: Seine langen Ohren sind hervorragende Sensoren. Mit ihnen kann es Bewegungen im Fluss wahrnehmen.
description.it: Le lunghe orecchie sono ottimi sensori. Distingue i movimenti di esseri viventi sui fondali fluviali.
description.pt-BR: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
description.ru: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
description.ja: 長い　耳は　優れた　センサー。 川底で　動く　生き物の　音を 聞き分ける　ことが　できる。

description.fr: Il prend l’apparence d’un arbre pour éviter les attaques, mais il déteste l’eau et fuit la pluie.
description.en: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
description.es: Aunque pretende ser un árbol, en su composición se parece más a una roca que a una planta.
description.de: Obwohl es vorgibt, ein Baum zu sein, kommt seine Zusammensetzung einem Stein näher als einer Pflanze.
description.it: Sebbene finga di essere un albero, la composizione sembra più simile a quella di una roccia.
description.pt-BR: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
description.ru: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi­ tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
description.ja: いつも　木のふりを　している。 体の　つくりは　植物より 石や　岩などに　近いようだ。

description.fr: Il rassemble ses pairs pour les commander. Il utilise son cri pour diriger Ptitard.
description.en: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
description.es: Cuando tres o más de estos se juntan, emiten un sonido muy fuerte parecido a un bramido.
description.de: Sind drei oder mehr von ihnen zusammen, lassen sie einen schallenden Ruf erklingen.
description.it: Quando tre o più Politoed si trovano insieme, iniziano a cantare ad alta voce producendo un gran frastuono.
description.pt-BR: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
description.ru: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
description.ja: ３匹以上　ニョロトノが　集まると かならず　怒鳴るような　鳴き声で 合唱を　はじめる。

description.fr: Il dérive avec le vent. Sa présence en nombre dans les champs et les montagnes annonce le printemps.
description.en: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
description.es: Su cuerpo es tan ligero, que debe agarrarse bien al suelo con las patas para no irse con el viento.
description.de: Sein Körper ist so leicht, dass es seine Füße im Boden verankert, damit es nicht davongeweht wird.
description.it: Ha un corpo così leggero che deve aggrapparsi saldamente al suolo per non volare via.
description.pt-BR: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
description.ru: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
description.ja: とても　軽い　体。 吹き飛ばされないよう　しっかり 地面を　踏みしめている。

description.fr: Il fleurit lorsque les températures remontent. Il flotte dans le ciel pour absorber les rayons du soleil.
description.en: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
description.es: La flor de su cabeza se abre y cierra según suba o baje la temperatura.
description.de: Temperaturschwankungen veranlassen es, die Blüte auf seinem Kopf immer zu öffnen oder zu schließen.
description.it: Il fiore sul capo si apre e si chiude con il continuo mutare della temperatura corporea.
description.pt-BR: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
description.ru: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
description.ja: 頭の上に　咲いた　花は 気温に　よって　開いたり 閉じたりする　性質を　持つ。

description.fr: Poussé par les vents saisonniers, il fait le tour du globe en semant des spores de coton.
description.en: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
description.es: Los vientos estacionales lo llevan por todo el mundo, donde va soltando sus esporas.
