description.de: Es lässt sich von den Winden um den Globus tragen und verteilt auf seinem Flug Baumwollsamen.
description.it: Sospinto dai venti stagionali, gira intorno al globo sparpagliando i suoi semi simili al cotone.
description.pt-BR: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
description.ru: Once it catches the wind, it deft­ ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
description.ja: 季節風に　流されて 世界を　１周してしまう。 途中で　綿胞子を　ばらまく。

description.fr: Sa queue est aussi agile que ses mains. Il vit en haut des grands arbres.
description.en: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
description.es: Vive en lo alto de los árboles. Cuando salta de rama en rama, usa su cola para equilibrarse.
description.de: Es lebt in den Kronen großer Bäume. Es hüpft von Ast zu Ast und balanciert mit seinem Schweif.
description.it: Vive in cima agli alberi più alti. Usando abilmente la coda, mantiene l’equilibrio quando salta di ramo in ramo.
description.pt-BR: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
description.ru: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
description.ja: 高い　木の上で　暮らしている。 枝から　枝へ　飛び移るとき 尻尾で　巧みに　バランスをとる。

description.fr: Il tombe du ciel sans crier gare en matinée. On en croise énormément l’année suivant un été froid.
description.en: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
description.es: Puede caer del cielo de repente. Si le ataca un Spearow, moverá violentamente sus hojas.
description.de: Manchmal fällt es plötzlich vom Himmel. Wird es von Habitak angegriffen, schüttelt es seine Blätter.
description.it: Piomba dall’alto improvvisamente. Se è attaccato da uno Spearow, agita violentemente le foglie.
description.pt-BR: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
description.ru: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
description.ja: ある朝　突然　降ってくる。 オニスズメに　襲われると　葉っぱを 激しく　振って　追い払う。

description.fr: Les rayons du soleil lui donnent de l’énergie. Il est connu pour migrer vers les régions ensoleillées.
description.en: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
description.es: A medida que se acerca el verano, va adquiriendo un color más vivo e intenso en los pétalos de la cara.
description.de: Steht der Sommer bevor, werden die Blätter um das Gesicht dieses Pokémon aktiv und lebhaft.
description.it: Con l’avvicinarsi della bella stagione, i suoi petali si fanno più vivi e splendenti.
description.pt-BR: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
description.ru: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
description.ja: 暑い　季節が　近づくと 顔の　花びらは　鮮やかになり 活発に　動くようになる。

description.fr: La vitesse de ses ailes lui permet un vol stationnaire. Il surveille ainsi tout son territoire.
description.en: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
description.es: Su campo visual es de 360° sin girar la cabeza. Detecta hasta las presas que están a su espalda.
description.de: Mit seinen Augen hat es einen Blickwinkel von 360 Grad. Es sieht sogar Beute, die sich hinter ihm befindet.
description.it: Ha un campo visivo a 360 gradi senza muovere la testa. Riesce a vedere persino le prede alle sue spalle.
description.pt-BR: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
description.ru: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
description.ja: 顔を　動かさずに　３６０度 すべてを　見渡す　目を　持つので 真後ろの　獲物も　見逃さない。

description.fr: Sur la terre ferme, il couvre son corps d’un fluide toxique qui le protège de la déshydratation.
description.en: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description.es: Este Pokémon vive en aguas frías. Sale del agua para buscar comida cuando refresca el ambiente.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon lebt in Eiswasser. Wird es an Land kalt, verlässt es das Wasser und sucht nach Futter.
description.it: Vive nell’acqua fredda. Quando fa freddo fuori, esce dall’acqua per cercare cibo.
description.pt-BR: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description.ru: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
description.ja: 冷たい　水の中で　生活。 あたりが　涼しくなると　エサを 探しに　地上にも　現れる。

description.fr: De nature placide, il a tendance à se cogner la tête contre les récifs et autres bateaux de passage.
description.en: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
description.es: Es un Pokémon bastante perezoso. Para pescar permanece en el fondo del río con la boca abierta.
description.de: Ein träges Pokémon, das auf dem Grund des Flusses liegt und wartet, dass ihm Beute ins Maul schwimmt.
description.it: È pigro per natura. Sta sul fondo dei fiumi con la bocca aperta in attesa di afferrare la preda.
description.pt-BR: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
description.ru: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
description.ja: のんびりとした　性格。 川底で　口を　開けて　エサが 飛びこんでくるのを　ひたすら　待つ。

description.fr: Sa fourrure est si sensible qu’il peut détecter les vibrations de l’air et prédire le temps qu’il fera.
description.en: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
description.es: Al predecir el siguiente movimiento de su rival, chasquea el extremo de la cola bífida que tiene.
description.de: Die Spitze seines geteilten Schweifs bebt, wenn es die nächste Attacke seines Feindes voraussagt.
description.it: Mentre predice la prossima mossa del nemico, la coda biforcuta gli inizia a tremare.
description.pt-BR: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
description.ru: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene­ my's actions.
description.ja: 相手の　動きを　予知するとき ふたまたに　なっている　尻尾の　先は 微妙に　揺れている。

description.fr: Quand il s’expose à la lumière de la lune, ses anneaux brillent et il obtient un mystérieux pouvoir.
description.en: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
description.es: Creado cuando la luz lunar alteró la estructura genética de Eevee. Busca presas en la oscuridad.
description.de: Mondlicht hat die genetische Struktur von Evoli verändert. Im Dunkeln wartet es auf Beute.
description.it: La luce lunare ha mutato la struttura genetica di Eevee. Si cela nel buio in attesa della preda.
description.pt-BR: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
description.ru: When agitated, this POKéMON pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
description.ja: 月の　光が　イーブイの 遺伝子を　変化させた。 闇に　潜み　獲物を　待つ。

description.fr: Quand il est en danger, il tente de semer ses poursuivants dans les chemins montagneux.
description.en: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
description.es: Esconde objetos brillantes en un lugar secreto. Meowth y Murkrow suelen saquear su escondite.
description.de: Es versteckt jeden schimmernden Gegenstand. Kramurx und Mauzi rauben sich gegenseitig die Beute.
description.it: Nasconde in un luogo segreto ogni oggetto che trova. Murkrow e Meowth si derubano tra di loro.
description.pt-BR: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
description.ru: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
description.ja: 輝く　物を　拾っては 秘密の　場所に　隠しておく。 よく　ニャースと　奪い合いになる。

description.fr: La morsure de Kokiyas a fait de lui un génie dont l’intelligence rivalise avec celle d’un prix Nobel.
description.en: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
description.es: Su intelecto e intuición son increíbles. No pierde la compostura en ninguna situación.
description.de: Sein feines Gespür und Intellekt zeichnen es aus. Es bleibt in jeder Situation gelassen und besonnen.
description.it: Dotato di incredibile intelligenza e intuito, sa restare calmo e padrone di sé in ogni situazione.
description.pt-BR: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
description.ru: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
description.ja: すごい　知性と　ひらめきを 持っている。どんなときでも　あわてず 騒がず　のんびりとしている。

description.fr: Il fait peur aux aventuriers en pleine nuit et se nourrit de leur frayeur.
description.en: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
description.es: Se deleita con el miedo, que absorbe con sus esferas rojas. Por el día, duerme en la oscuridad.
description.de: Es nährt sich von der Angst anderer Wesen und nimmt diese in roten Kugeln auf. Schläft am Tage.
description.it: Si nutre delle preoccupazioni che assorbe con le sue sfere rosse. Di giorno dorme nell’oscurità.
description.pt-BR: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
description.ru: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
description.ja: 怖がる　心を　赤い　玉で 吸収して　栄養にする。 昼間は　暗がりで　眠っている。

description.fr: Quand il est seul, il ne se passe rien... Mais en groupe, il semble habité par un mystérieux pouvoir.
description.en: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
description.es: Su cuerpo fino y plano aparece siempre en los muros. Su forma parece tener algún significado.
description.de: Sein flacher, dünner Körper hängt immer an Wänden. Seine Form scheint eine Bedeutung zu haben.
description.it: Il corpo piatto e sottile sta sempre attaccato ai muri. Pare che la forma abbia un preciso significato.
description.pt-BR: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
description.ru: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
description.ja: 体自体は　薄っぺらく いつも　壁に　張りついている。 形に　なにか　意味があるらしい。

description.fr: Il cherche désespérément à cacher sa queue noire. Certains pensent qu’elle renferme un secret.
description.en: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
description.es: Odia la luz y las sacudidas. Si le atacan, infla su cuerpo para aumentar su contraataque.
description.de: Es hasst Licht und Schläge. Wird es angegriffen, pumpt es sich auf, um einen Gegenschlag vorzubereiten.
description.it: Odia la luce e gli shock. Se è attaccato, gonfia il corpo per preparare il contrattacco.
description.pt-BR: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
description.ru: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
description.ja: 光や　ショックを　嫌う。 攻撃されると　体が　ふくらみ 反撃が　強力に　なる。

description.fr: La tête qu’il a sur la queue dispose de son propre cerveau et lui permet de couvrir ses arrières.
description.en: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
description.es: Cuando duerme, la cabeza de su cola se queda vigilando, ya que ella no necesita dormir.
description.de: Während es schläft, hält sein Schweif Wache. Dieser benötigt keinen Schlaf.
description.it: La testa che ha sulla coda rimane vigile mentre dorme. La coda, infatti, non ha bisogno di riposare.
description.pt-BR: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
description.ru: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
description.ja: 眠っている　あいだ　尻尾の　頭が あたりを　見張っている。 尻尾は　眠らなくても　平気。

description.fr: Il ressemble à une pomme de pin. Sa carapace le protège des Pokémon Oiseaux qui le picorent par erreur.
description.en: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
description.es: Le gusta engrosar su coraza añadiendo cortezas de árbol. El aumento de peso no le molesta.
description.de: Es fügt seiner Schale schichtenweise Baumrinde hinzu. Die zusätzliche Belastung ist ihm gleich.
description.it: Inspessisce il guscio aggiungendo strati di corteccia. Non lo impensierisce l’aumento di peso.
description.pt-BR: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
description.ru: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
description.ja: 木の　皮を　重ね合わせて 殻を　分厚くするのが　大好き。 重くなっても　気にしない。

description.fr: Il est prisonnier d’une coquille d’acier. Ses yeux vigilants sont la seule partie visible de son corps.
description.en: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
description.es: Se protege con su concha de acero de tal manera que solo se pueden ver sus ojos.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist von einer Stahlhülle umgeben. Seine stechenden Augen sind alles, was man von ihm sieht.
description.it: È incassato in una conchiglia d’acciaio. A parte gli occhi scrutatori, nessuno sa cosa ci sia all’interno.
description.pt-BR: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
description.ru: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
description.ja: 鋼鉄の　殻で　守られている。 すきまから　目玉が　のぞいているが 中身の　正体は　ナゾのまま。

description.fr: Son nid est un véritable labyrinthe qu’il creuse à l’aide de sa queue. Il sait à peine voler.
description.en: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
description.es: Este Pokémon escapa hacia atrás perforando el suelo con su cola, si es descubierto.
description.de: Wird es entdeckt, flüchtet dieses Pokémon, indem es sich mit seinem Schweif in den Boden gräbt.
description.it: Se lo si scopre, questo Pokémon fugge all’indietro scavando furiosamente nel terreno con la coda.
description.pt-BR: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
description.ru: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
description.ja: だれかに　見られると 尻尾で　地面を　掘って 後ろ向きに　逃げ出すのだ。

description.fr: Il fend l’air et fond sur sa proie pour s’agripper à son visage et la frapper avec son dard.
description.en: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
description.es: A veces se sujeta a los precipicios. Cuando divisa una presa, despliega sus alas y planea para atacar.
description.de: Es hängt meist an Klippen. Erspäht es Beute, spreizt es seine Flügel und greift diese sofort an.
description.it: Di solito sta attaccato agli scogli. Attacca la preda spalancando le ali e planando.
description.pt-BR: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
description.ru: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
description.ja: いつもは　崖に　張りついている。 獲物を見つけると　羽を広げ 風に乗り　襲いかかってくる。

description.fr: On pense que son corps s’est transformé à cause du fer contenu dans la terre dont il se nourrit.
description.en: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
description.es: Su cuerpo es más duro que cualquier metal debido a la gran presión y calor de su hábitat.
description.de: Hoher Druck und hohe Temperaturen haben seinen Körper härter als Stahl werden lassen.
description.it: Temprato dalla pressione e dal calore sotterraneo, il suo corpo è più duro di qualsiasi metallo.
description.pt-BR: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
description.ru: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
description.ja: 地中の　高い　圧力と　熱で 鍛えられた　体は あらゆる　金属よりも　硬い。

description.fr: Son visage horrible fait fuir les petits Pokémon. Par contre, les femmes le trouvent mignon.
description.en: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
description.es: Muy travieso por naturaleza, a muchas mujeres les gusta jugar con él porque es muy cariñoso.
description.de: Es ist von Natur aus verspielt. Es tollt mit vielen Frauen herum, da es ihnen zugeneigt ist.
description.it: Ha uno spirito attivo e giocoso. A molti piace giocherellare con lui per i suoi modi affettuosi.
description.pt-BR: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
description.ru: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
description.ja: 活発で　遊び好きな　性格。 懐いてくれるので　一緒に 遊びたがる　女性も　多い。

description.fr: En dépit des apparences, c’est un grand timide. Quand il s’énerve, il mord de ses énormes crocs.
description.en: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
description.es: A pesar de su aspecto, es muy tímido. Sin embargo, cuando se enfada, ataca con sus colmillos.
description.de: Es ist trotz seines Äußeren schüchtern. Wird es wütend, schnappt es mit seinen Fängen zu.
description.it: Malgrado il suo aspetto, è molto timido. Se si arrabbia, tuttavia, colpisce con le sue enormi zanne.
description.pt-BR: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
description.ru: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
description.ja: 顔に　似合わず　臆病。 しかし　ひとたび　怒りはじめると 大きな　キバで　反撃する。

description.fr: Il envoie ses piquants empoisonnés à la ronde. Sa forme sphérique en fait un piètre nageur.
description.en: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description.es: Para arrojar sus venenosas púas, infla su cuerpo bebiendo hasta diez litros de agua de una sola vez.
description.de: Um seine Giftstacheln abzufeuern, muss es seinen Körper aufpumpen, indem es 10 l trinkt.
description.it: Per sparare le punte velenose, gonfia il corpo bevendo più di 10 l d’acqua in una volta.
description.pt-BR: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description.ru: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
description.ja: 全身の　毒針を　飛ばすため １０リットルの　水を　一気に 飲みこみ　体を　ふくらませる。

description.fr: Les yeux sur ses pinces servent à intimider l’ennemi avant de passer à l’attaque.
description.en: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
description.es: Las pinzas que posee tienen acero. Con ellas, no hay nada que se le resista. Rompen todo lo que pillan.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinen stählernen Scheren jeden harten Gegenstand mühelos zermalmen.
description.it: Le chele, che contengono acciaio, possono fare a pezzi qualsiasi oggetto afferrino.
description.pt-BR: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
description.ru: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
description.ja: 鋼鉄を　含んでいる　ハサミで 捕らえたものは　どんなに　硬くても コナゴナに　砕く。

description.fr: Il stocke des Baies sous sa carapace. Elles fermentent et produisent des jus délicieux.
description.en: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
description.es: Las bayas que almacena en su caparazón con forma de tarro se convierten al final en un espeso zumo.
description.de: In seinem topfförmigen Panzer gelagerte Beeren verwandeln sich im Nu zu einem dickflüssigen Saft.
description.it: Il suo guscio è come un vaso nel quale conserva le bacche, che a un certo punto si trasformano in un denso succo.
description.pt-BR: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
description.ru: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
description.ja: ツボのような　甲羅の　中に ためこんだ　木の実は　いつの間にか ドロドロの　ジュースに　変わる。

description.fr: Il défend vaillamment sa réserve de miel personnelle à grand renfort de coups de corne.
description.en: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
description.es: Este fuerte Pokémon clava su preciado cuerno en la tripa del enemigo, lo eleva y luego lo arroja.
description.de: Dieses kräftige Pokémon rammt sein stolzes Horn unter den Rumpf des Gegners und wirft ihn um.
description.it: Questo potente Pokémon infilza con il corno la pancia del nemico, sollevandolo e lanciandolo lontano.
description.pt-BR: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
description.ru: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
description.ja: 自慢のツノを　相手の　お腹の 下に　ねじこみ　一気に　持ち上げ ぶん投げてしまう　力持ち。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon rusé agit parfois en équipe pour voler des œufs, l’un d’entre eux faisant diversion.
description.en: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
description.es: Se alimenta de huevos robados en nidos. Clava sus afiladas garras en los puntos débiles de sus rivales.
description.de: Es ernährt sich von Eiern, die es aus Nestern stiehlt. Beute greift es mit seinen scharfen Krallen an.
description.it: Mangia uova rubate dai nidi. Attacca i nemici nei punti deboli con i suoi artigli uncinati.
description.pt-BR: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
description.ru: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
description.ja: 住処から　タマゴを　かすめ取り 食べてしまう。鋭い　カギヅメが 相手の　急所を　切り裂く。

description.fr: Il baigne ses griffes dans le miel pour les lécher. Chaque paire de pattes a un goût unique.
description.en: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
description.es: Si encuentra miel, brillará la marca de su frente. Se lame las garras cuando están llenas de miel.
description.de: Findet es Honig, leuchtet die Sichel auf seinem Kopf. Es leckt oft seine mit Honig bedeckten Pfoten.
description.it: Se trova del miele la sua mezzaluna diventa più luminosa. Si lecca le zampe intrise di miele.
description.pt-BR: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
description.ru: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
description.ja: ミツを見つけると　三日月模様が 輝く。甘いミツが　染みこんだ 手のひらを　いつも　なめている。

description.fr: Il marque de ses griffes les arbres de son territoire qui portent des Baies ou des fruits.
description.en: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
description.es: Capaz de percibir cualquier tipo de aroma, encuentra sin problemas todo alimento enterrado bajo tierra.
description.de: Da es alle Gerüche perfekt unterscheiden kann, findet es sogar Nahrung, die tief im Erdreich ist.
description.it: Con la sua capacità di distinguere qualsiasi odore, trova cibo nel terreno anche a grandi profondità.
description.pt-BR: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
description.ru: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
description.ja: どんな　においも　かぎわける。 地面深くに　埋まっている 食べ物も　残らず　見つけ出す。

description.fr: Son corps est fait de magma. S’il cesse de bouger, il refroidit et durcit.
description.en: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
description.es: Asiduo a las zonas volcánicas, se desliza lentamente en busca de lugares calientes.
description.de: Es hält sich ständig bei Vulkanen auf und ist stets kriechend auf der Suche nach warmen Aufenthaltsorten.
description.it: Comune nelle aree vulcaniche, striscia in giro lentamente, sempre alla ricerca di luoghi caldi.
description.pt-BR: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
description.ru: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
description.ja: 火山地帯に　多く　発生。 暖かい　ところを　探して のろのろ　はいずり回っている。

description.fr: Sa température corporelle avoisine les 10 000 °C. Des flammes fusent des fissures de sa coquille.
description.en: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
description.es: En ocasiones, su resbaladiza concha lanza intensas llamaradas que recorren todo su cuerpo.
description.de: Aus seinem porösen Schneckengehäuse sprudeln Feuerfontänen, die seinen Körper durchfluten.
description.it: A volte intense fiamme partono dal fragile guscio e avvolgono tutto il suo corpo.
description.pt-BR: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
description.ru: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
description.ja: 背中の　殻は　崩れやすいが ときどき　体内を　巡っている 高熱の　炎が　噴き出す。

description.fr: Son nez très sensible détecte champignons, Baies et sources chaudes enfouis sous la glace.
description.en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description.es: Frota su hocico contra el suelo para desenterrar comida. A veces descubre aguas termales.
description.de: Auf Nahrungssuche schnüffelt es am Boden entlang. Es entdeckt dabei manchmal auch heiße Quellen.
description.it: Sfrega il muso sul terreno per scovare del cibo. Talvolta scopre sorgenti d’acqua calda.
description.pt-BR: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description.ru: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
description.ja: エサを　探すため　鼻を こすり合わせ　地面を　掘っている。 たまに　温泉を　掘り当てる。

description.fr: Il est protégé du froid mordant par son épais manteau de fourrure. Ses cornes sont formées de glace.
description.en: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
description.es: Aunque tiene las patas cortas, las fuertes pezuñas le permiten agarrarse bien al suelo, a pesar del hielo.
description.de: Trotz kurzer Beine rutscht es auf eisigen Flächen nicht aus, da seine Hufe ihm genügend Halt bieten.
description.it: Ha le zampe corte, ma grazie agli zoccoli ruvidi, riesce a non scivolare neppure sul ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
description.ru: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
description.ja: ４本の　脚は　短いが ひづめは　広く　ギザギザ　なので 雪の上でも　滑らず　歩ける。

description.fr: On en trouve beaucoup dans les mers claires du sud. On dirait qu’il ne peut pas vivre en eau polluée.
description.en: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
description.es: Crece y muda continuamente. La parte superior de su cabeza es muy apreciada por su belleza.
description.de: Es häutet sich ständig und wächst. Seine Kopfspitze wurde als Schatz der Schönheit ausgezeichnet.
description.it: Muta la pelle e cresce di continuo. La punta che ha sul capo è un simbolo della sua bellezza.
description.pt-BR: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
description.ru: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
description.ja: どんどん　育っては　生えかわる 頭の　先は　きれいなので 宝物として　人気が高い。

description.fr: Son puissant jet d’eau ne manque jamais sa cible, même quand il est au fond de l’eau.
description.en: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
description.es: Tiene muy buena puntería. Dispara agua a sus presas, hasta si se están moviendo, a más de 100 metros.
description.de: Es ist äußerst präzise. Es kann mit seinem Wasserschuss Beute erlegen, die 100 m entfernt ist.
description.it: La sua precisione è straordinaria. Può colpire una preda in movimento anche a più di 100 m.
description.pt-BR: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
description.ru: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
description.ja: ねらいは　正確。噴き出す　水は １００メートル先で　動く　獲物に かならず　命中する。

description.fr: Il adore se cacher dans les fissures de la roche. Il crache parfois de l’encre sur ses proies.
description.en: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
description.es: Tiene querencia por los agujeros. Ataca escupiendo tinta metido en las grietas de rocas o en recipientes.
description.de: Es verkriecht sich gerne in Löchern, von wo aus es Gegner mit Tinte beschießt. Es bevorzugt Felsspalten und Vasen.
description.it: Ama rintanarsi nei vasi o nelle fessure della roccia, da dove attacca sparando getti d’inchiostro.
description.pt-BR: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
description.ru: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
description.ja: 穴に　入りたがる　性質で 岩穴や　ツボを　好み　そこから 墨を　噴き出して　攻撃する。

description.fr: Il dépose sa nourriture dans sa queue enroulée. Il l’offre souvent aux gens égarés en montagne.
description.en: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
description.es: Transporta alimentos en su cola enrollada. Le gusta compartir su comida con los montañistas perdidos.
description.de: Im eingerollten Schweif transportiert es Futter, das es mit denen teilt, die sich verlaufen haben.
description.it: Trascina il cibo avvolgendolo nella coda e ha l’abitudine di condividerlo con chi si perde fra le montagne.
description.pt-BR: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
description.ru: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
description.ja: 尻尾で　エサを　包んで　運ぶ。 山で　遭難した　人に エサを　分け与える　習性。

description.fr: Il ignore royalement les Rémoraid qui s’accrochent à ses nageoires pour manger les restes qu’il sème.
description.en: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
description.es: Acumula velocidad nadando y puede saltar fuera del agua, alcanzando 100 metros de altura, para descender luego planeando.
description.de: Schwimmt es schnell genug, kann es über die Wellen springen und bis zu 100 m durch die Lüfte gleiten.
description.it: Prende velocità nuotando e, quando è pronto, usa le onde come trampolini per saltare a volte anche fino a 100 m.
description.pt-BR: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
description.ru: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
description.ja: 泳いで　スピードが　のってくると 波の上に　飛びだし　そのまま １００メートルも　滑空　する。

description.fr: Son corps est prisonnier d’une armure dure comme l’acier, mais il vole à plus de 300 km/h.
description.en: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
description.es: Después de anidar en zarzas, las alas de sus polluelos crecen fortalecidas por los rasguños.
description.de: Die dornigen Zweige seines Nests bewirken, dass die Flügel seiner Jungen fest und hart werden.
description.it: Facendo il nido tra i rovi, le ali dei suoi piccoli si rinforzano per i graffi causati dalle spine.
description.pt-BR: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
description.ru: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
description.ja: いばらの　中に　巣を作る。 トゲで　傷つきながら　育てられた ヒナの　羽は　硬くなる。

description.fr: Il est assez évolué pour chasser en meute et communiquer par des séries de cris modulés.
description.en: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
description.es: Al amanecer, resuena por la zona su inquietante aullido para anunciar que es su territorio.
description.de: Im Morgengrauen schallt sein ominöses Geheule über das Gebiet, das es für sich beansprucht.
description.it: All’alba, i suoi sinistri urli riecheggiano nell’aria. In questo modo demarca il territorio.
description.pt-BR: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
description.ru: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
description.ja: 夜明けごろ　あたり一帯に 響きわたる　不気味な　遠ぼえで 自分たちの　縄張りを　アピール。

description.fr: En colère, il crache des flammes contenant une toxine qui peut causer des dégâts irréversibles.
description.en: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
description.es: Hace mucho, la gente creía que sus horripilantes aullidos eran de la muerte personificada.
description.de: In alten Zeiten glaubte man, das Heulen dieses Pokémon sei der Ruf des Todes.
description.it: Molto tempo fa, si riteneva che le sue urla sinistre coincidessero con la chiamata della morte.
description.pt-BR: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
description.ru: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
description.ja: ヘルガーの　不気味な　遠ぼえは 地獄から　死神が　呼ぶ　声と 昔の　人は　想像していた。

description.fr: Chacun de ses déplacements provoque des tourbillons. Il vit dans les grottes sous-marines.
description.en: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description.es: Dicen que suele esconderse en cuevas submarinas. Puede crear torbellinos al bostezar.
description.de: Man sagt, es hause in Unterwasserhöhlen. Es kann mächtige Strudel generieren, wenn es gähnt.
description.it: Si dice che si nasconda in grotte sottacqua. Il suo sbadiglio può provocare dei vortici.
description.pt-BR: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description.ru: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
description.ja: 普段は　海底洞窟に 身を　潜めているらしい。 あくびで　渦潮を　発生させる。

description.fr: Il est fort malgré son aspect ramassé. Il n’a aucun mal à porter un humain adulte sur son dos.
description.en: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
description.es: Como muestra de afecto, golpea con su trompa. Aunque es tan fuerte que te mandará lejos.
description.de: Als Zeichen seiner Zuneigung stupst es dich mit dem Rüssel, was dich aber buchstäblich umwerfen könnte.
description.it: Dà colpi con il muso in segno di affetto, ma è così forte che può far volare la gente in questo modo.
description.pt-BR: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
description.ru: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
description.ja: 愛情表現で　鼻を　ぶつけてくるが 力が　あるので 気をつけないと　吹っ飛ばされる。

description.fr: Il attaque en se roulant en boule pour percuter l’ennemi. Il peut abattre une maison d’un seul coup.
description.en: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
description.es: Tiene afilados y duros colmillos, y una gruesa piel. Su Placaje es tan fuerte que puede derribar una casa.
description.de: Aufgrund seiner scharfen Stoßzähne und seiner rauen Haut könnte es mit Tackle ein Haus niederreißen.
description.it: Ha zanne dure e affilate e la pelle grinzosa. La sua Azione è così forte da abbattere una casa.
description.pt-BR: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
description.ru: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
description.ja: 鋭く　硬い　キバと さらに　頑丈な　皮膚で 体当たりは　家をも　壊すほど。

description.fr: Il a subi une mise à jour censée lui permettre d’explorer d’autres planètes... C’est un échec.
description.en: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
description.es: La investigación mejoró sus habilidades. A veces, puede actuar de forma no programada.
description.de: Seine Fähigkeiten wurden verbessert. Es zeigt manchmal sogar Handlungen, die nicht einprogrammiert sind.
description.it: Ricerche avanzate hanno potenziato le sue capacità. Ora può fare movimenti che non erano programmati.
description.pt-BR: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
description.ru: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
description.ja: さらに　研究が　進められ 能力が　高まった。ときどき プログラムにない　仕草を　見せる。

description.fr: Quiconque observe ses antennes ressent une sensation étrange, comme si leur centre l’attirait.
description.en: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
description.es: Mirar a su cornamenta provoca una extraña sensación de pérdida de equilibrio.
description.de: Starrt man auf sein Geweih, bekommt man das seltsame Gefühl, in dessen Mitte gezogen zu werden.
description.it: Chi fissa le sue corna riceve una strana sensazione, quasi come se venisse risucchiato.
description.pt-BR: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
description.ru: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
description.ja: ツノを　見つめていると　輪っかの 中心に　吸いこまれそうな 不思議な　気分に　なってしまう。

description.fr: Il marque son territoire en maniant sa queue comme un pinceau. On dénombre plus de 5 000 marques.
description.en: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
description.es: Marca su territorio usando su cola a modo de pincel. Ha hecho más de 5000 marcas diferentes.
description.de: Sein Revier markiert es mit seinem pinselartigen Schweif. Es kennt mehr als 5 000 Markierungen.
description.it: Delimita il suo territorio usando la coda come se fosse un pennello. Ha lasciato oltre 5000 segni diversi.
description.pt-BR: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
description.ru: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
description.ja: 尻尾を　筆のように　使って 縄張りを　マークで　描く。 その　種類は　５０００以上。

description.fr: Il est réputé pour sa combativité. Il se blesse toujours en défiant des ennemis plus grands.
description.en: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description.es: Ataca siempre con mucha energía. Para fortalecerse a sí mismo, sigue luchando aunque pierda.
description.de: Es strotzt vor Energie. Um noch stärker zu werden, kämpft es weiter, auch wenn es verloren hat.
description.it: Sempre traboccante di energia. Per rinforzarsi continua a combattere anche dopo aver perso.
description.pt-BR: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description.ru: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
description.ja: いつでも　元気いっぱい。 強くなるため　負けても　負けても 相手に　立ち向かっていく。

description.fr: Il combat en tournoyant comme une toupie. La force centrifuge décuple sa puissance destructrice.
description.en: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
description.es: Gira a gran velocidad al luchar. La fuerza centrífuga multiplica su poder de destrucción por diez.
description.de: Es kämpft, während es sich wie ein Kreisel dreht. Die Zentrifugalkraft verzehnfacht seine Kampfkraft.
description.it: Combatte mentre gira come una trottola. La forza centrifuga decuplica il suo potere distruttivo.
description.pt-BR: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
description.ru: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
description.ja: コマのように　回転しながら　戦う。 遠心力の　パワーで 破壊力は　１０倍だ。

description.fr: Il goûte à tout du bout des lèvres. Elles gardent en mémoire ses goûts et ses dégoûts.
description.en: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
description.es: Sus labios son la parte más sensible de su cuerpo. Siempre los usa para examinar las cosas.
description.de: Die Lippen sind sein empfindlichster Körperteil. Neue Dinge untersucht es zuerst damit.
description.it: Le labbra sono la parte più sensibile del corpo, il primo organo con cui analizza nuovi oggetti.
description.pt-BR: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
description.ru: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
description.ja: 唇が　一番　敏感。 なんでも　まず　唇で　触れて どんなものか　確認する。

description.fr: Un faible courant électrique circule entre ses cornes. Attention à ne pas y mettre la main!
description.en: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
description.es: Genera electricidad girando los brazos. No obstante, es incapaz de almacenar la energía creada.
description.de: Es bewegt seine Arme und generiert damit Elektrizität. Diese kann es aber nicht speichern.
description.it: Genera elettricità roteando le braccia. Tuttavia, non riesce a immagazzinare l’energia creata.
description.pt-BR: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
description.ru: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
description.ja: 両腕を　ぐるぐる　振り回して 電気を　発生させる。しかし 作った　電気は　ためておけない。

description.fr: Son sang est chaud comme du magma et la température de son corps peut atteindre 600 °C.
description.en: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
description.es: Es pequeño, pero su cuerpo puede llegar a alcanzar 600 °C. Cuando inspira y espira, expulsa llamas por la nariz y por la boca.
description.de: Seine Körpertemperatur misst 600 °C. Beim Ein- und Ausatmen springen glühende Kohlenstücke aus seinem Mund.
description.it: È di piccole dimensioni, ma la temperatura del suo corpo è di 600 °C. Quando respira emette scintille da naso e bocca.
description.pt-BR: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
description.ru: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
description.ja: 小柄だが　体温は　６００度。 息を　吸ったり　吐いたりするたび 口と　鼻から　火の粉が　漏れる。

description.fr: On raconte que les enfants élevés au lait d’Écrémeuh deviennent des adultes braves et robustes.
description.en: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
description.es: Si tiene crías, la leche que produce contiene muchos más nutrientes de lo normal.
description.de: Wenn es gerade ein Junges hat, dann enthält seine Milch mehr Nährstoffe als gewöhnlich.
description.it: Se ha appena avuto un piccolo, il latte che produce è molto più nutriente del normale.
description.pt-BR: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
description.ru: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
description.ja: 子供が　生まれたときに しぼられた　ミルクには　いつもより 栄養が　たっぷり　つまっている。

description.fr: Les œufs que pond Leuphorie sont un concentré de bonheur dont une bouchée suffit à apporter la joie.
description.en: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
description.es: Los huevos que pone están llenos de felicidad. Solo con probar un poquito de uno, cualquiera sonríe.
description.de: Eier, die es legt, stecken voller Fröhlichkeit. Schon ein Bissen erzeugt ein breites Lächeln.
description.it: Le uova che depone sono piene di felicità. Un assaggio rende chiunque allegro.
description.pt-BR: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
description.ru: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
description.ja: ハピナスの　産む　タマゴには 幸せが　つまっていて　ひとくち 食べると　だれでも　笑顔になれる。

description.fr: On prétend qu’il est tombé avec la foudre. Il peut lancer des éclairs grâce aux nuages sur son dos.
description.en: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description.es: Las nubes de lluvia que lleva le permiten lanzar rayos a voluntad. Dicen que apareció con un rayo.
description.de: Die Regenwolken, die es trägt, ermöglichen es ihm, Gewitter zu erzeugen. Es strotzt vor Blitzen.
description.it: Grazie alle nubi di pioggia che ha con sé lancia fulmini a volontà. Pare che sia arrivato con un lampo.
description.pt-BR: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description.ru: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
description.ja: 雨雲を　背負っているので どんなときでも　雷を　出せる。 雷とともに　落ちてきたという。

description.fr: On raconte qu’à chaque fois qu’il rugit, un volcan entre en éruption quelque part.
description.en: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
description.es: Un Pokémon que corre por la tierra. Dicen que siempre nace uno cuando aparece un nuevo volcán.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon jagt über das Land. Man sagt, in jedem neuen Vulkan wird ein Entei geboren.
description.it: Un Pokémon che corre in lungo e in largo. Si dice che nasca ogni volta che si forma un nuovo vulcano.
description.pt-BR: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
description.ru: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
description.ja: 新しい　火山が　できるたび 生まれてくると　伝えられる 大地を　駆け巡る　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il parcourt le vaste monde pour purifier les eaux polluées. Il accompagne le vent du nord.
description.en: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
description.es: Recorre el mundo para purificar agua contaminada. Corre veloz con el viento del norte.
description.de: Es wandert beständig in der Welt herum, um verunreinigtes Wasser zu reinigen. Es zieht mit dem Nordwind.
description.it: Corre per tutto il mondo per purificare l’acqua contaminata. Si allontana con i venti del nord.
description.pt-BR: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
description.ru: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
description.ja: 世界中を　駆け巡り 汚れた　水を　清めている。 北風と　ともに　走り去る。

description.fr: Un Pokémon qui se nourrit de terre. Après avoir dévoré une montagne, il s’endort pour grandir.
description.en: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
description.es: Se alimenta de tierra. Después de comer una gran montaña, se duerme y empieza a crecer.
description.de: Es ernährt sich von Erde. Nachdem es einen Berg verspeist hat, schläft es ein, um zu wachsen.
description.it: Si nutre di terra. Dopo aver divorato una montagna intera, si addormenta per poter crescere.
description.pt-BR: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
description.ru: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
description.ja: 土を　食べて　生きている。 大きな　山ひとつ　食べ終わると 成長のため　眠りはじめる。

description.fr: Son corps est dur comme la pierre souterraine. Il file comme une fusée en expulsant des gaz.
description.en: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
description.es: Su cuerpo es duro como la roca. Se autopropulsa como un cohete soltando los gases de su interior.
description.de: Sein Körper ist hart wie Fels. Es lässt mit Hochdruck Gas ab, um wie eine Rakete nach oben zu schießen.
description.it: Il suo corpo è duro come la roccia. Riesce a muoversi come un razzo espellendo gas con tutta la sua forza.
description.pt-BR: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
description.ru: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
description.ja: 岩盤のような　硬い　体。 圧縮した　ガスを　噴射して まるで　ロケットのように　飛び出す。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il est en colère, il abat des montagnes et enterre des fleuves. On doit alors modifier les cartes.
description.en: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
description.es: En una de sus poderosas garras tiene el poder de hacer temblar la tierra y las montañas.
description.de: Es besitzt so viel Kraft, dass es mit nur einer Hand die Erde beben lassen und Berge zerbröckeln kann.
description.it: Anche una sola delle sue mani può far tremare la terra e sbriciolare le montagne.
description.pt-BR: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
description.ru: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
description.ja: 片腕を　動かしただけで 山を崩し　地響きを　起こす とてつもない　パワーを　秘める。

description.fr: Il dort dans une faille des grands fonds. Ses battements d’ailes génèrent une tempête de 40 jours.
description.en: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
description.es: Duerme en una dorsal marina. Si bate sus alas, puede causar tormentas de 40 días.
description.de: Es schläft in einem Tiefseegraben. Schwingt es seine Flügel, entsteht ein Sturm, der 40 Tage dauert.
description.it: Dorme in una fossa negli abissi marini. Con un battito d’ali provoca una tempesta di 40 giorni.
description.pt-BR: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
description.ru: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
description.ja: 深い　海溝の　底で　眠る。 ルギアが　羽ばたくと　４０日 嵐が　続くと　言われている。

description.fr: Ses plumes possèdent sept couleurs. On prétend que sa vue apporte la joie éternelle.
description.en: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
description.es: Cuenta la leyenda que brilla en siete colores. Dicen que deja un arcoíris tras de sí al volar.
description.de: Sein Körper soll in sieben Farben leuchten. Im Flug zieht es einen Regenbogen hinter sich her.
description.it: Narra la leggenda che il suo corpo brilli di sette colori. Volando lascia un arcobaleno dietro di sé.
description.pt-BR: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
description.ru: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
description.ja: 体は　七色に　輝き 飛んだあとは　虹が　できると 神話に　残されている　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il a le pouvoir de voyager dans le temps. Cependant, on dit qu’il n’apparaît qu’en temps de paix.
description.en: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description.es: Este Pokémon vaga por el tiempo. La hierba y los árboles crecen por los campos por donde pasa.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon reist durch Zeit und Raum. Bäume und Wiesen wuchern, wenn es in der Nähe ist.
description.it: Questo Pokémon viaggia attraverso il tempo. Le foreste in cui appare prosperano rigogliose.
description.pt-BR: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description.ru: This POKéMON wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
description.ja: 時間を超えて　あちこち　さまよう。 セレビィが　姿を　現した　森は 草木が　生い茂るという。

description.fr: Ses plantes de pieds sont couvertes d’épines lui permettant de marcher au mur et au plafond.
description.en: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
description.es: Escala superficies verticales muy rápido. Con la cola detecta la humedad y prevé el tiempo que va a hacer.
description.de: Es klettert blitzschnell Wände empor. Mit seinem Schwanz misst es die Luftfeuchtigkeit, um das Wetter am nächsten Tag vorherzusagen.
description.it: Riesce a scalare rapidamente anche pareti verticali. Rileva l’umidità attraverso la coda per prevedere il tempo dell’indomani.
description.pt-BR: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
description.ru: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
description.ja: 垂直の　壁も　すいすい　登る。 尻尾で　空気の　湿度を　感じ 明日の　天気を　当てる。

description.fr: Il vit dans les jungles denses. Il saute de branche en branche pour approcher de sa proie.
description.en: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
description.es: Los desarrollados músculos que tiene en las extremidades inferiores le hacen ser muy ágil y le permiten dar grandes saltos.
description.de: Seine stark entwickelten Oberschenkelmuskeln verleihen ihm außergewöhnliche Agilität und Sprungkraft.
description.it: I muscoli delle zampe estremamente sviluppati gli permettono di saltare fino a grandi altezze.
description.pt-BR: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
description.ru: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
description.ja: 発達した　太ももの　筋肉が 驚異的な　瞬発力と 跳躍力を　生み出すぞ。

description.fr: Les feuilles sur ses bras peuvent trancher des troncs épais. C’est le meilleur combattant des jungles.
description.en: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
description.es: Las hojas de sus brazos pueden cortar gruesos árboles. Invencible en los combates en la jungla.
description.de: Die Blätter an seinen Armen können dicke Bäume fällen. Im Dschungelkampf gibt es kein stärkeres Pokémon.
description.it: Le foglie che crescono sulle sue braccia tagliano anche grandi alberi. Nel suo habitat, è imbattibile.
description.pt-BR: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
description.ru: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
description.ja: 腕に　生えた　葉っぱは　大木も スッパリ　切り倒す　切れ味。 密林の　戦いでは　無敵。

description.fr: Ses câlins réchauffent car il renferme une fournaise. Il envoie des boules de feu à 1 000 °C.
description.en: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
description.es: En su interior, guarda una llama que arde sin cesar. Si se le abraza, se nota que tiene una temperatura muy alta.
description.de: In seinem Bauch ist ein Flammensack, der stets brennt. Umarmt man es, fühlt es sich warm an.
description.it: Nel ventre ha una sacca di fuoco che brucia in continuazione. Se lo si abbraccia, emana calore.
description.pt-BR: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
description.ru: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
description.ja: お腹に　炎袋を　持つ。 抱きしめると　ぽかぽか　温かい。 命ある　限り　燃え続ける。

description.fr: Ce maître du coup de pied peut donner 10 coups par seconde. Ses cris aigus intimident l’ennemi.
description.en: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
description.es: Su habilidad le permite dar diez patadas por segundo. Lanza potentes gritos para intimidar.
description.de: Es kann zehn Tritte pro Sekunde austeilen. Es gibt schrille Schreie von sich, um Gegner einzuschüchtern.
description.it: Possiede l’abilità di sferrare anche dieci calci al secondo. Emette urla strazianti per intimorire i nemici.
description.pt-BR: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
description.ru: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
description.ja: １秒間に　キックを　１０発 繰り出す　足技の　持ち主。 鋭い　鳴き声で　威嚇する。

description.fr: Des flammes fusent de ses poignets et ses coups brûlent l’ennemi.
description.en: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
description.es: Puede saltar edificios de 30 plantas. Con sus golpes de fuego quema a sus rivales.
description.de: Mühelos springt es selbst über 30-stöckige Häuser. Sein Feuerschlag fügt dem Gegner Verbrennungen zu.
description.it: Riesce a superare un edificio di 30 piani con un salto. I suoi pugni di fuoco inceneriscono il nemico.
description.pt-BR: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
description.ru: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
description.ja: ３０階建ての　ビルを　ジャンプで 跳び越す　跳躍力。炎の　パンチが 相手を　焼きつくす。

description.fr: Il analyse le courant grâce à la nageoire sur sa tête. Il est assez fort pour soulever des rochers.
description.en: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
description.es: Tiene una larga cola que le propulsa por el agua con mucha potencia. A pesar de ser pequeño, tiene mucha fuerza.
description.de: Durch den propellerartigen Einsatz seiner großen Schwanzflosse schwimmt es schnell durchs Wasser. Trotz seiner kleinen Größe ist es stark.
description.it: La grande pinna sulla coda gli conferisce una straordinaria accelerazione in acqua. È minuto, ma forte.
description.pt-BR: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
description.ru: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
description.ja: 大きな　尾びれで　水を　かけば ぐんぐん　スピードが　上がる。 小さい　体でも　力持ち。

description.fr: Ses jambes robustes lui donnent un bon appui, même dans la boue. Il dort enfoui dans la saleté.
description.en: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
description.es: Sus piernas robustas impiden que pierda el equilibrio y caiga, incluso en el barro. Duerme bajo la arena.
description.de: Seine kräftigen Beine geben ihm sicheren Halt. Es gräbt sich in Dreck ein, wenn es schlafen will.
description.it: Grazie alle zampe vigorose, si muove con disinvoltura anche nel fango. Dorme immerso nella melma.
description.pt-BR: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
description.ru: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
description.ja: ぬかるんだ　足場でも　しっかり 歩ける　丈夫な　足腰。 泥に　体を　埋めて　眠る。

description.fr: Il peut traîner un grand bateau en nageant. Il assomme l’ennemi d’un grand coup de ses bras épais.
description.en: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
description.es: Con sus brazos duros como el acero puede partir rocas gigantescas en mil pedazos de un solo golpe.
description.de: Schon ein Hieb seiner steinharten Arme schlägt selbst den stärksten Felsen zu Bruch.
description.it: Ha braccia dure come roccia, capaci di frantumare in mille pezzi un masso con un colpo solo.
description.pt-BR: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
description.ru: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
description.ja: 岩の　ように　硬い　腕を 一振り　するだけで　巨大な　岩を コナゴナに　砕くぞ。

description.fr: Un Pokémon très obstiné qui poursuit sa proie jusqu’à ce qu’elle soit épuisée.
description.en: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
description.es: Es muy persistente. Si se fija en una presa, no la dejará hasta que caiga agotada.
description.de: Ein beharrliches Pokémon, das seine Beute jagt, bis diese erschöpft ist.
description.it: Pokémon di natura ostinata. Insegue la preda prescelta finché questa non è esausta.
description.pt-BR: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
description.ru: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
description.ja: しつこい　性格の　ポケモン。 目をつけた　獲物が　ヘトヘトに 疲れるまで　追いかけ回す。

description.fr: Il traque ses proies en groupe. Il ne désobéira jamais aux ordres d’un bon Dresseur.
description.en: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
description.es: Siempre obedece a los buenos Entrenadores. Está acostumbrado a vivir en jaurías en estado salvaje.
description.de: Es wird stets die Befehle eines begabten Trainers befolgen. Dieses Verhalten geht darauf zurück, dass es früher im Rudel lebte.
description.it: La sua eccezionale obbedienza verso gli Allenatori esperti deriva dall’antica abitudine di vivere in branchi.
description.pt-BR: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
description.ru: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
description.ja: 優れた　トレーナーの　命令には 絶対に　服従。大昔に 群れで　行動していた　名残り。

description.fr: Il marche en zigzaguant et n’a pas son pareil pour trouver des objets dans l’herbe ou sous terre.
description.en: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
description.es: Se mueve en zigzag. Se le da bien encontrar objetos ocultos en la hierba e incluso enterrados.
description.de: Es läuft im Zickzack. Es hat das Talent, Items im Gras, aber auch im Boden, zu finden.
description.it: Avanza a zigzag. È bravo a trovare strumenti nell’erba e sul terreno.
description.pt-BR: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
description.ru: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
description.ja: ジグザグに　歩いて　草陰や 地面に　埋まっている　宝物を 見つけるのが　得意な　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il fonce sur sa proie à plus de 100 km/h. Mais il ne peut pas dévier sa course et loupe souvent sa cible.
description.en: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
description.es: En línea recta corre a algo más de 100 km/h, pero no es tan hábil si hay curvas de por medio.
description.de: Auf gerader Strecke erreicht es mühelos 100 km/h. Nur die Kurven bereiten ihm große Schwierigkeiten.
description.it: Quando corre in rettilineo può raggiungere i 100 km/h, ma le curve non sono il suo forte.
description.pt-BR: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
description.ru: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
description.ja: まっすぐ　走る　スピードは 時速１００キロを　軽く　超える。 曲がった　道は　とても　苦手。

description.fr: Cible favorite des Pokémon Oiseaux, il tente de se protéger avec ses épines venimeuses.
description.en: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
description.es: Le encanta comer hojas. Si le ataca un Starly, se defenderá con sus púas.
description.de: Es isst am liebsten Blätter. Wird es von einem Staralili angegriffen, verteidigt es sich mit Stacheln.
description.it: Ama mangiare le foglie. Se Starly lo attacca, si difende con gli aculei che ha sulla parte posteriore.
description.pt-BR: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
description.ru: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
description.ja: 葉っぱが　大好物。 ムックルに　襲われたときは お尻の　トゲで　撃退する。

description.fr: Il attend d’évoluer dans son cocon de soie accroché aux branches et se nourrit d’eau de pluie.
description.en: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
description.es: Se agarra con su seda a las ramas de un árbol y espera su evolución bebiendo agua de lluvia.
description.de: Es bindet sich mit Seide an Äste und trinkt Regenwasser, während es starr auf seine Entwicklung wartet.
description.it: Si appende ai rami con fili di seta. Aspetta l’evoluzione bevendo l’acqua piovana che si posa sulla seta.
description.pt-BR: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
description.ru: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
description.ja: 糸を　木の枝に　巻きつけている。 糸についた　雨水を　飲みながら 進化の　ときを　待っている。

description.fr: Malgré les apparences, il est très agressif et attaque avec sa trompe quand on le dérange.
description.en: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
description.es: Los dibujos de sus coloridas alas son muy peculiares. Liba el néctar de las flores con su fina trompa.
description.de: Die bunten Flügel sind sein Markenzeichen. Mit seinem Rüssel saugt es süßen Honig aus Blumen.
description.it: Sulle ali ha splendidi, vividi colori. Succhia il dolce polline dai fiori allungando la bocca sottile.
description.pt-BR: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
description.ru: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
description.ja: 色　鮮やかな　羽の　模様が　特徴。 細い　口を　伸ばして 花の　甘い　ミツを　吸い取る。

description.fr: Rancunier, il n’oublie aucune des attaques subies dans le cocon et se venge une fois qu’il a évolué.
description.en: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
description.es: Está formado por seda que se endurece poco a poco. Si se resquebraja el capullo, está a punto de evolucionar.
description.de: Sein aus weicher Seide bestehender Körper erhärtet mit der Zeit. Sobald Risse sichtbar sind, steht die Entwicklung kurz bevor.
description.it: Il corpo di soffice seta si indurisce nel corso del tempo. Quando appaiono crepe, l’evoluzione è vicina.
description.pt-BR: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
description.ru: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
description.ja: やわらかい　糸で　できた　体は 時間と　ともに　硬くなっていく。 ひび割れると　進化は　間近だ。

description.fr: Il disperse un nuage de poudre toxique à chaque coup d’aile. Il aime les feuilles d’arbres urbains.
description.en: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
description.es: Pokémon nocturno. Atraído por las luces de la ciudad, se come las hojas y arbustos de las avenidas.
description.de: Nachtaktives Pokémon, das vom Licht der Stadt angezogen wird und dort die Blätter der Bäume frisst.
description.it: Pokémon notturno. Attirato dalla luce dei lampioni, divora le foglie degli alberi lungo i viali.
description.pt-BR: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
description.ru: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
description.ja: 夜行性の　ポケモン。 明かりに　誘われた　ドクケイルが 街路樹の　葉を　食い散らかす。

description.fr: Il ressemble à une plante aquatique et fait la navette pour les Pokémon qui ne savent pas nager.
description.en: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
description.es: Parece una planta acuática. Hace de ferry para los Pokémon que no saben nadar.
description.de: Es sieht aus wie eine Wasserpflanze. Es dient den Pokémon, die nicht schwimmen können, als Fähre.
description.it: Sembra una pianta acquatica e viene usato come traghetto dai Pokémon che non sanno nuotare.
description.pt-BR: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
description.ru: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
description.ja: 水草に　そっくりな　ポケモン。 泳げない　ポケモンを　葉っぱに 乗せて　向こう岸まで　運ぶ。

description.fr: C’est un mauvais plaisantin. Quand il repère un pêcheur, il tire sur sa ligne pour le déranger.
description.en: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
description.es: Vive en el agua y, cuando hace sol, se queda en la orilla. De día duerme sobre las algas y de noche entra en acción.
description.de: Es lebt am Ufer, wo die Sonne scheint. Tagsüber schläft es in einem Bett aus Schilf und wird nachts aktiv.
description.it: Vive in riva a specchi d’acqua, in aree soleggiate. Di giorno dorme su di un letto di alghe, mentre la notte è attivo.
description.pt-BR: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
description.ru: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
description.ja: 日当たりの　良い　水辺に　住む。 昼間は　水草の　ベッドで　眠り 日が　暮れると　動き出す。

description.fr: Ses muscles se tonifient au son d’une musique entraînante. Il ne peut pas s’empêcher de danser.
description.en: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
description.es: Cuando oye música alegre, sus músculos se llenan de energía, y no puede evitar ponerse a bailar.
description.de: Hört es fröhliche Musik, füllen sich seine Muskeln mit Energie. Es muss dann einfach tanzen.
description.it: Se ascolta musica allegra, tutto il suo corpo si rivitalizza e non riesce a evitare di ballare.
description.pt-BR: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
description.ru: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
description.ja: 陽気な　音楽を　聴くと 体中に　力が　みなぎり 踊らずには　いられなくなるのだ。

description.fr: Il ressemble à un gland pendu à une branche. Il adore effrayer les autres Pokémon.
description.en: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
description.es: Se cuelga de las ramas con el extremo de su cabeza. A veces se cae cuando soplan vientos fuertes.
description.de: Mit dem Stiel auf seinem Kopf hängt es sich an Äste. Bei starkem Wind fällt es durchaus einmal herunter.
description.it: Si attacca ai rami degli alberi usando il picciolo che ha sul capo. Talvolta il vento lo fa cadere.
description.pt-BR: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
description.ru: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
description.ja: 頭の　先を　枝に　くっつけて ぶら下がる。強風に　あおられ 落ちてしまう　ことも　あるのだ。

description.fr: Le son de sa flûte d’herbe déstabilise l’auditeur. Il vit au plus profond des forêts.
description.en: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
description.es: Cuando usa la hoja de su cabeza como flauta, asusta a la gente. Vive en lo más profundo de los bosques.
description.de: Der Ton seiner Grasflöte beunruhigt die, die ihn hören. Es lebt tief in den Wäldern.
description.it: Il fischio del suo flauto di foglia mette a disagio chi lo sente. Vive nelle foreste più fitte.
description.pt-BR: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
description.ru: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
description.ja: コノハナが　奏でる　草笛の　音色は 人を　不安にさせる。 森の　奥に　住んでいる。

description.fr: D’un coup de sa feuille éventail, il génère des bourrasques de 30 m/s capables de souffler une maison.
description.en: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
description.es: Habita los bosques y se le tiene miedo. Es capaz de leer los pensamientos del rival y actuar en consecuencia.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon wurde als Wächter des Waldes gefürchtet. Es kann die Gedanken des Gegners lesen und präventiv handeln.
description.it: Un tempo era un temuto guardiano della foresta. Sa leggere nella mente del nemico, anticipandolo.
description.pt-BR: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
description.ru: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
