description.ja: 森の　神様と　恐れられていた ポケモン。相手の　考えを　読み 先回りする　能力を　持つ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon téméraire n’a pas peur d’affronter des ennemis puissants. Il vole en quête de climats chauds.
description.en: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
description.es: Es un Pokémon valiente que no teme a los rivales fuertes. Vuela en busca de climas templados.
description.de: Es ist sehr mutig und stellt sich auch starken Gegnern. Es sucht ständig nach warmen Regionen.
description.it: È molto coraggioso e affronta spavaldo i nemici più forti. Migra verso i paesi caldi.
description.pt-BR: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
description.ru: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
description.ja: 強い　相手にも　勇敢に 立ち向かう　根性の　持ち主。 暖かい　土地を　目指して　飛ぶ。

description.fr: Il vole en cercle en quête d’une proie. Dès qu’il l’a repérée, il fond sur elle en un éclair.
description.en: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
description.es: Cuando se encuentra bien, pone firmes las plumas de la cola doble que tiene. Remonta el vuelo de forma muy elegante.
description.de: Wenn seine beiden Schwanzfedern aufrecht stehen, zeigt das, dass es bei bester Gesundheit ist. Es fliegt elegant in den Himmel empor.
description.it: Se le due penne sulla coda sono ritte, significa che è in buona salute. Si libra elegantemente nel cielo.
description.pt-BR: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
description.ru: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
description.ja: ２本の　尾羽が　ピンと　立って いれば　健康な　証拠。 優雅に　大空を　飛び回る。

description.fr: Il utilise les courants ascendants pour planer en altitude. Son bec lui sert à transporter la nourriture.
description.en: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
description.es: Sus largas alas aprovechan los vientos marinos para planear. Cuando descansa, las pliega.
description.de: Es lässt sich vom Wind der Meere treiben, als wäre es ein Segelflugzeug.
description.it: Segue i venti marini con le sue lunghe ali e si libra in volo come un aliante. Si riposa piegando le ali.
description.pt-BR: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
description.ru: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This POKéMON rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
description.ja: 長い　翼で　海風を　受けて グライダーのように　滑空する。 休むときは　翼を　折り畳む。

description.fr: Ce messager du ciel transporte petits Pokémon et œufs dans son bec en toute sécurité.
description.en: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
description.es: Hunde su gran pico en el mar para sacar numerosas presas junto con mucha agua.
description.de: Es taucht seinen großen Schnabel ins Wasser und fängt so eine Menge Beute.
description.it: Immerge il suo enorme becco nel mare, raccogliendo acqua e numerose prede.
description.pt-BR: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
description.ru: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON and eggs inside its massive bill. This POKéMON builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
description.ja: 大きな　クチバシを　海に　入れて ひとすくいすると　エサが　たくさん 入っているという　寸法だ。

description.fr: Quand ses cornes captent les ondes positives d’un Pokémon ou d’un humain, son corps se réchauffe.
description.en: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
description.es: Si sus cuernos perciben emociones positivas de personas o Pokémon, su cuerpo se calienta un poco.
description.de: Es erfasst warme Gefühle von Menschen und Pokémon mit seinen Hörnern und wärmt sich daran auf.
description.it: Se con le corna avverte emozioni positive di persone o Pokémon, il suo corpo si scalda leggermente.
description.pt-BR: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
description.ru: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
description.ja: 赤いツノで　人や　ポケモンの 温かな　気持ちを　キャッチすると 全身が　ほのかに　熱くなる。

description.fr: Quand il sent la joie de son Dresseur, il se met à danser, débordant d’énergie.
description.en: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
description.es: Al percibir la alegría de su Entrenador refuerza sus ataques psicoquinéticos. Cuando está contento, da vueltas y baila.
description.de: Die fröhliche Stimmung seines Trainers verleiht ihm Energie für psychokinetische Kraft. Wenn es glücklich ist, tanzt und dreht es sich.
description.it: Lo spirito gioioso è alla base dei suoi poteri psicocinetici. Quando è felice si lancia in danze e piroette.
description.pt-BR: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
description.ru: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
description.ja: トレーナーの　明るい　気持ちが サイコパワーの　源。楽しい 気分に　なると　クルクル　踊る。

description.fr: Prêt à tout pour protéger son Dresseur, il peut créer un mini trou noir par sa seule force mentale.
description.en: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
description.es: Para proteger a su Entrenador, emplea todo su poder psíquico en crear un pequeño agujero negro.
description.de: Erzeugt ein kleines schwarzes Loch mithilfe all seiner Psycho-Kräfte, um seinen Trainer zu schützen.
description.it: Quando il suo Allenatore è in pericolo usa tutto il suo potere psichico per creare un piccolo buco nero.
description.pt-BR: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
description.ru: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
description.ja: トレーナーを　守るためなら サイコパワーを　使いきり　小さな ブラックホールを　作り出す。

description.fr: Il semble patiner sur l’eau. Le parfum diffusé par le sommet de sa tête sert à attirer ses proies.
description.en: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
description.es: Vive en estanques, pero cuando se desata una tormenta puede aparecer en los charcos que se forman en las ciudades.
description.de: Normalerweise leben sie in Teichen, aber nach einem Schauer am Abend kann man sie auch in Pfützen in den Städten finden.
description.it: Normalmente vivono negli stagni, ma dopo un acquazzone è possibile trovarli anche in città, nelle pozzanghere.
description.pt-BR: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
description.ru: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
description.ja: 普段は　池に　住んでいるが 夕立の　後には　街中の 水たまりに　姿を　現す。

description.fr: Des motifs en forme d’yeux ornent ses antennes. Ses 4 ailes l’aident à voler dans toutes les directions.
description.en: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
description.es: Sus antenas tienen dibujos de ojos, mientras que sus alas le permiten volar en cualquier dirección.
description.de: Seine Antenne besitzt ein Augenmuster. Seine vier Flügel erlauben es, in alle Richtungen zu fliegen.
description.it: Le sue antenne presentano un motivo a occhi. Con le quattro ali riesce a volare in ogni direzione.
description.pt-BR: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
description.ru: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
description.ja: 目玉模様の　触角を　持つ。 ４枚の　羽で　浮かび上がり 前後左右に　動くことができる。

description.fr: Le sommet de sa tête libère des spores empoisonnées. Il est dangereux de les inhaler.
description.en: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
description.es: Prefiere los sitios húmedos. De día está tranquilamente en el bosque, a la sombra. Expulsa polvo tóxico por la cabeza.
description.de: Es bevorzugt feuchte Orte. Am Tag sitzt es regungslos im Schatten des Waldes. Von seinem Kopf sondert es einen giftigen Puder ab.
description.it: Predilige le aree umide. Di giorno resta immobile nell’ombra della foresta. Dal capo rilascia polvere tossica.
description.pt-BR: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
description.ru: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
description.ja: 湿った　場所を　好み　昼間は 森の　木陰で　じっと　している。 頭から　毒の　粉を　出す。

description.fr: Ses petits bras s’étendent quand il donne un coup de poing. Son talent égale celui d’un boxeur pro.
description.en: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
description.es: Sus cortos brazos se expanden cuando da puñetazos. Tiene una técnica pugilística muy depurada.
description.de: Seine kurzen Arme dehnen sich aus, wenn es zuschlägt. Seine Technik ähnelt der von Profi-Boxern.
description.it: Tirando pugni, i suoi cortissimi arti si allungano. Usa una tecnica simile a quella dei pugili professionisti.
description.pt-BR: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
description.ru: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
description.ja: 短い　腕は　パンチを　出すとき グーンと　伸びる。プロボクサー 顔負けの　テクニックを　持つ。

description.fr: Il passe le plus clair de son temps affalé. Rien qu’à le voir, on a envie de bâiller.
description.en: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
description.es: Slakoth se pasa todo el día holgazaneando y solo con verlo a uno le entra mucha pereza.
description.de: Allein bei Bummelz’ Anblick werden Gegner von Trägheit gepackt und schlummern alsbald ein.
description.it: Coloro che osservano Slakoth, perdono la voglia di muoversi e vengono colti da sonnolenza.
description.pt-BR: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
description.ru: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
description.ja: ナマケロの　怠けた　様子は 見ている　人の　怠け心を 存分に　刺激するのだ。

description.fr: Son cœur bat dix fois plus vite que la normale, c’est pourquoi il ne tient pas en place.
description.en: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
description.es: Su corazón palpita a un ritmo frenético, haciendo que su sangre bulla, así que no puede estarse quieto ni un segundo.
description.de: Sein Puls ist konstant so hoch, dass sein Blut immer in Wallung ist und es keine Sekunde stillhalten kann.
description.it: I battiti del suo cuore sono rapidissimi e il suo sangue scorre con tale impeto che non riesce a stare fermo un istante.
description.pt-BR: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
description.ru: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
description.ja: 心臓の　鼓動が　速く 全身の　血が　たぎっているため １秒も　じっと　していられない。

description.fr: Le Pokémon le plus fainéant du monde. Il s’allonge pour économiser ses forces et contre-attaquer.
description.en: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
description.es: El Pokémon más perezoso del mundo. Cambia de lugar para coger la comida al alcance de su mano.
description.de: Das faulste Pokémon der Welt. Es bewegt sich nur, wenn alles Essbare in Reichweite verputzt ist.
description.it: Il più pigro Pokémon del mondo. Si sposta solo quando non ha più cibo a portata di mano.
description.pt-BR: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
description.ru: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
description.ja: 世界一　ぐうたらな　ポケモン。 手が　届く　範囲の　エサを 食べつくすと　居場所を　替える。

description.fr: Il grandit sous terre et se repère grâce à ses antennes car ses yeux sont quasiment aveugles.
description.en: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
description.es: Como se ha pasado casi toda la vida viviendo bajo tierra, no ve bien. Las antenas que tiene le ayudan a orientarse.
description.de: Da es fast sein gesamtes Leben unter der Erde verbracht hat, ist es nahezu blind. Es setzt daher als Augenersatz seine Fühler ein.
description.it: Poiché passa quasi tutta l’esistenza sottoterra, è quasi cieco. Usa le antenne per orientarsi.
description.pt-BR: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
description.ru: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
description.ja: 長い　あいだ　地中で　暮らして いたため　目は　ほとんど　見えない。 触覚で　様子を　探る。

description.fr: Il bouge si vite que l’œil a parfois du mal à le suivre. Ils se regroupent près de la sève des arbres.
description.en: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
description.es: Escuchar su zumbido de forma continuada provoca jaquecas. Casi no se le ve de lo rápido que es.
description.de: Sein Gesang erzeugt unausweichlich Kopfweh. Es bewegt sich so schnell, dass es beinah unsichtbar zu sein scheint.
description.it: I suoi continui lamenti provocano atroci emicranie. Si sposta così velocemente che... non si vede!
description.pt-BR: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
description.ru: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
description.ja: 鳴き声を　聞き続けると 頭痛が　治まらなくなる。 見えない　ほどの　速さで　動く。

description.fr: Une carapace d’insecte laissée à l’abandon. On dit qu’il vole l’âme de celui qui regarde à l’intérieur.
description.en: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
description.es: Es el caparazón de un bicho que cobró vida. Si alguien lo mira por la espalda, le robará el alma.
description.de: Ein weggeworfener Käferpanzer, der zum Leben erwachte. Schaut man hinein, stiehlt es einem die Seele.
description.it: È nato dal guscio vuoto di un insetto. Pare che chi spia nella fessura sul suo dorso perda l’anima.
description.pt-BR: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
description.ru: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
description.ja: 抜け殻が　魂を　宿した。 背中の　すきまから　のぞきこむと 魂を　吸われてしまうらしい。

description.fr: En temps normal, son cri est pareil à un murmure. Effrayé, il atteint le volume d’un avion à réaction.
description.en: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
description.es: Normalmente murmulla, pero cuando siente que hay peligro se pone a chillar. Solo para cuando se le cierran las orejas.
description.de: Normalerweise murmelt es, aber bei Gefahr beginnt es laut zu schreien. Es hört auf zu schreien, wenn seine Ohrmuscheln bedeckt werden.
description.it: Di solito sussurra, ma se avverte un pericolo lancia grida acute, che interrompe quando ha le orecchie chiuse.
description.pt-BR: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
description.ru: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
description.ja: 普段は　ささやき　声。危険を 察知すると　大声で　泣き出す。 耳の　蓋を　閉じると　泣きやむ。

description.fr: L’onde de choc provoquée par son cri peut renverser un camion. Il trépigne pour augmenter sa force.
description.en: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
description.es: Aspira profundamente y luego, usando sus fuertes abdominales, suelta un potente vozarrón.
description.de: Es atmet tief ein und nutzt seine Bauchmuskeln, um die Luft in einem gewaltigen Schrei auszustoßen.
description.it: Leva potenti grida inspirando tanta aria e poi sparandola fuori con tutta la forza degli addominali.
description.pt-BR: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
description.ru: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
description.ja: 思い切り　吸いこんだ　空気を 発達した　腹筋を　使って 吐き出すことで　大声を　出す。

description.fr: Son hurlement s’entend à 10 km à la ronde. Ses orifices émettent toutes sortes de bruits.
description.en: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
description.es: Su aullido se puede oír a 10 km. Emite todo tipo de sonidos desde los tubos de su cuerpo.
description.de: Sein Heulen hört man in 10 km Entfernung. Es gibt alle Arten von Geräuschen von sich.
description.it: Le sue urla si sentono a 10 km di distanza. Emette diversi suoni dalle numerose aperture del suo corpo.
description.pt-BR: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
description.ru: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
description.ja: バクオングの　遠ぼえは　１０キロ 先まで　届く。体中の　穴から さまざまな　音を　出す。

description.fr: Il fortifie son corps en fonçant sur des arbres épais. Son nid est entouré d’arbres abattus.
description.en: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
description.es: Endurece su cuerpo golpeando grandes árboles sin perder jamás el ánimo.
description.de: Indem es wieder und wieder Bäume rammt, erhält es einen zähen Körper und einen stahlharten Willen.
description.it: Sbattendo a ripetizione contro enormi alberi, si costruisce un corpo e uno spirito indistruttibili.
description.pt-BR: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
description.ru: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this POKéMON stores more energy in its body for evolving.
description.ja: 大木に　何度も　体当たりして 強靭な　体と　くじけない　心を 鍛え上げるのだ。

description.fr: Il aime mesurer sa force à celle des plus grands Pokémon. Ses coups de paume peuvent projeter un camion.
description.en: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
description.es: Para aumentar su fuerza, da un pisotón en el suelo. Puede lanzar un camión de 10 toneladas por los aires de un puñetazo.
description.de: Es stampft auf den Boden, um Energie zu generieren. Ein einziger Armschlag reicht aus, um einen 10 t schweren LKW durch die Luft zu wirbeln.
description.it: Pesta i piedi sul terreno per accumulare energia. Con uno dei suoi schiaffi può far prendere il volo a un camion di 10 t.
description.pt-BR: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
description.ru: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
description.ja: 両足で　地面を　踏み鳴らして パワーを　ためる。張り手　１発で １０トン　トラックを　吹っ飛ばす。

description.fr: Sa queue est plus rebondissante qu’une balle du même nom. C’est aussi une massue très puissante.
description.en: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
description.es: Vive cerca del agua. En la tierra se mueve muy rápido botando sobre su gran cola.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon lebt am Wasser. An Land bewegt es sich schnell, indem es auf seinem großen Schweif hüpft.
description.it: Pokémon che vive nell’acqua. Si muove rapidamente sulla terraferma saltellando sulla grossa coda.
description.pt-BR: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
description.ru: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
description.ja: 大きな　尻尾に　乗って　弾むと 地上では　速く　移動できる。 水辺で　暮らす　ポケモン。

description.fr: Face au danger, il se protège en augmentant son magnétisme et en attirant tout objet métallique.
description.en: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
description.es: Siempre apunta al norte con su nariz imantada. Con ella reviste su cuerpo de objetos metálicos para protegerse.
description.de: Es schützt sich mit Objekten aus Eisen, die es mithilfe seiner immer nach Norden zeigenden magnetischen Nase anzieht.
description.it: Rafforza le sue difese attirando su di sé gli oggetti di ferro circostanti con il suo naso magnetico che indica sempre il nord.
description.pt-BR: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
description.ru: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these POKéMON meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
description.ja: いつも　北を　向いている 磁石の　鼻で　まわりの　鉄を 引き寄せて　守りを　固めるのだ。

description.fr: Il poursuit tout ce qui bouge. On le voit parfois courir en cercle, chassant sa propre queue.
description.en: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
description.es: No puede evitar ir tras las cosas que se mueven. Hasta corre en círculos persiguiéndose la cola.
description.de: Es muss Dinge, die sich bewegen, einfach jagen. Es rennt oft im Kreis und jagt seinen eigenen Schweif.
description.it: Non riesce a evitare di inseguire tutto ciò che si muove e corre in tondo a caccia della propria coda.
description.pt-BR: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
description.ru: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
description.ja: 動くものを　つい　追ってしまう。 自分の　尻尾を　追いかけて 同じ　場所を　グルグル　回る。

description.fr: Les femmes Dresseurs raffolent de sa sublime fourrure. Il ne possède pas de nid.
description.en: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
description.es: No soporta los lugares sucios. Le encanta acicalarse el pelaje cuando está a gusto en un sitio.
description.de: Hasst schmutzige Orte. Behagt ihm ein Platz, fängt es sofort an, sein glänzendes Fell zu pflegen.
description.it: Detesta gli ambienti sporchi. Se ne sta sempre ad allisciarsi la pelliccia in luoghi accoglienti.
description.pt-BR: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
description.ru: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
description.ja: 汚い　場所が　大嫌い。 居心地の　良い　場所で いつも　毛並みを　手入れしている。

description.fr: À force de manger des gemmes, les yeux de ce Pokémon des grottes obscures sont devenus des joyaux.
description.en: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
description.es: Se oculta en cavernas oscuras. De tanto comer gemas, sus ojos son piedras preciosas.
description.de: Es versteckt sich im Dunkeln von Höhlen. Seine Augen sind Edelsteine.
description.it: Si cela nell’oscurità delle caverne. Si nutre di gemme e per questo i suoi occhi sono pietre preziose.
description.pt-BR: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
description.ru: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
description.ja: 洞窟の　暗闇に　潜む。 宝石を　食べているうちに 目が　宝石に　なってしまった。

description.fr: Ses cornes forment une grande mâchoire attachée à sa tête. Elle peut broyer des barres de fer.
description.en: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
description.es: Engaña con su aspecto dócil; hace que el rival se confíe y le da un mordisco con sus enormes e implacables mandíbulas.
description.de: Mit seinem friedlichen Gesicht bringt es Gegner zur Selbstgefälligkeit und beißt anschließend mit seinem riesigen Kiefer gnadenlos zu.
description.it: Intenerisce i nemici con la sua faccia innocente, per poi morderli con le forti e instancabili mascelle.
description.pt-BR: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
description.ru: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
description.ja: おとなしい　顔で　相手を　油断 させてから　おおあごで　がぶり。 かみつくと　絶対に　放さない。

description.fr: Il vit habituellement au cœur des montagnes. Affamé, il dévore parfois des rails et des voitures.
description.en: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
description.es: Suele vivir en lugares inaccesibles de las montañas, pero el hambre lo empuja a comer raíles y coches.
description.de: Normalerweise lebt es in dunklen Bergen. Ist es hungrig, frisst es auch Eisenbahnschienen und Autos.
description.it: Vive generalmente sui monti ma, spinto dalla fame, scende per cibarsi di binari ferroviari e automobili.
description.pt-BR: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
description.ru: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
description.ja: 普段は　山奥で　暮らしているが お腹が　すくと　ふもとに　現われ 線路や　車を　食べてしまう。

description.fr: Il se nourrit du minerai de fer qu’il fore. Il défend son territoire en chargeant avec son corps d’acier.
description.en: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
description.es: Le encanta comer hierro. Lucha por su territorio embistiendo a sus rivales con su cuerpo de acero.
description.de: Ist verrückt nach Eisenerz. Bei Revierkämpfen stoßen Stollrak einander mit ihren Stahlkörpern.
description.it: Adora i minerali di ferro. Scaglia il suo corpo d’acciaio contro gli altri nella lotta per il territorio.
description.pt-BR: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
description.ru: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
description.ja: 鉄鉱石が　大好物。 鋼の　体を　ぶつけ合って 縄張り　争いを　する。

description.fr: Il creuse des galeries à travers la pierre avec ses cornes d’acier pour trouver le fer qu’il apprécie.
description.en: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
description.es: Hacen de toda una montaña su territorio. Cuantas más cicatrices tienen, más curtidos en disputas. ¡Mucha atención!
description.de: Ihre Reviere erstrecken sich über ganze Gebirge. Stolloss, die mit Narben übersät sind, sollte man besser meiden.
description.it: Sceglie come territorio intere montagne. Se ha tante cicatrici sul suo corpo, è meglio non scherzare con lui.
description.pt-BR: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
description.ru: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
description.ja: 山を　まるごと　縄張りに　する。 傷が　多い　ボスゴドラほど 戦っているので　侮れない。

description.fr: Son entraînement d’ermite lui permet de léviter par le seul pouvoir de la méditation.
description.en: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
description.es: Se entrena en la profundidad de las montañas. Cuando aumenta su poder espiritual con meditación, levita.
description.de: Trainiert tief in den Bergen. Erhöht es seine spirituelle Kraft durch Meditation, kann es schweben.
description.it: Si allena in montagna per elevare il suo potere spirituale. Con la meditazione riesce a levitare.
description.pt-BR: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
description.ru: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
description.ja: いつもは　山奥で　修行。 めいそうをして　精神力を　高めると 体が　浮かび上がる。

description.fr: Le jeûne lui permet de concentrer son esprit au point de déceler l’aura de ses adversaires.
description.en: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
description.es: Evita los ataques moviéndose de forma elegante, como si bailara. Ataca dando un golpe devastador y moviéndose igual.
description.de: Es weicht Attacken elegant tänzerisch aus, um anschließend eine verheerende Attacke aus derselben Bewegung heraus zu lancieren.
description.it: Evita elegantemente gli attacchi a passo di danza, per poi lanciare devastanti attacchi con la stessa grazia.
description.pt-BR: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
description.ru: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
description.ja: ダンスの　ような　優雅な　動きで 攻撃を　交わして　強烈な　一撃を 相手に　お見舞いする。

description.fr: Il améliore ses réflexes en stimulant ses muscles grâce à l’électricité dans sa fourrure.
description.en: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
description.es: Estimula sus músculos y aumenta sus reflejos con la electricidad que almacena su pelaje.
description.de: Die Elektrizität, die es im Fell speichert, nutzt es, um seine Muskeln zu stimulieren.
description.it: L’elettricità immagazzinata nella pelliccia gli stimola i muscoli e aumenta la sua velocità di reazione.
description.pt-BR: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
description.ru: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
description.ja: 体毛に　ためた　電気を　使い 筋肉を　刺激することで 瞬発力を　高める。

description.fr: Il libère l’électricité par sa crinière. Il crée un nuage d’orage pour appeler la foudre.
description.en: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
description.es: No suele aparecer ante la gente. Dicen que suele colocar su nido donde caen los rayos.
description.de: Es zeigt sich selten den Menschen. Man sagt, dass es sein Nest baut, wo der Blitz eingeschlagen hat.
description.it: Raramente si mostra agli umani. Si dice che nidifichi nelle zone dove è caduto un fulmine.
description.pt-BR: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
description.ru: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.
description.ja: 人前には　めったに　姿を　見せない。 雷の　落ちた　場所に 住処が　あると　いう。

description.fr: Il absorbe l’énergie des poteaux électriques et encourage ses amis avec des pompons d’étincelles.
description.en: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
description.es: Anima a sus compañeros con pompones de chispas. Roba energía de los postes telefónicos.
description.de: Es feuert Freunde mit Pompons an, die aus Funken bestehen. Es holt sich Energie aus Telegrafenmasten.
description.it: Incoraggia gli amici con un vivace scoppiettio di scintille. Assorbe elettricità dai pali telefonici.
description.pt-BR: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
description.ru: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
description.ja: 火花の　ボンボンを　作って 仲間を　応援する。 電柱から　電気を　吸い取る。

description.fr: Il encourage ses amis. Son corps produit plus d’étincelles quand il est en mauvaise posture.
description.en: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
description.es: La electricidad de Minun y Plusle es buena para la circulación y para desentumecer músculos.
description.de: Mit elektrischen Schlägen regen Plusle und Minun den Blutkreislauf an und lösen so Verspannungen.
description.it: L’elettricità tra un Plusle e un Minun favorisce la circolazione sanguigna e scioglie le tensioni.
description.pt-BR: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
description.ru: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
description.ja: マイナンと　プラスルの　電気は 血液の　流れを　良くして こりを　ほぐす　効果が　ある。

description.fr: Il communique avec ses pairs en allumant son postérieur la nuit. Il adore le doux parfum de Lumivole.
description.en: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
description.es: Se comunica con otros iluminando su cola por la noche. Le encanta el suave aroma de Illumise.
description.de: Es kommuniziert mit anderen, indem es sein Hinterteil zum Leuchten bringt. Es liebt Illumises Duft.
description.it: Di notte comunica con gli altri illuminando la sua coda. Ama il dolce aroma di Illumise.
description.pt-BR: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
description.ru: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
description.ja: 夜になると　お尻を　光らせ 仲間と　会話する。イルミーゼの 出す　甘い　香りが　大好き。

description.fr: Il utilise son doux parfum pour aider Muciole à décrire des arabesques dans le ciel nocturne.
description.en: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
description.es: Con su dulce aroma guía a grupos de Volbeat para que tracen hasta 200 dibujos distintos en el cielo nocturno.
description.de: Sein süßer Duft leitet Volbeat an, über 200 verschiedene Lichtmuster an den Nachthimmel zu malen.
description.it: Con un dolce aroma dirige il volo dei Volbeat, che disegnano più di 200 figure luminose nel cielo stellato.
description.pt-BR: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
description.ru: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
description.ja: 甘い　香りで　バルビートを　誘導して ２００　以上の　模様を 夜空に　描く。

description.fr: Plus le Rosélia est en bonne santé et plus son parfum est agréable et relaxant pour son entourage.
description.en: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
description.es: Ataca con sus manos, en las que tiene un tipo de veneno diferente en cada una. Cuanto más aroma, mejor salud tiene.
description.de: Aus seinen Händen verströmt es jeweils ein anderes Gift. Je stärker Roselia duftet, desto gesünder ist es.
description.it: Attacca usando abilmente i due tipi di veleno delle estremità dei suoi arti. Più è forte la sua fragranza, più è in salute.
description.pt-BR: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
description.ru: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
description.ja: 右手と　左手で　２種類の 毒を　使いわけて　攻撃する。 香りが　強いほど　元気だ。

description.fr: Il est principalement composé d’un estomac dont les sucs digestifs dissolvent tout ce qu’il avale.
description.en: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
description.es: Sus sesos y corazón son diminutos; es casi todo estómago. Sus jugos gástricos disuelven lo que sea.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht fast nur aus Magen. Herz und Hirn sind winzig. Sein Magensaft verdaut alles.
description.it: Ha cuore e cervello mini: lo stomaco prende troppo spazio! Con i succhi gastrici scioglie qualunque cosa.
description.pt-BR: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
description.ru: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
description.ja: 心臓や　脳みそは　小さく 体の　大部分が　胃袋。 なんでも　溶かす　胃液を　出す。

description.fr: Il avale tout en une bouchée. Ses follicules sécrètent des fluides toxiques qui endorment l’ennemi.
description.en: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
description.es: Se traga cualquier cosa de una pieza. Sus poros segregan fluidos tóxicos que dañan a sus enemigos.
description.de: Es verschluckt alles in einem Stück und sondert giftige Stoffe ab, mit denen es Gegner besprüht.
description.it: Inghiotte intera qualsiasi cosa. Dai pori traspira un liquido tossico con cui bagna i nemici.
description.pt-BR: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
description.ru: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
description.ja: なんでも　まるのみしてしまう。 毛穴から　猛毒の　体液を 分泌して　敵に　浴びせかける。

description.fr: Il attaque en banc quand on menace son territoire. Ses dents aiguisées peuvent couler un navire.
description.en: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
description.es: Atacan en grupo a los barcos y los hunden a base de bocados. Habitan en los ríos de la jungla.
description.de: Schwärme von Kanivanha haben in Dschungelflüssen schon so manches Boot zerbissen und versenkt.
description.it: I Carvanha attaccano le navi in branco e ne strappano gli scafi a morsi. Abitano i fiumi della giungla.
description.pt-BR: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
description.ru: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.
description.ja: 集団で　船に　襲いかかり 船底を　食いちぎり　沈める。 ジャングルの　川に　生息する。

description.fr: Ses crocs lacèrent des feuilles d’acier. Il nage à 120 km/h. On l’appelle “tyran des mers”.
description.en: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
description.es: Con sus colmillos puede atravesar el acero. Nada a 120 km/h. Le llaman el Terror de los Mares.
description.de: Seine Zähne durchdringen sogar Eisen. Es schwimmt mit 120 km/h und wird „Tyrann des Meeres“ genannt.
description.it: Con le sue zanne può spezzare il ferro. Nuota a 120 km/h. È noto come il “Tiranno del mare”.
description.pt-BR: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
description.ru: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these POKéMON can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
description.ja: 鉄板も　かみちぎる　キバを　持ち 泳ぐ　速度は　時速１２０キロ。 別名は　海のギャング。

description.fr: Par beau temps, il se pose sur les plages pour jouer et rebondir. Il expulse de l’eau par son évent.
description.en: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
description.es: Le gusta botar como una pelota de playa. Cuanta más agua de mar traga, más alto puede llegar.
description.de: Es hüpft gerne wie ein Ball herum. Je mehr Meerwasser es trinkt, desto höher kann es springen.
description.it: Si diverte a rimbalzare come una palla. Più acqua di mare ingolla, più in alto riesce a rimbalzare.
description.pt-BR: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
description.ru: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful POKéMON loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
description.ja: ボールの　ように　弾んで　遊ぶ。 たくさんの　海水を　飲みこむほど 高く　弾むように　なるのだ。

description.fr: Le plus grand des Pokémon. Il peut plonger à une profondeur de 3 000 m en retenant son souffle.
description.en: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
description.es: Puede dejar fuera de combate a sus oponentes con el impacto de su enorme cuerpo al caer en el agua tras un salto.
description.de: Springt es mit seinem gewaltigen Körper von einer Welle ab, kann es Gegner allein mit der Wucht des Aufpralls besiegen.
description.it: L’impatto creato dai suoi salti fuori e dentro l’acqua può arrivare a mandare KO un avversario.
description.pt-BR: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
description.ru: WAILORD is the largest of all identified POKéMON up to now. This giant POKéMON swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
description.ja: 大きな　体を　波の上で ジャンプさせ　衝撃を　生みだし 相手を　気絶　させることがある。

description.fr: Son dos bossu renferme une lave bouillonnante. Elle refroidit par temps de pluie, ce qui le ralentit.
description.en: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
description.es: En su joroba almacena magma ardiente que se enfría cuando llueve y lo ralentiza.
description.de: In seinem Rücken speichert es sehr heißes Magma. Regnet es, kühlt das Magma ab und es wird langsamer.
description.it: Nella gobba accumula magma. Quando piove, il magma si indurisce e il Pokémon diventa più lento.
description.pt-BR: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
description.ru: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
description.ja: 灼熱の　マグマを　背中の コブに　ためている。雨に　当たると マグマが　冷えて　動きが　鈍る。

description.fr: Il porte des volcans sur son dos. Quand le magma remonte, il frissonne et entre en éruption.
description.en: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
description.es: Los volcanes de su joroba entran en erupción cada 10 años o cuando Camerupt se enfada mucho.
description.de: Seine Vulkanhöcker brechen nur alle zehn Jahre aus oder wenn es richtig wütend ist.
description.it: I vulcani sul suo dorso eruttano ogni dieci anni o quando è veramente arrabbiato.
description.pt-BR: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
description.ru: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
description.ja: 背中の　コブの　火山は １０年ごとに　大噴火　するが 激しく　怒っても　噴火する。

description.fr: Il tire son énergie du charbon qu’il brûle dans sa carapace et crache de la suie noire en cas de danger.
description.en: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
description.es: Trabaja sin descanso en minas en desuso localizando y extrayendo carbón.
description.de: Große Gruppen Qurtel siedeln sich in stillgelegten Bergwerken an und graben dort emsig nach Kohle.
description.it: I Torkoal eleggono a propria dimora miniere di carbone abbandonate e vi scavano carbone con ardore.
description.pt-BR: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
description.ru: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
description.ja: 使われなくなった　炭鉱には たくさんの　コータスが　住みついて 石炭を　せっせと　掘っている。

description.fr: Il utilise sa queue comme un ressort et bondit partout. Chaque nouveau choc fait battre son cœur.
description.en: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
description.es: Bota continuamente usando su cola como muelle. Salta para mantener el latido de su corazón.
description.de: Es hüpft beständig umher, wobei es seinen Schweif als Feder verwendet. Nur so bleibt sein Herz aktiv.
description.it: Rimbalza costantemente usando la coda come una molla. Il movimento sollecita il cuore e lo fa battere.
description.pt-BR: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
description.ru: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
description.ja: 尻尾を　バネのかわりに　いつも 飛び跳ねている。跳ねる　振動で 心臓を　鼓動　させているのだ。

description.fr: Les perles noires amplifient ses pouvoirs psy. Sa danse étrange lui permet de contrôler ses ennemis.
description.en: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
description.es: Las perlas negras aumentan sus poderes psíquicos. Controla las mentes de sus rivales con un extraño baile.
description.de: Mit schwarzen Perlen verstärkt es seine Psycho-Kräfte. Mit einem Tanz kontrolliert es seine Gegner.
description.it: Amplifica i suoi poteri psichici con le sue perle nere. Si esibisce anche in danze bizzarre per controllare i suoi nemici.
description.pt-BR: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
description.ru: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
description.ja: 黒真珠で　サイコパワーを 強め　奇妙な　ステップで 相手の　心を　操るぞ。

description.fr: Les motifs sur leur fourrure sont propres à chaque Spinda. Son pas chancelant le rend difficile à viser.
description.en: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
description.es: No hay dos Spinda que tengan idénticos pelajes. Su tambaleo al bailar confunde a los rivales.
description.de: Das Muster eines Pandir ist wie ein Fingerabdruck. Sein Taumeln senkt die gegnerische Zielsicherheit.
description.it: Non ci sono due Spinda con lo stesso motivo maculato. Il suo passo barcollante confonde i nemici.
description.pt-BR: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
description.ru: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.
description.ja: 同じ　ブチ模様の　パッチールは いない。フラフラした　足取りで 相手の　ねらいを　外す。

description.fr: Il creuse un trou conique dans le sable du désert et se terre en attendant qu’une proie trébuche.
description.en: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
description.es: Habita desiertos áridos. Cava fosas profundas, en las que espera que caiga su presa.
description.de: Es lebt in trockenen Wüstengebieten, wo es eine Trichterfalle baut und seelenruhig darauf wartet, dass Beute hinabrutscht.
description.it: Vive nei deserti. Scava buche nel terreno e vi si apposta, attendendo che le prede vi caschino dentro.
description.pt-BR: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
description.ru: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
description.ja: 乾燥した　砂漠に　生息。 すり鉢状の　巣穴の　中で 獲物を　じっと　待ち続ける。

description.fr: Ses violents battements d’ailes génèrent des vagues d’ultrasons qui donnent mal au crâne.
description.en: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
description.es: Al agitar a gran velocidad ambas alas, emite ondas ultrasónicas que provocan fuertes dolores de cabeza.
description.de: Die Schallwellen, die es durch eine hohe Flügelschlagfrequenz erzeugt, verursachen heftige Kopfschmerzen.
description.it: Fa vibrare velocemente le ali generando onde ultrasoniche che provocano dei forti mal di testa.
description.pt-BR: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
description.ru: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
description.ja: ２枚の　羽を　高速で 振動させて　出す　超音波は 激しい　頭痛を　ひきおこす。

description.fr: Son puissant battement d’ailes provoque des tempêtes de sable. On l’appelle “esprit du désert”.
description.en: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
description.es: Su medio es el desierto. Para esconderse, levanta arena con las patas. Tiene los ojos protegidos con mallas rojas.
description.de: Es versteckt sich, indem es mit seinen Flügeln Wüstensand aufwirbelt. Rote Augenlider schützen es vor dem Sand.
description.it: Solleva sabbia con le ali per nascondersi. Un rivestimento rosso protegge gli occhi dalla sabbia stessa.
description.pt-BR: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
description.ru: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this POKéMON is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
description.ja: 羽の　羽ばたきで　砂漠の　砂を 巻き上げて　姿を　隠す。 赤い　カバーが　砂から　目を　守る。

description.fr: En stockant l’eau dans son corps, cet habitant du désert peut survivre 30 jours sans boire.
description.en: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
description.es: Vive en regiones secas y con pocas lluvias. Una vez al año, le brota una flor amarilla.
description.de: Es wächst an trockenen Orten mit wenig Niederschlag. Nur einmal im Jahr bildet es eine gelbe Blüte.
description.it: Cacnea vive in zone aride, dove non piove quasi mai. Il suo fiore giallo sboccia una volta all’anno.
description.pt-BR: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
description.ru: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
description.ja: 雨が　少ない　乾燥した 地域に　生息。１年に　１回 黄色の　花を　咲かせる。

description.fr: Il sort la nuit pour chasser. Il traque les proies épuisées après une journée dans le désert.
description.en: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
description.es: Es un Pokémon nocturno. Busca presas agotadas por el calor diurno del desierto.
description.de: Ein nachtaktives Pokémon, das Beute sucht, die durch die Tageshitze der Wüste bereits erschöpft ist.
description.it: Diventa attivo di notte, quando va a caccia di prede stremate dalla calura del deserto.
description.pt-BR: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
description.ru: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
description.ja: 夜になると　活動を　はじめる。 砂漠の　暑さに　疲れ果てた 獲物を　見つけ出し　捕らえるのだ。

description.fr: Il ne se sent à l’aise que dans un milieu propre et repousse la poussière avec ses ailes.
description.en: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
description.es: Se desconoce el porqué, pero le encanta posarse sobre la cabeza de los humanos y fingir que es un gorro.
description.de: Aus irgendeinem Grund setzt es sich gerne auf den Kopf von Menschen und tut so, als sei es ein Hut.
description.it: Per qualche motivo adora salire sulla testa delle persone e far finta di essere un cappello.
description.pt-BR: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
description.ru: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
description.ja: 人の　頭の　上に ちょこんと　乗って　帽子のように ふるまうのが　なぜか　大好き。

description.fr: Il aime enlacer ses amis dans ses ailes cotonneuses et ronronner.
description.en: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
description.es: Vuela pausadamente por el cielo azul. Su hermoso trino cautiva a todo aquel que lo escucha.
description.de: Es schwebt gemächlich durch den Himmel. Sein wunderschönes Summen gibt einem das Gefühl zu träumen.
description.it: Volteggia elegante nel cielo. Canticchia soavemente, mandando in onirica estasi chi lo ascolta.
description.pt-BR: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
description.ru: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
description.ja: 大空を　ゆったりと　飛ぶ。 チルタリスの　美しい　ハミングを 聴くと　うっとり　夢心地だ。

description.fr: C’est le rival de Séviper depuis des générations. Ses griffes aiguisées sont son meilleur atout.
description.en: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
description.es: Hace muchos años que se enfrenta a Seviper. Su arma más eficaz son sus zarpas afiladas.
description.de: Seit Generationen ist es mit Vipitis verfeindet. Seine scharfen Klauen sind seine stärksten Waffen.
description.it: Da generazioni, è acerrimo nemico di Seviper. Gli artigli aguzzi sono le sue armi più potenti.
description.pt-BR: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
description.ru: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
description.ja: 何世代にも　渡って ハブネークと　戦ってきた。 鋭い　ツメが　最大の　武器。

description.fr: Le rival historique de Mangriff. Il affûte la lame de sa queue sur les rochers avant le combat.
description.en: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
description.es: Hace frente a Zangoose con su agilidad y su afilada cola, que está cargada con un veneno letal.
description.de: Die flinken Angriffe von Sengo kontert es mit seinem messerscharfen Schweif, aus dem Gift austritt.
description.it: Respinge gli attacchi dell’agile Zangoose con la coda affilatissima, che secerne un micidiale veleno.
description.pt-BR: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
description.ru: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
description.ja: 猛毒が　染み出している 鋭い　切れ味の　尻尾で 素早い　ザングースに　立ち向かう。

description.fr: On suppose qu’il est lié au cycle lunaire, car il ne sort que les soirs de pleine lune.
description.en: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
description.es: Se piensa que está muy influido por las fases lunares, ya que solo actúa en noches de luna llena.
description.de: Da es in Vollmondnächten aktiv wird, sagt man ihm nach, mit den Mondphasen in Verbindung zu stehen.
description.it: Diventa attivo nelle notti di luna piena, pertanto si dice che abbia qualche legame con le fasi lunari.
description.pt-BR: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
description.ru: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
description.ja: 満月の　夜になると　活発に 活動するため　月の　満ち欠けと 関係していると　言われている。

description.fr: Le bruit court que cette nouvelle espèce vient du soleil. Il produit de la lumière en tournoyant.
description.en: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
description.es: Usa el sol como fuente de energía, por lo que es más poderoso de día. Brilla al rotar.
description.de: Da es seine Energie aus Sonnenlicht gewinnt, ist es tagsüber am stärksten. Wenn es sich dreht, leuchtet es.
description.it: L’energia solare è la fonte della sua potenza, per cui è più forte di giorno. Emana luce quando ruota su se stesso.
description.pt-BR: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
description.ru: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
description.ja: 太陽エネルギーが　パワーの 源　なので　昼間は　強い。 回転すると　体が　光る。

description.fr: Son corps glissant est difficile à attraper. On dit qu’il a été créé dans de la boue solidifiée.
description.en: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
description.es: Recubre su cuerpo de una película viscosa que le permite escapar si alguien lo agarra.
description.de: Es bedeckt seinen Körper mit einer schleimigen Substanz und kann sich so aus Umklammerungen winden.
description.it: Il suo corpo è ricoperto da una pellicola viscida, che gli permette di sgusciare via, se afferrato.
description.pt-BR: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
description.ru: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
description.ja: 全身が　ヌルヌルの　体液で 覆われているため　捕まっても ぬるりと　抜け出すことが　できる。

description.fr: Il défend férocement son territoire en déclenchant des secousses terribles.
description.en: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
description.es: Habita en grandes pantanos. Si se acerca un enemigo, se alborota y causa temblores monumentales.
description.de: Sein Revier hat es im Sumpfland. Nähert sich ein Feind, zappelt es wie wild und erzeugt so Erdbeben.
description.it: Stabilisce il suo territorio nelle grandi paludi. Se il nemico gli si accosta, provoca un terremoto.
description.pt-BR: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
description.ru: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these POKéMON will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
description.ja: 大きな　沼を　縄張りにする。 敵が　近づくと　大暴れして 大きな　地震を　起こすのだ。

description.fr: Sa nature robuste lui permet de vivre sur n’importe quel terrain. Ses pinces ne lâchent jamais prise.
description.en: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
description.es: Por sucio o contaminado que esté el río, se adaptan rápido y se multiplican. Poseen una gran fuerza vital.
description.de: Egal, wie schmutzig der Fluss ist, in dem sie leben, sie passen sich daran an und vermehren sich. Sie sind hart im Nehmen.
description.it: La sua grande vitalità gli permette di adattarsi e proliferare anche nelle acque dei fiumi più inquinati.
description.pt-BR: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
description.ru: CORPHISH were originally foreign POKéMON that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This POKéMON is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
description.ja: どんなに　水が　汚れた 川でも　適応して　増えていく タフな　生命力の　持ち主。

description.fr: C’est un voyou qui utilise ses pinces pour chasser les autres Pokémon hors de sa mare.
description.en: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
description.es: Este malandrín usa sus pinzas para atosigar y expulsar a los otros Pokémon que viven en su estanque.
description.de: Dieser Grobian ergreift andere Pokémon mit seinen Scheren und wirft sie aus seinem Teich.
description.it: Pokémon violento che afferra il nemico con le chele e lo scaraventa fuori dal suo stagno.
description.pt-BR: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
description.ru: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this POKéMON, making them desolate places.
description.ja: 池に　住む　ほかの　ポケモンを ハサミで　つまみ上げ　池の　外へ 放り出してしまう　暴れん坊。

description.fr: Il se déplace en tournoyant sur son pied. Ce Pokémon rare fut découvert dans de vieilles ruines.
description.en: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
description.es: Se mueve girando sobre su eje. También se le puede ver girando cabeza abajo.
description.de: Es bewegt sich, indem es auf seinem Fuß kreiselt. Vereinzelt sieht man Puppance, die kopfüber kreiseln.
description.it: Si sposta piroettando sull’unica estremità inferiore del proprio corpo. Molti fanno la verticale.
description.pt-BR: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
description.ru: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this POKéMON living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
description.ja: 一本足で　回転しながら　移動する。 逆さまに　なって 回転する　ヤジロンも　見かける。

description.fr: Une ancienne figurine d’argile qui s’est animée suite à son exposition à un rayon de lumière étrange.
description.en: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
description.es: Este Pokémon es una vieja figurilla de barro que cobró vida mediante la exposición a extraños rayos de luz.
description.de: Eine antike Lehmstatue, die durch ein mysteriöses Licht zum Leben erwacht ist.
description.it: Pokémon nato da un’antica statuetta d’argilla portata in vita da misteriose radiazioni.
description.pt-BR: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
description.ru: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.
description.ja: 古代の　泥人形が 怪光線を　浴びたことで 命が　宿り　ポケモンとなった。

description.fr: Il vivait au fond de la mer il y a 100 millions d’années. La science a permis de le ressusciter.
description.en: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
description.es: Se extinguió hace 100 millones de años. Sus tentáculos parecen pétalos para atraer a sus presas.
description.de: Vor 100 Millionen Jahren starb es aus. Es fängt seine Beute mit als Blüte getarnten Tentakeln.
description.it: Cattura le prede che si avvicinano con i tentacoli a forma di corolla. Si è estinto 100 milioni di anni fa.
description.pt-BR: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
description.ru: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient POKéMON attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
description.ja: 触手を　花びらに　見せかけて 近寄ってきた　獲物を　捕らえる。 １億年前に　絶滅した。

description.fr: Vit dans les hauts-fonds des mers chaudes. Il déterre sa proie du sable quand la marée se retire.
description.en: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
description.es: Vive en el fondo de los mares de aguas templadas. Emerge para cazar cuando baja la marea.
description.de: Es lebt in seichten Stellen warmer Meere. Bei Ebbe sucht es im Sand nach Beute.
description.it: Vive in acque poco profonde nei mari caldi. Con la bassa marea, scava sulla riva in cerca di prede.
description.pt-BR: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
description.ru: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This POKéMON freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
description.ja: 暖かい　海の　浅瀬に　いる。 潮が　引くと　砂浜に　潜った 獲物を　掘り出して　食べる。

description.fr: Un ancêtre Pokémon réanimé à partir d’un fossile. Il vivait en mer et chassait avec ses pinces.
description.en: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
description.es: Es una especie de Pokémon predecesor. Estira las pinzas para cazar a sus presas, que se esconden en las rocas del mar.
