description.de: Es ist eine Art Vorfahre der Pokémon. Mit seinen erweiterten Scheren geht es zwischen den Felsen am Meeresgrund auf Beutefang.
description.it: Pokémon di tipo primitivo, usa i lunghi artigli per catturare prede nascoste tra le rocce in fondo al mare.
description.pt-BR: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
description.ru: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive POKéMON once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
description.ja: ポケモンの　先祖の　一種。 海底の　岩場に　隠れた　獲物を 伸びる　ツノで　捕らえる。

description.fr: Il a gagné la côte après son évolution. Une armure robuste recouvre son corps.
description.en: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
description.es: Ensarta a sus presas con sus gigantescas garras elásticas. Una fuerte coraza cubre su cuerpo.
description.de: Es spießt die Beute mit seinen Scheren auf, ehe es sie verspeist. Den Körper umgibt ein robuster Panzer.
description.it: Cattura il nemico infilzandolo con gli enormi artigli retrattili. È rivestito di una robusta corazza.
description.pt-BR: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
description.ru: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This POKéMON’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
description.ja: 伸び縮みする　巨大な　ツメで 獲物を　くし刺しにして　捕らえる。 丈夫な　よろいを　身に　まとう。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon a peut-être un physique disgracieux, mais il est robuste et peut survivre dans très peu d’eau.
description.en: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
description.es: Come de todo, por lo que puede vivir en aguas contaminadas. Nadie le presta atención.
description.de: Es frisst einfach alles und kann daher auch in verschmutzter Umgebung leben. Niemand beachtet es.
description.it: Si nutre di qualsiasi cosa, pertanto vive anche in fiumi e laghi inquinati. È un Pokémon di scarso interesse.
description.pt-BR: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
description.ru: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this POKéMON is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
description.ja: なんでも　食べるので 汚い　川や　湖でも　生きていける。 だれも　注目しない　ポケモン。

description.fr: Ses splendides écailles aux couleurs de l’arc-en-ciel changent de teinte selon l’angle de vue.
description.en: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
description.es: Milotic es impresionantemente bello. Quienes lo ven, temen perder las ganas de luchar contra él.
description.de: Milotic ist atemberaubend schön. Man sagt, dass diejenigen, die es sehen, vergessen zu kämpfen.
description.it: Pokémon di una bellezza vertiginosa. Chi lo vede perde ogni voglia di combattere.
description.pt-BR: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
description.ru: MILOTIC is said to be the most beautiful of all the POKéMON. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
description.ja: ミロカロスの　美しい　姿を 見た者は　争いの　気持ちを 忘れてしまうと　言われている。

description.fr: Son aspect change avec la météo. On a récemment découvert que ses molécules étaient pareilles à l’eau.
description.en: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
description.es: Sus células son muy sensibles a los cambios de temperatura y humedad y se adapta sin problema.
description.de: Formeo kann seine Gestalt ändern. Seine Zellen reagieren auf Temperaturschwankungen und Feuchtigkeit.
description.it: Il suo aspetto varia con l’umidità e la temperatura, che influenzano la sua struttura molecolare.
description.pt-BR: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
description.ru: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This POKéMON gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
description.ja: 気温や　湿度の　変化が 体の　細胞に　影響して 姿を　変える　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il change de couleur à volonté, mais le motif en zigzag qui orne son ventre reste le même.
description.en: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
description.es: Puede mudar el color de su cuerpo a voluntad, pero el dibujo en zigzag de su panza nunca desaparece.
description.de: Es kann nach Belieben seine Farbe ändern. Nur das gezackte Muster auf seinem Bauch bleibt gleich.
description.it: Può mutare il colore del corpo a piacimento. Tuttavia, il motivo a zigzag sul ventre non cambia.
description.pt-BR: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
description.ru: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this POKéMON can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
description.ja: 体の　色を　自由に　変える 能力を　持つ。お腹にある ギザギザ模様　だけは　変わらない。

description.fr: Il aime le goût de la vengeance. Ils vivent en rangs sous les gouttières des gens vindicatifs.
description.en: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
description.es: Dicen que con su cuerno se alimenta de sentimientos de celos y envidia. Es muy activo a medianoche.
description.de: Man sagt, durch sein Horn ernähre es sich von Rachsucht und Neid. Erst nachts wird es richtig aktiv.
description.it: Si dice che si nutra di rancore e invidia con il corno che ha sulla testa. A mezzanotte si scatena.
description.pt-BR: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
description.ru: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this POKéMON will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
description.ja: 頭の　ツノで　恨みや　ねたみの 感情を　食べると　言われる。 真夜中　活発に　活動する。

description.fr: Une poupée mue par la tristesse qui la ronge depuis qu’on l’a délaissée. Elle recherche son propriétaire.
description.en: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
description.es: Este muñeco se convirtió en un Pokémon cuando lo tiraron a la basura. Busca a su antiguo dueño.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon war eine Puppe, die weggeworfen wurde. Es sucht nun das Kind, das dies getan hat.
description.it: Un peluche divenuto Pokémon per la rabbia di essere stato buttato via da un bimbo, di cui è alla ricerca.
description.pt-BR: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
description.ru: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
description.ja: 捨てられた　ぬいぐるみに　おんねんが 宿り　ポケモンになった。自分を 捨てた　子供を　捜している。

description.fr: Les cris des enfants l’amusent. Il effraie les moins sages d’entre eux en traversant les murs.
description.en: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
description.es: Persigue a su presa sin descanso allá donde vaya. No obstante, abandona la caza al amanecer.
description.de: Verbissen verfolgt es seine Beute überallhin. Doch sobald die Sonne aufgeht, ist die Jagd vorbei.
description.it: Segue ostinatamente la preda ovunque essa vada. Abbandona la caccia solo all’alba.
description.pt-BR: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
description.ru: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
description.ja: どこまでも　獲物を　追い続ける。 執念深い　性格だが 朝日が　昇ると　あきらめる。

description.fr: Il cherche des feux follets pour les avaler. Ce qui se passe alors dans son corps est un mystère.
description.en: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
description.es: Si alguien mira los fuegos fatuos del interior de Dusclops, perderá su alma irremediablemente.
description.de: Blickt man direkt in den Feuerball in seinem Inneren, wird einem die Seele ausgesaugt.
description.it: Se si osserva troppo da vicino la palla di fuoco dentro Dusclops, la propria anima viene risucchiata.
description.pt-BR: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
description.ru: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
description.ja: 体の　中で　燃えている 人魂を　のぞきこむと 魂を　吸い取られてしまう。

description.fr: À force de toujours manger le même fruit succulent, il en pousse à la base de son cou.
description.en: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
description.es: Puede volar al agitar sus grandes hojas. Reparte entre los niños la codiciada fruta dulce que crece de su cuello.
description.de: Es nutzt seine großen Blätter als Flügel und verteilt die süßen Früchte, die an seinem Hals wachsen, an Kinder.
description.it: Vola sbattendo delle grandi ali a forma di foglia e distribuisce ai bambini i deliziosi frutti che gli crescono sul collo.
description.pt-BR: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
description.ru: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS’s neck are very popular with children. This POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
description.ja: 大きな　葉っぱで　空を飛んで 子供たちに　大人気の　首に できる　甘い　くだものを　配る。

description.fr: Ses cris se répercutent dans son corps creux avant d’exploser en notes mélodieuses et saisissantes.
description.en: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
description.es: Se cuelga de ramas y aleros con la ventosa de su cabeza. Tiene siete tipos de gritos diferentes.
description.de: Mit seinem Saugnapf hängt es sich an Äste oder unter Vordächer. Es kennt sieben verschiedene Schreie.
description.it: Emette sette tipi di versi penzolando da rami o cornicioni, a cui si attacca con la ventosa che ha sul capo.
description.pt-BR: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
description.ru: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
description.ja: 頭の　吸盤で　木の　枝や 家の　軒下に　ぶら下がる。 ７種類　音色を　使い分ける。

description.fr: La capacité de sa corne à sentir les catastrophes ayant trop attiré l’attention sur lui, il vit reclus.
description.en: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
description.es: Presiente desastres inminentes y se aparece a la gente para advertir del peligro.
description.de: Es spürt drohende Katastrophen und erscheint nur dann, wenn es andere vor der Gefahr warnen will.
description.it: Percepisce i disastri naturali imminenti e si mostra solo per avvertire la gente del pericolo.
description.pt-BR: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
description.ru: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster POKéMON.
description.ja: 災害を　予感する。 危険を　知らせる　ときだけ 人前に　現れるという。

description.fr: Il se muscle en bousculant ses semblables lors de mêlées. Il raffole des fruits sucrés.
description.en: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
description.es: Suelen ir en grupo y a la hora de dormir se resguardan en una cueva.
description.de: Es zieht normalerweise im Rudel umher. Zum Schlafen drängen sie sich ganz eng in einer Höhle zusammen.
description.it: Tendono a spostarsi in gruppo. Anche per dormire si stringono fra loro, nelle grotte.
description.pt-BR: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
description.ru: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
description.ja: 群れで　行動する　習性。 眠る　ときは　洞窟の　中で 仲間たちと　体を　寄せ合う。

description.fr: On dit que des groupes entiers de Stalgamin vivent en harmonie sous des feuilles gigantesques.
description.en: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
description.es: Se dice que se reúnen en grupos bajo hojas gigantescas y viven allí en total armonía.
description.de: Gerüchten zufolge sammeln sich Schneppke unter riesigen Blättern und leben dort friedlich zusammen.
description.it: Si dice che gli Snorunt vivano in armonia riuniti sotto gigantesche foglie.
description.pt-BR: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
description.ru: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
description.ja: 大きな　葉っぱの　下に 数匹の　ユキワラシが　集まり 仲良く　暮らしているという。

description.fr: Il empêche ses proies de prendre la fuite en gelant instantanément l’humidité de l’air.
description.en: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
description.es: Se protege con una armadura de hielo creada por congelación de la humedad del aire.
description.de: Um sich zu schützen, umgibt es seinen Körper mit einer Rüstung aus Eis.
description.it: Per difendersi, riveste il suo corpo con un’armatura di ghiaccio, fatta congelando l’umidità dell’aria.
description.pt-BR: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
description.ru: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This POKéMON has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
description.ja: 空気中の　水分を　凍らせ 氷の　装甲で　体を　包みこみ 身を　守っている。

description.fr: Il gagne la côte en roulant sur les blocs de glace car sa morphologie n’est pas adaptée à la nage.
description.en: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
description.es: Como no saben nadar muy bien, se mueven rápidamente rodando. Cuando están alegres, dan palmadas con las aletas.
description.de: Es ist noch kein guter Schwimmer und bewegt sich rollend schneller fort. Ist es froh, klatscht es mit seinen Flossen.
description.it: Non sa ancora nuotare molto bene e si muove più velocemente rotolando. Quando è felice batte le pinne.
description.pt-BR: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
description.ru: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
description.ja: まだ　上手に　泳げず 転がったほうが　速く　動ける。 うれしいと　みんなで　手をたたく。

description.fr: Il fait souvent tourner des objets sur son museau pour connaître leur odeur et leur texture.
description.en: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
description.es: Su nariz es muy sensible. Cuando ve algo por primera vez, lo toca con ella para recordarlo después.
description.de: Die Nerven in seiner Nase sind sehr empfindlich. Sieht es etwas Neues, berührt es es zuerst mit der Nase.
description.it: Per memorizzare un nuovo oggetto, ha bisogno di toccarlo con il naso, dove risiede la sua sensibilità.
description.pt-BR: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
description.ru: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
description.ja: 鼻の　神経が　敏感。 はじめて　目に　する　物は 鼻で　触って　覚えるのだ。

description.fr: Il brise la glace avec ses grosses défenses. Sa graisse le protège du froid, mais aussi des attaques.
description.en: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
description.es: Rompe el hielo con sus colmillos. Su gruesa capa de grasa le protege del frío y de los enemigos.
description.de: Mit seinen Stoßzähnen bricht es durch Eis. Eine Speckschicht schützt es vor Kälte und Angriffen.
description.it: Frantuma il ghiaccio con le zanne. Lo spesso strato adiposo respinge il freddo e gli attacchi nemici.
description.pt-BR: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
description.ru: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
description.ja: 大きな　氷を　キバで　砕く。 厚い　脂肪は　寒さだけでなく 敵の　攻撃も　はね返す。

description.fr: Il ne produit qu’une perle durant son existence. On raconte qu’elle amplifie les pouvoirs psychiques.
description.en: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
description.es: Produce durante su vida una sola perla que aumenta los poderes psíquicos al evolucionar.
description.de: Es entwickelt sich nur einmal im Leben, wobei es eine wundersame Perle erzeugt, die Psycho-Kräfte verstärkt.
description.it: Crea una sola perla in tutta la sua vita, quando si evolve. Questa perla amplifica i poteri psichici.
description.pt-BR: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
description.ru: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
description.ja: 一生に　１回　進化の　とき サイコパワーを　増幅する 不思議な　真珠を　作るのだ。

description.fr: Il vit loin sous la mer. Il appâte les proies crédules avec sa queue qui rappelle un petit poisson.
description.en: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
description.es: Vive en los abismos marinos, donde no se filtra la luz. Tiene una cola en forma de pez, que enciende para atraer a su presa.
description.de: Es lebt tief im Meer, wo Sonnenlicht nie vordringt. Beim Beutefang leuchtet sein fischartiger Schwanz, um Beute anzulocken.
description.it: Vive in mare a grandi profondità, dove non filtra nessuna luce. Attira le prede illuminando la codina a forma di pesce.
description.pt-BR: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
description.ru: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This POKéMON’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
description.ja: 光の　届かない　深海に　生息。 小魚に　似た　尻尾を　光らせて 獲物を　誘い出す。

description.fr: Au printemps, son corps rose se fait plus vif sans que l’on sache pourquoi. Il vit au fond de la mer.
description.en: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
description.es: Vive en el fondo del mar. En primavera, su cuerpo rosado adquiere colores más vivos.
description.de: Es lebt auf dem Grund des Meeres. Im Frühling wirkt die Farbe seines Körpers viel kräftiger.
description.it: Vive sui fondali marini. In primavera il suo corpo rosato diventa più vivido per chissà quale motivo.
description.pt-BR: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
description.ru: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this POKéMON’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
description.ja: 海の　底で　暮らしているが 春になると　体の　ピンク色が なぜか　鮮やかに　色づく。

description.fr: Un Pokémon rare aperçu lors d’une exploration sous-marine. Il n’a pas évolué depuis 100 millions d’années.
description.en: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
description.es: No ha sufrido ningún cambio desde hace 100 millones de años. Fue descubierto durante una expedición marina.
description.de: 100 Millionen Jahre lang blieb es unverändert. Es wurde bei einer Tiefsee-Tauchexpedition entdeckt.
description.it: Immutato da 100 milioni di anni, è stato scoperto durante un’esplorazione nelle profondità marine.
description.pt-BR: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
description.ru: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient POKéMON feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
description.ja: １億年前から 姿が　変わらない　ポケモン。 深海を　調査中に　発見された。

description.fr: Un habitant des mers chaudes. On dit que le couple qui tombe sur ce Pokémon connaîtra l’amour éternel.
description.en: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
description.es: Vive en mares cálidos. Se dice que, si una pareja lo encuentra, será bendecida con amor eterno.
description.de: Es lebt in warmen Meeren. Man sagt, dass Verliebte, die es sehen, mit ewiger Liebe gesegnet sind.
description.it: Vive nei mari caldi. Si dice che le coppie che trovano questo Pokémon riceveranno in dono l’eterno amore.
description.pt-BR: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
description.ru: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
description.ja: 暖かい　海に　生息する。 ラブカスを　見つけた　カップルは 永遠の　愛が　続くという。

description.fr: Il rêve de pouvoir voler un jour. Pour l’heure, il s’entraîne en sautant du haut des falaises.
description.en: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
description.es: Su desarrollado cuello y su cabeza dura como el acero le permiten reducir a añicos rocas enormes.
description.de: Mit seinen robusten Nackenmuskeln und seinem stahlharten Kopf kann es sogar Felsen zertrümmern.
description.it: Frantuma grandi massi con la testa dura come il ferro e gli allenatissimi muscoli del collo.
description.pt-BR: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
description.ru: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
description.ja: 鍛えられた　首の　筋肉と 鉄の　ように　硬い　頭で 大岩を　コナゴナに　砕く。

description.fr: Ses cellules ont commencé à changer dans sa robuste coquille. Il la perd en évoluant.
description.en: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
description.es: Las células han empezado a cambiar dentro de su dura concha, que se separa cuando evoluciona.
description.de: Die Zellen seines Panzers fingen an, sich zu verändern. Er fällt ab, sobald sich das Pokémon entwickelt.
description.it: Nella sua dura corazza le cellule hanno cominciato a cambiare. Quando si evolve, la corazza cade.
description.pt-BR: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
description.ru: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
description.ja: 硬い　殻の　中では　細胞が 変化を　はじめている。進化する 瞬間に　殻が　はがれ落ちる。

description.fr: À force de rêver de pouvoir voler, sa structure cellulaire a évolué et il s’est vu pousser des ailes.
description.en: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
description.es: Si se enfada, no hay forma de calmarlo; lo destruye todo lanzando arañazos y llamas.
description.de: Wenn es wütend ist, gerät es außer Kontrolle. Es zerstört alles mit seinen Klauen und mit Feuer.
description.it: Quando è adirato diventa una furia. Con i suoi artigli laceranti e le fiammate che lancia può distruggere qualsiasi cosa.
description.pt-BR: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
description.ru: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
description.ja: 怒らせると　手が　つけられない。 すべての　ものを　ツメで　切り裂き 炎で　燃やして　破壊する。

description.fr: Il dialogue avec les siens par impulsions magnétiques. En bande, ils se déplacent à l’unisson.
description.en: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
description.es: Los pulsos magnéticos de su cuerpo repelen la gravedad, lo que le permite flotar en el aire.
description.de: Es fliegt, indem es eine magnetische Kraft erzeugt, durch die es der natürlichen Anziehungskraft der Erde trotzt.
description.it: Riesce a fluttuare in aria grazie alla repulsione tra le proprie onde magnetiche e quelle della terra.
description.pt-BR: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
description.ru: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
description.ja: 体から　出ている　磁力と 地上の　磁力を　反発させて 空に　浮かぶのだ。

description.fr: Il est formé de deux Terhal soudés. Son corps de fer résiste à un choc avec un avion à réaction.
description.en: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
description.es: Lo forman dos Beldum unidos. Puede chocarse con un avión sin que su cuerpo de acero sufra ni un rasguño.
description.de: Das Pokémon besteht aus zwei Tanhel. Es bekommt selbst dann keinen Kratzer, wenn ein Jet es streift.
description.it: È sorto dalla fusione di due Beldum. Il suo corpo d’acciaio non viene scalfito neanche se urta un jet.
description.pt-BR: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
description.ru: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
description.ja: ２匹の　ダンバルが　合体した。 鋼の　ボディは　ジェット機と 衝突しても　傷つかない。

description.fr: Il est né de la fusion de plusieurs Métang. Ses quatre cerveaux en font l’égal d’un superordinateur.
description.en: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
description.es: Gracias a sus cuatro cerebros, es más inteligente que un superordenador y analiza con precisión al enemigo.
description.de: Dank seiner vier vernetzten Hirne kann es Gegner besser als ein Supercomputer mit komplizierten Formeln analysieren.
description.it: Con l’incredibile velocità di calcolo dei suoi quattro cervelli analizza il nemico più rapidamente di un supercomputer.
description.pt-BR: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
description.ru: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
description.ja: ４つの　脳みそが　連なり スーパーコンピュータより　すごい 計算で　相手を　分析する。

description.fr: Tout son corps est fait de roche. S’il s’ébrèche au combat, il utilise des pierres pour le réparer.
description.en: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
description.es: Su cuerpo está hecho de roca. Si se astilla durante el combate, emplea piedras para repararlo.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht aus Stein. Bricht im Kampf etwas heraus, wird es durch Stein wieder ersetzt.
description.it: È formato interamente da rocce. Se si staccano nella lotta, ne cerca altre per sostituirle.
description.pt-BR: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
description.ru: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
description.ja: 全身が　岩で　できている。 戦いで　体が　欠けても 岩を　くっつけて　治してしまう。

description.fr: Son corps est fait de glace datant de l’ère glaciaire. Il contrôle un air gelé de -200 °C.
description.en: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
description.es: Dicen que ha yacido durmiendo en un glaciar durante milenios. Ni el magma puede derretir su cuerpo.
description.de: Es heißt, es habe Jahrtausende lang im ewigen Eis geschlummert. Selbst Magma schmilzt es nicht.
description.it: Si dice che sia rimasto a dormire nei ghiacci per alcuni millenni. Nemmeno il magma riuscirebbe a scioglierlo.
description.pt-BR: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
description.ru: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
description.ja: 氷河の　中で　数千年 眠っていたと　言われている。 マグマでも　体は　溶けない。

description.fr: Son corps invulnérable fut forgé par la pression souterraine durant des dizaines de milliers d’années.
description.en: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
description.es: Su cuerpo ha estado sometido a la presión subterránea durante miles de años y no puede arañarse.
description.de: Im Laufe der Jahrtausende, die es unterirdisch lebte, wurde sein Körper durch Druck und Wärme hart.
description.it: La pressione subita sottoterra per decine di migliaia di anni ha reso il suo corpo resistentissimo.
description.pt-BR: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
description.ru: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
description.ja: 何万年も　地下の　圧力で 鍛えられた　金属の　ボディは 傷ひとつ　つかない。

description.fr: Son corps est recouvert d’un duvet qui reflète la lumière et le rend invisible.
description.en: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
description.es: Se comunica por telepatía. Su plumaje refleja la luz, lo que le permite hacerse invisible.
description.de: Es kommuniziert durch Telepathie. Sein Daunenkleid bricht das Licht, sodass es unsichtbar wird.
description.it: Sa comunicare telepaticamente. Le piume sul suo corpo riflettono la luce e lo rendono invisibile.
description.pt-BR: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
description.ru: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
description.ja: テレパシーで　気持ちを　通わせる。 光を　屈折させる　羽毛で 体を　包み　姿を　消す。

description.fr: Un Pokémon très intelligent. Il peut voler plus vite qu’un avion à réaction en repliant ses ailes.
description.en: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
description.es: Es un Pokémon muy inteligente. Puede adelantar a aviones a reacción plegando las alas.
description.de: Ein hochintelligentes Pokémon. Wenn es im Flug seine Flügel nach hinten legt, ist es schneller als ein Jet.
description.it: Pokémon molto intelligente. Ripiegando indietro le ali, riesce a volare più veloce di un jet.
description.pt-BR: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
description.ru: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
description.ja: 高い　知能を　持つ　ポケモン。 腕を　折りたたんで　飛べば ジェット機を　追い越す　スピードだ。

description.fr: On dit qu’il a fait monter les eaux en causant des pluies diluviennes. Il somnolait dans une fosse marine.
description.en: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
description.es: Pokémon legendario que aumentó los mares con diluvios y maremotos. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Groudon.
description.de: Der Legende nach erschuf sein Regen das Meer. Es und Groudon lieferten sich einen langen Kampf.
description.it: Nella mitologia, Kyogre è il Pokémon che ha ampliato i mari con megaonde e megapiogge. Nemico di Groudon.
description.pt-BR: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
description.ru: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
description.ja: 大雨と　大津波で　海を　広げた 神話の　ポケモン。 グラードンと　激しく　戦った。

description.fr: Il dormait dans le magma souterrain depuis sa lutte féroce contre Kyogre, il y a longtemps de cela.
description.en: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
description.es: Dicen que aumentó la superficie terrestre evaporando el agua. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Kyogre.
description.de: Sein Feuer erschuf einst das Land. Es und Kyogre lieferten sich einen langen Kampf.
description.it: Si tramanda che fece evaporare l’acqua per aumentare la superficie terrestre. Nemico di Kyogre.
description.pt-BR: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
description.ru: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
description.ja: 高熱で　水を　蒸発させて 大地を　広げたと　言われている。 カイオーガと　激しく　戦った。

description.fr: Il vit dans la couche d’ozone, au dessus des nuages. Il est invisible depuis le sol.
description.en: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
description.es: Vive en la capa de ozono sobre las nubes y no puede ser visto desde el suelo.
description.de: Es lebt in der Ozonschicht hoch über den Wolken und kann vom Boden aus nicht gesehen werden.
description.it: Vive nello strato di ozono oltre le nuvole e non può essere avvistato da terra.
description.pt-BR: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
description.ru: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
description.ja: 雲より　はるか上の　オゾン層に 生息しているため　地上から 姿を　見ることは　できない。

description.fr: On raconte qu’une fois tous les mille ans, il a la capacité d’exaucer tous les vœux durant une semaine.
description.en: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
description.es: Desde antaño se dice que concederá los deseos escritos en las notas de su cabeza cuando se despierte.
description.de: Wenn Jirachi erwacht, erfüllt es die Wünsche, die man auf die Zettel an seinem Kopf geschrieben hat.
description.it: Da sempre si dice che al risveglio realizzi i desideri scritti sulle striscioline attaccate in testa.
description.pt-BR: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
description.ru: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
description.ja: 目覚めた　とき　頭の　短冊に 書かれた　願い事を　かなえると 大昔から　語り継がれてきた。

description.fr: Il vient d’un virus extraterrestre arrivé avec une météorite et ayant subi une mutation génétique.
description.en: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
description.es: Surgió a raíz de la mutación de ADN de un virus alienígena que cayó a la Tierra en un meteorito.
description.de: Ein außerirdischer Virus kam mit einem Meteor auf die Erde. Seine DNA mutierte. So entstand Deoxys.
description.it: È il risultato della mutazione genetica di un virus alieno giunto con un meteorite.
description.pt-BR: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
description.ru: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
description.ja: 隕石に　付着していた 宇宙ウイルスの　ＤＮＡが 変異して　生まれた　ポケモン。

description.fr: La coquille sur son dos est faite de terre. Plus il est en bonne santé, plus elle est humide.
description.en: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description.es: Realiza la fotosíntesis al bañarle los rayos de sol. Su concha está formada por tierra endurecida.
description.de: Im Sonnenlicht betreibt sein ganzer Körper Photosynthese. Sein Panzer besteht aus hartem Lehm.
description.it: Fa la fotosintesi su tutto il corpo esponendosi ai raggi solari. La sua corazza è fatta di terra compatta.
description.pt-BR: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description.ru: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
description.ja: 太陽の　光を　浴びて 全身で　光合成を　する。 甲羅は　土が　硬くなったもの。

description.fr: Il sait d’instinct où trouver une source d’eau pure. Il y transporte d’autres Pokémon sur son dos.
description.en: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.es: Vive en los bosques cerca del agua. Por el día, sale a que les dé el sol a las plantas de su espalda.
description.de: Es lebt in der Nähe von Wasser in Wäldern. Tagsüber verlässt es diese, um ein Sonnenbad zu nehmen.
description.it: Vive nelle foreste vicino all’acqua, ma esce di giorno per far prendere sole alle piante sul guscio.
description.pt-BR: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.ru: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
description.ja: 森の　中の　水辺で　暮らす。 昼間は　森の　外に　出て 甲羅の　木に　光を　当てる。

description.fr: Certains petits Pokémon peuvent naître sur son dos et y passer toute leur vie.
description.en: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description.es: Las gentes de antaño creían que el planeta se sustentaba en la espalda de un gran Torterra.
description.de: In alten Zeiten malten die Menschen sich aus, die Erde ruhe auf dem Rücken eines riesigen Chelterrar.
description.it: In tempi antichissimi la gente pensava che sottoterra ci fossero dei giganteschi Torterra.
description.pt-BR: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description.ru: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
description.ja: 大昔の　人々は　大地の　下には 巨大な　ドダイトスが　いると 空想していた。

description.fr: Il est très agile. Il fait toujours attention d’éteindre la flamme de sa queue avant de se coucher.
description.en: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description.es: El gas de su panza alimenta el fuego de su parte trasera, que ni la lluvia puede extinguir.
description.de: Das Feuer an seinem Hinterteil wird durch Gase im Bauch genährt. Selbst Regen löscht es nicht.
description.it: Le fiamme sulla coda, alimentate dai gas della pancia, non si spengono neppure quando piove.
description.pt-BR: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description.ru: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
description.ja: お尻の　炎は お腹で　作られた　ガスが　燃料。 雨に　ぬれても　消えない。

description.fr: Il contrôle habilement l’intensité de la flamme de sa queue pour tenir ses adversaires à distance.
description.en: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description.es: Controla hábilmente la intensidad del fuego de su cola para mantener al enemigo a una distancia ideal.
description.de: Es kontrolliert die Stärke des Feuers auf seinem Schweif geschickt, um Gegner auf Distanz zu halten.
description.it: Controlla abilmente l’intensità delle fiamme sulla sua coda per tenere i nemici alla distanza ideale.
description.pt-BR: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description.ru: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
description.ja: 尻尾の　炎の　勢いを うまく　コントロールして 自分の　得意な　間合いで　戦うのだ。

description.fr: Ses techniques de combat inédites à base de pieds et poings enflammés sont redoutables.
description.en: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description.es: Su corona de fuego demuestra su naturaleza ígnea. Nadie le gana en velocidad.
description.de: Seine Krone aus Feuer ist Zeichen seines feurigen Wesens. Niemand ist schneller im Kampf als dieses Pokémon.
description.it: La sua criniera di fuoco è indice della sua natura violenta. Nessuno può batterlo in velocità.
description.pt-BR: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description.ru: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
description.ja: 頭で　燃える　炎の　ように 激しい　性格の　ポケモン。 素早さでは　だれにも　負けない。

description.fr: Malgré sa démarche maladroite et ses pertes d’équilibre, il bombe toujours fièrement le torse.
description.en: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description.es: No le gusta que lo cuiden. Como no aprecia el apoyo de su Entrenador, le cuesta coger confianza con él.
description.de: Einmischung kann es gar nicht leiden. Es ist bockig und fasst nur schwer Zutrauen zu seinem Trainer.
description.it: Molto orgoglioso. Difficile farci amicizia perché non ascolta mai i consigli dell’Allenatore.
description.pt-BR: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description.ru: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
description.ja: 世話を　焼かれる　ことが　大嫌い。 トレーナーの　指示を　聞かないので 仲良く　なるのが　難しい。

description.fr: La fierté du Prinplouf est si grande qu’il lui est impossible de vivre en groupe.
description.en: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.es: Vive solo, alejado de los demás. Cada uno piensa que es el más importante.
description.de: Es lebt allein, entfernt von anderen. Jedes von ihnen denkt, es sei das Bedeutendste unter ihnen.
description.it: Vive da solo lontano dagli altri. Apparentemente ogni esemplare crede di essere il più importante.
description.pt-BR: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.ru: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
description.ja: 群れを　作らずに　１匹で　いる。 自分が　一番　偉いと　どの ポッタイシも　考えているようだ。

description.fr: S’il voit son honneur bafoué, il est capable de faire des ravages avec ses ailes tranchantes.
description.en: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description.es: Nada tan rápido como un fueraborda. Con los afilados bordes de sus alas puede cortar el hielo.
description.de: Es schwimmt so schnell wie ein Rennboot. Seine Flügel haben scharfe Seiten und können Packeis schneiden.
description.it: Nuota veloce come una moto d’acqua. Le estremità delle ali sono aguzze e spaccano anche il ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description.ru: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
description.ja: ジェットスキーに　負けない　速度で 泳ぐ。翼の　縁は　鋭く 流氷を　切断する。

description.fr: La faiblesse des Étourmi les force à vivre en groupe, mais ils se chamaillent souvent.
description.en: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.es: Viaja en grandes bandadas. Aunque es pequeño, agita las alas con gran fuerza.
description.de: Ihr Schwarm ist stets groß. Obwohl es kleine Pokémon sind, schwingen sie ihre Flügel mit enormer Kraft.
description.it: Si muove in grandi gruppi. Anche se piccolo, batte le ali in maniera molto energica.
description.pt-BR: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.ru: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
description.ja: たくさんの　群れで　行動する。 体は　小さいが 羽ばたく　力は　非常に　強い。

description.fr: Conscient de sa propre faiblesse, il vit toujours en groupe, piaillant bruyamment quand il est seul.
description.en: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description.es: Vive siempre en grandes grupos y las disputas dentro de ellos son muy intensas.
description.de: Es neigt dazu, sich in großen Gruppen zu bewegen. Zwischen ihnen kommt es zu heftigen Kämpfen.
description.it: Ha l’abitudine di riunirsi in grandi gruppi. Le zuffe tra gruppi sono particolarmente vivaci.
description.pt-BR: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description.ru: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
description.ja: 大きな　グループを　作って 行動する　習性。 グループ同士の　争いは　激しい。

description.fr: Il combattra sans relâche, même blessé. Il prend grand soin de sa mèche.
description.en: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description.es: Sus alas y sus patas son muy fuertes. Puede llevarse volando Pokémon pequeños.
description.de: Die Muskeln in seinen Flügeln und Beinen sind stark. Es kann im Flug sogar ein anderes Pokémon tragen.
description.it: I muscoli di ali e zampe sono molto sviluppati. Vola senza fatica anche portando un piccolo Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description.ru: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
description.ja: 翼と　脚の　筋肉が　強く 小さな　ポケモンを　つかんだまま らくらくと　飛ぶことが　できる。

description.fr: Une étude a montré que les dents du Keunotor poussaient aussi vite que celles du Rattata.
description.en: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.es: Tiene nervios de acero y nada puede perturbarlo. Es más ágil y activo de lo que aparenta.
description.de: Es hat Nerven wie Drahtseile, nichts kann es erschüttern. Es ist agiler und aktiver, als es scheint.
description.it: Ha i nervi d’acciaio e niente può turbarlo. È più agile e attivo di quanto sembri.
description.pt-BR: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.ru: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
description.ja: なにごとにも　動じない 図太い　神経の　持ち主。 見かけの　割には　機敏に　活動する。

description.fr: Les digues insubmersibles qu’il construit font le bonheur des habitants proches.
description.en: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description.es: Con sus incisivos roe ramas y raíces y las apila para construir sus madrigueras junto al río.
description.de: Emsig durchbeißt es mit seinen scharfen Vorderzähnen Wurzeln und Äste und baut daraus sein Nest.
description.it: Costruisce con zelo la tana in riva ai corsi d’acqua, levigando radici e rami con gli affilati incisivi.
description.pt-BR: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description.ru: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
description.ja: 鋭い　前歯で　削り取った 木の枝や　根っこを　積み上げて 水辺に　せっせと　巣を　作る。

description.fr: Quand il tombe du haut de ses petites pattes, ses antennes font un bruit de xylophone.
description.en: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description.es: Hablan entre sí chocando las antenas. Los sonidos producidos son muy característicos.
description.de: Diese Pokémon unterhalten sich, indem sie ihre Antennen aneinanderschlagen. Der Ton ist ihr Kennzeichen.
description.it: Comunica con il suono prodotto dallo scontro delle sue antenne. Esso indica l’arrivo dell’autunno.
description.pt-BR: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description.ru: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
description.ja: 触覚を　ぶつけ合って　鳴らす　音で 仲間と　会話をする。 音色は　秋の　夜の　風物詩。

description.fr: Ses cris sont tellement variés qu’il existe un village où on organise des concours en leur honneur.
description.en: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.es: Cuando llora, cruza sus brazos con forma de cuchillo. Puede improvisar melodías.
description.de: Wenn es ruft, verschränkt es seine messerartigen Arme vor der Brust. Es komponiert aus dem Stegreif.
description.it: Quando canta tiene le zampe incrociate al petto. Sa improvvisare melodie.
description.pt-BR: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.ru: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
description.ja: 鳴くときは　ナイフのような　腕を 胸の　前で　交差させる。 即興で　メロディを　作る。

description.fr: Ses muscles génèrent un courant électrique lorsqu’ils travaillent. Il s’illumine en cas de danger.
description.en: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description.es: La extensión y contracción de sus músculos genera electricidad. Brilla cuando está en peligro.
description.de: Es erzeugt Elektrizität durch das Strecken und Zusammenziehen seiner Muskeln. Bei Bedrohung glüht es.
description.it: Produce elettricità contraendo e rilassando i muscoli. Quando si sente minacciato si illumina.
description.pt-BR: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description.ru: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
description.ja: 体を　動かすたびに　筋肉が 伸び縮みして　電気が　生まれる。 ピンチになると　体が　輝く。

description.fr: Le courant qui circule à la pointe de ses griffes est capable de faire perdre connaissance à ses proies.
description.en: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.es: Sus garras emiten electricidad que puede debilitar a sus rivales. Viven en grupos pequeños.
description.de: Seine Krallen geben Elektrizität ab, die stark genug ist, jemanden bewusstlos zu machen.
description.it: Dagli artigli rilascia un’elettricità talmente intensa da mandare KO il nemico. Vive in piccoli gruppi.
description.pt-BR: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.ru: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
description.ja: １発で　気絶させるほどの　電流を ツメから　流す。 数匹の　グループで　暮らす。

description.fr: Il est capable de voir à travers les murs pour chasser des proies ou retrouver ses petits égarés.
description.en: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description.es: Cuando sus ojos brillan como el oro, puede ver presas escondidas, incluso detrás de un muro.
description.de: Leuchten seine Augen golden auf, kann es Beute, die sich versteckt, sehen. Es kann durch Wände sehen.
description.it: Se i suoi occhi sono dorati, può individuare le prede, anche quelle che si nascondono dietro i muri.
description.pt-BR: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description.ru: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
description.ja: 瞳が　金色に　光るとき 壁の　向こうに　隠れている 獲物を　見つけることが　できる。

description.fr: Il est sensible aux variations de température et on dit qu’il fleurit quand il sent la chaleur du soleil.
description.en: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description.es: Vive cerca de aguas cristalinas. Su cabello se abre y esparce polen cuando le bañan los rayos del sol.
description.de: Bei Sonnenlicht öffnet es seine Knospe und gibt Pollen ab. Es lebt in der Nähe von sauberem Wasser.
description.it: I raggi del sole gli fanno schiudere la gemma e rilasciare polline. Fa la tana vicino a bei corsi d’acqua.
description.pt-BR: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description.ru: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
description.ja: 暖かい　日差しを　浴びると つぼみが　開き　花粉を　飛ばす。 きれいな　水の　近くが　住処。

description.fr: Ses mains contenant chacune des toxines différentes sont capables d’asséner de puissants coups.
description.en: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description.es: Atrae a sus presas con una dulce fragancia y usa sus cepas venenosas para atenazarlas y acabar con ellas.
description.de: Es lockt seine Beute mit süßem Duft an, um sie danach mit seinen dornigen Ranken zu peitschen oder zu würgen.
description.it: Attira la preda con il suo profumo soave per poi afferrarla e abbatterla con gli arti velenosi.
description.pt-BR: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description.ru: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
description.ja: 甘い　香りで　獲物を　誘い 両腕の　毒のムチを　使って 刺したり　締めたりして　しとめる。

description.fr: Il vivait dans la jungle il y a 100 millions d’années. Il abat un arbre d’un coup de tête.
description.en: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description.es: Fue recreado a partir de un fósil con forma esférica. Derriba a las presas a cabezazos.
description.de: Es wurde aus einem ballartigen, eisernen Fossil geschaffen. Es schlägt Beute mit einem Kopfstoß.
description.it: È stato fatto rivivere da un fossile di ferro simile a una palla. Abbatte le prede con le punte sulla testa.
description.pt-BR: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description.ru: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
description.ja: 鉄球の　ような　化石から 復活した　古代の　ポケモン。 頭突きで　獲物を　しとめた。

description.fr: Quand deux Charkos se rentrent dedans, leur crâne extrêmement épais les empêche de s’assommer.
description.en: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description.es: Tiene sesos pequeños porque su duro cráneo, que soporta cualquier golpe, les impide desarrollarse.
description.de: Sein dicker Schädelknochen trotzt jedem Angriff. Gleichzeitig stoppt er jedoch sein Hirnwachstum.
description.it: Il suo spesso cranio, che sopporta qualunque impatto, è ridotto, e il cervello non si è sviluppato.
description.pt-BR: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description.ru: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
description.ja: どんな　衝撃にも　耐えられる 分厚い　頭蓋骨に　押さえられて 脳みそは　大きく　ならなかった。

description.fr: Il est si bien protégé qu’il peut déguster Baies et herbe fraîche sans craindre de prédateurs.
description.en: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description.es: Se abrillanta la cara frotándola contra los árboles. Es vulnerable a los ataques por la espalda.
description.de: Es reibt sein Gesicht an Baumstämmen, um es zu polieren. Es ist leicht, es von hinten anzugreifen.
description.it: Si pulisce il muso strofinandolo contro i tronchi degli alberi. È vulnerabile agli attacchi alle spalle.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description.ru: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
description.ja: 大木の　幹に　こすりつけて 硬い　顔を　磨く　習性。 後ろからの　攻撃に　弱い。

description.fr: En groupe, ils protègent leurs petits en formant autour d’eux une impénétrable muraille.
description.en: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description.es: Se alineaban y creaban una barrera que ningún enemigo podía cruzar. Así protegían a sus crías.
description.de: Stellen sie sich Seite an Seite, kann kein Gegner hindurchbrechen. So schützen sie auch ihre Jungen.
description.it: Se si mettono uno di fianco all’altro nessun nemico riesce a passare. Proteggono così i loro cuccioli.
description.pt-BR: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description.ru: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
description.ja: 横一列に　並ぶと　どんな ポケモンでも　突破　できない。 そうやって　子供を　守っていた。

description.fr: Nul ne sait comment il y parvient, mais il arrive toujours à se former une cape, où qu’il soit.
description.en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.es: Para protegerse de los vientos fríos invernales, se cubre con un caparazón de ramas y hojas.
description.de: Um sich vor dem eisigen Winterwind zu schützen, legt es sich unter einen Umhang aus Ästen und Laub.
description.it: Per ripararsi dal freddo e dai venti invernali si copre con un manto fatto di rami e foglie.
description.pt-BR: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.ru: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
description.ja: 冷たい　木枯らしを　防ぐため 小枝や　落ち葉を　材料に ミノを　作り　体を　覆う。

description.fr: À l’évolution, son corps absorbe les matériaux à proximité et peut ainsi présenter divers aspects.
description.en: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description.es: Su apariencia varía según dónde evolucione. Los materiales que haya pasan a formar parte de su cuerpo.
description.de: Die Umgebung, in der es sich entwickelt, bestimmt sein Aussehen. Es formt seinen Körper mithilfe der umliegenden Materialien.
description.it: Il suo aspetto dipende dal luogo in cui si evolve. Tutto ciò che ha intorno va a costituire il suo corpo.
description.pt-BR: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description.ru: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
description.ja: 進化した　場所によって 姿が　変わる。身近にある　材料が 体の　一部に　なるのだ。

description.fr: Il adore le nectar des fleurs mais n’en récolte pas lui-même. Il préfère en voler à un Apitrini.
description.en: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
description.es: Le encanta la miel de las flores y roba la que recoge Combee.
description.de: Es liebt Honig und stiehlt den Honig, der von Wadribie gesammelt wurde.
description.it: Ama il nettare dei fiori. Ruba e mangia il nettare raccolto da Combee.
description.pt-BR: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
description.ru: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
description.ja: 花の　ミツが　大好き。 ミツハニーの　集めた　ミツを 横取りして　食べてしまう。

description.fr: Ce trio inséparable depuis la naissance récolte du miel pour satisfaire Apireine.
description.en: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
description.es: El trío se forma al nacer y se pasa la vida recogiendo miel de las flores para satisfacer a Vespiquen.
description.de: Dieses Trio ist von Geburt an zusammen. Fleißig bringt es Blütenhonig zu Honweisel.
description.it: Il trio è insieme dalla nascita. È sempre impegnato a portare il nettare dei fiori a Vespiquen.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
description.ru: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
description.ja: 生まれたときから　３匹　一緒。 ビークインに　喜んでもらうため いつも　花のミツを　集めている。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon utilise des phéromones pour donner des ordres de combat aux larves dans son abdomen.
description.en: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
description.es: Cría larvas en los panales de su cuerpo. Segrega diversas feromonas de su cuerpo con las cuales controla a sus crías.
description.de: Es beherbergt Jung-Pokémon in seinem Rumpf, die es mithilfe von verschiedenen Pheromonen frei herumkommandieren kann.
description.it: Nell’addome ospita la sua progenie, sulla quale esercita un controllo assoluto tramite i feromoni che rilascia.
description.pt-BR: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
description.ru: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
description.ja: 胴体は　子供たちの　巣穴。 いろんな　フェロモンを　だして 子供たちを　自由に　操る。

description.fr: Il arrive que deux Pachirisu se frottent les joues pour partager l’électricité qu’ils ont accumulée.
description.en: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.es: Crea bolas de pelo que crepitan con electricidad estática. Las almacena en agujeros de árboles.
description.de: Es bildet ein Fellknäuel, der vor statischer Energie knistert. Es speichert die Energie in Bäumen.
description.it: Forma delle palle di pelo cariche elettrostaticamente e le conserva negli alberi insieme alle bacche.
description.pt-BR: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.ru: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
description.ja: 静電気が　たまって　パチパチする 毛玉を　大好物の　木の実と　一緒に 幹の　穴に　隠す。

description.fr: Il utilise ses deux queues comme une hélice pour se propulser sous l’eau et trancher les algues.
description.en: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description.es: Nada rotando sus dos colas a modo de tornillo. Cuando bucea, el flotador se pliega.
description.de: Es schwimmt, indem es seine beiden Schweife wie eine Schiffsschraube rotieren lässt.
description.it: Nuota roteando le due code come fossero viti. Quando si immerge, il suo galleggiante si sgonfia.
description.pt-BR: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description.ru: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
description.ja: ２本の　尻尾を スクリューの　ように　回して　泳ぐ。 潜る　ときは　浮き袋が　しぼむ。

description.fr: Il chasse souvent près des ports de pêche où il sauve parfois les gens tombés à la mer.
description.en: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.es: Nada gracias a su flotador. Ayuda en los rescates de gente que se está ahogando.
description.de: Es treibt mithilfe einer Art Rettungsring auf dem Wasser und hilft dem, der zu ertrinken droht.
description.it: Nuota con il suo grosso galleggiante e aiuta a soccorrere chi sta per annegare.
description.pt-BR: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.ru: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
description.ja: 発達した　浮き袋で　浮かぶ。 おぼれた　人を　救助する 手伝いを　している　ポケモンだ。

description.fr: Sa petite boule rose est nutritive et délicieuse. Les Étourmi en raffolent.
description.en: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description.es: Bajo la luz solar es rojo. La esfera pequeña pierde sus nutrientes y se seca para anunciar la evolución.
description.de: Sonnenlicht färbt es rot. Verliert das kleine Bällchen Nährstoffe, welkt es und die Entwicklung beginnt.
description.it: La luce solare lo tinge di rosso. Se la pallina esaurisce i nutrimenti, si avvizzisce indicando l’evoluzione.
description.pt-BR: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description.ru: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
description.ja: 日の光で　赤く　色づく。 栄養分が　吸われて　小さい　玉が しぼむと　進化が　近い。

description.fr: Sous un grand soleil, il ouvre ses pétales pour en absorber les rayons.
description.en: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description.es: Cuando los rayos de sol inundan su capullo, abre de par en par sus pétalos y se vuelve muy dinámico.
description.de: Bei Sonnenschein entfaltet seine Knospe ihre Blütenblätter und es springt lebhaft umher.
description.it: Sboccia quando si espone ai raggi solari, espandendo la corolla e diventando molto attivo.
description.pt-BR: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description.ru: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
description.ja: つぼみが　太陽の　光を　浴びて 花びらを　広げると 活発に　動くように　なる。

description.fr: Un étrange liquide mauve s’échappe de son corps, ne lui appuyez pas dessus.
description.en: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description.es: No hay que apretarle muy fuerte, ya que, si lo haces, secreta un misterioso fluido morado.
description.de: Nicht seinen Körper zusammendrücken, sonst sickert eine seltsame lilafarbene Flüssigkeit aus!
description.it: Se si esercita una forte pressione sul suo corpo, ne fuoriesce un misterioso liquido viola.
description.pt-BR: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description.ru: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
description.ja: やわらかい　体を　強く押すと 紫色の　ナゾの　液体が にじみ出るので　要注意。

description.fr: Ses gènes ont démontré qu’il avait jadis une carapace couvrant la totalité de son dos.
description.en: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description.es: Si se ve amenazado por sus enemigos naturales, segrega un líquido morado y huye rápidamente.
description.de: Wird es von einem natürlichen Feind angegriffen, flieht es, indem es ein lila Sekret über die Haut ausstößt.
description.it: Se minacciato da un nemico naturale rilascia un liquido viola e se la dà a gambe, per così dire...
description.pt-BR: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description.ru: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
description.ja: 天敵に　襲われたときは 紫色の　液体を 体から　出して　逃げる。

description.fr: Ses queues jumelles sont si agiles et efficaces qu’il ne se sert que très rarement de ses bras.
description.en: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description.es: Habitan en grandes colonias y forman anillos uniendo sus colas, aparentemente en signo de amistad.
description.de: Sie leben in großen Kolonien und verbinden ihre Schweife in Freundschaft.
description.it: Vivono in colonie numerose e formano anelli legando le loro code in segno di amicizia.
description.pt-BR: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description.ru: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
description.ja: 大勢の　群れで　行動する。 尻尾を　つなぎ合わせて　輪っかを 作る。友情の　印らしい。

description.fr: Sa façon de flotter sans but au gré du vent lui a valu le surnom de “bouée des esprits égarés”.
description.en: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description.es: Está formado por los espíritus de personas y Pokémon. Le encantan las estaciones húmedas.
description.de: Ein Pokémon, entstanden aus den Gefühlen von Menschen und Pokémon. Es mag feuchte Jahreszeiten.
description.it: Pokémon formato dalle anime di persone e Pokémon. Ama le stagioni umide.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description.ru: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
description.ja: 人や　ポケモンの　魂が 固まって　生まれた　ポケモン。 ジメジメした　季節が　大好き。

description.fr: Des nuées de Grodrive dérivent dans le ciel au crépuscule. Ils disparaissent dès qu’on les voit.
description.en: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description.es: Transporta a gente y a Pokémon volando, pero, como se deja llevar, puede acabar en cualquier sitio.
description.de: Es trägt Menschen und Pokémon im Flug. Da es sich aber nur vom Wind tragen lässt, weiß man nie, wo es hingeht.
description.it: Vola trascinando persone e Pokémon. Poiché si fa portare dal vento, non si sa dove vada a finire.
description.pt-BR: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description.ru: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
description.ja: 人や　ポケモンを　乗せて　飛ぶが 風に　流されているだけなので どこへ　飛んでいくか　わからない。

description.fr: Ses oreilles repliées se déroulent avec une force capable de briser un gros rocher.
description.en: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description.es: Lleva las orejas enrolladas. Cuando las extiende, golpea con tal fuerza que incluso puede romper rocas.
description.de: Seine Ohren sind immer aufgerollt. Mit ihnen kann es selbst große Felsbrocken zertrümmern.
description.it: Le sue orecchie sono sempre arrotolate. Può estenderle con forza per distruggere qualsiasi cosa.
description.pt-BR: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description.ru: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
description.ja: いつも　まるめている　耳を 勢いよく　伸ばすと　大きな 岩も　簡単に　壊せる。

description.fr: Il est capable de décocher de puissants coups de pied si on touche à ses délicates oreilles.
description.en: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description.es: Este Pokémon resulta muy precavido. Si siente peligro, escapa corriendo a grandes saltos.
description.de: Es ist extrem vorsichtig. Wenn es Gefahr wittert, macht es sich mit flinken Sprüngen aus dem Staub.
description.it: È un Pokémon estremamente cauto. Se avverte un pericolo, si dà subito alla fuga saltellando.
description.pt-BR: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description.ru: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
description.ja: 警戒心が　とても　強い。 危険を　感じると　軽やかに 飛び跳ねて　走り去ってしまう。

description.fr: Pareil à une incantation magique, son cri n’est que très rarement source de joie.
description.en: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description.es: Recita cánticos. Algunos de ellos atormentan a sus rivales, mientras que otros producen felicidad.
description.de: Es spricht Beschwörungen. Viele lösen Schmerzen aus, manche aber bringen Glück.
description.it: Recita incantesimi che tormentano il nemico. Tuttavia, alcune formule portano felicità.
description.pt-BR: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description.ru: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
description.ja: じゅもんを　唱える　ポケモン。 相手を　苦しめるもの　だけでなく 幸せにする　じゅもんも　ある。

description.fr: Son cri profond peut invoquer une meute de Cornèbre. On l’appelle “le crieur de mauvais augure”.
description.en: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description.es: Si uno lanza un grito profundo, los demás acuden. Por eso se le llama también Invocador de la Noche.
description.de: Sein tiefer Ruf lockt andere Kramurx herbei. Man nennt es daher „Beschwörer der Nacht“.
description.it: Se emette un verso profondo, molti Murkrow accorrono all’istante. È detto “Evocatore della notte”.
