description.pt-BR: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description.ru: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
description.ja: ドンカラスが　低い声で　鳴くと すぐさま　ヤミカラスが　集まるため 夜を招くもの　とも　言われる。

description.fr: Il a tendance à planter ses griffes dans le nez de son Dresseur s’il n’a pas été nourri à temps.
description.en: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.es: Araña cuando está enfadado y ronronea cuando está cariñoso. Su imprevisibilidad es famosa.
description.de: Es schlägt mit Krallen zu oder schnurrt, je nachdem, ob es gerade wütend oder zutraulich ist.
description.it: Se disturbato, tira fuori gli artigli; se soddisfatto, fa le fusa. La sua incostanza piace a molti.
description.pt-BR: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.ru: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
description.ja: 気に入らないと　ツメを　立てるが たまに　のどを　鳴らして 甘える　性格が　一部に　大人気だ。

description.fr: Il plaque ses queues contre son dos pour paraître plus grand. Il soutient un regard des heures.
description.en: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description.es: Si se siente a gusto, no tiene ningún reparo en apropiarse de las moradas de otros Pokémon.
description.de: Behagt ihm die Behausung eines anderen Pokémon, bleibt Shnurgarst einfach da und nistet sich dort ein.
description.it: Si introduce sfacciatamente nelle tane degli altri Pokémon rivendicandole poi come proprie.
description.pt-BR: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description.ru: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
description.ja: ほかの　ポケモンの　住処でも 居心地が　良ければ　居座って 自分の　住処に　してしまう。

description.fr: Quand il sautille, l’orbe qu’il a dans la bouche s’agite et tinte comme une cloche.
description.en: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description.es: Emite un tintineo cada vez que salta. Ensordece a sus rivales con sonidos de alta frecuencia.
description.de: Jedes Mal, wenn es hüpft, entsteht ein klingender Laut. Seine hohen Schreie machen die Gegner taub.
description.it: A ogni salto produce un suono che sembra uno squillo. I suoi versi ad alta frequenza assordano i nemici.
description.pt-BR: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description.ru: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
description.ja: 跳ねるたびに　リリンと　音を　出す。 高い　周波数の　鳴き声で 相手の　耳を　聞こえなくする。

description.fr: Son derrière propulse un fluide nauséabond qui peut faire fuir les Pokémon dans un rayon de 2 km.
description.en: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description.es: Expulsa un fluido maloliente por sus cuartos traseros. El hedor repele Pokémon en un radio de 2 km.
description.de: Versprüht eine Substanz aus seinem Hinterleib, die in einem großen Radius andere Pokémon fernhält.
description.it: Emette un fluido puzzolente dal posteriore. Il tanfo si sparge per 2 km e tiene lontani i Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description.ru: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
description.ja: お尻から飛ばす　くさい　汁の においは　半径２キロに　広がり まわりの　ポケモンは　いなくなる。

description.fr: Il attaque en projetant un liquide fétide du bout de sa queue. Mieux vaut l’attaquer par les airs.
description.en: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.es: Para atacar, emite un fluido maloliente por la punta de su cola que puede llegar a más de 50 m.
description.de: Über seine Schweifspitze versprüht es eine übelriechende Substanz. Die Reichweite liegt bei über 50 m.
description.it: Attacca spruzzando un fluido puzzolente dalla coda. Ha un raggio d’azione di oltre 50 m.
description.pt-BR: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.ru: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
description.ja: 尻尾の　先から　ひどい　においの 液体を　飛ばして　攻撃する。 飛距離は　５０メートル以上。

description.fr: Certains scientifiques soutiennent que ce Pokémon était jadis aussi réfléchissant qu’un miroir.
description.en: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description.es: Antaño se creía que en los dibujos de su parte posterior residía una fuerza misteriosa.
description.de: Früher glaubten die Menschen, dem Muster auf seinem Rücken wohne eine mysteriöse Kraft inne.
description.it: Nell’antichità si credeva che una forza misteriosa dimorasse nei disegni sul dorso di Bronzor.
description.pt-BR: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description.ru: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
description.ja: ドーミラーの　背中の　模様には 神秘的な　力が　宿ると 昔の　人たちは　信じていた。

description.fr: Il apportait la pluie en créant un portail vers une autre dimension. Il était synonyme de bonne récolte.
description.en: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description.es: Desde antaño se adora a este Pokémon para que propicie lluvias abundantes. A veces se esconde bajo tierra.
description.de: Man verehrt sie schon seit Urzeiten als Regenmacher. Manchmal findet man eines von ihnen im Boden vergraben.
description.it: È stato venerato per secoli come Pokémon che porta la pioggia. A volte lo si trova sepolto nel terreno.
description.pt-BR: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description.ru: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
description.ja: 雨雲を　呼べる　ポケモンとして 大昔から　まつられていた。 ときどき　地面に　埋められている。

description.fr: Adepte des climats secs, il régule son humidité en laissant couler ce qui ressemble à des larmes.
description.en: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description.es: Prefiere entornos áridos. Sus ojos expulsan agua para ajustar los niveles de fluido corporal.
description.de: Es bevorzugt trockene Gebiete. Es gibt über die Augen Wasser ab, um den Wasserhaushalt zu regulieren.
description.it: Preferisce le terre aride. Rilascia acqua dagli occhi per regolare il livello dei suoi fluidi corporei.
description.pt-BR: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description.ru: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description.ja: 乾燥した　場所を　好む。 目から　水を　出して 体の　水分を　調節する。

description.fr: Il imite les mouvements et les expressions des autres pour comprendre leurs sentiments.
description.en: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description.es: Desconcierta a sus rivales imitando sus movimientos a la perfección y aprovecha para darse a la fuga.
description.de: Es ahmt seinen Gegner nach. Während dieser noch verblüfft dreinsieht, macht es sich aus dem Staub.
description.it: Imita i movimenti del nemico, approfittando del suo momento di confusione per fuggire.
description.pt-BR: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description.ru: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
description.ja: 相手の　動きを　そっくりに 真似を　して　戸惑わせている あいだに　さっさと　逃げるのだ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon ne se sépare jamais de son petit caillou et a tendance à traîner dans les pieds des gens.
description.en: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description.es: Les da a sus amigos una roca con forma de huevo que transporta en la bolsa de su panza.
description.de: In seinem Beutel trägt es einen runden, eiförmigen Stein, den es Freunden gibt.
description.it: Trasporta una roccia a forma di uovo nella sua tasca ventrale e poi la offre ai suoi amici.
description.pt-BR: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description.ru: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
description.ja: タマゴに　似た　真んまるい　石を お腹の　袋に　入れている。 好きな　相手に　石を　渡す。

description.fr: Sa langue comparable à celle de l’homme lui permet d’imiter habilement le langage humain.
description.en: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description.es: Imita los sonidos de sus rivales, haciéndoles creer que son amigos e impidiendo que le ataquen.
description.de: Es versucht Attacken zu entgehen, indem es den Ruf des Gegners nachahmt und einen Artgenossen mimt.
description.it: Imita la voce dei nemici per far credere che è dei loro, evitando così di essere assalito.
description.pt-BR: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description.ru: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
description.ja: 相手と　同じ　鳴き声を　出す　ことで 仲間と　思いこませて 襲われないように　しているのだ。

description.fr: Son mauvais comportement lui a valu d’être enchaîné à une Clé de Voûte par un mystérieux sortilège.
description.en: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.es: Se formó a partir de 108 espíritus. Está unido a la fisura de una piedra angular mística.
description.de: Ein Pokémon, das aus 108 Geistern besteht. Es ist an einen Spalt in einem mysteriösen Stein gebunden.
description.it: Pokémon formato da 108 spiriti. È stato imprigionato nella fessura di una Roccianima.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.ru: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
description.ja: １０８個の　魂が　集まって 生まれた　ポケモン。 要石の　ひび割れに　つながれている。

description.fr: Malgré sa maladresse, son énorme gueule lui permet de lancer des attaques puissantes.
description.en: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description.es: Vive en agujeros en las cuevas, al amparo del calor geotérmico. Si se acerca un enemigo, le muerde.
description.de: Es lebt in Höhlen, die Erdwärme ausgesetzt sind. Es springt heraus und beißt, wenn Feinde sich nähern.
description.it: Vive in gallerie scaldate dal calore geotermico. Se sente un nemico arrivare, salta fuori e lo addenta.
description.pt-BR: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description.ru: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
description.ja: 地熱で　温められた　横穴で　暮らす。 敵が　近づくと　穴から　飛び出して 大口で　かみつく。

description.fr: Toujours à la recherche d’objets brillants, il arpente les grottes pour constituer son butin.
description.en: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description.es: Le gustan las cosas brillantes. Busca tesoros en cuevas y se lleva el botín a su nido.
description.de: Es liebt funkelnde Dinge und sucht nach Schätzen in Höhlen, die es dann in seinem Nest hortet.
description.it: Adora gli oggetti luccicanti. Va a caccia di tesori nelle grotte e li trasporta nel suo nido.
description.pt-BR: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description.ru: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
description.ja: 光り輝く　ものが　大好きで 洞窟の　中で　見つけた 宝を　自分の巣に　ためこむ。

description.fr: On dit que lancé à pleine vitesse, il crée des lames de vent avec ses ailes pouvant trancher un arbre.
description.en: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description.es: Cuando despliega su cuerpo y sus alas, parece un avión a reacción. Vuela a velocidad sónica.
description.de: Spannt es seinen Körper und seine Flügel, sieht es aus wie ein Jet. Es fliegt mit Schallgeschwindigkeit.
description.it: Quando si piega e distende le ali, sembra un jet. Vola a una velocità supersonica.
description.pt-BR: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description.ru: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
description.ja: 体を　折り畳み　翼を　伸ばすと まるで　ジェット機。 音速で　飛ぶことが　できる。

description.fr: Obnubilé par sa quête incessante de nourriture, il oublie parfois qu’il en a caché dans sa fourrure.
description.en: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description.es: Esconde comida bajo el largo pelo de su cuerpo, pero más tarde lo olvida.
description.de: Unter seinem langen Fell versteckt es Nahrung. Aber es vergisst, dass es sie dort versteckt hat.
description.it: Nasconde il cibo sotto i lunghi peli del suo corpo. Tuttavia, finisce spesso per dimenticarlo.
description.pt-BR: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description.ru: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
description.ja: 長い　体の　毛の　下に 食べ物を　隠す　習性。 隠したことを　忘れてしまう。

description.fr: Il a la faculté unique de visualiser les émotions telles que la joie ou la colère sous forme d’ondes.
description.en: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description.es: Se comunica con los suyos mediante la emisión de unas ondas que cambian de forma en función de los sentimientos.
description.de: Es kommuniziert mit seinen Artgenossen über Wellen, die je nach Gefühlslage eine andere Form annehmen.
description.it: Comunica con i suoi simili tramite delle onde che cambiano forma a seconda del sentimento che prova.
description.pt-BR: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description.ru: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
description.ja: 感情で　形が　変わる 波動を　だしあって　仲間同士 コミュニケーションを　とっている。

description.fr: Un spécimen bien entraîné peut sentir et identifier les émotions de quelqu’un à plus d’un kilomètre.
description.en: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description.es: Puede leer los pensamientos y movimientos de su adversario a través de su aura.
description.de: Es nimmt die Aura seines Gegners wahr. So kann es dessen Gedanken und Bewegungen erkennen.
description.it: Riesce a leggere i pensieri e i movimenti del nemico decifrando l’aura che questo emette.
description.pt-BR: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description.ru: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
description.ja: 相手の　発する　波動を キャッチすることで　考えや　動きを 読み取ることが　できる。

description.fr: Il peut obturer ses narines et traverser le sable comme un ver. Il vit en colonies de 10 individus.
description.en: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.es: Vive en zonas áridas. En lugar de sudar, su cuerpo expulsa granos de arena.
description.de: Es lebt in ausgetrockneten Gebieten. Statt zu schwitzen, sondert sein Körper Sand ab.
description.it: Vive in territori aridi. Invece del sudore, espelle dal corpo sabbia granulosa.
description.pt-BR: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.ru: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
description.ja: 乾燥した　土地で　暮らす。 汗の　かわりに　砂粒を 体から　分泌する　ポケモン。

description.fr: Facilement irritable, il ouvre ses mâchoires au maximum pour intimider ses adversaires.
description.en: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description.es: Hace gala de su fuerza abriendo su enorme boca. Para atacar levanta gran cantidad de arena.
description.de: Das weit aufgerissene Maul demonstriert seine Stärke. Es attackiert mit gebündeltem Sand.
description.it: Mostra la propria forza spalancando le fauci. Attacca sollevando immani quantità di sabbia.
description.pt-BR: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description.ru: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
description.ja: 大きく　口を　開けて 自分の　強さを　アピール。 大量の　砂を　巻き上げて　攻撃する。

description.fr: Il saisit sa proie avec les pinces de sa queue et lui injecte un poison. Il peut survivre un an sans manger.
description.en: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.es: Agarra a sus presas con las pinzas de la cola y les inyecta veneno. Espera hasta que hace efecto.
description.de: Es greift seine Beute mit den Krallen an seinem Schweif und vergiftet sie. Dann wartet es ab...
description.it: Afferra le prede con gli artigli della coda e non si allontana finché il veleno che inietta non agisce.
description.pt-BR: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.ru: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
description.ja: 尻尾の　ツメで　獲物を　挟み 毒を　送りこむ。毒が　効くまで 絶対に　放さない　執念。

description.fr: Fier et robuste, il met un point d’honneur à battre ses adversaires sans utiliser de poison.
description.en: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description.es: Aunque sabe que puede aplastar al rival con su gran fuerza, le gusta dar el golpe de gracia con su virulento veneno.
description.de: Es bringt seine Gegner mit starkem Gift zur Strecke, obwohl es weiß, dass es stark genug ist, um sie zu zerfetzen.
description.it: Va fiero della sua forza con cui può fare a pezzi il nemico, ma in genere preferisce finirlo usando le sue tossine.
description.pt-BR: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description.ru: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
description.ja: 自慢の　パワーで　相手を ばらばらに　できるのに　さらに 猛毒で　とどめを　刺すのだ。

description.fr: Son instinct de survie le pousse à ne pas se battre dans les règles. C’est une mascotte populaire.
description.en: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.es: Tiene bolsas venenosas en las mejillas. Pilla desprevenidos a sus rivales para pincharles.
description.de: In seinen Backen sammelt sich Gift. Es versucht, Beute zu überraschen und mit Giftfingern zu schnappen.
description.it: Le sacche delle guance contengono veleno. Infilza i nemici con le sue unghie avvelenate.
description.pt-BR: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.ru: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
description.ja: ほっぺたに　毒袋を　持つ。 相手の　すきを　ついて　猛毒を にじませている　指を　突き刺す。

description.fr: Quand il coasse, le poison stocké sous sa gorge est secoué, le rendant ainsi plus efficace.
description.en: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description.es: Almacena veneno en una bolsa de la garganta. Cuando croa, este se agita para lograr mayor potencia.
description.de: Verfügt über einen Giftsack an seiner Kehle. Quakt es, schäumt das Gift und wird so noch stärker.
description.it: Ha una sacca di veleno sulla gola. Quando gracida il veleno si rimescola, diventando più efficace.
description.pt-BR: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description.ru: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
description.ja: のど元に　毒袋を　持つ。 のどを　鳴らすと　たまった　毒は 練りこまれ　強力になる。

description.fr: Il s’accroche aux arbres des marais et attire ses proies avec sa salive à l’odeur enivrante.
description.en: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.es: Atrae a sus presas con saliva de olor dulce y las mastica. Tarda todo un día en comérselas.
description.de: Sein süßlich riechender Speichel zieht Beute an, die es frisst. Es braucht einen Tag, sie zu fressen.
description.it: Attira le prede con il dolce aroma della saliva e poi le ingoia. Impiega un giorno per mangiare una preda.
description.pt-BR: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.ru: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
description.ja: 甘い　においの　だえきで　獲物を おびき寄せ　おおあごで　がぶり。 １日　かけて　獲物を　食べる。

description.fr: La ligne qui fait le tour de son corps stocke l’énergie solaire et brille dans la nuit.
description.en: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description.es: La línea que le recorre el costado puede almacenar luz solar. Brilla con mucha fuerza por la noche.
description.de: Die Linie an seiner Seite kann Sonnenlicht speichern. Nachts leuchtet es sehr intensiv.
description.it: La linea che contorna il suo corpo immagazzina la luce solare. Di notte si illumina di una luce splendente.
description.pt-BR: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description.ru: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
description.ja: 体の　横側にある　ラインは 太陽の光を　ためておける。 夜になると　鮮やかに　輝く。

description.fr: Il rampe au fond de l’océan grâce aux nageoires de son torse. Le Lanturn est son rival.
description.en: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description.es: Vive en las profundidades marinas. Atrae a sus presas con parpadeos del dibujo de sus cuatro aletas.
description.de: Es lebt tief auf dem Meeresboden. Das blinkende Muster auf seinen vier Rückenflossen zieht Beute an.
description.it: Vive negli abissi marini. Attira le prede illuminando i motivi delle sue quattro pinne.
description.pt-BR: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description.ru: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
description.ja: 深い　海の　底で　暮らす。 ４枚の　ヒレの　模様を　光らせて 獲物を　おびき寄せる。

description.fr: On organise des excursions pour le voir surfer sur les vagues au côté des Rémoraid.
description.en: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description.es: Los símbolos de su espalda cambian según la región. A veces se mezcla con bancos de Remoraid y nada junto a ellos.
description.de: Ihre Rücken sind je nach Region unterschiedlich gemustert. Oft mischen sie sich unter Remoraid-Schwärme.
description.it: Il disegno sul suo dorso cambia a seconda della regione. Nuota spesso assieme ai branchi di Remoraid.
description.pt-BR: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description.ru: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
description.ja: 背中の　模様は　地域によって 異なっている。テッポウオの　群れに 混ざって　泳ぐことが　多い。

description.fr: Curieux de rencontrer des gens, ils se rassemblent autour des traces de pas trouvées dans la montagne.
description.en: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description.es: En las estaciones frías baja al pie de la montaña, pero regresa a las cimas nevadas en primavera.
description.de: Im Winter steigt es bis zum Fuß der Berge herab. Im Frühjahr kehrt es auf den Gipfel zurück.
description.it: In inverno scende a valle, ma in primavera se ne torna sulle cime montuose dove c’è ancora neve.
description.pt-BR: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description.ru: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
description.ja: 寒い　季節は　山の　ふもとまで 降りてくるが　春に　なると 雪が　残る　山頂に　戻っていく。

description.fr: Il apparaît quand les fleurs des terres enneigées fleurissent et se retire quand elles se fanent.
description.en: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description.es: Genera ventiscas con las que cubre de nieve grandes áreas. Se le llama el Monstruo de Hielo.
description.de: Es bedeckt weite Gebiete mit Schnee, indem es Blizzards auslöst. Man nennt es „Das Eismonster“.
description.it: Crea bufere che ricoprono di neve ampissime aree. È noto anche come “Mostro dei ghiacci”.
description.pt-BR: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description.ru: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
description.ja: ブリザードを　発生させて　あたり 一面を　真っ白に　してしまう。 別名　アイスモンスター。

description.fr: L’évolution l’a rendu encore plus retors. Il communique en griffant des signes dans les pierres.
description.en: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description.es: Vive en zonas nevadas. Deja marcas en los árboles con sus garras para comunicarse con sus compañeros.
description.de: Es lebt in schneereichen Gebieten. Snibunna senden einander Signale, indem sie Zeichen in Rinde ritzen.
description.it: Il suo habitat sono le grandi aree innevate. Con gli artigli, incide sui tronchi segnali per i suoi simili.
description.pt-BR: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description.ru: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
description.ja: 雪の　多い　地方に　生息。 樹木に　ツメで　サインを　描き 仲間に　合図を　送る。

description.fr: Des scientifiques ont essayé de faire évoluer un Magnézone en laboratoire, mais ce fut un échec.
description.en: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description.es: Emiten campos magnéticos tan potentes que se atraen entre sí e incluso pueden llegar a inmovilizarse.
description.de: Gelegentlich erzeugen sie so starke Magnetfelder, dass sie sich gegenseitig anziehen und einander immobilisieren.
description.it: A volte si attraggono l’un l’altro con la loro potentissima carica magnetica e poi non riescono più a muoversi.
description.pt-BR: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description.ru: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
description.ja: 強すぎる　磁力を　だして ジバコイル同士　引き寄せあって まったく　動けなくなったりする。

description.fr: Sa longue langue est couverte en permanence d’une épaisse couche de bave anesthésiante.
description.en: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description.es: Agarra cosas con su lengua extensible. Si te acercas mucho, te deja lleno de babas.
description.de: Es umklammert Dinge mit seiner dehnbaren Zunge. Kommt man ihm zu nahe, wird man eingespeichelt.
description.it: Avvolge ogni cosa con la sua lingua allungabile. Chi si avvicina troppo, si ritroverà tutto bagnato di bava.
description.pt-BR: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description.ru: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
description.ja: ぐんぐん　伸びる　ベロを　なんにでも 巻きつける。うかつに　近寄ると だえきで　べとべとに　されてしまう。

description.fr: Il peut lancer des pierres à une vitesse saisissante en bandant et relâchant ses muscles en un éclair.
description.en: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
description.es: Lanza Geodude por los agujeros de las manos. Gracias a Protector resiste erupciones volcánicas.
description.de: Es feuert Kleinstein aus seinen Handflächen. Durch seinen Schützer erträgt es sogar Vulkanausbrüche.
description.it: Mette dei Geodude nelle cavità dei palmi e li lancia. Usa Copertura per resistere alle eruzioni vulcaniche.
description.pt-BR: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
description.ru: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
description.ja: 手のひらの　穴から　イシツブテを 発射。全身の　プロテクターは 火山の　噴火にも　耐えられる。

description.fr: Ses bras sont en fait des plantes qui s’attachent à tout ce qu’elles touchent et peuvent repousser.
description.en: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.es: Atrapa a su presa desplegando las ramas de sus brazos, que no le importa perder ante depredadores.
description.de: Es umwickelt Beute, indem es seine Arme, die aus Ranken bestehen, verlängert.
description.it: Intrappola le prede con gli arti, che sono costituiti da liane. Se ne perde uno, non si turba affatto.
description.pt-BR: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.ru: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
description.ja: 植物の　ツルで　できた　腕を 伸ばして　獲物を　絡め取る。 腕を　食べられても　へっちゃら。

description.fr: Encaissant les attaques, il vient toucher l’ennemi de ses queues et lui inflige une forte décharge.
description.en: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description.es: Al almacenar mucha electricidad, desprende chispas de una claridad increíble entre sus dos cuernos.
description.de: Bei voller Ladung zucken feurige, blassweiße Funken zwischen seinen zwei Hörnern hin und her.
description.it: Quando accumula tanta elettricità sparge scintille azzurrine dallo spazio tra le due corna.
description.pt-BR: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description.ru: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
description.ja: 電気を　いっぱいに　ためると ２本の　ツノの　あいだで　激しく 青白い　火花を　散らす。

description.fr: Quand il lance des boules de feu à plus de 2 000 °C, son corps est comme chauffé à blanc.
description.en: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.es: Sus brazos disparan bolas de fuego de más de 2000 °C. Vive en cráteres volcánicos.
description.de: Aus den Enden seiner Arme schießen Feuerbälle mit 2 000 °C. Es lebt in Vulkankratern.
description.it: Spara palle di fuoco di oltre 2000 °C dagli arti superiori. Vive nei crateri dei vulcani.
description.pt-BR: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.ru: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
description.ja: 腕の　先から　摂氏２０００度の 火の玉を　発射する。 火山の　火口を　住処にする。

description.fr: Il apprécie particulièrement les gens qui respectent les autres et évitent les conflits inutiles.
description.en: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description.es: Se dice que aparece en zonas pacíficas y las bendice con sus dones.
description.de: Es heißt, Togekiss erscheine in friedlichen Zeiten und verteile alle möglichen Wohltaten.
description.it: Pare che Togekiss ami visitare le regioni pacifiche, senza conflitti, donando bontà e dolcezza.
description.pt-BR: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description.ru: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
description.ja: 争いのない　平和な　土地に トゲキッスは　訪れ　さまざまな　恵みを 分け与えると　言われる。

description.fr: Doté de mandibules à la force colossale, il excelle pour mordre ses ennemis en plein vol.
description.en: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description.es: Su técnica favorita consiste en volar a gran velocidad y despedazar con su mandíbula a su oponente en un instante.
description.de: Seine bevorzugte Strategie besteht darin, seine Gegner aus dem Flug blitzartig zur Strecke zu bringen.
description.it: Preferisce piombare sui nemici a grande velocità per tagliuzzarli a dovere in un batter d’occhio.
description.pt-BR: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description.ru: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
description.ja: 高速で　飛んで　すれ違った 相手の　首を　一瞬で かみちぎる　戦い方を　好む。

description.fr: Il utilise la photosynthèse comme une plante et a aussi tendance à éviter le combat à tout prix.
description.en: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description.es: En días soleados duerme y hace la fotosíntesis, emitiendo aire puro a su alrededor.
description.de: An klaren Tagen erzeugt Folipurba saubere Luft, indem es Photosynthese betreibt.
description.it: Nelle belle giornate si sdraia al sole e usa la fotosintesi, producendo aria pulita.
description.pt-BR: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description.ru: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
description.ja: 晴れた　日に　寝ている　リーフィアは 光合成を　して　きれいな　空気を 作り出しているのだ。

description.fr: Il ajuste la température de son corps pour créer un vent de glace en gelant l’air qui l’entoure.
description.en: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description.es: Controla su temperatura corporal para congelar el ambiente y causar ráfagas de nieve en polvo.
description.de: Erzeugt ein Diamantstaubgestöber durch das Einfrieren der Luft um sich herum.
description.it: Modificando la temperatura del corpo, congela l’aria e crea folate di cristalli di ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description.ru: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
description.ja: 体温を　コントロールすることで 周囲の　空気を　凍らせて ダイヤモンドダストを　降らせる。

description.fr: Le plus petit courant d’air peut lui donner assez d’élan pour faire le tour du monde sans un coup d’aile.
description.en: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.es: Espera a sus presas colgado de una rama bocabajo. Cuando llega su oportunidad, se lanza en picado.
description.de: Es hängt kopfüber von einem Ast und beobachtet seine Beute. Bei Gelegenheit stürzt es sich auf sie.
description.it: Sta appeso ai rami con la testa in giù. Alla prima occasione, si butta a capofitto sulla preda.
description.pt-BR: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.ru: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
description.ja: 尻尾で　木の枝に　ぶら下がり 獲物を　観察する。すきを　見て 上空から　襲いかかる。

description.fr: On a libéré un spécimen de sa prison glacée au bout de 10 000 ans. Il n’en revenait pas.
description.en: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description.es: Ya existía en la antigüedad. Se encontró uno bajo hielo de hace más de 10 000 años.
description.de: Es existiert schon seit Urzeiten. Mamutel wurde sogar schon in 10 000 Jahre altem Eis gefunden.
description.it: Un Pokémon antico al punto che ne sono stati ritrovati degli esemplari tra i ghiacci di 10.000 anni fa.
description.pt-BR: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description.ru: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
description.ja: １万年前の　氷の　下から 発見された　ことも　あるほど 大昔から　いた　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il a été modifié pour être capable de travailler dans des dimensions parallèles, mais c’est un échec.
description.en: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description.es: Se le instaló un software para mejorarlo. Sin embargo, comenzó a comportarse de manera extraña.
description.de: Zusätzliche Software wurde installiert, um das Pokémon zu verbessern. Seitdem benimmt es sich seltsam.
description.it: È stato aggiunto un software per migliorare le prestazioni di questo Pokémon. Agisce in modo strano.
description.pt-BR: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description.ru: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
description.ja: より　優れた　ポケモンに　するため プログラムを　追加したが　なぜか おかしな　行動を　はじめた。

description.fr: Toujours prêt à protéger son prochain, il se bat férocement avec ses coudes en forme d’épées.
description.en: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description.es: Puede presentir los movimientos de sus rivales y por eso ataca siempre antes que ellos.
description.de: Da es selbst die leisesten Gedanken seines Gegners lesen kann, kann es immer zuerst angreifen.
description.it: Il suo intuito gli consente di capire cosa pensa il nemico: può così attaccare per primo.
description.pt-BR: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description.ru: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
description.ja: 相手の　考えを　敏感に キャッチする　能力を　持つため 先に　攻撃が　できるのだ。

description.fr: Il utilise sa force magnétique pour diriger trois petites unités appelées Mini-nez.
description.en: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description.es: Emana un fuerte magnetismo. Controla tres pequeñas unidades llamadas mininarices.
description.de: Es gibt starken Magnetismus ab. Es steuert drei kleine Einheiten, die sich Mininasen nennen.
description.it: Emana un forte magnetismo da tutto il corpo. Controlla tre piccole unità, dette Mininasi.
description.pt-BR: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description.ru: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
description.ja: 全身から　強い　磁力を　出している。 ３個の　チビノーズと　呼ばれる ユニットを　操る。

description.fr: Son corps se replie sur lui-même pour emprisonner les esprits perdus et les ramener chez eux.
description.en: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description.es: Se dice que recoge en su cuerpo flexible a los espíritus extraviados y los guía hasta casa.
description.de: Man sagt, dass es verlorene Seelen in seinem biegsamen Körper nach Hause geleite.
description.it: Si dice che accolga gli spiriti smarriti nel suo corpo flessibile per riportarli a casa.
description.pt-BR: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description.ru: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
description.ja: 弾力のある　体の　中に 行き場のない　魂を　取りこんで あの世に　連れていくと　言われる。

description.fr: On dit que Momartik gèle ses proies grâce à son souffle à -50 °C avant de les exposer dans sa tanière.
description.en: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description.es: Congela a sus enemigos con un aliento gélido de -50 °C. Su cuerpo está hueco.
description.de: Sein eisiger Atem mit -50 °C friert Gegner ein. Was aussieht wie sein Körper, ist tatsächlich hohl.
description.it: Congela i nemici con un alito glaciale a -50 °C. Il suo corpo è vuoto.
description.pt-BR: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description.ru: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
description.ja: マイナス５０度の　冷気を　吐いて 相手を　凍らせる。胴体に　見える 部分は　じつは　空洞。

description.fr: Son corps parcouru d’électricité lui permet de prendre le contrôle de certains appareils ménagers.
description.en: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description.es: Desde hace mucho tiempo se estudia su singular motor como fuente de energía motriz.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon wurde lange Zeit erforscht, um als Energiequelle für einen besonderen Motor zu dienen.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è stato usato a lungo per ricerche come forza motrice su motori speciali.
description.pt-BR: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description.ru: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
description.ja: 特殊な　モーターを　動かす 動力源として　長い　あいだ 研究されていた　ポケモン。

description.fr: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes apprirent à résoudre les problèmes. Le savoir était né.
description.en: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Sabiduría. Se dice que puede borrar la memoria con una mirada.
description.de: „Das wissende Wesen“. Es soll die Erinnerungen derer löschen, die ihm in die Augen sehen.
description.it: Noto come “Essere della conoscenza”. Pare che faccia perdere la memoria a chiunque lo fissi.
description.pt-BR: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.ru: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
description.ja: 知識の神と　呼ばれている。 目を　合わせた　者の　記憶を 消してしまう　力を　持つという。

description.fr: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes apprirent à ressentir la joie et la peine. L’émotion était née.
description.en: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Emoción. Enseñó a los humanos la nobleza del dolor y la alegría.
description.de: „Das fühlende Wesen“. Es lehrt die Menschen die Ideale von Trauer, Schmerz und Freude.
description.it: Detto “Essere delle emozioni”. Ha insegnato agli uomini la nobiltà di tristezza, gioia e dolore.
description.pt-BR: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.ru: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
description.ja: 悲しみの　苦しさと　喜びの　尊さを 人々に　教えた。 感情の神と　呼ばれている。

description.fr: Quand il prit son envol, les hommes acquirent la détermination. La volonté était née.
description.en: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.es: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Voluntad. Duerme en el fondo de un lago para equilibrar el mundo.
description.de: „Das starke Wesen“. Es schläft auf dem Grund eines Sees und hält so die Welt in Balance.
description.it: Detto “Essere della volontà”. Dorme sul fondo di un lago per mantenere il mondo in equilibrio.
description.pt-BR: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.ru: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
description.ja: 意思の神と　呼ばれている。 湖の　底で　眠り続け 世界の　バランスを　とっている。

description.fr: On dit que le temps s’écoule au rythme des battements de cœur de ce Pokémon légendaire de Sinnoh.
description.en: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description.es: Un Pokémon de leyenda. Se dice que el tiempo comenzó a avanzar cuando Dialga nació.
description.de: Ein Pokémon, das in Legenden zu finden ist. Man sagt, als Dialga geboren wurde, begann der Lauf der Zeit.
description.it: Pokémon menzionato nelle leggende. Pare che il tempo abbia avuto origine alla nascita di Dialga.
description.pt-BR: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description.ru: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
description.ja: ディアルガが　生まれたことで 時間が　動き出したという 伝説を　持つ　ポケモン。

description.fr: On dit que la stabilité de l’espace est maintenue par le souffle de ce Pokémon légendaire de Sinnoh.
description.en: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description.es: Se dice que vive en una dimensión espacial paralela. Aparece en la mitología.
description.de: Man sagt, es lebe in einem Spalt in einer Paralleldimension. Es wird in der Mythologie erwähnt.
description.it: Si dice che viva in una dimensione parallela alla nostra. Appare nella mitologia.
description.pt-BR: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description.ru: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
description.ja: 並行して　並ぶ　空間の　狭間に 住むと　言われている。 神話に　登場する　ポケモン。

description.fr: Son corps est composé d’acier brut dont certaines parties ont fondu à cause de sa propre chaleur.
description.en: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.es: Habita cuevas volcánicas. Cava con sus pies en forma de cruz para trepar por techos y paredes.
description.de: Es lebt in vulkanischen Höhlen. Mit seinen kreuzförmigen Klauen kann es sogar an der Decke laufen.
description.it: Vive nelle cavità dei vulcani. Scava con i suoi piedi a croce per scalare pareti e arrampicarsi sui soffitti.
description.pt-BR: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.ru: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
description.ja: 火山の　洞穴に　生息。 十字の　ツメを　食いこませて 壁や　天井を　はい回る。

description.fr: On dit qu’il a créé des Pokémon à son image à partir de glace, de roche et de magma.
description.en: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description.es: Se dice que usó rocas, magma y un hielo especial de montaña para crear Pokémon con su aspecto.
description.de: Man sagt, es habe Pokémon aus einem Eisberg, Felsen und Magma nach seinem Abbild geschaffen.
description.it: Si dice che abbia creato dei Pokémon simili a sé usando una montagna ghiacciata, rocce e magma.
description.pt-BR: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description.ru: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
description.ja: 特殊な　氷山や　岩石　マグマから 自分の　姿に　似た　ポケモンを つくったと　言われる。

description.fr: Sa grande violence lui a valu d’être banni. Il observe les hommes en silence depuis le Monde Distorsion.
description.en: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.es: Vive en el Mundo Distorsión, un mundo opuesto al nuestro y cuyas leyes desafían el sentido común.
description.de: Es lebt in einer Zerrwelt, die auf der Kehrseite der unseren liegt und die sich aller Logik entzieht.
description.it: Vive nel Mondo Distorto che, sfidando l’ordine cosmico, si trova sul lato opposto al nostro.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.ru: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
description.ja: 常識の　通用しない この世の　裏側にあると　言われる 破れた世界に　生息する。

description.fr: Les nuits où le premier croissant de lune est visible, l’arc de sa queue se déploie de façon superbe.
description.en: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.es: Sus alas emiten un velo de partículas brillantes. Se dice que representa un cuarto lunar.
description.de: Seine Flügel geben schimmernde Partikel ab, die wie ein Schleier herabrieseln. Man sagt, es verkörpere die Mondsichel.
description.it: Volando rilascia un velo di particelle brillanti. Si dice che rappresenti la luna crescente.
description.pt-BR: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.ru: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
description.ja: 飛行するときは　ベールのような 羽から　光る　粒子を　出す。 三日月の化身と　呼ばれている。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon des mers chaudes revient toujours à son lieu de naissance, peu importe la distance.
description.en: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description.es: Si sube la temperatura del mar, infla el flotador de su cabeza y flota en grupo en la superficie.
description.de: Steigt die Meerestemperatur, bläst es seinen Schwimmbeutel auf und treibt in Schwärmen auf dem Wasser.
description.it: Quando la temperatura del mare si alza, gonfia il galleggiante che ha in testa e fluttua in gruppo.
description.pt-BR: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description.ru: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
description.ja: 海の　温度が　高くなると 頭の　浮き袋を　ふくらませて 海面を　集団で　漂う。

description.fr: Il est né avec le pouvoir incroyable de créer des liens avec n’importe quel Pokémon.
description.en: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description.es: Nace con un maravilloso poder que le permite establecer vínculos con cualquier tipo de Pokémon.
description.de: Es wird mit einer wundersamen Kraft geboren, die eine Bindung zu jedem anderen Pokémon möglich macht.
description.it: Dispone di un potere innato che lo fa legare con qualsiasi specie di Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description.ru: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
description.ja: 生まれたときから　備わっている 不思議な　力を　使うと　どんな ポケモンとも　心が　通い合う。

description.fr: Menacé, ce Pokémon se protège en créant des cauchemars dans l’esprit de ses ennemis.
description.en: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description.es: Defiende su territorio de personas y Pokémon haciéndoles dormir y provocándoles pesadillas.
description.de: Es vertreibt Eindringlinge aus seinem Revier, indem es sie in Schlaf versetzt und mit Alpträumen quält.
description.it: Respinge umani e Pokémon dal suo territorio inducendoli a un sonno profondo e provocando incubi.
description.pt-BR: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description.ru: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
description.ja: 深い　眠りに　誘う　力で 人や　ポケモンに　悪夢を　見せて 自分の　縄張りから　追い出す。

description.fr: Les fleurs qui couvrent son corps s’ouvrent quand il est câliné avec amour et perçoit de la gratitude.
description.en: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.es: Puede disolver las toxinas del aire para transformar tierra yerma en campos de flores.
description.de: Es kann die Luft von Giften reinigen und Ödland in ein üppig blühendes Blumenfeld verwandeln.
description.it: Può dissolvere le tossine nell’aria per mutare all’istante una terra arida in un rigoglioso campo fiorito.
description.pt-BR: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.ru: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
description.ja: 大気の　毒素を　分解して 荒れた　大地を　一瞬のうちに 花畑にする　力を　持つ。

description.fr: On dit que son œuf a éclos dans le néant et qu’il est à l’origine de la création du monde.
description.en: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description.es: Según la mitología de Sinnoh, Arceus surgió de un huevo y después creó todo el mundo.
description.de: In den Legenden Sinnohs heißt es, es sei aus einem Ei geschlüpft und hätte die gesamte Welt geschaffen.
description.it: Secondo la mitologia di Sinnoh, Arceus è nato da un uovo e poi ha creato il mondo.
description.pt-BR: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description.ru: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
description.ja: タマゴから　姿を　現して 世界の　すべてを　生み出したと シンオウ神話に　語られている。

description.fr: Un Pokémon qui amène la victoire. On dit que les Dresseurs qui le possèdent peuvent gagner n’importe quel combat.
description.en: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description.es: Pokémon que atrae la victoria. Dicen que el Entrenador que lo lleve saldrá vencedor de cualquier batalla.
description.de: Ein siegverheißendes Pokémon. Man sagt, Trainer, die ein Victini in ihrem Team haben, seien unschlagbar.
description.it: Pokémon che porta la vittoria. Si dice che l’Allenatore che ha con sé Victini possa vincere qualsiasi lotta.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description.ru: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description.ja: 勝利を　もたらす　ポケモン。 ビクティニを　連れた　トレーナーは どんな　勝負にも　勝てるという。

description.fr: Un Pokémon intelligent et très calme. Lorsqu’il a reçu suffisamment de lumière du soleil, il devient plus agile.
description.en: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description.es: Cuando recibe los rayos de sol, se mueve mucho más rápido que de costumbre. Usa mejor sus lianas que sus manos.
description.de: Im Sonnenlicht erhöht sich das Tempo seiner Bewegungen. Es ist mit seinen Schlingen geschickter als mit den Händen.
description.it: Quando è esposto alla luce solare può muoversi più velocemente. Usa le sue liane meglio dei suoi stessi arti.
description.pt-BR: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description.ru: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description.ja: 太陽の　光を　浴びると いつもよりも　素早く　動ける。 手よりも　ツルを　うまく使う。

description.fr: Il court comme s’il glissait sur le sol. Il déroute l’ennemi par ses mouvements et l’assomme d’un coup de liane.
description.en: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description.es: Parece que se desliza al correr. Engaña a sus rivales con su velocidad y los fustiga con su látigo.
description.de: Huscht beinahe gleitend über den Boden und täuscht Gegner mit agilen Manövern, bis es mithilfe seiner Efeurute obsiegt.
description.it: Corre quasi scivolando sulle superfici. Confonde il nemico con i rapidi movimenti, per poi attaccarlo con una frustata.
description.pt-BR: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description.ru: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description.ja: 地面を　滑るように　走る。 素早い　動きで　敵を　まどわせ つるのムチで　しとめるのだ。

description.fr: Il peut paralyser l’ennemi d’un regard. Il amplifie l’énergie du soleil dans son corps.
description.en: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description.es: Tan solo muestra su verdadero poder a quienes no se amedrentan ante su noble pero inquisitoria mirada.
description.de: Im Kampf zeigt es nur Gegnern, die seinem edlen Blick standhalten, seine wahre Kraft.
description.it: Dà il meglio di sé solo contro chi non resta intimidito dal suo nobile sguardo.
description.pt-BR: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description.ru: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description.ja: ジャローダの　気高い　瞳で 射すくめられても　平気な　強い 相手にだけ　本気を　出す。

description.fr: Il évite agilement les attaques ennemies et crache des boules de feu par le groin. Il aime griller des Baies pour les manger.
description.en: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description.es: Evita con agilidad los ataques enemigos. Lanza bolas de fuego por su hocico y tuesta bayas del bosque para comer.
description.de: Weicht flink gegnerischen Angriffen aus und schießt Flammen aus dem Rüssel, mit denen es gern auch mal Nüsse röstet.
description.it: Lancia palle di fuoco dal naso mentre evita abilmente gli attacchi del nemico. Mangia bacche che arrostisce lui stesso.
description.pt-BR: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description.ru: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description.ja: 敵の　攻撃を　身軽に　避けて 鼻から　火の玉を　撃ち出す。 炎で　木の実を　焼いて　食べる。

description.fr: Quand le feu dans son corps s’embrase, sa vitesse et son agilité augmentent. En cas d’urgence, il crache de la fumée.
description.en: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description.es: Cuanto más come, más combustible tiene en su interior para avivar sus llamas, con lo que también aumenta su poder.
description.de: Je mehr es frisst, desto stärker werden die Flammen in seinem Magen. Dies führt zu rapiden Energieschüben.
description.it: Più mangia e più le fiamme che bruciano nel suo stomaco si rinvigoriscono, aumentando così il suo potere.
description.pt-BR: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description.ru: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description.ja: 食べるほどに　燃やすものが　増えて 胃袋内の　炎が　強まり パワーも　どんどん　あふれ出すのだ。

description.fr: Il embrase ses poings avec les flammes sur son menton et cogne l’ennemi avec. C’est un Pokémon très solidaire.
description.en: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description.es: Calienta sus puños con las llamas de su barbilla para propinar puñetazos ardientes. Es muy fiel a sus compañeros.
description.de: Steckt mit dem Feuer um sein Kinn seine Fäuste in Brand und holt zu feurigen Fausthieben aus. Zeigt großen Teamgeist.
description.it: Infiamma i pugni sulla barba ardente, poi sferra attacchi di fuoco sui nemici. Ha molta considerazione per i suoi simili.
description.pt-BR: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description.ru: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description.ja: アゴの　炎で　こぶしを　燃やして 炎の　パンチを　繰り出す。 とても　仲間思いの　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il combat avec le coupillage de son ventre. Il peut parer un assaut et immédiatement contre-attaquer.
description.en: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description.es: La vieira de su ombligo no solo sirve como arma, sino también como instrumento para cortar las bayas que estén duras.
description.de: Die Muschel an seinem Bauch dient ihm nicht nur als Waffe, sondern auch als Messer, mit dem es Beeren aufschneidet.
description.it: Non usa la conchiglia del suo ventre solo durante la lotta, ma anche per tagliare a metà le bacche.
description.pt-BR: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description.ru: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
description.ja: お腹に　できる　ホタチは 戦うとき　だけでなく　硬い 木の実を　割るときにも　使う。

description.fr: L’apprentissage de sa technique de combat, qui utilise élégamment ses deux coupillages, est extrêmement rigoureux.
description.en: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description.es: Gran espadachín. Utiliza sus dos vieiras con soltura al ejecutar las técnicas que aprende con una disciplina espartana.
description.de: Es eignet sich durch strenges Training elegant ineinander übergehende Attacken mit seinen zwei Muscheln an.
description.it: Ha appreso tramite un durissimo allenamento l’arte di maneggiare le sue due conchiglie come fossero lame.
description.pt-BR: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description.ru: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
description.ja: 流れるような　太刀さばきで ２枚の　ホタチを　あつかう　技は きびしい　修業によって　身につける。

description.fr: Il peut terrasser ses ennemis d’un coup de la lame enchâssée dans son armure, et les faire taire d’un seul regard.
description.en: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description.es: En un abrir y cerrar de ojos, puede desenvainar y envainar los sables que hay en sus patas delanteras.
description.de: Ehe man sichs versieht, hat es schon das Langschwert aus seinen Vorderbeinen gezogen und seinen Gegner besiegt.
description.it: Riesce a estrarre le sue spade, colpire il nemico e riporle al loro posto nelle zampe anteriori in un batter d’occhio.
description.pt-BR: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description.ru: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
description.ja: 敵が　瞬きする　あいだに 前足に　ついた　アシガタナで 相手を　切りつけ　元に戻せる。

description.fr: Ils stockent à manger dans leurs bajoues et font le guet indéfiniment. Ils se font des signes en remuant la queue.
description.en: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description.es: Almacena víveres en unas bolsas en sus mofletes y vigila durante días. Hace señales con la cola a sus compañeros.
description.de: Hortet in seinen Backentaschen Futter, um tagelang Wache stehen zu können, und gibt Kameraden über seine Rute Signale.
description.it: Immagazzina cibo nelle guance e monta la guardia per molti giorni di seguito. Usa la coda per fare segnali ai compagni.
description.pt-BR: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description.ru: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description.ja: ほほの　袋に　エサを　ためこみ 何日も　見張りを　続ける。 尻尾で　仲間に　合図する。

description.fr: Il attaque en crachant les graines des Baies qu’il accumule dans ses bajoues. S’il voit un ennemi, il dresse la queue.
description.en: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description.es: Los componentes luminiscentes de su interior hacen que sus ojos y su cuerpo brillen, y así intimida a sus rivales.
description.de: Es kann mit einer körpereigenen Substanz seine Augen und seinen Torso aufleuchten lassen, um Gegner zu erschrecken.
description.it: Fa tentennare il nemico facendo brillare occhi e pelliccia grazie a una sostanza fluorescente contenuta nel suo corpo.
description.pt-BR: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description.ru: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description.ja: 体内の　発光物質で 目玉や　体を　光らせ 襲ってきた　敵を　ひるませる。

description.fr: Il fait vaillamment face à des ennemis très puissants, mais il est intelligent et évite les combats trop inégaux.
description.en: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
description.es: Los mechones que cubren su cara actúan como un magnífico radar para detectar con precisión lo que hay a su alrededor.
description.de: Das lange Fell um sein Gesicht fungiert als Hightech-Radar, mit dem es fein säuberlich seine Umgebung abtastet.
description.it: I lunghi peli che gli coprono il volto sono un radar molto sensibile alle variazioni dell’ambiente circostante.
description.pt-BR: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
description.ru: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
description.ja: 顔を　覆う　長い　毛は 優れた　レーダー。周囲の　様子を 敏感に　察知する。

description.fr: Les poils qui entourent son corps comme un manteau sont extrêmement durs et amortissent les coups.
description.en: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description.es: Este Pokémon es muy leal. No solo ayuda a Entrenadores, sino que también se preocupa por otros Pokémon.
description.de: Dieses äußerst treue Pokémon geht nicht nur seinem Trainer zur Hand, sondern hilft auch anderen Pokémon.
description.it: È un Pokémon molto leale, che aiuta il suo Allenatore e al contempo si prende cura degli altri Pokémon della squadra.
description.pt-BR: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description.ru: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description.ja: トレーナーを　助けながら 他の　ポケモンの　世話もする とても　忠実な　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il sauve les gens bloqués dans les montagnes par des tempêtes de neige. Ses longs poils le protègent du froid.
description.en: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description.es: Socorre a humanos perdidos en montañas azotadas por ventiscas. Su largo pelaje le protege del frío.
description.de: Es rettet Menschen, die aufgrund eines Schneesturmes im Gebirge festsitzen. Sein langes Fell schützt es vor Kälte.
description.it: Soccorre chi si trova in difficoltà sulle montagne spazzate da bufere di neve. I lunghi peli lo proteggono dal freddo.
description.pt-BR: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description.ru: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description.ja: 吹雪で　閉ざされた　山に　入り 遭難した　人を　助ける。 長い　毛が　寒さを　防ぐ。

description.fr: Il vole les gens pour le plaisir, mais il est tellement mignon que ses victimes finissent toujours par lui pardonner.
description.en: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description.es: Distrae a su oponente con movimientos gráciles y sustrae sus pertenencias. Cuando se enfada, ataca con las garras.
description.de: Es lenkt die Menschen durch sein süßes Verhalten ab, um sie zu bestehlen. Ist es wütend, kratzt es gern mal.
description.it: Distrae con pose ammalianti i nemici incauti e ne approfitta per depredarli. Se si arrabbia, sguaina le unghie.
description.pt-BR: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description.ru: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description.ja: かわいらしい　仕草で　油断させて その　すきに　持ち物を　奪う。 怒ると　ツメを　立てて　反撃。

description.fr: Un Pokémon insaisissable. Son style et son pelage magnifique attirent de nombreux Dresseurs.
description.en: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description.es: Su bella y grácil silueta le viene dada por su desarrollada musculatura, que le permite andar de noche sin hacer ruido.
description.de: Sein anmutiges Auftreten verdankt es den Muskeln, die es entwickelt hat. Es prescht lautlos durch die Nacht.
description.it: I muscoli tonici del suo corpo gli donano una figura davvero affascinante. Si aggira silenzioso nel buio della notte.
description.pt-BR: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description.ru: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description.ja: 美しい　スタイルは　全身の 発達した　筋肉の　おかげ。 音もたてずに　夜を　駆けぬける。

description.fr: Il vit dans les forêts profondes. Manger la feuille qui pousse sur sa tête fait disparaître la fatigue.
description.en: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description.es: Comparte las hojas de su cabeza con Pokémon agotados. Posee la facultad de aliviar el cansancio.
description.de: Schwächelnden Pokémon gibt es ein paar der Kräuter auf seinem Kopf ab und hilft ihnen so wieder auf die Beine.
description.it: Distribuisce le foglie sulla sua testa ai Pokémon affaticati, per alleviare la loro stanchezza.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description.ru: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description.ja: 元気の　ない　ポケモンに 頭の　葉っぱを　分け与える。 疲れを　取る　効果が　あるのだ。

description.fr: Il a un tempérament violent et se bat avec sa queue pleine d’épines. La feuille sur sa tête est très amère.
description.en: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description.es: Ataca estampando las espinas de su cola en el enemigo. Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento.
description.de: Wer sich mit diesem temperamentvollen Pokémon anlegt, bekommt seinen mit Dornen bestückten Schweif zu spüren.
description.it: Attacca il nemico colpendolo con la coda piena di aculei. Pokémon dal carattere impetuoso.
description.pt-BR: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description.ru: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description.ja: トゲの　たくさん　ついた　尻尾を 相手に　たたきつけて　攻撃。 気性の　激しい　ポケモン。

description.fr: Quand il s’énerve, la mèche sur sa tête chauffe à 300 °C. Il s’en sert pour griller des Baies et les manger.
description.en: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description.es: Pokémon muy inteligente que tiene la costumbre de tostar las bayas antes de comérselas. Ayuda mucho a los humanos.
description.de: Ein kultiviertes Pokémon, das Beeren vor dem Verzehr stets anbrät. Es bietet den Menschen gerne seine Hilfe an.
description.it: È molto intelligente e ha l’abitudine di arrostire le bacche prima di mangiarle. Adora aiutare gli esseri umani.
description.pt-BR: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description.ru: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description.ja: 知能が　高く　木の実は 焼いてから　食べる　習性。 人の　手伝いを　好んでいる。

description.fr: Il adore les aliments sucrés. Ils lui servent d’énergie pour alimenter le feu à l’intérieur de son corps.
description.en: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description.es: Achicharra a sus enemigos desprendiendo llamas por la cola y la cabeza, fruto de su desmesurado calor interno.
description.de: Es entfacht in seinem Körper ein Feuer und verkohlt Gegner mit Funken aus seinem Kopf und Schweif.
description.it: Alimentando la fiamma all’interno del suo corpo, sparge dalla testa o dalla coda una pioggia di fuoco che scotta i nemici.
description.pt-BR: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description.ru: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description.ja: 体の　中の　炎を　燃やして 頭や　尻尾から　火の粉を まき散らせて　敵を　焦がす。

description.fr: L’eau contenue dans la mèche sur sa tête est pleine de nutriments. Elle fait pousser les plantes avec vigueur.
description.en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description.es: El agua acumulada en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes. Usa su cola para regar plantas con esa misma agua.
description.de: Das Büschel auf seinem Kopf enthält eine sehr nahrhafte Flüssigkeit, mit der es über seinen Schweif Pflanzen wässert.
description.it: L’acqua contenuta nel suo ciuffo è ricca di nutrienti e la usa per annaffiare le piante con la coda.
description.pt-BR: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description.ru: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description.ja: 頭の房に　ためこんだ　水は 栄養　たっぷり。尻尾を使って その　水を　草木に　かけている。

description.fr: Il stocke de l’eau dans les mèches de sa tête. Quand il est à sec, il se ravitaille en aspirant de l’eau par la queue.
description.en: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description.es: Cuando lanza agua a alta presión con su cola, puede incluso resquebrajar una pared de cemento.
description.de: Es schießt mit so hohem Druck Wasser aus seinem Schweif, dass selbst Betonwände den Kürzeren ziehen.
description.it: Spruzza dalla coda un getto d’acqua ad alta pressione, con una potenza tale da distruggere anche pareti di cemento.
description.pt-BR: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description.ru: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description.ja: 尻尾から　高圧の　水を　発射すると コンクリートの　壁も 破壊する　威力。

description.fr: Quand Munna mange un rêve, celui-ci est aussitôt oublié par le rêveur. Il lévite en permanence.
description.en: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description.es: Cuando un humano o un Pokémon sufre una pesadilla, Munna se aparece ante ellos y la engulle.
description.de: Es erscheint vor schlafenden Menschen und Pokémon und frisst ihre Alpträume.
description.it: Compare accanto a Pokémon e uomini tormentati dagli incubi per nutrirsi di tutti i loro brutti sogni.
description.pt-BR: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description.ru: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description.ja: 悪い　夢に　うなされている ポケモンや　人の　前に　現われ その夢を　食べてしまう　ポケモン。

description.fr: La fumée qui sort de son front contient les rêves de nombreuses personnes et ceux de nombreux Pokémon.
description.en: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description.es: Multitud de sueños de humanos y Pokémon se encuentran atrapados en el humo que despide por su frente.
description.de: Der Dunst, der aus seiner Stirn tritt, enthält die Träume unzähliger Menschen und Pokémon.
description.it: Nel fumo che gli esce dalla fronte sono racchiusi molti sogni di esseri umani e di Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description.ru: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description.ja: おでこから　出ている　煙の　中には 人や　ポケモンの　見た　夢が たくさん　つまっているのだ。

description.fr: Il suit scrupuleusement les consignes de son Dresseur, mais il a du mal à comprendre les ordres trop compliqués.
description.en: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description.es: Es un Pokémon muy despistado. Aunque reciba órdenes de su Entrenador, se le olvidan, y se queda esperando.
description.de: Wartet oft vergeblich auf Anweisungen, obwohl es bereits einen Befehl erhalten hat. Ein sehr zerstreutes Pokémon.
description.it: È un Pokémon un po’ smemorato. A volte dimentica l’ordine appena ricevuto e allora aspetta di riceverne un altro.
description.pt-BR: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description.ru: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description.ja: とても　忘れっぽい　ポケモンで トレーナーに　命令　されたのに 新しい　命令を　待っている。

description.fr: Aussi éloigné qu’il puisse se trouver, il parvient toujours à retourner auprès de son Dresseur.
description.en: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description.es: Según los rumores, en lo más profundo del bosque donde mora Tranquill, hay un mundo pacífico y exento de luchas.
description.de: Viele Leute glauben, dass es tief in seinem heimatlichen Wald ein Land der Harmonie gibt, wo man keine Kriege kennt.
description.it: Si dice che nel cuore della foresta in cui vive Tranquill si trovi un paese che non conosce conflitti.
description.pt-BR: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description.ru: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description.ja: ハトーボーの　住む　森の　奥には 争いのない　平和な　国が　あると 信じられている。

description.fr: Le mâle intimide ses ennemis avec ses caroncules. La femelle vole mieux que le mâle.
description.en: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.es: El macho amenaza al enemigo meciendo el adorno de su cabeza. Al volar, la hembra es mucho más diestra que el macho.
description.de: Männchen schrecken Gegner ab, indem sie ihren Kopfschmuck schütteln. Weibchen verfügen über bessere Flugfertigkeiten.
description.it: Il maschio minaccia il nemico facendo ondeggiare gli ornamenti del capo. La femmina eccelle nel volo.
description.pt-BR: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.ru: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description.ja: オスは　頭の　飾りを　揺らして 相手を　威嚇する。 メスの　飛行能力は　オスを　上回る。

description.fr: Leur crinière scintille quand ils lâchent une décharge électrique. Ils se servent de ces scintillements pour communiquer.
description.en: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
description.es: Aparece cuando nubes envueltas en rayos encapotan el cielo. Atrapa rayos con su crin y almacena electricidad.
description.de: Es erscheint, wenn Gewitterwolken den Himmel verdunkeln. Es fängt mit seiner Mähne Blitze und hortet ihre Energie.
