description.it: Appare quando il cielo si riempie di fulmini e saette. Accumula elettricità attirando i fulmini con la criniera.
description.pt-BR: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
description.ru: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
description.ja: 雷雲で　空が　覆われると 現れる。たてがみで　雷を キャッチして　電気を　ためる。

description.fr: Il réagit à la vitesse de l’éclair. Lorsqu’il est en plein galop, on peut entendre le grondement du tonnerre.
description.en: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description.es: Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento. Cuando se enoja, lanza rayos desde su crin en todas direcciones.
description.de: Ein stürmischer Geselle. Wenn es wütend ist, feuert es über seine Mähne in alle Richtungen Stromsalven ab.
description.it: Ha un temperamento sanguigno. Quando si arrabbia dalla criniera lancia saette in ogni direzione.
description.pt-BR: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description.ru: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description.ja: 激しい　気性の　持ち主。 荒ぶると　たてがみから　雷を 四方八方に　放電する。

description.fr: Il a une oreille hexagonale. Son corps, compressé dans des strates profondes, est dur comme de l’acier.
description.en: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description.es: Su oreja tiene forma hexagonal. Su cuerpo fue comprimido bajo tierra. Por eso, es duro como el acero.
description.de: Hat ein sechseckiges Ohr. Sein durch das Erdreich gepresster Körper steht Stahl in Sachen Härte in nichts nach.
description.it: Ha un solo orecchio di forma esagonale. Essendo stato compresso sotto terra, il suo corpo è duro quasi come l’acciaio.
description.pt-BR: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description.ru: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description.ja: ６角形の　耳を　持つ。 地底で　圧縮された　体は 鉄に　負けないくらい　硬い。

description.fr: Quand il est gonflé à bloc, ses cristaux orangés scintillent. Il cherche de l’eau souterraine dans les grottes.
description.en: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description.es: La energía que no puede contener en el interior de su cuerpo se escapa formando cristales naranjas.
description.de: Energie, die ungehindert aus seinem Körper austrat, hat sich an ihm zu orangefarbenen Kristallen verfestigt.
description.it: L’energia sovrabbondante cerca sfogo all’esterno del corpo e si solidifica formando cristalli di colore arancione.
description.pt-BR: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description.ru: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description.ja: 体内に　収まりきらず　漏れ出した エネルギーが　固まり オレンジ色の　結晶になった。

description.fr: Il comprime de l’énergie dans son corps, et ses attaques sont assez puissantes pour renverser des montagnes.
description.en: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description.es: Absorbe los rayos solares, procesa esa energía en su núcleo y lanza poderosas bolas de luz a sus enemigos.
description.de: Es verarbeitet Sonnenstrahlen in seinem Energiekern zu Lichtkugeln weiter, um sie im Kampf auf seinen Gegner abzufeuern.
description.it: Assorbe i raggi solari e, grazie al suo nucleo energetico, li trasforma in palle di luce che poi spara.
description.pt-BR: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description.ru: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description.ja: 取りこんだ　太陽光線を エネルギーコアで　反応　させて 光の玉として　撃ちだしてくる。

description.fr: Il vit dans les forêts sombres et les grottes. Il émet des ultrasons par le nez pour se diriger.
description.en: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description.es: Vive en bosques oscuros y cavernas. Emite ultrasonidos por la nariz para saber todo lo que pasa a su alrededor.
description.de: Wohnt in dunklen Wäldern und Höhlen. Es sendet Ultraschallwellen mit seiner Nase aus, um die Gegend abzutasten.
description.it: Vive nelle foreste buie o nelle caverne. Sonda l’ambiente circostante emettendo degli ultrasuoni dalle narici.
description.pt-BR: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description.ru: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description.ja: 暗い　森や　洞穴で　暮らす。 鼻の　穴から　超音波を　出して あたりの　様子を　探る。

description.fr: Il émet des ondes sonores de différentes fréquences par le nez. Certaines peuvent briser des rochers.
description.en: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description.es: Cuando emite ondas ultrasónicas, que incluso pueden reventar el cemento, agita su cola con vehemencia.
description.de: Beim Abfeuern seiner Ultraschallwellen, mit denen es selbst Beton zertrümmern kann, wedelt es eifrig mit dem Schweif.
description.it: Quando emette delle onde ultrasoniche così forti da rompere il cemento, la coda gli oscilla con forza.
description.pt-BR: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description.ru: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description.ja: コンクリートも　壊せるほどの 強い　超音波を　出すとき 尻尾が　激しく　震える。

description.fr: Il peut creuser à plus de 50 km/h et faire la course avec une voiture roulant sur le terrain qu’il creuse.
description.en: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description.es: Cuando junta las garras y comienza a dar vueltas frenéticas, avanza bajo tierra a gran velocidad.
description.de: Es führt seine beiden Klauen zusammen, dreht sich rapide um die eigene Achse und gräbt sich ratzfatz durch das Erdreich.
description.it: Sfreccia a gran velocità sotto terra, avvitandosi su se stesso, mentre si apre un passaggio scavando con le unghie.
description.pt-BR: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description.ru: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description.ja: 両手の　ツメを　重ね合わせて 体を　高速　回転させると 猛スピードで　地中を　進む。

description.fr: Ses vrilles en acier peuvent transpercer des poutres en fer. Il est très employé dans la construction de tunnels.
description.en: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description.es: Su taladro ha evolucionado y es capaz de atravesar una lámina de hierro. Es muy útil para construir túneles.
description.de: Seine zu Stahl weiterentwickelten Bohrer kriegen selbst Eisenplatten klein. Im Tunnelbau ist es ein absolutes Ass.
description.it: La trivella si è evoluta diventando d’acciaio e può perforare una lastra di ferro. È molto utile per scavare tunnel.
description.pt-BR: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description.ru: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description.ja: 鋼に　進化した　ドリルは 鉄板を　つらぬく　破壊力。 トンネル工事で　大活躍する。

description.fr: Il ausculte les gens avec ses antennes auriculaires pour juger de leurs émotions ou de leur santé.
description.en: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description.es: Con las antenas de sus oídos, perciben el estado de un rival o predicen cuándo va a eclosionar un Huevo Pokémon.
description.de: Über die Fühler an seinen Ohren kann es ertasten, wie es einer Person geht oder wann ein Pokémon aus seinem Ei schlüpft.
description.it: Le sue orecchie sono antenne capaci di sondare lo stato di salute degli altri o capire quando un uovo si schiuderà.
description.pt-BR: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description.ru: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description.ja: 耳の　触角で　相手の 体調や　タマゴから　ポケモンが いつ　でてくるのかも　わかるのだ。

description.fr: Il combat avec une poutre. Quand il en arrive à transporter de lourds madriers sans problème, l’évolution est proche.
description.en: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description.es: Siempre lleva vigas de madera. Normalmente ayuda en obras de construcción.
description.de: Trägt stets einen Holzbalken bei sich. Es taucht hier und da auf Baustellen auf und hilft dort den Arbeitern aus.
description.it: Porta sempre con sé una tavola di legno. Appare nei cantieri dove aiuta nei lavori.
description.pt-BR: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description.ru: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description.ja: いつも　角材を　抱えている。 建築　現場に　現れて 工事を　手伝う　ポケモン。

description.fr: Même une armée de catcheurs se jetant sur son corps hyper musclé ne le ferait pas ciller.
description.en: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description.es: Gracias a su entrenada musculatura, puede blandir vigas de acero sin problema para así derribar edificios enteros.
description.de: Diese durchtrainierten Muskelprotze sind im Umgang mit Stahlträgern versiert und können damit ganze Häuser abreißen.
description.it: Ha un corpo pieno di muscoli e manovra con abilità la sua trave d’acciaio, con cui può abbattere una casa intera.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description.ru: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description.ja: 鍛えあげた　筋肉の　持ち主。 鉄骨を　たくみに　操って 一軒家を　解体してくれる。

description.fr: On pense que la recette du ciment a été enseignée aux humains par un Bétochef il y a 2 000 ans.
description.en: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description.es: Se cree que Conkeldurr enseñó a los humanos la técnica para elaborar cemento hace más de 2000 años.
description.de: Man nimmt an, dass es der Menschheit vor ca. 2 000 Jahren das Betonmischen beigebracht hat.
description.it: Si pensa che la tecnica per fare il cemento sia stata diffusa proprio da Conkeldurr, 2000 anni fa.
description.pt-BR: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description.ru: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description.ja: コンクリートを　作る　技術は ２０００年前に　ローブシンから 教わったと　考えられている。

description.fr: Il prévient ses camarades du danger en faisant vibrer ses joues pour générer un signal d’alarme très aigu.
description.en: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description.es: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y advierte de algún peligro a los suyos.
description.de: Erzeugt mit seinen Wangen für Menschen unhörbare Schallwellen, um Artgenossen vor Gefahr zu warnen.
description.it: Fa vibrare le membrane sulle guance per emettere onde sonore impercettibili agli umani con cui segnala un pericolo.
description.pt-BR: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description.ru: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description.ja: ほほの　振動膜を　震わせ 人には　きこえない　音波を　だし 仲間たちに　危険を　伝える。

description.fr: Quand il fait vibrer la bosse sur sa tête, il provoque des ondulations dans l’eau, mais aussi des tremblements de terre.
description.en: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description.es: Cuando hace vibrar el bulto de su cabeza, no solo se embravece el mar, sino que la tierra también tiembla.
description.de: Wenn es die Beulen auf seinem Kopf zum Schwingen bringt, tobt je nach Umgebung entweder das Wasser oder die Erde bebt.
description.it: Se fa vibrare il bernoccolo sulla testa può sollevare onde nell’acqua e anche provocare terremoti.
description.pt-BR: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description.ru: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description.ja: 頭の　コブを　振動させると 水中が　波立つ　だけでなく 地面も　地震のように　揺れる。

description.fr: Il fait gicler un liquide paralysant des pustules sur sa tête, et attaque ses ennemis à coups de vibrations.
description.en: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description.es: Aumenta la potencia de sus puñetazos haciendo vibrar sus puños. Es capaz de quebrar una roca de un solo golpe.
description.de: Wenn es die Beulen an seinen Fäusten zum Schwingen bringt, kann es doppelt so fest zuschlagen und Felsen zertrümmern.
description.it: Facendo vibrare le protuberanze sui pugni, ne raddoppia la potenza. Frantuma enormi massi con un colpo.
description.pt-BR: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description.ru: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description.ja: こぶしの　コブを　振動させると パンチの　威力が　倍増する。 一撃で　大岩を　粉砕。

description.fr: Quand il noue sa ceinture, il devient plus puissant. Les Judokrak sauvages tressent leur ceinture avec des lianes.
description.en: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description.es: Aumenta su potencia si se aprieta el cinturón. Un Throh salvaje teje su propio cinturón usando lianas.
description.de: Zurrt es seinen Gürtel fest, gewinnt es an Kraft. Wilde Exemplare flechten sich ihren Gürtel in Handarbeit aus Ranken.
description.it: La cintura da karate lo rende più forte. I Throh selvatici si costruiscono le cinture usando piante rampicanti.
description.pt-BR: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description.ru: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description.ja: 帯を　締めると　パワーアップする。 野生の　ナゲキは　つる草を　編んで 自分の　帯を　作る。

description.fr: Dans les montagnes où il s’entraîne, on peut l’entendre donner des coups de poing aux rochers et aux grands arbres.
description.en: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description.es: Para lograr dominar las técnicas de kárate más letales, se retiran a las montañas y entrenan día y noche.
description.de: Es lebt zurückgezogen in den Bergen und trainiert Tag und Nacht, um seinen Karateschlag zu perfektionieren.
description.it: Si allena senza posa, giorno e notte, sui monti per potenziare al massimo i suoi colpi di karate.
description.pt-BR: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description.ru: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description.ja: 最強の　からてチョップを 求めて　山奥に　こもって 眠ることなく　修行する。

description.fr: Quand il éclot, Manternel lui coud son vêtement. Il dort en cachant son visage sous sa capuche.
description.en: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description.es: Recorta hojas y las teje con el líquido viscoso que segrega por la boca para hacerse su propia ropa.
description.de: Schneidert sich ein Kleid, indem es sich Blätter zurechtbeißt und sie mit Klebefäden aus seinem Mund zusammennäht.
description.it: Si prepara da sé i vestiti, tagliando le foglie e usando i fili viscosi che secerne dalla bocca per cucirli.
description.pt-BR: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description.ru: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description.ja: 葉っぱを　かみ切り　口から　出す 粘着糸で　縫い合わせる。 自分で　服を　作る　ポケモン。

description.fr: Dans les forêts où il vit, la végétation pousse bien car il transforme les feuilles mortes en engrais.
description.en: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description.es: La vegetación abunda en los bosques que habita. Este Pokémon transforma las hojas caídas en nutrientes.
description.de: Es wandelt herabgefallenes Laub in Nährstoffe um. In Wäldern, wo es Folikon gibt, fühlen sich Pflanzen pudelwohl.
description.it: Le foreste in cui vive Swadloon sono lussureggianti, poiché trasforma le foglie morte in sostanze nutritive.
description.pt-BR: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description.ru: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description.ja: クルマユの　住む　森は　草木が よく　育つ。クルマユが　落ち葉を 栄養分に　変えているのだ。

description.fr: Quand il trouve de petits Pokémon, il leur coud des vêtements de feuilles en utilisant ses coupoirs et son fil adhésif.
description.en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description.es: Si se encuentra con un Pokémon joven, segrega por la boca hilos pegadizos con los que le teje una prenda de ropa.
description.de: Begegnet es einem jungen Pokémon, näht es ihm mit den klebrigen Fäden aus seinem Mund ein Kleid aus Blättern.
description.it: Quando incontra un giovane Pokémon gli fa un vestito di foglie che cuce con il filo appiccicoso prodotto dalla bocca.
description.pt-BR: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description.ru: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description.ja: 幼い　ポケモンを　みつけると 口から　出す　粘着糸で 葉っぱの　服を　縫ってあげる。

description.fr: Sa morsure est très venimeuse. Elle paralyse même les grands Pokémon Oiseaux, ses prédateurs.
description.en: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description.es: Percibe su entorno con su sentido del tacto, residente en su cabeza y cola. Su carácter es violento por naturaleza.
description.de: Mit seinen Ruten und den Fühlern an seinem Kopf tastet es die Umgebung ab. Ein überaus aggressiver Geselle.
description.it: Sonda l’ambiente circostante con le antenne del capo e della coda. Ha un carattere estremamente collerico.
description.pt-BR: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description.ru: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description.ja: 頭と　尻尾の　触角で まわりの　様子を　探る。 非常に　凶暴な　性格。

description.fr: Protégé par sa solide carapace, il fonce sur ses ennemis en roulant comme un pneu.
description.en: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description.es: Lo protege un duro caparazón. Gira como una rueda y realiza brutales placajes contra sus enemigos.
description.de: Von einem harten Schutzpanzer umgeben. Es greift seine Gegner an, indem es mit Karacho wie ein Rad in sie hineinrollt.
description.it: È protetto da un guscio resistente. Si scaglia contro il nemico rotolando come uno pneumatico.
description.pt-BR: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description.ru: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description.ja: 硬い　殻に　守られている。 タイヤのように　回転して 敵に　激しく　体当たりする。

description.fr: Il accule l’ennemi par ses mouvements rapides et l’attaque avec ses cornes. Il ne s’arrête qu’au coup de grâce.
description.en: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description.es: Atenaza a sus presas con las garras que sobresalen de su cuello hasta que no se pueden mover y las remata con veneno.
description.de: Lähmt seine Beute, indem es sie mit den Zacken an seinem Hals aufspießt. Mit einer Ladung Gift gibt es ihr den Rest.
description.it: Trafigge la preda con gli aculei del collo e dopo averla immobilizzata la finisce con le sue tossine.
description.pt-BR: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description.ru: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description.ja: 獲物を　首のツメで　挟みこみ 身動きを　とれなくしてから 猛毒を　与え　とどめを　刺す。

description.fr: Si on l’attaque, il projette un nuage de coton. L’ennemi le confond avec lui, ce qui permet à Doudouvet de s’enfuir.
description.en: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description.es: Despide motas de algodón cuando lo atacan para confundir a los enemigos y poner pies en polvorosa.
description.de: Wird es angegriffen, verstreut es zur Täuschung Watte. Es flieht, während der Gegner nach dem wahren Waumboll sucht.
description.it: Se viene attaccato crea una nuvola di cotone per confondere il nemico, poi ne approfitta per fuggire.
description.pt-BR: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description.ru: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description.ja: 襲われると　体から　綿を　飛ばす。 敵が　綿を　モンメンと 間違えている　すきに　逃げるのだ。

description.fr: Il se faufile comme le vent par les espaces les plus étroits, en laissant une touffe de poils blancs.
description.en: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description.es: Aparecen en medio de un torbellino y entran en las casas para descolocar los muebles o esparcir algodón por doquier.
description.de: Sie erscheinen mit Orkanböen und spielen den Leuten Streiche, indem sie in Häusern Möbel verrücken oder Watte verstreuen.
description.it: Appare con un vortice d’aria, facendo piccoli dispetti come spostare i mobili nelle case o lasciare cotone ovunque.
description.pt-BR: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description.ru: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description.ja: つむじかぜと　ともに　現われて 家の　中の　家具を　動かしたり 綿を　残す　いたずらをする。

description.fr: Les feuilles sur sa tête sont très amères, mais elles remettent d’aplomb les corps les plus éreintés.
description.en: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
description.es: Mordisquear las hojas de su cabeza permite recuperar toda la vitalidad, a pesar de que están muy amargas.
description.de: Die Blätter auf seinem Kopf schmecken furchtbar bitter, doch sie helfen ausgezeichnet gegen Erschöpfung.
description.it: Le foglie che ha sul capo sono molto amare ma, se masticate, hanno l’effetto di rinvigorire il corpo stanco.
description.pt-BR: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
description.ru: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
description.ja: 頭の　葉っぱを　かじると とても　苦いが　疲れた　体を 元気にする　効果が　あるのだ。

description.fr: Même les Dresseurs confirmés ont du mal à faire éclore sa belle fleur. Un Pokémon apprécié des célébrités.
description.en: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
description.es: El aroma de la flor de su tocado relaja a cualquiera a su alrededor. Hay que cuidarle mucho para que no se marchite.
description.de: Der Duft des Blumenschmucks auf seinem Kopf wirkt beruhigend. Damit der Schmuck nicht verwelkt, muss man es gut pflegen.
description.it: I fiori che ha sulla testa spandono un profumo rilassante, ma necessitano di continue attenzioni per non appassire.
description.pt-BR: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
description.ru: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
description.ja: 頭の　花飾りの　香りには リラックスさせる　効果が　ある。 手入れを　怠けると　枯れてしまう。

description.fr: Les bleus et les rouges se détestent cordialement et se battent dès qu’ils s’aperçoivent. Un Pokémon très violent.
description.en: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
description.es: Los de color azul y los de color rojo siempre se pelean. Son muy violentos, pero su sabor es excepcional.
description.de: Sie gelten als Delikatesse. Aufgrund ihrer brutalen Natur liegen rot und blau gestreifte Exemplare immer im Clinch.
description.it: I Basculin con la linea rossa e quelli con la linea blu sono molto violenti e litigano spesso.
description.pt-BR: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
description.ru: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
description.ja: とても　乱暴で　いつも　あかと あおの　バスラオは　争っている。 食べると　意外と　おいしいらしい。

description.fr: Il vit dans le sable des déserts. Le sable chauffé par le soleil empêche son corps de refroidir.
description.en: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description.es: Se desplaza hundido en la arena, dejando al descubierto solo los ojos y la nariz. Una membrana negra le protege los ojos.
description.de: Wenn es sich durch den Sand gräbt, ragen nur noch Nase und Augen hervor. Die schwarze Haut dient als Augenschutz.
description.it: Si nasconde sotto la sabbia e si sposta cacciando fuori gli occhi e il naso. Una membrana nera gli protegge gli occhi.
description.pt-BR: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description.ru: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description.ja: 砂の　中に　潜り　目と　鼻を 外に　出して　移動する。 黒い　膜が　目を　守る。

description.fr: Ils vivent en petits groupes. La membrane qui couvre leurs yeux les protège du soleil.
description.en: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description.es: Viven en manadas. La membrana que cubre sus ojos los protege de la arena.
description.de: Bildet mit mehreren Artgenossen ein Rudel. Eine Membran schützt seine Augen vor Sandstürmen.
description.it: Forma gruppi di pochi esemplari. La pellicola che ricopre i suoi occhi lo protegge dalle tempeste di sabbia.
description.pt-BR: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description.ru: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description.ja: 数匹で　群れを　作る。 眼球を　カバーする　膜が 砂嵐から　目を　守る。

description.fr: Il ne laisse jamais échapper ses proies. Ses mâchoires surpuissantes peuvent broyer une voiture.
description.en: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description.es: Un Pokémon bastante violento. Ataca todo lo que se mueva delante de él con sus mortíferas mandíbulas.
description.de: Ein äußerst grausames Pokémon. Es greift jeden, der ihm unter die Augen kommt, mit seinen scharfen Reißzähnen an.
description.it: È un Pokémon molto feroce. Attacca tutto ciò che gli si para davanti, prendendolo a morsi.
description.pt-BR: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description.ru: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description.ja: とても　凶暴な　ポケモン。 目の前で　動くものは　すべて 襲いかかり　かみくだこうとする。

description.fr: Quand le feu brûle dans son corps, il est tout excité et court partout. Quand le feu s’apaise, il s’endort.
description.en: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description.es: Como sus excrementos están muy calientes, la gente de antaño se los metía en los bolsillos para calentarse.
description.de: Früher nutzte man die heißen Ausscheidungen von Flampion, um sich den Körper zu wärmen.
description.it: Poiché i suoi escrementi sono molto caldi, nell’antichità gli uomini solevano conservarli in buste per riscaldarsi.
description.pt-BR: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description.ru: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description.ja: ダルマッカの　フンは　熱いので 昔の　人は　懐に　入れて 体を　温めていたのだ。

description.fr: Il entretient des flammes à 1 400 °C dans son corps. De quoi détruire un camion-benne d’un coup de poing!
description.en: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description.es: Cuando resulta gravemente herido, se endurece como una piedra y medita para agudizar la mente.
description.de: Nimmt es in einem heißen Kampf Schaden, wird es hart wie Stein und fällt in eine Trance, um seinen Verstand zu schärfen.
description.it: Se resta ferito durante una battaglia violenta, diventa duro come la pietra e medita per purificare la mente.
description.pt-BR: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description.ru: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description.ja: 激しい　戦いで　傷つくと 岩のように　固まり　黙考して 心を　研ぎ澄ませるのだ。

description.fr: Avec une danse et des sons saccadés, il fait fuir ses prédateurs, les Pokémon Oiseaux dévoreurs de graines de fleur.
description.en: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description.es: Espanta a los Pokémon pájaro con un baile rápido y haciendo ruido para evitar que picoteen las semillas de sus flores.
description.de: Verjagt Vogel-Pokémon, die auf seine Blüten aus sind, mit einem flotten Tänzchen und lauter Untermalung.
description.it: Con danze e suoni a ritmo vivace scaccia i suoi predatori, i Pokémon uccello, che divorano i semi dei suoi fiori.
description.pt-BR: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description.ru: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description.ja: アップテンポの　踊りと　音で 花の　タネを　ねらう　天敵の とりポケモンを　追い払うのだ。

description.fr: Il peut facilement creuser son trou dans les pierres les plus dures grâce au liquide sécrété par sa bouche.
description.en: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description.es: Abre un agujero en la roca y vive en él. Si la roca se resquebraja, no se queda tranquilo hasta que no encuentra otra.
description.de: Höhlt sich einen brauchbaren Stein aus, um darin zu wohnen. Geht er zu Bruch, ruht es nicht, bis es einen neuen findet.
description.it: Scava un buco in una pietra adatta per farne la sua dimora. Se si rompe, non si dà pace finché non ne trova un’altra.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description.ru: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description.ja: 手ごろな　石に　穴を　開けて 住処にする。壊されると　かわりの 石が　見つかるまで　落ち着かない。

description.fr: Entre eux, les querelles de territoire sont fréquentes et violentes. Celui qui se fait briser son rocher a perdu.
description.en: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description.es: Su inmensa capacidad motriz le permite desplazarse cargando a sus espaldas rocas enormes durante días.
description.de: Es ist hart genug im Nehmen, um mitsamt seines schweren Felsens mehrere Tage durch trockene Gebiete zu wandern.
description.it: Ha una tale forza nelle gambe, che può spostarsi per giorni in zone aride con una pesante roccia sulle spalle.
description.pt-BR: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description.ru: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description.ja: 重たい　岩を　背負って 乾燥した　土地を　何日でも 移動できる　脚力を　持つ。

description.fr: Il remonte sa peau jusqu’à son cou pour se protéger. Elle a une constitution élastique qui absorbe les coups.
description.en: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description.es: Se sube la piel hasta el cuello para defenderse. Su elasticidad, similar a la de una goma, reduce el daño recibido.
description.de: Es zieht seine gummiartige Haut bis zum Hals hinauf und nimmt eine Abwehrhaltung ein, um sich vor Schaden zu schützen.
description.it: Assumono la posizione difensiva tirando su fino al collo la pelle, che è elastica come la gomma e previene i danni.
description.pt-BR: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description.ru: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description.ja: 皮を　首まで　引き上げて 防御の　姿勢。ゴムのような　弾力で ダメージを　減らす。

description.fr: Ils se regroupent pour rosser ceux qui pénètrent sur leur territoire. Ils crachent un venin corrosif.
description.en: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description.es: Se protege de los ataques con la muda de su piel mientras reparte patadas. Cuanto mayor es su cresta, más se le respeta.
description.de: Es wehrt Angriffe mit seiner alten Haut ab und kontert mit Tritten. Sein Ego entspricht der Größe seines Kamms.
description.it: Quando tira calci, si protegge dai danni con la pelle della muta. Più grande è la cresta e più arie si dà.
description.pt-BR: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description.ru: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description.ja: 脱皮した　皮を　ずりあげて ダメージを　減らしつつ　キック！ とさかが　大きいほど　偉そうだ。

description.fr: On dit qu’il parcourt toujours le même itinéraire parce qu’il a gardé la mémoire de la ville antique qu’il protégeait.
description.en: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description.es: Fue la deidad protectora de una ciudad milenaria. Ataca con su poder psíquico a los enemigos que invaden su territorio.
description.de: Einst war es der Wächter einer Stadt aus uralten Zeiten. Wer sich in sein Revier wagt, lernt seine Psycho-Kräfte kennen.
description.it: Era lo spirito custode di un’antica città. Attaccava con poteri psichici i nemici che invadevano il suo territorio.
description.pt-BR: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description.ru: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description.ja: 古代都市の　守り神だった。 縄張りに　侵入した　敵を サイコパワーで　攻撃する。

description.fr: Le motif de son masque est son visage quand il était humain. Parfois, il le regarde et se met à pleurer.
description.en: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description.es: Almas de humanos sepultados en tumbas que han adquirido forma de Pokémon. Recuerdan su vida antes de la muerte.
description.de: Es entsteht aus den Seelen von längst begrabenen Menschen und kann sich immer noch an deren Vergangenheit erinnern.
description.it: Erano un tempo spettri che riposavano in antiche tombe. Conservano la memoria della loro vita mortale.
description.pt-BR: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description.ru: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description.ja: お墓に　埋葬された　人の 魂が　ポケモンに　変化した。 死ぬ前の　記憶が　残っている。

description.fr: Il paraît qu’il avale les gens et les transforme en momies. Il adore manger des lingots d’or.
description.en: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description.es: Se comenta que engulle a todo humano que se le acerca y lo momifica. Su comida favorita son las pepitas de oro.
description.de: Angeblich verschlingt es jeden, der sich ihm auch nur nähert. Besonders gern frisst es Klumpen aus reinem Gold.
description.it: Si dice che inghiottisca le prede che gli si avvicinano e le trasformi in mummie. Gli piace mangiare le pepite d’oro.
description.pt-BR: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description.ru: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description.ja: 近づいた　人間を　飲みこんで ミイラに　してしまうという　ウワサ。 金塊を　好んで　食べる。

description.fr: Il a été recréé à partir d’un fossile préhistorique. Il peut plonger jusqu’à 1 000 mètres de profondeur.
description.en: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description.es: Ya pululaba por las aguas hace 100 millones de años. También va a tierra a veces en busca de alimento.
description.de: Schwamm bereits vor 100 Millionen Jahren durch die Meere. Ab und zu führt es die Jagd auch an Land.
description.it: Nuotava nei mari 100 milioni di anni fa. A volte sale in superficie per aggredire le prede.
description.pt-BR: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description.ru: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description.ja: およそ　１億年前の　海を 泳いでいた。陸地へ　上がって 獲物に　襲いかかる　こともある。

description.fr: Il vit sur terre et en mer. Ses bras surpuissants peuvent percer des trous dans la coque des paquebots.
description.en: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description.es: Vive en el mar y en la superficie. Sus garras pueden abrir un agujero en el fondo de un petrolero.
description.de: Es lebt im Meer und an Land. Es ist so stark, dass es mit einem einzigen Hieb ein Loch in ein Schiff reißen kann.
description.it: Vive nel mare e sulla terraferma. Ha una forza tale da sfondare con un solo colpo il fondo di una nave cisterna.
description.pt-BR: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description.ru: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description.ja: 海と　陸地で　生活する。 張り手で　タンカーの　船底に 穴を　開ける　パワーの　持ち主。

description.fr: On dit qu’il serait l’ancêtre de tous les Pokémon Oiseaux. Il ne sait pas voler et se déplace en sautant d’arbre en arbre.
description.en: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description.es: Pokémon que renació de un fósil. Dicen que es el antepasado de todos los Pokémon pájaro.
description.de: Es wurde aus einem Fossil reanimiert. Man geht davon aus, dass es der Urahn aller Vogel-Pokémon ist.
description.it: Pokémon risvegliatosi da un fossile. Si ritiene che sia l’antenato di tutti i Pokémon uccello.
description.pt-BR: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description.ru: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description.ja: 化石から　復活した　ポケモン。 あらゆる　とりポケモンの　祖先と 考えられている。

description.fr: Il s’envole après avoir pris de l’élan. Il est assez intelligent pour chasser ses proies en groupe.
description.en: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description.es: Levanta el vuelo tras coger carrerilla. Coopera con sus compañeros de bandada para atrapar a sus presas.
description.de: Bevor es abhebt, nimmt es am Boden Anlauf. Es ist schlau genug, seine Beute zusammen mit Artgenossen zu jagen.
description.it: Spicca il volo prendendo la rincorsa da terra. Collabora con i suoi simili per catturare le prede.
description.pt-BR: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description.ru: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description.ja: 地上で　助走を　つけてから 飛び立つ。仲間と　協力して 獲物を　しとめる　知能を　持つ。

description.fr: Il aime les endroits mal tenus. Le gaz qu’il rote endort pendant une semaine.
description.en: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description.es: Pokémon nacido de la reacción química entre una bolsa de basura y residuos industriales.
description.de: Eine Mülltüte, der Industrieabfälle und chemische Reaktionen neues Leben eingehaucht haben.
description.it: È nato da un sacchetto della spazzatura che ha subito un cambiamento chimico a causa delle scorie industriali.
description.pt-BR: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description.ru: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description.ja: ゴミ袋が　産業廃棄物と 化学変化を　起こした　ことで ポケモンとして　生まれ変わった。

description.fr: Il étrangle ses ennemis avec son bras droit et les achève avec le gaz puant et empoisonné qu’il exhale par la bouche.
description.en: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description.es: Apresa a su rival con el brazo izquierdo y le da el golpe de gracia exhalando por la boca un apestoso gas venenoso.
description.de: Es nimmt mit dem rechten Arm Gegner in die Mangel und gibt ihnen mit dem giftigen Gas aus seinem Maul den Rest.
description.it: Serra l’avversario con l’arto sinistro e gli dà il colpo di grazia esalando dalla bocca un fetido gas velenoso.
description.pt-BR: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description.ru: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description.ja: 左腕で　相手を　絞めつけて 口から　吐き出す　悪臭の　毒ガスで とどめを　刺すのだ。

description.fr: Il a le pouvoir de prendre l’apparence des autres. On dit qu’il se transforme souvent en petit enfant silencieux.
description.en: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
description.es: Adopta la apariencia de su enemigo para engañarlo vilmente y aprovecha su estupor para poner tierra por medio.
description.de: Nicht selten überrumpelt es Gegner, indem es ihre Gestalt annimmt und den Überraschungseffekt zur Flucht nutzt.
description.it: Inganna spesso il nemico assumendone la forma e lasciandolo esterrefatto, per poi darsi alla fuga.
description.pt-BR: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
description.ru: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
description.ja: 相手そっくりに　化けているように みせかけ　だましたり　驚かして そのすきに　逃げ出すことが　多い。

description.fr: Ces Pokémon protègent les leurs en prenant l’apparence de leurs ennemis. Ils forment des groupes très soudés.
description.en: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
description.es: Tiene la facultad de confundir a muchos humanos a la vez. Protege su guarida creando un paisaje ilusorio.
description.de: Kann auf einen Schlag große Massen von Menschen täuschen. Es kreiert Illusionen, um sein Revier zu schützen.
description.it: Ha la capacità di trarre in inganno una folla di persone. Protegge la tana creando dei miraggi.
description.pt-BR: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
description.ru: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
description.ja: いっぺんに　大勢の　人を 化かす　力を　持つ。 幻の　景色を　見せて　住処を　守る。

description.fr: Ils se saluent en se caressant mutuellement le corps avec la queue, qu’ils gardent toujours immaculée.
description.en: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description.es: Se saludan entre sí frotándose con la cola y limpiándose a conciencia.
description.de: Sie begrüßen einander, indem sie ihr Gegenüber mithilfe ihres Schweifs säubern.
description.it: Si salutano pulendosi l’un l’altro con le loro code.
description.pt-BR: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description.ru: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description.ja: お互いの　尻尾で　相手を とことん　きれいに　してあげるのが チラーミィ同士の　あいさつ。

description.fr: Leurs poils blancs sont recouverts d’une graisse spéciale qui leur permet d’esquiver facilement les attaques.
description.en: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description.es: El pelo que cubre su cuerpo proporciona una agradable sensación al tocarlo. No acumula ni polvo ni electricidad estática.
description.de: Sein weißer Flaum fühlt sich wunderbar flauschig an und zieht weder Staub noch statische Elektrizität an.
description.it: La sua pelliccia bianca è morbidissima al tatto. Non accumula né polvere né elettricità statica.
description.pt-BR: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description.ru: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description.ja: 白い　体毛は　肌触りが　抜群。 ほこりや　静電気を まったく　寄せつけないのだ。

description.fr: Concentre des pouvoirs psychiques dans ses antennes semblables à des rubans, et regarde fixement... mais quoi?
description.en: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description.es: Amplifica su poder psíquico con sus antenitas en forma de lazo. Siempre está mirando algo fijamente.
description.de: Die schleifenförmigen Fühler erhöhen seine Psycho-Kräfte. Es scheint stets irgendetwas anzustarren.
description.it: Amplifica i poteri psichici con le antenne a forma di fiocchetti. Il suo sguardo è sempre fisso.
description.pt-BR: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description.ru: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description.ja: リボンのような　触角で サイコパワーを　増幅させる。 なにかを　じっと　見つめている。

description.fr: Hypnotise les Pokémon et les gens. Il y a de nombreuses légendes de gens enlevés dans leur sommeil par des Mesmérella.
description.en: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description.es: La luz de las estrellas origina su poder. De noche, marca su posición haciendo levitar piedras con su poder psíquico.
description.de: Zieht seine Energie aus dem Sternenlicht. Bei Nacht bringt es Steine zum Schweben und bildet damit Sternzeichen nach.
description.it: Trae energia dalla luce delle stelle. Ne traccia la posizione facendo levitare le pietre con i poteri psichici.
description.pt-BR: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description.ru: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description.ja: 星明りが　パワーの　源。 夜になると　サイコパワーで　石を 浮かべて　星の　配置を　印す。

description.fr: Ses pouvoirs psychiques plient l’espace aux alentours. On y voit des étoiles éloignées de millions d’années-lumière.
description.en: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description.es: Su inmenso poder psíquico distorsiona el espacio y le permite reflejar incluso estrellas a años luz de distancia.
description.de: Durch seine mächtigen Psycho-Kräfte krümmt sich der Raum und Bilder eines Lichtjahre entfernten Ortes erscheinen.
description.it: I suoi forti poteri psichici modificano lo spazio circostante rendendo visibili galassie lontane milioni di anni luce.
description.pt-BR: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description.ru: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description.ja: 強力な　サイコパワーの　影響で ゴチルゼルの　周囲の　空間が　ねじれ 何万光年も　遠くの　星空が　映る。

description.fr: Ils repoussent leurs assaillants avec leurs pouvoirs psychiques et communiquent entre eux par télépathie.
description.en: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description.es: Gracias a la sustancia viscosa que envuelve su cuerpo, permanece tranquilo por dura o rigurosa que sea la situación.
description.de: Die spezielle Flüssigkeit, die es umgibt, bietet ihm in jeder noch so gefährlichen Situation Schutz.
description.it: Il liquido speciale in cui è avvolto il suo corpo gli permette di resistere alle condizioni più estreme.
description.pt-BR: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description.ru: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description.ja: 体が　特殊な　液体に 包まれているので　どんな　きびしい 状況でも　平気なのだ。

description.fr: Il possède deux cerveaux séparés qui le font parfois agir de façon totalement incohérente.
description.en: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description.es: Dado que su cerebro está dividido en dos, a veces tiene conflictos a la hora de decidir qué hacer.
description.de: Wegen seines gespaltenen Denkapparates kann es vorkommen, dass es sich abrupt einer anderen Tätigkeit zuwendet.
description.it: Poiché ha due cervelli separati e indipendenti, può capitare che si comporti in modo del tutto incoerente.
description.pt-BR: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description.ru: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description.ja: ２つに　分裂した　脳みそを 持っているため　いきなり　違う 行動を　とることが　あるのだ。

description.fr: Quand ils se tiennent par la main, leurs cerveaux forment un réseau qui démultiplie leurs pouvoirs psychiques.
description.en: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description.es: Hacen gala de su poder psíquico y mueven sus brazos compuestos de líquido para controlar rocas y hacerlas añicos.
description.de: Seine Arme bestehen aus einer speziellen Flüssigkeit. Dank seiner Psycho-Kräfte kann es mit ihnen Felsen zerschmettern.
description.it: Le sue braccia, piene di un liquido che convoglia i suoi poteri psichici, sono anche in grado di frantumare le rocce.
description.pt-BR: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description.ru: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description.ja: 発揮した　サイコパワーを　使い 特殊な　液体で　つくられた 腕を　操り　岩を　砕く。

description.fr: Un Pokémon Oiseau doué pour la plongée. Il nage sous l’eau à la recherche de sphaigne, son plat préféré.
description.en: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description.es: Cuando se ve atacado, las plumas que lo recubren despiden ráfagas de agua que lo ayudan a escapar.
description.de: Gerät es in Gefahr, versprüht es Wasser aus seinem Federkleid und nutzt den Sprühregen, um Reißaus zu nehmen.
description.it: Quando viene attaccato schizza acqua da tutte le piume del corpo. Fugge dileguandosi in una nuvola di spruzzi.
description.pt-BR: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description.ru: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description.ja: 敵に　襲われると　全身の　羽毛から 水しぶきを　出す。 水煙に　紛れて　逃げるのだ。

description.fr: Ils se mettent à danser à la tombée de la nuit. Le Lakmécygne qui danse au centre est le chef de la troupe.
description.en: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description.es: Aunque no lo parezca por su grácil elegancia, puede batir con fuerza las alas y volar durante miles de kilómetros.
description.de: Sie wirken zerbrechlich, aber ihre starken Schwingen tragen sie in einem Stück bis zu 1 000 km weit.
description.it: Non è solo elegante. Con il poderoso battito d’ali riesce a volare per migliaia di chilometri senza fermarsi.
description.pt-BR: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description.ru: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description.ja: 優雅な　みかけに　よらず 翼で　力強く　羽ばたき 数千キロ　飛び続けられる。

description.fr: Il exhale une haleine à -50 °C. Il fabrique des cristaux de neige et fait neiger autour de lui.
description.en: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description.es: Lanza un aliento de -50 °C. Crea bloques de nieve y es capaz de lograr que nieve a su alrededor.
description.de: Die Temperatur seines Odems liegt bei -50 °C. Es erzeugt Eiskristalle und lässt es in seiner Umgebung schneien.
description.it: Il suo fiato è a -50 °C. Fa nevicare tutto intorno, formando dei cristalli di neve.
description.pt-BR: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description.ru: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description.ja: マイナス５０度の　息を　吐く。 雪の　結晶を　作って あたりに　雪を　降らせる。

description.fr: Un Pokémon qui vit dans les montagnes enneigées. Il a émigré au sud durant l’ère glaciaire, il y a bien longtemps.
description.en: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description.es: Enfrían el aire a su alrededor y crean partículas de hielo mediante las cuales congelan a sus oponentes.
description.de: Es produziert Eiskörner, indem es die Luft um sich herum abkühlt, und zieht mit ihnen eine Eisschicht um seinen Gegner.
description.it: Congela il corpo del nemico con granelli di ghiaccio che genera raffreddando l’aria circostante.
description.pt-BR: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description.ru: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description.ja: 辺りの　空気を　冷やして 氷の　粒を　発生　させて 敵の　体を　凍りつかせる。

description.fr: Il avale de l’eau en grande quantité et la transforme en nuages neigeux. Il souffle du blizzard sur ses ennemis.
description.en: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description.es: Si sus dos cabezas se irritan al mismo tiempo, genera una ventisca desde su cuerno cubriendo su entorno con nieve.
description.de: Bringt man beide Köpfe in Rage, stößt sein Horn heftige Eisböen aus, und alles in seiner Umgebung versinkt in Schnee.
description.it: Se le due teste si arrabbiano allo stesso tempo, scatena una bufera dalle corna, coprendo di neve i dintorni.
description.pt-BR: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description.ru: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description.ja: ２つの　頭が　同時に　怒ると ツノから　猛吹雪を　噴き出す。 あたりを　大雪で　埋めてしまう。

description.fr: Son pelage prend la même couleur et la même odeur que les hautes herbes. S’il sent un ennemi, il court s’y réfugier.
description.en: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description.es: El color de su cuerpo cambia no solo con las estaciones, sino también con los cambios de humedad y temperatura.
description.de: Unabhängig von der Jahreszeit ändert sich seine Farbe auch bei wechselnder Temperatur oder Luftfeuchtigkeit leicht.
description.it: Il suo corpo muta non solo a seconda della stagione ma in misura minore anche al cambiare di temperatura e umidità.
description.pt-BR: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description.ru: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description.ja: 季節が　変わったとき　だけでなく 気温や　湿度に　よっても 体の色は　少し　変化する。

description.fr: Il change d’habitat selon les saisons. Les gens constatent le passage des saisons en regardant ses ramures.
description.en: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description.es: Cambia de morada dependiendo de las estaciones. Observando sus cuernos, la gente sabe cuándo estas van a cambiar.
description.de: An seinem Geweih kann man ablesen, wann eine neue Jahreszeit beginnt. Sein Revier wechselt mit jeder neuen Jahreszeit.
description.it: Cambia dimora a seconda delle stagioni. Gli uomini si accorgono del cambio di stagione osservando le sue corna.
description.pt-BR: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description.ru: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description.ja: 季節によって　住処を　変える。 人々は　メブキジカの　ツノで 季節の　移り変わりを　感じる。

description.fr: Il accumule dans ses membranes l’électricité qu’il produit dans ses bajoues, et la relâche tout en planant.
description.en: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description.es: Vive en la copa de los árboles. Produce descargas mientras vuela con el interior de la membrana que hace de capa.
description.de: Lebt in den Wipfeln der Waldbäume. Während es durch die Lüfte gleitet, entlädt es Strom aus seinen Fluglappen.
description.it: Vive nelle foreste sulle cime degli alberi. Plana usando una membrana simile a un mantello, elettrificata all’interno.
description.pt-BR: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description.ru: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description.ja: 森の　木の上で　暮らす。 マントのような　膜の　内側を 放電　させながら　滑空する。

description.fr: Un Pokémon mystérieux qui évolue quand il reçoit un stimulus électrique en étant proche d’un Escargaume.
description.en: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description.es: Si recibe un estímulo eléctrico al estar en contacto con un Shelmet, evoluciona.
description.de: Ein mysteriöses Pokémon, das sich entwickelt, wenn es zusammen mit Schnuthelm einen Stromschlag abbekommt.
description.it: Pokémon misterioso che si evolve ricevendo uno stimolo elettrico se si trova in presenza di Shelmet.
description.pt-BR: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description.ru: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description.ja: チョボマキと　一緒に　いるときに 電気的な　刺激を　受けると 進化する　不思議な　ポケモンだ。

description.fr: Il vole à toute vitesse et frappe tout ennemi de ses lances pointues. Il combat bravement contre les plus forts que lui.
description.en: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description.es: Se defienden de los ataques con el caparazón que roban a los Shelmet. Atacan con sus dos mortíferas lanzas.
description.de: Eine von einem Schnuthelm gestohlene Muschel dient ihm als Helm. Es greift Gegner mit seinen beiden Lanzen an.
description.it: Protegge il corpo con la conchiglia che ha rubato a Shelmet mentre spunzona il nemico con due lance.
description.pt-BR: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description.ru: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description.ja: チョボマキから　奪った　殻で 体を　覆い　ガードしながら ２本の　ヤリで　突いてくる。

description.fr: Grâce à sa ressemblance mystérieuse avec une Poké Ball, il attire ses ennemis et relâche des spores empoisonnées.
description.en: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description.es: Gracias a su misterioso parecido a una Poké Ball, atrae a sus presas y lanza rápidamente esporas de veneno.
description.de: Fällt ein Trainer auf sein Äußeres herein, das komischerweise einem Pokéball ähnelt, besprüht es ihn mit Giftsporen.
description.it: Simile a una Poké Ball, adesca i nemici e sparge spore velenose. Da dove venga questa somiglianza è un vero mistero.
description.pt-BR: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description.ru: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description.ja: モンスターボールに　似た　模様で 誘い　毒胞子を　吹きかける。 なぜ　似ているかは　ナゾである。

description.fr: Il danse en faisant tournoyer les coupoles en forme de Poké Ball de ses bras pour attirer ses proies.
description.en: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description.es: Aunque intenta pasar por parte superior de una Poké Ball para atraer a sus presas, consigue engañar a pocos.
description.de: Um Beute anzulocken, bietet es seinen Hut feil, der einem Pokéball ähnelt. Doch kaum ein Pokémon fällt darauf herein.
description.it: Cerca di attirare le prede esibendo un cappello a forma di Poké Ball, ma sono pochi i Pokémon che si fanno ingannare.
description.pt-BR: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description.ru: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description.ja: モンスターボールの　カサを　見せつけ 獲物を　誘き寄せようとするが だまされる　ポケモンは　少ない。

description.fr: Il s’enfonce dans les profondeurs de la mer en emmenant son ennemi, qu’il ligote avec ses bras fins comme des voiles.
description.en: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description.es: Paraliza a sus presas con veneno y las lleva a su morada, que se encuentra a 8000 m en el fondo del mar.
description.de: Es lähmt seine Beute mit Gift und verschleppt sie in seinen Unterschlupf, 8 km unter dem Meeresspiegel.
description.it: Paralizza la preda con il veleno e la porta nella sua dimora a 8000 m in fondo al mare.
description.pt-BR: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description.ru: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description.ja: 獲物を　毒で　しびれさせて ８０００メートルの　深海に あるという　住処に　連れていく。

description.fr: Les bateaux qui s’aventurent sur son territoire coulent, et Moyade aspire l’énergie vitale des marins.
description.en: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description.es: Su cuerpo se compone de agua salada. Dicen que ha construido un palacio en el fondo del mar con restos de barcos.
description.de: Es heißt, am Meeresboden gebe es einen Palast aus Schiffen, die es versenkt hat. Es besteht fast nur aus Meerwasser.
description.it: È composto per lo più d’acqua marina. Dicono che si sia costruito un castello con i relitti delle navi che ha affondato.
description.pt-BR: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description.ru: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description.ja: 体の　ほとんどが　海水。 海底には　ブルンゲルが　沈めた 船で　できた　城が　あるという。

description.fr: La membrane spéciale qui entoure son corps a la capacité de guérir les blessures.
description.en: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description.es: Vive flotando a la deriva en mar abierto. Siempre que encuentra un Pokémon herido, lo abraza y lo lleva a la costa.
description.de: Es treibt durch den Ozean. Findet es ein verletztes Pokémon, nimmt es dieses auf und trägt es zurück an Land.
description.it: Vive in mare aperto trasportato dalle onde. Se si imbatte in un Pokémon ferito, lo riaccompagna a riva.
description.pt-BR: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description.ru: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description.ja: 大海原を　漂って　暮らす。 傷ついた　ポケモンを　見つけると 抱きかかえて　岸まで　運ぶ。

description.fr: Les Statitik qui vivent en ville ont appris à aspirer le courant depuis les prises électriques des maisons.
description.en: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description.es: No puede generar electricidad por sí mismo, así que se encarama a Pokémon grandes y absorbe su energía estática.
description.de: Da es selbst keinen Strom erzeugen kann, klettert es auf andere Pokémon, um ihnen elektrostatische Energie abzusaugen.
description.it: Non può produrre elettricità da sé, per cui si attacca a Pokémon più grandi per succhiarne l’energia elettrostatica.
description.pt-BR: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description.ru: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description.ja: 自分では　電気を　つくれないので 他の　大きな　ポケモンに とりつき　静電気を　吸いとる。

description.fr: Quand on l’attaque, il projette une multitude de fils électrifiés pour créer une barrière électrique.
description.en: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description.es: Pone trampas con hilos electrificados. De este modo, electrocuta a sus enemigos y los inmoviliza por completo.
description.de: Lässt seine Beute in elektrisch geladene Fäden tappen. Solang diese durch den Schock gelähmt ist, labt es sich an ihr.
description.it: Tende trappole con fili elettrificati. Consuma poi con comodo le prede immobilizzate dalla scarica elettrica.
description.pt-BR: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description.ru: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description.ja: 電気を　帯びた　糸で　ワナを 仕掛ける。感電して　動けない　獲物を ゆっくりと　いただくのだ。

description.fr: Quand il sent un danger, il réagit en projetant toutes ses épines d’un coup et s’enfuit en roulant sur lui-même.
description.en: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description.es: Lanza numerosas púas al detectar peligro. En cuanto tiene ocasión, echa a rodar y se escapa.
description.de: Fühlt es sich bedroht, wehrt es sich, indem es eine großzügige Salve Dornen abfeuert.
description.it: Quando avverte un pericolo, reagisce sparando simultaneamente tutti i suoi aculei, per poi fuggire via rotolando.
description.pt-BR: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description.ru: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description.ja: 危険を　察知すると　トゲを いっせいに　発射して　反撃。 その　すきに　転がって　逃げる。

description.fr: Il combat avec ses trois tentacules épineux. Un coup de ses épines d’acier peut briser en deux de gros rochers.
description.en: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description.es: Azota al enemigo con sus tres tentáculos y después dispara púas hasta que no deja ni rastro del rival.
description.de: Es macht mit Gegnern kurzen Prozess, indem es mit seinen drei Schlingen auf sie eindrischt und Dornen auf sie abfeuert.
description.it: Fa a pezzi il nemico colpendolo prima con le sue tre antenne e poi sparandogli addosso i suoi aculei.
description.pt-BR: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description.ru: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description.ja: ３本の　触手を　たたきつけ さらに　トゲを　飛ばして　相手を 跡形残らず　粉砕する。

description.fr: La compatibilité entre ses deux rouages est prédéterminée. Ceux-ci ne se fixeront à aucun autre.
description.en: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description.es: Genera la energía vital que necesita haciendo girar sus dos cuerpos.
description.de: Es gewinnt lebenswichtige Energie, indem es seine zwei Einzelteile ineinander verzahnt und rotieren lässt.
description.it: Produce l’energia che gli serve per vivere incastrando e facendo ruotare le due parti che lo compongono.
description.pt-BR: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description.ru: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description.ja: ２つの　体が　かみ合い 回転することで　生きるための エネルギーを　作り出している。

description.fr: Ils communiquent entre eux en changeant leur sens de rotation. Plus ils sont en colère, plus ils tournent vite.
description.en: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description.es: Muestra sus sentimientos cambiando la dirección de su giro. Cuanto más se enfade, más rápido girará.
description.de: Teilt Artgenossen seine Gefühlslage mit, indem es die Umlaufrichtung ändert. Wenn es wütend ist, dreht es sich schneller.
description.it: Comunicano il loro stato d’animo cambiando senso di rotazione. Più si arrabbiano, più girano velocemente.
description.pt-BR: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description.ru: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description.ja: 回転方向を　変える　ことで 仲間に　気持ちを　伝えている。 怒るほど　回転が　速くなる。

description.fr: Son noyau rouge lui permet d’accumuler de l’énergie qu’il projette ensuite aux alentours grâce à ses pics.
description.en: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description.es: Recarga su energía rápidamente haciendo girar con gran celeridad el engranaje equipado con un núcleo rojo.
description.de: Indem es das Rad mit dem roten Zentrum mit hohem Tempo zum Rotieren bringt, kann es eine Turboladung durchführen.
description.it: Facendo girare velocemente l’ingranaggio dotato del nucleo rosso, accumula una grande quantità di energia.
description.pt-BR: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description.ru: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
description.ja: 赤い　コアの　ついた　ギアを 高速回転させて　エネルギーを 急速チャージ　するのだ。

description.fr: Tout seuls, ils ne dégagent pas beaucoup d’électricité, mais un banc d’Anchwatt produit la même puissance qu’un éclair.
description.en: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description.es: La electricidad de uno solo es diminuta, pero, si multitud de Tynamo se conectan, consiguen la potencia de un rayo.
description.de: Allein erzeugt es nur wenig Strom, doch tritt es geschlossen im Schwarm auf, gleicht seine Kraft der eines Blitzes.
description.it: La carica elettrica di un Tynamo è debole, ma se più esemplari si uniscono raggiungono la potenza di un fulmine.
description.pt-BR: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description.ru: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description.ja: １匹の　電力は　小さいが たくさんの　シビシラスが　つながると 雷と　同じ　威力になる。

description.fr: Ses taches rondes émettent de l’électricité. Il s’enroule autour de ses proies et les électrocute.
description.en: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description.es: Se enrolla alrededor de su presa, la paraliza con la electricidad de sus marcas circulares y le asesta mordiscos.
description.de: Schlingt sich um Gegner, lähmt sie über die rund gemaserten Flächen an seinem Körper mit Strom und beißt beherzt zu.
description.it: Si avvinghia alla preda e la paralizza rilasciando elettricità dalle macchie tonde, poi la ingoia intera.
description.pt-BR: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description.ru: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description.ja: 相手に　巻きつき　まるい はん点から　電気を　流して しびれたところを　まるかじりする。

description.fr: Il peut sortir de l’eau à la force de ses bras pour attraper des proies sur la rive. Il retourne à l’eau en un instant.
description.en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description.es: Pega la ventosa de su boca en su presa y la electrocuta con sus colmillos.
description.de: Mit dem Saugnapf an seinem Maul hakt es sich an seiner Beute fest und versetzt ihr über seine Fangzähne Stromschläge.
description.it: Si attacca alla preda con la bocca a ventosa e la fulmina attraverso i denti conficcati.
description.pt-BR: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description.ru: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description.ja: 吸盤の　口で　獲物に　吸いつき 食いこませた　キバから 電気を　流して　感電させる。

description.fr: Avec son puissant pouvoir psychique, il peut compresser le cerveau de ses ennemis et déclencher des migraines.
description.en: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description.es: Posee un gran poder psíquico. Lo usa para comprimir el cerebro del enemigo y ocasionarle dolores de cabeza.
description.de: Es verfügt über mächtige Psycho-Kräfte, mit denen es die Hirne seiner Gegner verwirrt, um ihnen Kopfweh zu bereiten.
description.it: Con i suoi incredibili poteri psichici comprime il cervello dei suoi nemici provocando loro fortissime emicranie.
description.pt-BR: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description.ru: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description.ja: 強力な　サイコパワーを　操る。 サイコパワーで　相手の　脳みそを 絞めつけて　頭痛を　起こさせる。

description.fr: Il peut manipuler les souvenirs de ses ennemis et fait clignoter ses doigts tricolores pour discuter avec ses amis.
description.en: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description.es: Parece que se comunica haciendo brillar sus dedos tricolores, pero nadie ha conseguido descifrar aún su patrón.
description.de: Es spricht, indem es seine Fingerspitzen leuchten lässt, doch noch konnte der Code dahinter nicht entziffert werden.
description.it: Dialoga con i suoi simili tramite le luci sui suoi arti, ma il suo linguaggio è ancora un mistero.
description.pt-BR: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description.ru: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description.ja: 指先を　点滅　させて 会話するらしいが　その　パターンは まだ　解読　できていない。

description.fr: Sa flamme brûle en consumant l’énergie vitale des gens et des Pokémon.
description.en: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description.es: Finge ser una luz guía en el camino, pero en realidad solo quiere absorber la energía vital de quien lo sigue.
description.de: Es entzündet ein Licht und gibt vor, dem Gegner den Weg zu weisen, doch eigentlich saugt es ihm seine Lebensenergie ab.
description.it: Mentre fa luce col pretesto di fare loro da guida, assorbe energia vitale dalle sue prede.
description.pt-BR: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description.ru: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description.ja: 明かりを　灯して　道案内を するように　見せかけながら 生命力を　吸い取っている。

description.fr: Un Pokémon craint pour être de mauvais augure. Il erre dans les villes à la recherche d’âmes de défunts.
description.en: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
description.es: Al absorber almas, su llama se enciende. Espera a que la gente fallezca, así que suele deambular por los hospitales.
description.de: Es nährt seine Flamme mit den Seelen seiner Opfer. Heutzutage irrt es auf der Suche nach Seelen durch Krankenhäuser.
description.it: La sua fiamma si accende quando risucchia gli spettri. Si trova spesso nei pressi dei cimiteri, dove questi abbondano.
description.pt-BR: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
