description.ru: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
description.ja: 魂を　吸いとり　火を灯す。 人が　死ぬのを　待つため 病院を　うろつくようになった。

description.fr: Il brûle en aspirant les âmes, et hypnotise ses ennemis en faisant osciller les flammes de ses bras.
description.en: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description.es: Sus llamas absorben el alma del enemigo y la abrasan, dejando solo su cuerpo inerte.
description.de: Es saugt die Seele eines jeden auf, der in seinen Feuerkranz gerät, bis nur noch eine leere Hülle von ihm übrig ist.
description.it: Le fiamme di Chandelure risucchiano lo spirito e lasciano il corpo come un guscio vuoto.
description.pt-BR: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description.ru: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description.ja: シャンデラの　炎に　包まれると 魂が　吸い取られ　燃やされる。 抜け殻の　体　だけが　残る。

description.fr: Il broie les Baies à grands coups de crocs. Ceux-ci repoussent plusieurs fois, toujours plus forts et aiguisés.
description.en: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description.es: Usa sus colmillos para romper las bayas que come. Estos se regeneran una y otra vez, por eso son tan fuertes y afilados.
description.de: Es knackt mit seinen Hauern Nüsse. Brechen seine Fangzähne ab, wächst an ihrer Stelle ein stärkeres Ersatzpaar.
description.it: Mangia le bacche sminuzzandole con i denti, che ricrescono costantemente, diventando sempre più forti e affilati.
description.pt-BR: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description.ru: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description.ja: 木の実を　キバで　砕いて　食べる。 何回も　生え変わることで 強く　鋭い　キバに　なる。

description.fr: Comme ses crocs brisés ne repoussent pas, il les aiguise après le combat grâce à une pierre ramassée près d’un fleuve.
description.en: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
description.es: Sus colmillos pueden hacer añicos rocas inmensas. Las luchas territoriales de los Fraxure son encarnizadas.
description.de: Mit seinen Fängen kriegt es sogar Felsen klein. Gegen Artgenossen, die sein Revier passieren, geht es besonders hart vor.
description.it: Ha zanne in grado di frantumare rocce. Le lotte per il territorio tra i Fraxure sono furibonde.
description.pt-BR: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
description.ru: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
description.ja: 大岩を　砕く　キバを　持つ。 縄張りを　巡る　オノンドたちの 争いは　非常に　激しい。

description.fr: Il est doux, mais ne pardonne pas à ceux qui viennent saccager son territoire. Ses crocs peuvent découper de l’acier.
description.en: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description.es: Es gentil, pero no perdona a todo el que ose invadir su territorio. Su mayor baza son sus colmillos, que cortan el acero.
description.de: Hat eine eher sanfte Natur, doch bei Eindringlingen kennt es keine Gnade. Seine Stoßzähne durchbohren sogar Eisen.
description.it: Ha un carattere gentile, ma non perdona chi devasta il suo territorio. Le sue zanne possono tagliare l’acciaio.
description.pt-BR: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description.ru: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description.ja: 優しい　性格だが　縄張りを　荒らす 者には　容赦しない。 鉄を　切る　キバで　挑みかかる。

description.fr: Quand il est malade, sa goutte au nez dégèle et ses capacités de type Glace deviennent moins efficaces.
description.en: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
description.es: Siempre está con mucosidades colgando. Las aspira para hacer un movimiento, ya que son su materia prima para esto.
description.de: Der Schleim, der stets aus seiner Nase hängt, treibt seine Attacken an. Zieht es ihn hoch, steht ein Angriff bevor.
description.it: Ha sempre il naso gocciolante e se ne serve per lanciare le sue mosse. Il muco è l’origine della sua forza.
description.pt-BR: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
description.ru: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
description.ja: いつも　鼻水を　垂らしている。 鼻水を　すすって　技を　出す。 鼻水が　技の　素　なのだ。

description.fr: Il fait lui-même geler son haleine. Il est bon nageur et sillonne les mers du nord à la recherche de ses proies.
description.en: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
description.es: Adoran los mares gélidos del norte. Congelan su aliento para crear sendas por las que caminar sobre las aguas.
description.de: Es liebt die kalten Meere im Norden und überquert ihre Flächen auf Stegen, die es mit seinem gefrorenen Atem baut.
description.it: Predilige i freddi mari del nord. Crea strade di ghiaccio soffiando con il suo alito gelido sulla superficie del mare.
description.pt-BR: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
description.ru: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
description.ja: 北の　冷たい　海を　好む。 口から　吐きだした　息を凍らせ 海の上に　道をつくり　歩く。

description.fr: Si sa température monte, il se dissipe en vapeur d’eau et disparaît. Quand elle diminue, il redevient de glace.
description.en: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
description.es: Nació entre nubes de nieve. Atrapa a sus presas con una cadena hecha de hielo cristalizado.
description.de: Es fängt seine Beute mit Ketten, die sich aus Eiskristallen zusammensetzen. Entstanden ist es aus einer Schneewolke.
description.it: È nato nelle nuvole cariche di neve. Cattura le prede con una catena fatta di cristalli di ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
description.ru: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
description.ja: 雪雲の　中で　生まれた。 氷の　結晶で　できた　鎖で 獲物を　捕まえる。

description.fr: Quand on l’attaque, il referme sa visière pour se défendre, et projette un poison visqueux.
description.en: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
description.es: Si está junto a Karrablast, y ambos reciben una descarga eléctrica, evolucionan los dos a la vez.
description.de: Hält sich ein Laukaps in seiner Nähe auf und kommen beide mit Strom in Berührung, entwickeln sie sich.
description.it: Quando incontra Karrablast si crea della corrente elettrica che stimola entrambi i Pokémon causandone l’evoluzione.
description.pt-BR: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
description.ru: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
description.ja: カブルモと　一緒に　いるときに 電気的な　刺激を　受けると お互いの　体が　進化する。

description.fr: Quand son corps s’assèche, il faiblit. Il s’en prémunit en s’enroulant dans plusieurs couches d’une fine muqueuse.
description.en: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description.es: Se siente ligero una vez liberado de su caparazón. Lucha y se mueve como un ninja.
description.de: Seit es die schwere Muschel abgestreift hat, ist es viel leichter. Nun gleichen seine Kampfbewegungen denen eines Ninja.
description.it: Liberatosi della pesante conchiglia, è diventato leggero. Lotta con le movenze proprie di un ninja.
description.pt-BR: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description.ru: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description.ja: 重い　殻を　脱いだために 身軽になった。まるで　忍者のような 身のこなしで　戦う。

description.fr: Sa peau est si dure qu’il peut se faire piétiner par un sumo sans rien sentir. Il sourit en émettant de l’électricité.
description.en: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description.es: Ni un pisotón de un luchador de sumo lo aplastaría gracias a su piel sólida. Sonríe al soltar descargas eléctricas.
description.de: Dank seiner dicken Haut hält es selbst das Gewicht eines Sumoringers aus. Wenn es Stromschläge verteilt, grinst es.
description.it: Ha la pelle così dura che un lottatore di sumo potrebbe calpestarlo senza fargli male. L’elettricità gli fa il solletico.
description.pt-BR: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description.ru: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description.ja: 皮膚が　硬いので 相撲取りに　踏まれても　平気。 電気を　流すとき　笑い顔に　なる。

description.fr: Il découpe ses ennemis avec ses griffes acérées et les terrasse avec ses enchaînements de coups hyper fluides.
description.en: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
description.es: La velocidad de sus ataques es su gran orgullo. Lo que le falta de fuerza bruta lo compensa en cantidad de golpes.
description.de: Schnelle Angriffe sind seine Spezialität. Es gleicht seine Schwächen mit der Vielfalt seines Attackenrepertoires aus.
description.it: Va fiero della rapidità delle sue mosse. Sopperisce a un’eventuale mancanza di potenza con il numero dei colpi.
description.pt-BR: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
description.ru: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
description.ja: 技を繰り出す　スピードが　自慢。 たとえ　パワーは　低くても 手数の　多さで　カバーする。

description.fr: Il se sert des poils de ses pattes antérieures comme de fouets. Ses coups ultrarapides sont invisibles à l’œil nu.
description.en: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
description.es: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a manera de látigos. Sus ataques alcanzan velocidades de vértigo.
description.de: Es benutzt das Fell an seinen Armen als Peitsche. Beide Arme bewegen sich dabei mit atemberaubender Geschwindigkeit.
description.it: Usa i peli degli arti come fruste. I suoi attacchi sono talmente rapidi da essere invisibili a occhio nudo.
description.pt-BR: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
description.ru: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
description.ja: 腕の　体毛を　ムチのように あつかう。両腕の　攻撃は 目にも　止まらぬ　速さ。

description.fr: Il utilise ses ailes pour emmagasiner la chaleur du soleil. Si la température de son corps baisse, il ne peut plus bouger.
description.en: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
description.es: Corre por estrechas cavernas y atrapa a sus presas con sus afiladas garras. La piel de la cara es más dura que una roca.
description.de: Es jagt durch enge Höhlengänge und spießt seine Gegner mit spitzen Klauen auf. Seine Kopfhaut ist fester als Stein.
description.it: Percorre le grotte anguste catturando le prede con gli artigli affilati. La pelle del muso è più dura della roccia.
description.pt-BR: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
description.ru: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
description.ja: 狭い　洞穴を　走り回り 獲物を　鋭い　ツメで　捕獲。 顔の　皮膚は　岩より　硬い。

description.fr: Il se meut grâce à l’énergie stockée dans son corps. Personne ne sait d’où vient cette énergie mystérieuse.
description.en: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
description.es: Se mueve gracias a la energía que quema dentro de su cuerpo, pero el origen de esta energía es incierto.
description.de: Es wird durch eine Energie angetrieben, die seinem Körper entspringt. Keiner weiß jedoch, woher diese Energie stammt.
description.it: Si muove grazie all’energia che gli brucia dentro, ma nessuno sa di che tipo di energia si tratti.
description.pt-BR: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
description.ru: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
description.ja: 体内で　燃える　エネルギーに　よって 活動しているが　どんな エネルギーなのかは　不明である。

description.fr: Il vole à la vitesse du son. Si le sceau sur sa poitrine est retiré, il perd tout contrôle de lui-même.
description.en: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
description.es: Al parecer, aquel que antaño lo creó le ordenó proteger a los Pokémon y a los humanos.
description.de: Man munkelt, sein Schöpfer habe ihm aufgetragen, schützend über Pokémon und Menschen zu wachen.
description.it: Si narra che gli antichi costruttori dei Golurk avessero ordinato loro di proteggere gli uomini e i Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
description.ru: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
description.ja: ゴルーグを　作った　古代人から 人や　ポケモンを　守るように 命令されていると　言われている。

description.fr: Tout son corps est fait de lames. Si une lame s’émousse, il va l’aiguiser contre une pierre au bord d’une rivière.
description.en: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
description.es: Su cuerpo está provisto de hojas afiladas. Cuando se desgastan, las afila con cantos rodados a la orilla del río.
description.de: Sein Körper ist mit Klingen übersät, die es an Felsen eines Flussbettes schärft, wenn sie im Kampf schartig werden.
description.it: Il suo intero corpo è un’arma da taglio. Se le lame si smussano lottando, le affila con pietre di fiume.
description.pt-BR: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
description.ru: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
description.ja: 全身が　刃物の　ポケモン。 戦いで　刃こぼれすると 河原の　石で　刃を　とぐ。

description.fr: Ils dirigent les groupes de Scalpion. Ils se battent pour la suprématie sur le groupe, et les perdants en sont exclus.
description.en: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
description.es: Un Pokémon temible que remata a su presa una vez que su séquito de Pawniard la ha debilitado e inmovilizado.
description.de: Ein kaltblütiges Pokémon, das Gegner zunächst mit einer Schar von Gladiantri lähmt und dann zweiteilt.
description.it: È molto crudele. Lascia che un gruppo di Pawniard attacchi la preda e, quando è ferita e non può più muoversi, la finisce.
description.pt-BR: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
description.ru: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
description.ja: 数匹の　コマタナを　戦わせ 傷つき　動けなくなった　獲物を 真っ二つにする　怖い　ポケモン。

description.fr: Son pelage fourni absorbe les chocs et lui permet d’asséner sans broncher le plus violent des coups de tête.
description.en: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
description.es: Embiste con la cabeza sin distinción. Su potencia es capaz de hacer descarrilar un tren en marcha.
description.de: Rammt seine Gegner ohne Rücksicht auf Verluste mit dem Kopf und vermag damit sogar Züge zum Entgleisen zu bringen.
description.it: Sferra testate contro tutto e tutti. Ha una forza distruttiva tale da far deragliare un treno in corsa.
description.pt-BR: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
description.ru: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
description.ja: 見境なく　突進して　頭突きを 食らわせる。走っている　列車を 脱線させる　破壊力。

description.fr: Il casse les Baies avec ses serres. Il combat courageusement, quelle que soit la force de l’adversaire.
description.en: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
description.es: Quiebra bayas con sus extremidades. Se enfrenta con valentía a todo enemigo por fuerte que este sea.
description.de: Kann mit seinen Füßen Nüsse zermalmen. Es stellt sich jedem noch so starken Gegner tapfer zum Kampf.
description.it: Si serve degli arti come schiaccianoci per rompere le bacche. Affronta con valore anche i nemici più forti.
description.pt-BR: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
description.ru: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
description.ja: 脚力で　木の実を　砕く。 どんなに　強い　相手でも 勇敢に　立ち向かう　習性。

description.fr: Pour les siens, il combat au mépris du danger. Il est capable de soulever une voiture haut dans le ciel.
description.en: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
description.es: Un valiente guerrero del cielo que no duda en luchar por sus compañeros por graves que sean sus heridas.
description.de: Ein tapferer Krieger der Lüfte, der zum Schutz seiner Kameraden auch mit Verletzungen immer weiterkämpft.
description.it: È l’intrepido guerriero del cielo. Per difendere i suoi simili, lotta fino all’ultimo senza badare alle ferite.
description.pt-BR: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
description.ru: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
description.ja: 仲間の　ためなら　どれだけ 傷つこうとも　戦いを　やめない 勇敢な　大空の　戦士。

description.fr: Ses ailes sont trop petites pour lui permettre de voler. Quand l’évolution approche, il sort lui-même de sa coquille.
description.en: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
description.es: No puede volar porque sus alas son muy pequeñas. Cuando va a evolucionar, se deshace de su calavera.
description.de: Seine Flügel sind noch zu klein zum Fliegen. Kurz bevor es sich entwickelt, wirft es seine Schädelwindel ab.
description.it: Le piccole ali non gli consentono di volare. Quando si avvicina il momento di evolversi, si libera del teschio.
description.pt-BR: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
description.ru: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
description.ja: 翼が　小さいため　飛べない。 進化の　ときが　近づくと 自分から　ガイコツを　脱ぎ捨てる。

description.fr: Il construit des nids en os. Il attrape les proies affaiblies avec ses serres et les transporte allègrement au nid.
description.en: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
description.es: Vuela en círculos. Cuando avista una presa, la ataca y la transporta a su nido con suma facilidad.
description.de: Es kreist am Himmel, bis es seine Beute findet. Nach erfolgtem Angriff trägt es sie mühelos zu seinem Nest.
description.it: Vola in cerchio nel cielo e quando scorge una preda le si lancia contro in picchiata per trasportarla al suo nido.
description.pt-BR: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
description.ru: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
description.ja: 大空で　円を描きつつ　飛び 獲物を　みつけると　襲いかかって 巣まで　軽々と　運んでいく。

description.fr: Il aspire de l’air par la queue et entretient un brasier dans son corps. C’est le prédateur des Fermite.
description.en: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
description.es: Usa su lengua de fuego para derretir la armadura de acero de los Durant y llegar así hasta su interior.
description.de: Mit seiner brandheißen Zunge bringt es Fermicula zum Schmelzen, um so an sein weiches Inneres zu gelangen.
description.it: Con la sua lingua infuocata scioglie la corazza d’acciaio di Durant e ne consuma l’interno.
description.pt-BR: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
description.ru: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
description.ja: 高温で　燃える　炎の　舌で アイアントの　鋼の　体を　溶かして 中身を　いただくのだ。

description.fr: Ils portent une armure de fer et se regroupent pour contrer les attaques de leurs prédateurs, les Aflamanoir.
description.en: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
description.es: Actúan en grupo para expulsar de sus colonias a los Heatmor, sus depredadores naturales.
description.de: Eine ausgeklügelte Rollenverteilung hilft ihnen dabei, ihren natürlichen Feind Furnifraß aus dem Nest zu verjagen.
description.it: Heatmor è il loro acerrimo nemico, e quando vogliono cacciarlo dalla tana si dividono i compiti e partono all’attacco!
description.pt-BR: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
description.ru: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
description.ja: 天敵の　クイタランに　対して みんなで　役割分担　しながら 反撃して　巣から　追い払う。

description.fr: Il mord tout ce qui bouge, et mange tout ce qu’il trouve. Il vaut mieux éviter de s’en approcher.
description.en: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
description.es: No ve, por eso va haciendo placajes y dando mordiscos a diestro y siniestro. Su cuerpo está plagado de heridas.
description.de: Da es nichts sehen kann, sucht es seine Umgebung mit Rempel- und Bissattacken ab und ist immer mit Wunden übersät.
description.it: Dal momento che non ci vede, esamina ciò che lo circonda mordendo o lanciandosi di peso. Ha ammaccature su tutto il corpo.
description.pt-BR: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
description.ru: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
description.ja: 目が　見えないため　体当たりしたり かみついて　まわりを　探る。 体中　生傷が　絶えない。

description.fr: Quand il a mangé tout ce qui traînait sur son territoire, il migre vers d’autres horizons. Ses 2 têtes s’entendent mal.
description.en: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
description.es: Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal, y la que consigue comer más que la otra es la que lleva la voz cantante.
description.de: Seine zwei Köpfe sind sich spinnefeind. Beide versuchen, über Fresswettbewerbe die Oberhand zu gewinnen.
description.it: Le due teste non vanno d’accordo e si contendono la posizione di comando in base a quale mangia di più.
description.pt-BR: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
description.ru: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
description.ja: ２つの　頭は　仲が　悪く 相手より　多く　食べることで 主導権を　握ろうと　する。

description.fr: Un Pokémon violent qui patrouille le ciel avec ses six ailes et se jette sur tout ce qui bouge, pensant voir un ennemi.
description.en: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
description.es: Las cabezas de sus dos brazos no tienen cerebro. Con sus tres cabezas destruye y devora todo a su paso.
description.de: Die Köpfe an seinen beiden Armen haben kein eigenes Gehirn. Seine drei Mäuler kauen alles radikal kurz und klein.
description.it: Le teste che ha sugli arti non hanno cervello. Distrugge e divora qualsiasi cosa usando tutte e tre le teste.
description.pt-BR: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
description.ru: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
description.ja: 両腕の　頭は　脳みそを　持たない。 ３つの　頭で　すべてを　食べつくし 破壊してしまう。

description.fr: On dit que ce Pokémon serait né du soleil. Lorsqu’il évolue, tout son corps est enveloppé de flammes.
description.en: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
description.es: Se dice que nació del sol. Al evolucionar, cubre su cuerpo con llamas que brotan de sus cuernos.
description.de: Es heißt, es sei ein Produkt der Sonne. Wenn es sich entwickelt, hüllt es sich in Flammen, die es aus seinen Hörnern bläst.
description.it: Si dice che sia nato dal sole. Prima di evolversi, avvolge tutto il suo corpo nelle fiamme emesse dai corni.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
description.ru: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
description.ja: 太陽から　生まれたと　いわれる。 進化するとき　ツノから　噴き出した 炎で　全身を　包みこむ。

description.fr: On dit que quand le ciel s’est obscurci à cause des cendres d’un volcan, le feu d’un Pyrax aurait remplacé le soleil.
description.en: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
description.es: Cuando combate, despide escamas ardientes de sus seis alas y genera un mar ígneo a su alrededor.
description.de: Schüttelt sich glühenden Staub aus seinen sechs Flügeln und verwandelt das Umfeld in ein einziges Meer aus Flammen.
description.it: Quando lotta, sparge scaglie infuocate dalle sue sei ali, creando tutto intorno un mare di fuoco.
description.pt-BR: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
description.ru: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
description.ja: 戦いになると　６枚の　羽から 火の粉の　りんぷんを　まき散らして あたり　一面を　火の海にする。

description.fr: Un Pokémon légendaire qui a combattu les humains pour protéger les Pokémon. Il est d’un naturel calme et posé.
description.en: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
description.es: Posee un cuerpo y un corazón de acero. Basta una mirada suya para que Pokémon violentos le obedezcan.
description.de: Sein Körper und sein Herz sind aus Stahl. Ein böser Blick genügt und selbst die wildesten Pokémon unterwerfen sich ihm.
description.it: Ha un corpo e uno spirito d’acciaio. Gli basta lo sguardo per farsi ubbidire anche dai Pokémon più feroci.
description.pt-BR: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
description.ru: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
description.ja: 鋼の　体と　心を　持つ。 にらみつけるだけで　凶暴な ポケモンも　従わせてしまう。

description.fr: Il a combattu les humains pour protéger les Pokémon ayant perdu leur foyer à cause de leurs guerres fratricides.
description.en: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
description.es: Su potencia al embestir es capaz de derribar las murallas de un castillo. Las leyendas hablan de sus proezas.
description.de: Seine Angriffskraft genügt, um selbst mächtige Wälle niederzureißen. Ein Held zahlreicher Legenden.
description.it: Quando carica, ha una forza tale da sfondare un’enorme muraglia. Si racconta di lui nelle leggende.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
description.ru: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
description.ja: 巨大な　城壁を 一撃で　突破するほどの　突進力。 伝説で　語られる　ポケモン。

description.fr: Il a défié les humains pour protéger les siens. Son nom est resté dans la légende.
description.en: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
description.es: Sus cuernos son hojas afiladas. Sacude a sus enemigos con sus relampagueantes movimientos y los reduce.
description.de: Das Horn an seinem Kopf ist eine scharfe Klinge. Neckt seine Gegner mit quirligen Bewegungen und greift blitzartig an.
description.it: Le corna della testa sono lame affilate. Muovendosi come un turbine, scuote e falcia fulmineo i nemici.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
description.ru: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
description.ja: 頭の　ツノは　鋭い　刃。 旋風のような　動きで　敵を 翻弄して　素早く　切りつける。

description.fr: Le bas de son corps est entouré d’une masse d’énergie semblable à un nuage. Il vole dans le ciel à 300 km/h.
description.en: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
description.es: La parte inferior de su cuerpo, similar a una nube, está recubierta de un campo de energía. Vuela a 300 km/h.
description.de: Sein Unterkörper ist in eine wolkenartige Energieschicht gehüllt. Es jagt mit bis zu 300 km/h durch die Lüfte.
description.it: Ha la parte inferiore del corpo avvolta in una nuvola di energia. Sfreccia nei cieli a 300 km/h.
description.pt-BR: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
description.ru: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
description.ja: 雲のような　エネルギー体に 下半身が　包まれている。 時速３００キロで　空を　飛ぶ。

description.fr: Les terres qu’il a survolées sont recouvertes d’innombrables traces des éclairs qu’il y a fait tomber.
description.en: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
description.es: Lanza descargas eléctricas por las púas de su cola. Sobrevuela Teselia dejando caer rayos.
description.de: Es greift mit elektrischer Ladung aus den Dornen seiner Rute an und bombardiert Einall aus der Luft mit Blitzen.
description.it: Lancia scariche elettriche dagli aculei della coda. Vola per i cieli di Unima scagliando fulmini.
description.pt-BR: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
description.ru: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
description.ja: 尻尾の　トゲから　電撃を 撃ち出す。イッシュ地方の　空を 飛び回り　雷を　落とす。

description.fr: Un Pokémon mythique. Il projette de sa queue un tourbillon de flammes capable de tout emporter.
description.en: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
description.es: Pokémon legendario capaz de abrasar el mundo con sus llamas. Ayuda a quienes persiguen un mundo veraz.
description.de: Ein Legendäres Pokémon mit der Macht, die Welt mit seinen Flammen einzuäschern. Hilft allen, die nach Wirklichkeit streben.
description.it: Questo Pokémon leggendario può rendere il mondo un inferno di fiamme. Aiuta chi vuole costruire un mondo di verità.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
description.ru: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
description.ja: 炎で　世界を　燃やしつくせる 伝説の　ポケモン。真実の 世界を　築く　人を　助ける。

description.fr: Sa queue produit de l’électricité. Il dissimule son corps dans un nuage électrique et plane dans le ciel d’Unys.
description.en: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
description.es: Pokémon legendario capaz de chamuscar el mundo con sus rayos. Ayuda a quienes persiguen un mundo de ideales.
description.de: Ein Legendäres Pokémon mit der Macht, die Welt durch Donner einzuäschern. Hilft allen, die einer Welt der Wünsche harren.
description.it: Questo Pokémon leggendario può riempire il mondo di fulmini e saette. Aiuta chi vuole costruire un mondo ideale.
description.pt-BR: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
description.ru: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
description.ja: 稲妻で　世界を　焼きつくせる 伝説の　ポケモン。理想の 世界を　つくる　人を　補佐する。

description.fr: Il fait fructifier les cultures partout où il passe, c’est pourquoi on l’appelle “le dieu des moissons”.
description.en: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
description.es: Lo consideran una deidad de las cosechas porque los cultivos crecen en abundancia en las tierras por las que pasa.
description.de: Da an Orten, wo es sich blicken lässt, mit reicher Ernte zu rechnen ist, nennt man es auch den „Herrn des Ackerbaus“.
description.it: Poiché le terre che visita producono abbondanti raccolti, è considerato una benedizione per i campi.
description.pt-BR: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
description.ru: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
description.ja: ランドロスが　訪れる　土地は 作物が　たくさん　実るため 畑の神様　と　言われている。

description.fr: Son corps produit une énergie à très basse température, mais le souffle glacé qu’il exhale l’a gelé lui-même.
description.en: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
description.es: Pokémon legendario que aguarda al héroe que compense el vacío de su cuerpo de hielo con verdad e ideales.
description.de: Ein Legendäres Eis-Pokémon, das auf den Helden wartet, der seinen verstümmelten Körper mit Wunsch und Wirklichkeit heilt.
description.it: Questo leggendario Pokémon dei ghiacci attende l’eroe che gli restituirà le sue vere sembianze con gli ideali o la verità.
description.pt-BR: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
description.ru: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
description.ja: 失った　体を　真実と 理想で　埋めてくれる　英雄を 待つ　氷の　伝説ポケモン。

description.fr: Il projette de l’eau depuis ses sabots et se déplace ainsi à grande vitesse. Sa botte secrète est le coup de sabot.
description.en: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
description.es: Corre por mares, ríos o cualquier superficie acuática de todo el mundo. Aparece en aguas límpidas.
description.de: Es kann auf dem Wasser laufen und reist auf Flüssen und Meeren um die Welt. Zu sehen in malerischen Küstengebieten.
description.it: Scorrazza per il mondo muovendosi sulla superficie dei mari o dei fiumi. Appare nei lidi più ameni.
description.pt-BR: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
description.ru: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
description.ja: 海や　川など　水面を　走り 世界中を　駆け巡る。 美しい　水辺に　現れる。

description.fr: Sa voix si particulière lui permet de chanter des mélodies qui ensorcellent les gens et modifient leurs émotions.
description.en: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
description.es: Las melodías que canta Meloetta tienen el poder de hacer sentir felicidad a los Pokémon que hay a su alrededor.
description.de: Es besitzt die Macht, Pokémon, die sich in seiner Nähe aufhalten, mit seinen Melodien froh oder traurig zu stimmen.
description.it: Canta una melodia che ha il potere di portare la gioia o la tristezza nel cuore dei Pokémon che l’ascoltano.
description.pt-BR: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
description.ru: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
description.ja: メロエッタの　奏でる　旋律は まわりの　ポケモンを　喜ばせたり 悲しませるほどの　パワーがある。

description.fr: Il y a 300 millions d’années, il était craint comme l’ultime prédateur. Il a été modifié par la Team Plasma.
description.en: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
description.es: Pokémon de tipo Bicho de la antigüedad, modificado por el Equipo Plasma. El cañón de su lomo ha sido mejorado.
description.de: Ein von Team Plasma modifiziertes Käfer-Pokémon aus dem Altertum. Die Kanone auf seinem Rücken ist nun noch stärker.
description.it: Antico Pokémon Coleottero modificato dal Team Plasma, che ne ha notevolmente potenziato il cannone sulla schiena.
description.pt-BR: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
description.ru: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
description.ja: プラズマ団によって　改造された 古代の　むしポケモン。 背中の　大砲が　パワーアップした。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il rassemble ses forces, les piquants souples qui recouvrent sa tête deviennent si durs et acérés qu’ils pourraient transpercer un rocher.
description.en: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description.es: Cuando acumula energía, las suaves púas de su cabeza se vuelven tan duras y afiladas que hasta pueden atravesar rocas.
description.de: Wenn es seine Kraft auf die sonst eher weichen Stacheln auf seinem Kopf konzentriert, werden diese robust genug, um damit Steine zu zertrümmern.
description.it: Può indurire le punte che ha sulla testa, di solito morbide, per farle diventare talmente affilate e appuntite da penetrare nella roccia.
description.pt-BR: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description.ru: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description.ja: 普段　やわらかい　頭の　トゲは 力を　こめると　鋭く　とがり 岩をも　つらぬくほど　硬くなる。

description.fr: La carapace qui recouvre son corps le protège des attaques adverses, et ses piquants lui permettent de contre-attaquer.
description.en: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description.es: Desvía los ataques de los enemigos con la robusta coraza que cubre su cuerpo y contraataca con sus dos afilados cuernos.
description.de: Der Panzer, der seinen Körper umgibt, bietet ihm Schutz vor Angreifern und straft direkte Angriffe postwendend mit spitzen Stacheln ab.
description.it: Respinge gli attacchi dei nemici grazie al guscio che gli ricopre il corpo e contrattacca con gli aculei affilati.
description.pt-BR: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description.ru: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description.ja: 体を　覆う　頑丈な　殻が 敵の　攻撃を　弾き返し 鋭い　トゲで　反撃する。

description.fr: Il est si puissant qu’il pourrait renverser un char de 50 t d’un seul assaut. Il se sert de son corps comme d’un bouclier pour protéger ses alliés.
description.en: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description.es: Su fuerza es tal que, de un empellón, puede hacer volcar un tanque de 50 toneladas. Protege a sus aliados cuando hace de escudo.
description.de: Es ist so stark, dass es selbst 50 t schwere Panzer umkippen kann. Es schützt seine Artgenossen, indem es sich ihnen als Schild anbietet.
description.it: Attaccando può rovesciare un carro armato da 50 t. Protegge gli alleati facendo loro scudo con il proprio corpo.
description.pt-BR: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description.ru: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description.ja: 体当たりで　５０トンの　戦車を ひっくり返す　パワー。 自分が　盾となって　仲間を　守る。

description.fr: En cas de coup de fatigue, il grignote des rameaux pour recharger ses batteries. Ses oreilles dégagent une chaleur qui dépasse les 200 °C.
description.en: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: Tras masticar e ingerir pequeñas ramas se siente pletórico y expulsa aire caliente por sus grandes orejas a temperaturas superiores a los 200 ºC.
description.de: Wenn es Zweige frisst, fasst es neue Kraft und stößt über seine Ohren über 200 °C heiße Luft aus.
description.it: Fa il pieno di energia mangiando ramoscelli ed emette aria calda dalle grandi orecchie a una temperatura di oltre 200 °C.
description.pt-BR: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ru: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ja: 小枝を　食べると　元気になって 摂氏２００度を　超える　熱気を 大きな　耳から　噴き出す。

description.fr: Il allume la branche plantée dans sa queue en la frottant contre son pelage et s’en sert au combat.
description.en: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description.es: Tiene una rama enredada en la cola. Cuando la saca, la rama prende fuego al hacer fricción con su pelaje y se lanza al ataque con ella.
description.de: In seinem Schweif steckt ein Zweig, den es bei Bedarf mit der Reibungswärme seiner Schweifhaare anzündet und im Kampf einsetzt.
description.it: Incendia il ramo che ha infilato nella coda grazie allo sfregamento del pelo per poi lanciarsi nella lotta.
description.pt-BR: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description.ru: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description.ja: 木の枝を　尻尾に　挿している。 尻尾の　毛の　摩擦熱で 枝に　火をつけて　戦う。

description.fr: Peut prédire l’avenir s’il se concentre en fixant la flamme qui danse au bout de sa canne.
description.en: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description.es: Fija la mirada en la llama que arde en la punta de su bastón para concentrarse y prever sucesos que tienen lugar en el futuro.
description.de: Es kann die Zukunft vorhersehen, indem es konzentriert in die Flamme an der Spitze seines Zweiges blickt.
description.it: Fissando la fiamma del ramo che ha in mano, aumenta al massimo la concentrazione e può predire il futuro.
description.pt-BR: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description.ru: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description.ja: 杖の　先端で　燃える　炎を　見つめて 精神統一すると 未来の　出来事を　見通せる。

description.fr: Sa poitrine et son dos sécrètent une mousse qui lui permet de subir moins de dégâts en amortissant le choc des attaques.
description.en: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description.es: Secreta burbujas tanto por la espalda como por el pecho. Gracias a la elasticidad de estas, puede parar ataques y reducir el daño recibido.
description.de: Es stößt aus Brust und Rücken elastische Blasen aus, mit denen es gegnerische Angriffe abfängt und so den erlittenen Schaden verringert.
description.it: Dal petto e dalla schiena secerne una schiuma che gli permette di attutire i danni causati dagli attacchi nemici.
description.pt-BR: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description.ru: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description.ja: 胸と　背中から　泡を　出す。 弾力のある　泡で　攻撃を　受け止めて ダメージを　減らす。

description.fr: Il est capable de lancer des pierres recouvertes de mousse avec une précision suffisante pour toucher une canette vide à 30 m.
description.en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description.es: Puede lanzar piedras envueltas en burbujas con tal puntería, que acierta latas vacías a 30 metros de distancia.
description.de: Es kann kleine in Blasen gehüllte Steine mit solcher Präzision werfen, dass es selbst 30 m entfernte Dosen problemlos trifft.
description.it: Lancia dei sassi racchiusi in bolle di schiuma. È talmente preciso da riuscire a colpire una lattina vuota a 30 m di distanza.
description.pt-BR: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description.ru: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description.ja: 泡で　包んだ　小石を　投げる 技を　使う。３０メートル　先の 空き缶に　当てる　コントロール。

description.fr: Il transforme des jets d’eau sous pression en redoutables shuriken. Une fois lancés, ils tournent si vite qu’ils peuvent même couper le métal.
description.en: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description.es: Comprime el agua y crea estrellas ninja con las que ataca al enemigo. Cuando las hace girar a gran velocidad cortan en dos hasta el metal.
description.de: Es stellt Wurfsterne aus komprimiertem Wasser her, die durch ihre hohe Drehgeschwindigkeit beim Werfen sogar Metall durchtrennen.
description.it: Crea lame d’acqua micidiali che ruotano ad alta velocità e, se lanciate, possono perforare il metallo.
description.pt-BR: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description.ru: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description.ja: 水を　圧縮して　手裏剣を　作り出す。 高速回転させて　飛ばすと 金属も　真っ二つ。

description.fr: Ses larges oreilles lui permettent de creuser des terriers. Il est capable de forer sans s’arrêter pendant toute une nuit.
description.en: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description.es: Usa sus grandes orejas para excavar en la tierra y así crear madrigueras. Puede pasarse una noche entera cavando sin parar.
description.de: Mit seinen großen Ohren schaufelt es sich einen Bau. Es kann die ganze Nacht ohne Pause durchschaufeln.
description.it: Scava tane nel terreno grazie alle grandi orecchie. Può andare avanti senza fermarsi per tutta la notte.
description.pt-BR: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description.ru: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description.ja: 大きな　耳で　地面を　掘って 巣穴を　作る。 一晩中　休まずに　掘り続けられる。

description.fr: Ses grandes oreilles sont si musclées qu’il peut soulever un rocher d’une tonne sans broncher. Ce Pokémon est souvent utilisé sur les chantiers.
description.en: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description.es: Sus grandes orejas tienen tal fuerza que con ellas puede levantar con facilidad rocas de más de una tonelada. Es de una ayuda inestimable en las obras.
description.de: Seine großen Ohren besitzen die Kraft, selbst Felsen, die 1 t schwer sind, mühelos hochzuheben. Es wird daher oft auf Baustellen eingesetzt.
description.it: Con le sue grandi orecchie può sollevare facilmente massi da più di una tonnellata. Può essere di grande aiuto nei cantieri edili.
description.pt-BR: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description.ru: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description.ja: 大きな　耳は　１トンを　超える 岩を 楽に　持ち上げる　パワー。 工事現場で　大活躍する。

description.fr: Peu farouche, il communique avec ses congénères par un doux gazouillis et par des signaux de la queue.
description.en: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description.es: Es muy amigable y se comunica con sus aliados mediante melodiosos gorjeos y el movimiento de su cola y sus gráciles alas.
description.de: Ein sehr zutrauliches Pokémon. Durch Zwitschern und Bewegen der Schwanzfedern sendet es Signale an seine Gefährten.
description.it: Ha una natura amichevole. Comunica con i suoi simili tramite meravigliosi cinguettii e movimenti delle penne della coda.
description.pt-BR: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description.ru: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description.ja: 人懐っこい　性格。美しい　さえずりと 尾羽を　振る　動きで 仲間に　合図を　送る。

description.fr: Il crache des étincelles pour brûler les hautes herbes et attraper les proies surprises qui tentent d’échapper à l’incendie.
description.en: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description.es: Lanza chispas por su pico y prende fuego a la hierba alta para así sorprender a sus presas y atraparlas cuando intentan escapar.
description.de: Es speit Funken aus seinem Schnabel und fängt die Beute, die überrascht aus dem angesengten Gras hervorspringt.
description.it: Incendia i cespugli producendo scintille con il becco e cattura le prede che ne escono spaventate.
description.pt-BR: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description.ru: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description.ja: 火の粉を　クチバシから　飛ばして 草むらを　焦がし　驚いて 飛び出した　獲物を　捕まえる。

description.fr: Exalté par un combat sans merci, il s’envole en semant dans son sillage les escarbilles du feu qui couve dans son plumage.
description.en: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description.es: Si se exalta durante un combate reñido, arroja chispas y ascuas de los intersticios entre su plumaje mientras vuela.
description.de: Die Aufregung eines harten Kampfes veranlasst es dazu, im Flug Funken aus den Zwischenräumen seines Gefieders zu sprühen.
description.it: Durante lotte senza esclusione di colpi, spicca il volo sprizzando scintille dalle fessure che ha tra le piume.
description.pt-BR: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description.ru: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description.ja: 激しい　戦いで　興奮すると 全身の　羽毛の　すきまから 火の粉を　噴き出して　飛行する。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il est poursuivi par un Pokémon Oiseau, il projette une poudre noire qui paralyse tous ceux qu’elle touche.
description.en: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description.es: Cuando recibe el ataque de un Pokémon pájaro, expulsa unas escamas negras que provocan parálisis si se entra en contacto con ellas.
description.de: Wird es von einem fliegenden Pokémon angegriffen, verstreut es schwarzen Puder. Der giftige Puder löst bei Berührung Paralyse aus.
description.it: Se assalito da Pokémon uccello, si difende emettendo velenose scaglie nere che paralizzano al minimo contatto.
description.pt-BR: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description.ru: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description.ja: とりポケモンに　襲われると 黒い　粉を　まき散らす。 触れると　マヒする　毒の粉だ。

description.fr: Vit caché sous le couvert des buissons. Poursuivi par un ennemi, il tente de l’intimider en hérissant les poils qui lui couvrent le corps.
description.en: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description.es: Habita en la sombra de la espesura. Si percibe alguna amenaza, su pelaje se eriza y se vuelve muy afilado para así intimidar al enemigo.
description.de: Es lebt versteckt im schattigen Dickicht. Wird es von einem Feind angegriffen, stellt es sein Fell zur Abschreckung zu scharfen Spitzen auf.
description.it: Vive nascosto nella boscaglia. Se attaccato, minaccia i nemici rizzando il pelo.
description.pt-BR: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description.ru: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description.ja: しげみの　陰に　隠れて　暮らす。 敵に　襲われると　体の　毛を 鋭く　逆立てて　威嚇する。

description.fr: Les ailes des Prismillon arborent différents motifs en fonction de leur aire d’origine. Il est possible que le climat y soit pour quelque chose.
description.en: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description.es: En el mundo existen Vivillon con diferentes motivos en sus alas. El clima de cada región influye en sus rasgos.
description.de: Vivillon kommen weltweit mit den unterschiedlichsten Musterungen vor. Das Klima ihres Habitats hat Einfluss auf ihre Flügelmusterung.
description.it: Nel mondo ne esistono diverse varietà che si differenziano per i motivi sulle ali. Sembra che questi dipendano dal clima del loro habitat.
description.pt-BR: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description.ru: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description.ja: 世界には　さまざまな　羽模様の ビビヨンがいる。住んでいる　土地の 気候が　影響しているようだ。

description.fr: Plus l’adversaire auquel il est confronté est fort, plus la température de sa crinière augmente, l’énergie générée se diffusant alors dans tout son corps.
description.en: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description.es: Cuanto más poderoso es el enemigo al que se enfrenta, más calor desprende su mechón y más energía recorre todo su cuerpo.
description.de: Je stärker sein Gegner ist, desto heißer wird seine Mähne und umso kraftvoller wird es.
description.it: Più l’avversario che affronta è temibile, più la sua criniera si scalda, aumentandone la forza.
description.pt-BR: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description.ru: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description.ja: 強い　相手に　立ち向かうときほど たてがみが　高温になり 全身に　力が　みなぎるのだ。

description.fr: Le mâle qui possède la crinière de feu la plus imposante devient le chef de la horde.
description.en: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description.es: El macho con la melena de fuego más grande de toda la manada es el líder de sus compañeros.
description.de: Das Männchen mit der prächtigsten Feuermähne führt das Rudel an.
description.it: Di solito, il maschio con la criniera fiammeggiante più ampia guida i compagni del gruppo.
description.pt-BR: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description.ru: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description.ja: 群れの　中で　一番　大きな　炎の たてがみを　持つ　オスが リーダーとして　仲間を　率いる。

description.fr: Capable de libérer et de contrôler la force cachée des plantes. La fleur qu’il tient fait partie de lui.
description.en: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description.es: Puede controlar el poder oculto de las flores. La flor que lleva consigo es como si formara parte de su cuerpo.
description.de: Es entlockt Blumen ihre geheimen Kräfte und kontrolliert diese nach Belieben. Die Blume, die es trägt, ist wie ein Teil seines Körpers.
description.it: È in grado di controllare a piacimento la forza nascosta dei fiori. Il fiore a cui si aggrappa fa parte del suo stesso corpo.
description.pt-BR: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description.ru: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description.ja: 花の　秘めた　力を　引き出して 自在に　操る。フラベベが　持つ　花は もはや　体の　一部だ。

description.fr: Il survole les champs de fleurs, et prend soin de celles qui sont sur le point de faner. Au combat, il fait appel à leur force cachée.
description.en: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description.es: Revolotea alrededor de campos de flores y cuida de aquellas que empiezan a marchitarse. Usa en combate el poder oculto de las flores.
description.de: Es fliegt auf Wiesen umher und kümmert sich um welkende Blumen. Es setzt deren geheime Kräfte frei und nutzt diese zum Kämpfen.
description.it: Vola sui campi in fiore e si prende cura delle piante che si stanno seccando. Lotta sfruttando i poteri nascosti dei fiori.
description.pt-BR: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description.ru: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description.ja: 花畑を　飛び回り　枯れかけた　花を 世話する。花の　秘められた　力を 引き出して　戦う。

description.fr: Les jardins fleuris sont son territoire. Il se baigne dans l’énergie dégagée par les plantes en fleurs pour l’absorber.
description.en: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description.es: Habita en preciosos jardines floridos. Absorbe la energía que emiten las plantas y la convierte en su fuente de poder.
description.de: Wunderschöne Blumengärten sind sein Revier. Es badet in der von blühenden Blumen freigesetzten Energie und zieht daraus seine Kraft.
description.it: Il suo habitat preferito sono i meravigliosi giardini fioriti. Assorbe e utilizza l’energia di piante e fiori.
description.pt-BR: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description.ru: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description.ja: テリトリーは　見事な　花園。 草花の　放つ　エネルギーを　浴びて 自分の　パワーにするのだ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon paisible serait le premier à avoir jamais cohabité avec les humains.
description.en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description.es: Se dice que fue la primera especie de Pokémon que se acostumbró a vivir con los seres humanos. Tiene una naturaleza muy afable.
description.de: Man sagt, es sei eines der ersten Pokémon, die mit Menschen zusammengelebt haben. Es ist sehr ruhig und friedfertig.
description.it: Ha un carattere pacifico ed è considerato il primo Pokémon ad avere stretto amicizia con l’uomo.
description.pt-BR: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description.ru: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description.ja: 人と　暮らすようになった 最初の　ポケモンと　言われる。 穏やかな　性格の　ポケモン。

description.fr: Quand son Dresseur le tient par une corne, il est capable de deviner ses plus subtils changements d’humeur et de s’y adapter.
description.en: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description.es: Percibe los sentimientos del Entrenador por la forma en la que agarra sus cuernos, aunque sean variaciones sutiles, y así avanzan como si fueran un solo ente.
description.de: Es kann die Stimmung seines Trainers an der kleinsten Veränderung dessen Griffes um seine Hörner ablesen und galoppiert sofort los, wenn dieser es wünscht.
description.it: È in grado di intuire gli stati d’animo del suo Allenatore dal modo in cui questi gli afferra le corna. Questo permette a entrambi di correre in perfetta armonia.
description.pt-BR: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description.ru: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description.ja: ツノを　握る　わずかな　違いから トレーナーの　気持ちを　読み取るので 一体となって　走れるのだ。

description.fr: Il fait son possible pour intimider ses adversaires avec un regard menaçant, mais sans succès. Il a l’habitude de constamment mâcher une feuille.
description.en: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description.es: Se esfuerza mucho para que el enemigo no lo menosprecie, pero su mirada no intimida demasiado. Se caracteriza por mascar siempre una hoja.
description.de: Es starrt den Gegner finster an, um nicht unterschätzt zu werden, hat aber nur wenig Erfolg damit. Das Kauen auf einem Blatt ist sein Markenzeichen.
description.it: Fa di tutto per farsi prendere sul serio dai nemici, ma il suo sguardo di sfida non è molto efficace. Ha il vizio di masticare una foglia.
description.pt-BR: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description.ru: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description.ja: 敵に　なめられないよう　がんばって にらみつけるが　効果は　薄い。 くわえた　葉っぱが　トレードマーク。

description.fr: D’un tempérament fougueux, il ne supporte pas que l’on s’en prenne aux faibles. Sa feuille lui permet de deviner les actions de l’ennemi.
description.en: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description.es: Es muy temperamental, pero no permite que nadie se meta con los débiles. Mediante su hoja, predice los movimientos del enemigo.
description.de: Es ist sehr grob und streitlustig, lässt es aber nicht zu, dass Schwächere gemobbt werden. Mit seinem Blatt erspürt es die Bewegungen des Gegners.
description.it: Ha un carattere focoso e attaccabrighe, ma non sopporta chi maltratta i più deboli. Usa la foglia che tiene in bocca per prevedere i movimenti dei nemici.
description.pt-BR: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description.ru: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description.ja: 気性が　荒く　ケンカっ早いが 弱いものいじめは　許さない。 葉っぱで　敵の　動きを　読む。

description.fr: Si son abondante fourrure gagne à être toilettée, ce n’est pas qu’une question de style. En effet, cela lui permet également de se mouvoir plus librement.
description.en: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description.es: Cuando le esquilan su mullido pelaje, no solo mejora su apariencia, sino que aumenta su agilidad.
description.de: Schneidet man sein Fell zurecht, wird es nicht nur schöner, sondern auch beweglicher.
description.it: La toelettatura del manto vaporoso non solo lo rende più bello, ma gli consente anche di muoversi più liberamente.
description.pt-BR: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description.ru: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description.ja: ボサボサの　体毛を　刈りこむと 姿が　美しくなる　だけでなく 身体の　キレが　良くなるのだ。

description.fr: Il couvre la source de ses pouvoirs psychiques hors du commun avec ses oreilles afin d’éviter les accidents.
description.en: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description.es: Protege con las orejas el órgano con el que irradia su intenso poder psíquico para evitar que este se escape al exterior.
description.de: Damit die starken Psycho-Kräfte dieses Pokémon nicht unkontrolliert nach außen dringen, ist das Organ, das diese freisetzt, von seinen Ohren bedeckt.
description.it: Copre con le orecchie gli organi che presiedono ai suoi grandi poteri psichici per non perderne il controllo.
description.pt-BR: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description.ru: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description.ja: 強力な　サイコパワーが 漏れ出さないように　放出する　器官を 耳で　ふさいでいるのだ。

description.fr: S’il se sent menacé, il lève les oreilles et déchaîne un pouvoir psychique capable de réduire en miettes un camion de 10 t.
description.en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.es: Cuando percibe peligro, yergue sus orejas y desata un poder psíquico capaz de levantar un camión de unas 10 toneladas.
description.de: In Gefahrensituationen hebt es seine Ohren an und setzt Psycho-Kräfte frei, die einen 10 t schweren LKW zu Schrott verarbeiten können.
description.it: Se si sente minacciato, drizza le orecchie e libera un potere psichico devastante, in grado di accartocciare un camion da 10 t come se fosse una lattina.
description.pt-BR: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.ru: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description.ja: 危険が　迫ると　耳を　持ち上げ １０トン　トラックを　ひねりつぶす サイコパワーを　解放する。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon naît quand l’âme d’un défunt prend possession d’une épée ancienne. Il s’accroche aux humains pour absorber leur énergie vitale.
description.en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description.es: Cuentan que este Pokémon nace cuando el espíritu de un difunto toma posesión de una espada antigua. Se aferra a las personas y absorbe su energía.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon wird geboren, wenn die Seele eines Verstorbenen sich in einem Schwert festsetzt. Es heftet sich an Menschen und saugt deren Lebenskraft aus.
description.it: Sembra sia nato quando uno spirito si impossessò di un’antica spada. Si lega agli esseri umani per assorbirne la forza vitale.
description.pt-BR: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description.ru: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description.ja: 死者の　魂が　古代の　剣に 宿って　生まれたらしい。 人に　とりつき　命を　吸う。

description.fr: En évoluant, Monorpale se divise en deux épées qui communiquent par télépathie pour mieux découper leur adversaire en morceaux.
description.en: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description.es: Al evolucionar se divide en dos espadas. Se comunican entre sí mediante telepatía y coordinan los ataques para rebanar al enemigo.
description.de: Bei seiner Entwicklung hat es sich in zwei Schwerter geteilt. Es begegnet seinen Gegnern mit Attacken, die es mittels Telepathie koordiniert.
description.it: Sdoppiatesi con l’evoluzione, le due parti comunicano telepaticamente per lanciarsi in un attacco coordinato.
description.pt-BR: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description.ru: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description.ja: 進化して　２本に　分裂した。 テレパシーで　会話して 連係攻撃で　敵を　切り刻む。

description.fr: Ils ont fait le bonheur de générations de rois. Leurs pouvoirs psychiques leur permettent de contrôler hommes et Pokémon.
description.en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.es: Han permanecido junto a estirpes de reyes durante generaciones. Mediante su poder espectral pueden controlar a humanos y a Pokémon.
description.de: Generationen von Königen hatten dieses Pokémon an ihrer Seite. Mit seiner mysteriösen Kraft kann es Menschen und Pokémon gleichermaßen kontrollieren.
description.it: Ha accompagnato generazioni di re. È in grado di controllare e manipolare esseri umani e Pokémon col suo potere spettrale.
description.pt-BR: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.ru: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description.ja: 歴代の　王が　連れていた。 霊力で　人や　ポケモンの 心を　操り　従わせる。

description.fr: Son corps dégage un parfum qui envoûte ceux qui le respirent et change en fonction de son alimentation.
description.en: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description.es: Su cuerpo emana una fragancia que embelesa a quien la huele. La fragancia es diferente según los alimentos que ingiere.
description.de: Der von ihm verströmte Duft verzückt jeden, der ihn riecht. Je nachdem, was es frisst, ändert sich sein Duft.
description.it: Il suo corpo emette un profumo che inebria chi lo annusa. La fragranza cambia in base a ciò che mangia.
description.pt-BR: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description.ru: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description.ja: かいだ　者を　うっとりさせる 香りを　体から　漂わせる。 食べた　もので　香りが　変わる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est capable d’émettre toutes sortes d’odeurs pour incommoder son adversaire et augmenter ses chances de gagner.
description.en: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description.es: Puede producir multitud de olores diferentes y, en combate, secreta los que le resultan molestos al enemigo para así contar con cierta ventaja.
description.de: Es produziert verschiedene Düfte. Im Kampf verschafft es sich einen Vorteil, indem es einen Duft verströmt, der dem Gegner zuwider ist.
description.it: È in grado di emanare profumi di diversi tipi. Durante la lotta, mette in difficoltà i nemici emettendo odori sgradevoli.
description.pt-BR: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description.ru: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description.ja: さまざまな　においを　作り出す。 相手の　嫌がる　においを　出して 戦いを　有利に　進めるのだ。

description.fr: Il immobilise son adversaire à l’aide de filaments blancs, sucrés et collants qui ressemblent à de la barbe à papa.
description.en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description.es: Escupe hebras pegajosas de color blanco y textura parecida a la del algodón de azúcar, con las que envuelve al enemigo y le impide que se mueva.
description.de: Es stößt weiße Fäden aus, die so süß und klebrig wie Zuckerwatte sind. Mit ihnen umwickelt es den Gegner und hindert ihn daran, sich zu bewegen.
description.it: Immobilizza il nemico avvolgendolo in filamenti bianchi, dolci e appiccicosi, simili a zucchero filato.
description.pt-BR: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description.ru: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description.ja: わたあめのような　甘くて　ベタつく 白い　糸を　出して 相手を　絡め取り　動きを　封じる。

description.fr: La finesse de son odorat lui permet de distinguer les nuances de parfums les plus subtiles, ce qui en fait un compagnon idéal pour les pâtissiers.
description.en: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description.es: Puede rastrear hasta el más débil de los olores. Hace uso de su fino olfato para ayudar a los pasteleros más exquisitos.
description.de: Es verfügt über einen feinen Geruchssinn, mit dem es selbst die schwächsten Gerüche erkennen kann. Es hilft deshalb oft in Konditoreien aus.
description.it: È dotato di un olfatto sensibilissimo che gli permette di distinguere anche gli odori più sottili. Si serve di questo talento per aiutare i pasticcieri.
description.pt-BR: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description.ru: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description.ja: わずかな　においでも　かぎわける 敏感な　きゅうかくを　活かして パティシエの　手伝いを　している。

description.fr: Éblouis par les points lumineux qui clignotent sur son corps, les ennemis perdent toute envie de se battre.
description.en: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description.es: Los enemigos que contemplan el titilante fulgor de su brillante cuerpo terminan mareándose y pierden las ganas de continuar combatiendo.
description.de: Gegner, die auf die blinkenden Punkte an seinem Körper blicken, werden geblendet und verlieren den Willen zu kämpfen.
description.it: I nemici che guardano la luce lampeggiante emessa dal suo corpo rimangono abbagliati e perdono il loro spirito combattivo.
description.pt-BR: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description.ru: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description.ja: 発光体の　点滅を　見つめた　相手は 目が　くらみ　戦う　気持ちが なくなってしまうのだ。

description.fr: Doté des pouvoirs hypnotiques les plus puissants du règne des Pokémon, il manipule son adversaire à sa guise.
description.en: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description.es: Tiene a su disposición los poderes hipnóticos más poderosos de entre todos los Pokémon. Controla al enemigo a su voluntad.
description.de: Unter allen Pokémon verfügt es über die stärksten hypnotischen Kräfte, mit denen es Gegner nach Belieben kontrollieren kann.
description.it: È il Pokémon con il potere ipnotico più forte in assoluto. Può controllare a piacimento i suoi nemici.
description.pt-BR: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description.ru: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description.ja: ポケモンで　一番　強力な 催眠術を　使う。相手を　意のままに 操ってしまうのだ。

description.fr: Chaque rocher abrite deux Opermine. S’ils se disputent, l’un d’entre eux part à la recherche d’un nouveau logis.
description.en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description.es: Dos Binacle conviven en la misma roca, pero cuando se produce un altercado entre ambos, uno de ellos se muda a otra.
description.de: Bithora bewohnen jeweils zu zweit einen Felsen. Entzweien sie sich im Streit, sucht sich eines der beiden einen neuen Felsen als Unterkunft.
description.it: I Binacle vivono su una roccia. Quando litigano, uno dei due finisce per spostarsi su una pietra diversa.
description.pt-BR: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description.ru: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description.ja: ２匹の　カメテテが　ひとつの　岩で 暮らす。ケンカすると　どちらかが 他の　岩に　移る。

description.fr: Après évolution, les deux Opermine laissent place à sept créatures qui ont la puissance cumulée de sept Opermine.
description.en: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description.es: Al evolucionar, los dos Binacle se dividen y dan lugar a siete criaturas que se aglomeran formando un Barbaracle y suman su poder al combatir.
description.de: Es entsteht bei der entwicklungsbedingten Aufspaltung der beiden Bithora in sieben Vertreter ihrer Art. Gemeinsam verfügen sie über die siebenfache Stärke.
description.it: Con l’evoluzione, i due Binacle si moltiplicano e il Pokémon lotta con la forza di sette Binacle.
description.pt-BR: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description.ru: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description.ja: 進化のとき　２匹の　カメテテが ７匹に　分裂した　ポケモン。 ７匹分の　パワーで　戦う。

description.fr: Il se cache parmi les algues en décomposition pour mieux approcher ses proies, qu’il achève en les aspergeant de poison.
description.en: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description.es: Adopta la apariencia de algas podridas y lanza un líquido venenoso a las presas desprevenidas que pasan cerca.
