description.de: Als verfaulter Seetang getarnt, lauert es auf Beute und bespritzt alles und jeden, der sich ahnungslos nähert, mit flüssigem Gift, bevor es ihm den Rest gibt.
description.it: Si mimetizza assumendo l’aspetto della vegetazione marina in decomposizione. Spruzza sulle prede ignare un liquido velenoso per poi finirle.
description.pt-BR: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description.ru: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description.ja: 腐った　海藻に　擬態する。 気づかずに　近寄ってきた　獲物に 毒液を　浴びせて　しとめる。

description.fr: Il asperge tous ceux qui osent pénétrer sur son territoire d’un poison assez corrosif pour dissoudre la coque d’un pétrolier.
description.en: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description.es: Ataca de manera indiscriminada a quien ose adentrarse en su territorio, escupiéndole un virulento veneno que puede corroer hasta el casco de un petrolero.
description.de: Das Gift, mit dem es Eindringlinge in seinem Revier bespritzt, ist ätzend genug, um sich durch den Stahl eines Tankschiffes zu fressen.
description.it: Spruzza su chiunque invada il suo territorio un veleno talmente potente da sciogliere lo scafo di una petroliera.
description.pt-BR: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description.ru: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description.ja: タンカーの　船体を　腐らせる　猛毒を 縄張りに　入りこんだ　ものに 見境なく　吐きかける。

description.fr: Sa pince projette un jet d’eau sous pression suffisamment puissant pour abattre ses proies en plein vol.
description.en: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description.es: Abate a enemigos voladores disparando agua a presión con su enorme pinza como si de una pistola se tratara.
description.de: Mit Salven komprimierten Wassers, die es wie Pistolenkugeln aus seinen Scheren abfeuert, schießt es fliegende Beute ab.
description.it: Abbatte le prede volanti sparando un getto d’acqua ad alta pressione dalla chela più grande, che usa come una pistola.
description.pt-BR: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description.ru: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description.ja: 大きな　ハサミから　圧縮した　水を ピストルのように　撃ち出し 飛んでいる　獲物を　撃ち落とす。

description.fr: Son énorme pince projette de véritables obus d’eau capables de transpercer la coque d’un pétrolier.
description.en: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description.es: Posee una enorme pinza que dispara bolas de agua que podrían atravesar incluso el casco de un petrolero.
description.de: Aus seinen gewaltigen Scheren feuert es mächtige Wassergeschosse ab, die selbst den Rumpf eines Tankschiffes durchdringen.
description.it: Ha un’enorme chela che spara proiettili d’acqua in grado di sfondare lo scafo di un transatlantico.
description.pt-BR: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description.ru: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description.ja: 水の　砲弾を　発射する 巨大な　腕を　持つ。 タンカーの　船体を　撃ち抜くぞ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon vit dans le désert. Il n’a pas besoin de se nourrir, car il est capable d’absorber l’énergie du soleil.
description.en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description.es: Habita en los desiertos y, cuando toma el sol, acumula energía, lo que le permite vivir sin la necesidad de ingerir alimentos.
description.de: Es ist in der Wüste zu Hause und wandelt die Energie der Sonne in Körperkraft um, wodurch es auch ohne Nahrung auskommt.
description.it: Vive nei deserti. Può produrre energia elettrica sfruttando la luce solare e, grazie a essa, può sopravvivere anche senza mangiare.
description.pt-BR: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description.ru: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description.ja: 砂漠で　生活する。 太陽の　光を　浴びて　発電すれば エサを　食べなくても　平気なのだ。

description.fr: L’électricité que produit un seul Iguolta en agitant sa collerette suffit à alimenter un immeuble entier.
description.en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description.es: Extiende su gorguera y genera energía eléctrica suficiente para cubrir el consumo de electricidad de un rascacielos entero.
description.de: Die Strommenge, die ein Elezard mit ausgebreiteten Hautlappen durch Umwandlung von Sonnenstrahlen erzeugt, genügt zur Versorgung eines Wolkenkratzers.
description.it: Può produrre energia elettrica aprendo il collare. Un solo Pokémon di questa specie sarebbe in grado di illuminare un intero grattacielo.
description.pt-BR: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description.ru: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description.ja: エリマキを　広げて　発電する。 エレザード　１匹で　高層ビルで 必要な　電気を　作れるのだ。

description.fr: Ramené à la vie à partir d’un fossile, ce Pokémon très capricieux devient violent à la moindre contrariété.
description.en: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description.es: Pokémon recreado a partir de fósiles. Cuando sucede algo que no es de su agrado, se enfurece y se vuelve violento.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon wurde aus einem Fossil neu belebt. Missfällt ihm etwas, rastet es vollkommen aus.
description.it: Pokémon risvegliatosi da un fossile. Se viene disturbato, si infuria e provoca disastri.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description.ru: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description.ja: 化石から　復活した　ポケモン。 気に入らない　ことが　あると かんしゃくを　起こして　大暴れ。

description.fr: Dans les temps anciens, aucun Pokémon ne pouvait rivaliser avec lui. Ses puissantes mâchoires peuvent réduire une épaisse plaque de métal en confettis.
description.en: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description.es: En el mundo antiguo en el que habitaba no tenía rivales gracias a sus mandíbulas, con las que podría despedazar con facilidad gruesas placas de acero.
description.de: Aufgrund der Zerstörungskraft seines Kiefers, der Stahl zerreißen kann, als wäre es Papier, galt es in seiner Zeit als unbesiegbar.
description.it: Grazie alle enormi fauci, che gli permettevano di masticare una lastra di metallo come se fosse carta, era il più forte dei Pokémon preistorici.
description.pt-BR: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description.ru: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description.ja: 分厚い　鉄板を　紙のように かみちぎる　おおあごで　古代の 世界では　無敵を　誇った。

description.fr: Pokémon ancien, ramené à la vie après la découverte d’une partie de son corps conservée dans la glace pendant 100 millions d’années.
description.en: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description.es: Pokémon que ha sido regenerado a partir de un trozo de su antiguo cuerpo, que quedó congelado hace unos 100 millones de años.
description.de: Dieses antike Pokémon wurde aus Teilen seines Körpers neu belebt, die 100 Millionen Jahre lang im ewigen Eis geschlummert hatten.
description.it: Pokémon preistorico riportato in vita dopo più di 100 milioni di anni grazie a parti del suo corpo rinvenute nel ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description.ru: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description.ja: １億年前から　氷漬けに　なっていた 体の　一部から　復活した 古代の　ポケモン。

description.fr: Les cristaux qui parsèment son corps lui permettent de piéger ses ennemis dans la glace en émettant de l’air refroidi à -150 °C.
description.en: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description.es: Expulsa un gas gélido a temperaturas inferiores a los -150 ºC a través de sus cristales romboides y congela así a su enemigo.
description.de: Mit der -150 °C kalten Luft, die den diamantförmigen Kristallen auf seinem Körper entströmt, friert es Gegner ein.
description.it: Emette aria gelida a -150 °C dai cristalli romboidali che ha sul corpo congelando i nemici.
description.pt-BR: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description.ru: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description.ja: マイナス１５０度の　冷気を ひし形の　結晶から　出して 敵を　包み　氷漬けにする。

description.fr: Pour arrêter le combat, il émet des ondes apaisantes avec ses rubans.
description.en: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
description.es: A través de sus apéndices sensitivos con forma de cinta, emite unas ondas tranquilizadoras mediante las cuales detiene los combates.
description.de: Seinen bandförmigen Fühlern lässt es beruhigende Wellen entströmen, die das Ende von Kämpfen herbeiführen.
description.it: Le sue antenne simili a fiocchetti emettono onde dagli effetti rilassanti, grazie alle quali fa cessare le lotte.
description.pt-BR: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
description.ru: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
description.ja: リボンのような　触覚から 気持ちを　和らげる　波動を　送りこみ 戦いを　やめさせる。

description.fr: Malgré sa petite taille, son intelligence lui permet d’affronter sans trembler de grands Pokémon tels que les Mackogneur ou les Hariyama.
description.en: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description.es: A pesar de ser un Pokémon de pequeña estatura, su pericia en el combate le permite plantar cara a Pokémon como Machamp o Hariyama.
description.de: Ungeachtet seines kleinen Wuchses, erweist es sich, dank seiner Kampftechnik, gegenüber größeren Gegnern wie Machomei oder Hariyama als ebenbürtig.
description.it: Nonostante le piccole dimensioni, è in grado di tenere testa a Pokémon ben più grandi come Machamp o Hariyama.
description.pt-BR: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description.ru: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description.ja: 体格は　小柄だが　カイリキーや ハリテヤマなど　大きな　ポケモンと 互角に　戦う　テクニシャン。

description.fr: Ses moustaches lui servent d’antennes, et lui permettent d’envoyer et de recevoir des signaux pour communiquer à distance avec ses congénères.
description.en: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description.es: Sus bigotes hacen la función de antenas, por lo que puede enviar y recibir ondas eléctricas para comunicarse a grandes distancias.
description.de: Seine Schnurrhaare dienen ihm als Antennen. Durch das Senden und Empfangen von elektrischen Wellen kann es mit weit entfernten Freunden kommunizieren.
description.it: I suoi baffi fungono da antenne che trasmettono e ricevono onde radio. Se ne serve per comunicare con i suoi simili.
description.pt-BR: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description.ru: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description.ja: ヒゲが　アンテナの　役割。 電波を　送受信して　遠くの　仲間と 連絡を　取り合うのだ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon vient des profondeurs de la terre, où la chaleur et la pression sont intenses. La pierre qui orne sa tête émet de l’énergie.
description.en: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description.es: Nace en las profundidades subterráneas, a altas temperaturas y a gran presión. Irradia energía por la roca que tiene en la cabeza.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon entstand aus Druck und Hitze in den tiefsten Erdschichten. Mithilfe des Steines in seinem Kopf feuert es Energiestrahlen ab.
description.it: Nato in ambienti sotterranei a elevati livelli di pressione e temperatura, emette energia dalla pietra che ha sulla testa.
description.pt-BR: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description.ru: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description.ja: 地下深くの　高温　高圧な 環境で　生まれた。 頭の　石から　エネルギーを　放つ。

description.fr: C’est le plus faible de tous les Pokémon Dragon. Pour éviter que son corps ne se dessèche, il recherche les lieux humides et ombragés.
description.en: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
description.es: Es el Pokémon de tipo Dragón más débil. Habita en zonas oscuras y húmedas para evitar que su viscoso cuerpo se seque.
description.de: Dieses schwächste aller Drachen-Pokémon lebt an feuchten und schattigen Plätzen, um seinen glitschigen Körper vor dem Austrocknen zu bewahren.
description.it: È il Pokémon Drago più debole di tutti. Vive in ambienti umidi e in ombra per evitare che il suo corpo si secchi.
description.pt-BR: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
description.ru: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
description.ja: 一番　弱い　ドラゴンポケモン。 ヌメヌメの　体が　乾かないよう ジメジメした　日陰で　暮らす。

description.fr: Il repousse ses ennemis en sécrétant un fluide qui dissout tout ce qu’il touche. Suite à une dégénérescence de ses yeux, il est aveugle.
description.en: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
description.es: Segrega una mucosidad que corroe todo lo que toca y consigue así ahuyentar al enemigo. Sus ojos han involucionado, por lo que no puede ver.
description.de: Es verjagt Gegner durch Absonderung eines alles zersetzenden Schleims. Die zurückgebildeten Augäpfel des Pokémon gewähren ihm keine Sicht.
description.it: Respinge i nemici secernendo un liquido vischioso in grado di sciogliere qualunque cosa. I suoi occhi hanno subito una degenerazione che lo ha reso cieco.
description.pt-BR: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
description.ru: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
description.ja: なんでも　溶かしてしまう　粘液を 分泌して　敵を　撃退する。 目玉は　退化して　見えていない。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon Dragon peu farouche aime faire la fête à son Dresseur adoré, le couvrant au passage de sa bave collante.
description.en: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
description.es: Pokémon de tipo Dragón muy afable al que le gusta abrazar con efusión a su Entrenador, aunque después lo deja totalmente pringado.
description.de: Dieses äußerst freundliche Drachen-Pokémon neigt dazu, seinen geliebten Trainer zu umarmen und so mit einer dicken Schleimschicht zu umhüllen.
description.it: Un Pokémon Drago davvero amichevole. Ama fare le feste al suo Allenatore lasciandolo ricoperto di bava.
description.pt-BR: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
description.ru: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
description.ja: 人懐っこい　ドラゴンポケモン。 大好きな　トレーナーに　抱き着いて 粘液で　ヌルヌルにしてしまう。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon collectionne les clés qu’il agite devant ses ennemis pour les intimider.
description.en: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description.es: Tiene el hábito de coleccionar llaves. Cuando un enemigo lo ataca, las hace tintinear como método de intimidación.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon sammelt eifrig Schlüssel, mit denen es wild herumfuchtelt, um Gegner abzuschrecken.
description.it: Ha l’abitudine di raccogliere chiavi. Quando viene attaccato, minaccia il nemico agitandole e facendo un gran chiasso.
description.pt-BR: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description.ru: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description.ja: カギを　集める　習性。 敵に　襲われると　ジャラジャラと カギを　打ち鳴らして　威嚇する。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon apparaît lorsqu’un esprit possède un arbre en décomposition. Il vit dans les forêts où les humains n’osent pas s’aventurer.
description.en: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description.es: Pokémon que nace cuando un espíritu se adentra en un tocón podrido. Habita en bosques que son poco frecuentados por humanos.
description.de: Bei diesen Pokémon handelt es sich um verrottete und von Geistern besessene Baumstümpfe, die sich in von Menschen gemiedene Wälder zurückziehen.
description.it: Pokémon nato da un ceppo marcescente in cui alberga uno spirito. Vive in boschi non frequentati dagli esseri umani.
description.pt-BR: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description.ru: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description.ja: 腐った　切り株に　魂が　宿り ポケモンに　なった。 人の　寄りつかない　森に　住む。

description.fr: Commande aux autres arbres. Il emprisonne jusqu’à la fin de leurs jours les humains qui abîment la forêt.
description.en: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description.es: Puede controlar los árboles a su voluntad. Retiene hasta el fin de sus días a los humanos que se adentran en el bosque y lo mancillan.
description.de: Die Bäume des Waldes folgen ihm blind. Menschen, die dem Wald Schaden zufügen, hält es bis an ihr Lebensende darin gefangen.
description.it: In grado di manovrare gli alberi a piacimento, intrappola per sempre nei boschi gli umani che danneggiano la natura.
description.pt-BR: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description.ru: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description.ja: ほかの　木々を　自在に　操る。 森を　荒らす　人間は　死ぬまで 森から　出られないようにするのだ。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est né du mariage d’un esprit piégé dans le monde des vivants et d’une citrouille. Il commence à s’animer au coucher du soleil.
description.en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.es: En el interior de la calabaza reside un espíritu que ha permanecido atrapado en este mundo. Entra en acción al caer la noche.
description.de: Es entsteht aus der Vereinigung einer in der Welt der Lebenden gefangenen Seele mit einem Kürbis. Es wird erst nach Sonnenuntergang aktiv.
description.it: Pokémon nato quando uno spirito inquieto è entrato in una zucca. Si attiva dopo il calar del sole.
description.pt-BR: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.ru: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description.ja: 成仏できない　魂を カボチャの　体に　入れている。 日暮れと　ともに　動きはじめる。

description.fr: Les nuits de nouvelle lune, ce Pokémon erre dans les rues en chantant d’une voix lugubre. Ceux qui l’entendent sont maudits.
description.en: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description.es: En las noches de luna nueva deambula por las calles de las ciudades y emite espeluznantes alaridos que maldicen a quienes los oyen.
description.de: Unter unheimlichen Gesängen durchstreift es in Neumondnächten Städte und Dörfer. Wer dem unheilvollen Gesang lauscht, wird verflucht.
description.it: Vaga per le città nelle notti di luna nuova intonando una melodia sinistra. Chi la ascolta, viene colpito da una maledizione.
description.pt-BR: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description.ru: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description.ja: 新月の　夜に　不気味な　声で 歌いながら　街中を　さまよう。 その歌を　聞くと　のろわれる。

description.fr: La glace qui couvre son corps bloque les attaques ennemies. Si elle se fissure, il la reconstitue immédiatement en soufflant de l’air glacé.
description.en: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
description.es: Envuelve su cuerpo en una capa de hielo que le permite evitar los ataques del enemigo. Si se resquebraja, la recompone con aire gélido.
description.de: Es wehrt gegnerische Angriffe mit seinem in Eis gehüllten Körper ab. Bruchstellen bessert es mit aus kalter Luft gewonnenem neuen Eis aus.
description.it: Si difende dagli attacchi nemici grazie al ghiaccio che ricopre il suo corpo. Se viene danneggiato, rigenera lo strato protettivo, riparandolo.
description.pt-BR: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
description.ru: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
description.ja: 体を　覆う　氷が 敵の　攻撃を　防ぐ。割られても 冷気で　すぐに　氷を　張る。

description.fr: Son immense corps recouvert de glace est aussi solide que de l’acier. Quand il se déplace, il écrase tout qui se trouve sur son passage.
description.en: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
description.es: Su cuerpo, cubierto de hielo, es tan duro como el propio acero. Su abultada figura le permite arramblar con todo lo que se encuentra a su paso.
description.de: Sein eisbedeckter Körper ist so hart wie Stahl. Es nutzt diese stahlharte Hülle, um Hindernisse zu zerschmettern und sich so seinen Weg zu bahnen.
description.it: Il suo enorme corpo di ghiaccio è duro come l’acciaio. Avanza distruggendo tutto ciò che gli si para davanti.
description.pt-BR: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
description.ru: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
description.ja: 凍りついた　体は　鋼鉄のように 硬い。立ちふさがる　ものを 巨体で　押しつぶし　移動する。

description.fr: Il apprécie les grottes les plus sombres. Ses grandes oreilles lui permettent de générer des ultrasons d’une fréquence de 200 000 Hz.
description.en: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description.es: Habita en cuevas donde reina la más absoluta oscuridad y emite ondas ultrasónicas de 200 000 Hz a través de sus enormes orejas.
description.de: Es lebt im Inneren pechschwarzer Höhlen. Seine riesigen Ohren setzen Ultraschallwellen von 200 000 Hz frei.
description.it: Vive in caverne completamente buie. Emette onde ultrasoniche alla frequenza di 200.000 Hz dalle grandi orecchie.
description.pt-BR: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description.ru: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description.ja: 真っ暗な　洞窟で　暮らす。 ２０万ヘルツの　超音波を 大きな　耳から　発射する。

description.fr: Les nuits sans lune, il quadrille le ciel à la recherche d’une proie. Dans l’obscurité, aucun Pokémon ne peut rivaliser avec lui.
description.en: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description.es: Surca el cielo nocturno cuando ni siquiera la luna brilla y ataca a presas incautas. Es imbatible en combates que tienen lugar a oscuras.
description.de: Es fliegt in finsterer, mondloser Nacht umher und macht Jagd auf achtlose Beute. Ist bei Dunkelheit jedem Gegner überlegen.
description.it: Vola nelle notti senza luna e attacca le prede approfittando di ogni loro minima distrazione. Nell’oscurità è invincibile.
description.pt-BR: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description.ru: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description.ja: 月明かりすら　ない　闇夜を　飛び 油断している　獲物を　襲う。 暗闇の　戦いでは　無敵だ。

description.fr: On dit que ce Pokémon immortel peut offrir ses forces vitales. Il a été ranimé après avoir passé 1 000 ans endormi sous la forme d’un arbre.
description.en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.es: Según las leyendas, puede compartir el secreto de la vida eterna. Ha despertado tras dormir durante mil años bajo la apariencia de un árbol.
description.de: Legenden nach kann dieses Pokémon ewiges Leben spenden. In Gestalt eines Baumes ist es aus seinem tausendjährigen Schlaf erwacht.
description.it: Si dice che possieda l’immortalità e possa farne dono agli altri. Torna in vita dopo aver dormito per 1000 anni sotto forma di albero.
description.pt-BR: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.ru: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description.ja: 永遠の　命を　分け与えると 言われている。樹木の　姿で １０００年　眠り　復活する。

description.fr: Lorsque les plumes de sa queue et de ses ailes sont déployées et virent au rouge, ce Pokémon légendaire absorbe l’énergie vitale de ce qui l’entoure.
description.en: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description.es: Pokémon legendario que, al extender sus alas y las plumas de la cola, emite un brillo carmesí que absorbe la energía vital de su enemigo.
description.de: Wenn Schwingen und Schwanzgefieder dieses Legendären Pokémon rot leuchten, entzieht es Lebewesen deren Energie.
description.it: Quando le ali e le piume della coda di questo Pokémon leggendario sono spiegate e di colore rosso acceso, può assorbire l’energia degli esseri viventi.
description.pt-BR: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description.ru: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description.ja: 翼と　尾羽を　広げて　赤く　輝くとき 生き物の　命を　吸い取る 伝説の　ポケモン。

description.fr: Lorsque l’écosystème de Kalos est menacé, ce Pokémon apparaît et utilise son mystérieux pouvoir.
description.en: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
description.es: Cuando el ecosistema de Kalos se encuentra en peligro, aparece y revela su poder secreto.
description.de: Wenn das Ökosystem der Kalos-Region kippt, erscheint dieses Pokémon und offenbart seine geheimen Kräfte.
description.it: Secondo le leggende, quando l’equilibrio dell’ecosistema della regione di Kalos è in pericolo, appare e libera il suo potere misterioso.
description.pt-BR: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
description.ru: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
description.ja: カロス地方の　生態系が　崩れると 姿を　現して 秘めた　力を　発揮するらしい。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est une mutation spontanée de Strassie. Son corps rose et luisant est d’une beauté incomparable.
description.en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.es: Es una transformación súbita de Carbink. Se dice que su cuerpo, que irradia destellos rosados, es lo más bonito de este mundo.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist eine Mutation von Rocara. Sein rosafarben schimmernder Körper gilt als schönster Anblick überhaupt.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è una mutazione inaspettata di Carbink. Alcuni ritengono che il suo corpo rosa splendente sia la cosa più bella del mondo.
description.pt-BR: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.ru: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description.ja: メレシーの　突然変異。 ピンク色に　輝く　体は 世界一　美しいと　言われる。

description.fr: Ce fauteur de troubles est doté d’anneaux qui déforment l’espace et lui permettent d’expédier au loin n’importe quel objet.
description.en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description.es: Este problemático Pokémon envía cualquier objeto a lugares remotos mediante unos anillos que deforman el espacio.
description.de: Mittels seiner Ringe, die Raumkrümmungen verursachen, verfrachtet dieser Unruhestifter alles und jeden an die entlegensten Orte.
description.it: È un gran combinaguai e spedisce lontano tutto ciò che gli capita a tiro grazie ai suoi anelli in grado di piegare lo spazio.
description.pt-BR: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description.ru: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description.ja: 空間を　ゆがめる　リングで あらゆる　ものを　離れた　場所へ 飛ばしてしまう　トラブルメーカー。

description.fr: Il est capable de générer un nuage de vapeur pour se cacher. Il vit dans des montagnes inhabitées.
description.en: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description.es: Expulsa vapor y desaparece entre la densa niebla. Dicen que habita en montañas solitarias.
description.de: Es stößt Wasserdampf aus und versteckt sich im dadurch entstehenden dichten Nebel. Es lebt in Bergen, die von Menschen gemieden werden.
description.it: Si nasconde emettendo spesse nubi di vapore attorno a sé. Si dice che viva su montagne non frequentate dall’uomo.
description.pt-BR: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description.ru: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description.ja: 水蒸気を　噴き出して　自分の　姿を 濃霧で　隠す。人の　立ち入らない 山に　住むという。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon ne baisse jamais sa garde. Pendant la journée, il accumule de l’énergie par photosynthèse, pour mieux agir la nuit venue.
description.en: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
description.es: Es cauteloso, desconfiado y de naturaleza nocturna. Durante el día acumula energía mediante la fotosíntesis.
description.de: Ein wachsames und nachtaktives Pokémon. Tagsüber sammelt es per Photosynthese Kräfte, um fit für die Nacht zu sein.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è sempre all’erta. Di giorno accumula energia tramite fotosintesi per poi passare all’azione di notte.
description.pt-BR: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
description.ru: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
description.ja: 警戒心が　強い。　昼は 光合成で　力を　溜めて 夜になったら　活動開始。

description.fr: Légèrement vaniteux, il aime prendre soin de ses ailes quand il en a le temps. Il refuse parfois de se battre si ses plumes sont trop sales.
description.en: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
description.es: Es un poco coqueto, por lo que, cuando puede, se acicala las alas. En ocasiones se niega a combatir por temor a mancharse las plumas.
description.de: Dieses affektierte Pokémon pflegt sein Gefieder, wann immer es kann. Mit verschmutzten Federn hat es nämlich oft keine Lust zu kämpfen.
description.it: È un po’ vanitoso e non perde mai l’occasione di dedicarsi alla cura delle proprie ali. A volte rinuncia a lottare per non sporcarsi le piume.
description.pt-BR: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
description.ru: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
description.ja: 気取り屋で　暇が　あれば　翼の 手入れ。　羽毛の　汚れが　気に なりすぎて　戦えないことも。

description.fr: Les plumes de ses ailes lui servent de flèches. Sa précision au tir est si grande qu’il peut atteindre un gravillon à 100 m.
description.en: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
description.es: Las plumas de sus alas le sirven de flechas con las que puede acertar a un guijarro a 100 m.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon kann die Federn seiner Flügel wie Pfeile verschießen. Dabei ist es so präzise, dass es einen Kiesel auf 100 m durchbohrt.
description.it: Scocca piume dalle sue ali come se fossero frecce. È preciso al punto da riuscire a centrare una piccola pietra a 100 m di distanza.
description.pt-BR: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
description.ru: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
description.ja: 翼に　仕込まれた　矢羽を 番えて放つ。　１００メートル先の 小石も　貫く　精度。

description.fr: Les poils qu’il avale pendant sa toilette brûlent et forment une flamme dans son ventre. Celle-ci change selon la façon dont il la recrache.
description.en: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
description.es: Prende las bolas de pelo que se forman en su estómago tras acicalarse. Las llamas que escupe tienen formas variopintas.
description.de: Es verbrennt Haare, die es bei der Körperpflege verschluckt hat, indem es Feuer speit. Die Flammen variieren je nach Art des Speiens.
description.it: Incendia i grumi di pelo accumulati nella pancia durante la toeletta per sputare fiamme che plasma a suo piacimento.
description.pt-BR: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
description.ru: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
description.ja: 毛づくろいで　お腹に　溜まった 抜け毛を　燃やして　火を　吹く。 毛の　吐きかたで　炎も　変化。

description.fr: Il porte à son cou une cloche de feu. Lorsqu’il crache des flammes, cette dernière se met à tinter bruyamment.
description.en: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
description.es: Luce al cuello un cascabel incandescente que tintinea con fuerza cuando desprende llamas.
description.de: Es trägt ein feuriges Glöckchen um den Hals. Immer, wenn es Flammen ausstößt, ertönt ein helles Läuten.
description.it: Quando si mette a sputare fuoco, il sonaglio infuocato che tiene al collo emette un forte tintinnio.
description.pt-BR: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
description.ru: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
description.ja: 首の　付け根に　炎の　鈴が ある。　炎が　噴きだすとき リンリンと　高い音が　鳴る。

description.fr: Un Pokémon brutal qui n’en fait qu’à sa tête. Selon son humeur du moment, il lui arrive d’ignorer sciemment les ordres de son Dresseur.
description.en: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
description.es: Posee un carácter rudo y egoísta. Si un Entrenador no le cae en gracia, ignora sus órdenes con total impasibilidad.
description.de: Ein raues und selbstsüchtiges Pokémon. Wenn es keine Lust hat, ignoriert es auch schon mal die Befehle seines Trainers.
description.it: Ha un carattere aggressivo ed egoista. Se ha la luna storta, non si fa problemi a ignorare gli ordini del proprio Allenatore.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
description.ru: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
description.ja: 粗暴で　身勝手な　性格。 気分が　乗らなければ　トレーナーの 命令も　平気で　無視するぞ。

description.fr: Connu pour son tempérament de battant, il rassemble l’eau de son corps au bout de son museau en un ballon qu’il projette sur l’ennemi.
description.en: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
description.es: Se le conoce por su diligencia y predisposición. Segrega agua por la nariz para hinchar globos con los que golpea a sus rivales.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist für seine Willensstärke bekannt. Bläst es Körperflüssigkeit durch die Nase, entsteht eine Blase, die als Waffe fungiert.
description.it: È conosciuto per la sua forza di volontà. Lancia sul nemico dei palloncini pieni d’acqua che gonfia con il naso.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
description.ru: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
description.ja: 頑張り屋な　性質で　有名。 体液を　鼻で　膨らませた バルーンを　敵に　ぶつける。

description.fr: Danseur hors pair, il produit des ballons d’eau à la chaîne afin d’éclabousser l’adversaire lors d’un impitoyable ballet funeste.
description.en: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
description.es: Un bailarín consumado. Crea globos de agua con los que golpea a sus rivales una y otra vez sin dejar de bailar.
description.de: Dieser begnadete Tänzer erzeugt beim Tanzen eine Wasserblase nach der anderen und greift damit seine Feinde an.
description.it: È un provetto ballerino e scaglia contro il nemico una serie di palloncini d’acqua, che crea a ritmo di danza.
description.pt-BR: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
description.ru: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
description.ja: ダンスが　得意で　踊りながら 次々に　水の　バルーンを 作りだし　敵に　ぶつけるぞ。

description.fr: Il contrôle ses ballons d’eau par son chant, dont la mélodie, apprise auprès de ses semblables, se transmet de génération en génération.
description.en: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
description.es: Es capaz de controlar globos de agua mediante un canto cuya melodía se ha transmitido entre los suyos de generación en generación.
description.de: Es kontrolliert mit seinem Gesang Wasserblasen. Die Melodie, die über Generationen im Rudel überliefert wird, lernt es von seinen Kameraden.
description.it: Controlla i suoi palloncini d’acqua con il canto, intonando una melodia tramandata tra i propri simili di generazione in generazione.
description.pt-BR: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
description.ru: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
description.ja: 水のバルーンを　歌で　操る。 そのメロディは　仲間に　学び 代々　群れに　引き継がれていく。

description.fr: Il creuse les arbres à raison de seize coups de bec par seconde. Le trou creusé lui sert ensuite à stocker des provisions ou à faire son nid.
description.en: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
description.es: Hace agujeros en los árboles a una velocidad de 16 picotazos por segundo y los utiliza como despensa o como su nido.
description.de: Pickt 16-mal pro Sekunde auf Bäume ein, um Löcher ins Holz zu schlagen. Diese nutzt es dann als Futterspeicher oder Nest.
description.it: Riesce a beccare i tronchi degli alberi al ritmo di 16 colpi al secondo. Usa i buchi così scavati come nido o per immagazzinare cibo.
description.pt-BR: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
description.ru: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
description.ja: 秒間１６連打　で　木を　突き 穴を　ほる。　開けた　穴は　餌を 仕舞う　貯蔵庫や　巣に　使う。

description.fr: Il garde toujours dans son bec les pépins des fruits qu’il mange, ce qui lui permet de faire feu dès qu’un ennemi se présente.
description.en: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
description.es: Almacena en su pico las semillas de las bayas de las que se alimenta para usarlas como arma contra enemigos y posibles presas.
description.de: Sammelt Beerensamen in seinem Schnabel. Begegnet es Feinden oder Beute, kann es alle auf einmal verschießen.
description.it: Conserva nel becco i semi delle bacche che mangia, per poi spararli contro nemici e prede non appena ne incontra.
description.pt-BR: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
description.ru: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
description.ja: クチバシに　喰った　きのみの　タネを 溜め込む。　敵や　獲物に 出会うと　一気に　発射する。

description.fr: Pendant le combat, son bec chauffe et dépasse allègrement les 100 °C. Ses adversaires repartent généralement avec de graves brûlures.
description.en: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
description.es: Cuando va a combatir, calienta su pico hasta temperaturas que superan los 100 °C, lo que puede causar graves quemaduras al contacto.
description.de: Erhitzt vor jedem Kampf seinen Schnabel auf über 100 °C. Dadurch erleiden Gepiesackte schwere Verbrennungen.
description.it: Quando lotta arroventa il suo becco a una temperatura di oltre 100 °C, sufficiente a provocare delle bruciature ai suoi avversari.
description.pt-BR: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
description.ru: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
description.ja: クチバシを　発熱させ　戦う。 その温度は　１００度を　優に　超え 突かれるだけで　大火傷。

description.fr: Avec ses crocs acérés, il ne peut s’empêcher de mordre tout ce qui bouge. Il fut introduit à Alola il y a longtemps, depuis une autre région.
description.en: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
description.es: Sus afilados colmillos lo atraviesan todo. No es autóctono de Alola, sino que proviene de otra región.
description.de: Mit seinen scharfen Zähnen schnappt es nach allem. Es lebte ursprünglich nicht in Alola und wurde aus einer anderen Region eingeführt.
description.it: Addenta qualsiasi cosa con le sue zanne aguzze. È stato introdotto ad Alola tempo fa da un’altra regione.
description.pt-BR: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
description.ru: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
description.ja: 鋭いキバで　なんにでも　かみつく。 元々　アローラには　棲んでおらず 他の地方から　連れてこられた。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il est sur les traces d’une proie, ce Pokémon n’est pas du genre à abandonner. Sauf le soir, lorsqu’il tombe de sommeil.
description.en: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
description.es: Al detectar el rastro de una presa, la acecha con tenacidad, pero al ponerse el sol le vence el sueño.
description.de: Findet es Spuren potenzieller Beute, legt es sich sofort auf die Lauer. Spätestens bei Sonnenuntergang nickt es aber ein.
description.it: Scovate le tracce della preda, rimane di guardia sul posto senza battere ciglio fino al calare del sole, poi cede alla stanchezza.
description.pt-BR: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
description.ru: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
description.ja: 獲物の　痕跡を　みつけると 粘り強く　その場に　張り込むが 日暮れには　うつらうつら　している。

description.fr: Il creuse l’écorce des arbres avec ses robustes mandibules pour en siroter la sève. Il vit en temps normal dans le sol.
description.en: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
description.es: Con sus duras mandíbulas arranca la corteza de los árboles y sorbe la savia. Suele habitar bajo tierra.
description.de: Mit seinem robusten Kiefer schabt es an Bäumen, um an ihren Pflanzensaft zu gelangen. Es lebt normalerweise im Erdreich.
description.it: Raschia le cortecce degli alberi con le sue robuste mandibole per succhiarne la linfa. Vive solitamente sottoterra.
description.pt-BR: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
description.ru: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
description.ja: 丈夫な　顎で　樹木を 削り　樹液を　すする。 普段は　地面の　中で　暮らす。

description.fr: Avec son corps capable de stocker l’électricité comme une batterie, il a déjà sauvé la mise à plus d’un campeur peu prévoyant.
description.en: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
description.es: Almacena electricidad en su cuerpo, lo que puede resultar útil en numerosas situaciones, como al salir de acampada.
description.de: Speichert Elektrizität in seinem Körper. Bei einem Campingausflug kann man wohl kein praktischeres Pokémon dabeihaben!
description.it: Può immagazzinare elettricità all’interno del corpo. Per questo la sua compagnia è utile quando si va in campeggio.
description.pt-BR: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
description.ru: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
description.ja: 体内に　蓄電機能を　持つ。 キャンプの　ときなど　１匹　いると とても　ありがたい　ポケモンだ。

description.fr: Il virevolte dans tous les sens, guettant la faille pour frapper. Il concentre l’électricité dans ses grandes mandibules pour foudroyer l’ennemi.
description.en: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
description.es: Sobrevuela un área en busca de presas. Puede concentrar una potente carga eléctrica entre sus mandíbulas para atacar a sus rivales.
description.de: Es fliegt umher und wartet auf seine Chance. In seinem großen Kiefer speichert es elektrische Energie, die es auf Feinde abfeuern kann.
description.it: Sorvola l’area in attesa dell’occasione giusta per attaccare. Nelle grandi mandibole concentra energia elettrica che scarica contro il nemico.
description.pt-BR: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
description.ru: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
description.ja: 飛び回って　隙を　うかがう。 電気エネルギーを　大きなアゴで 収束させ　敵に　発射。

description.fr: Il protège ses points faibles avec ses pinces en guettant le moment propice pour riposter. Il crache de l’écume lorsqu’il tombe K.O.
description.en: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
description.es: Protege sus puntos débiles con las pinzas y propina puñetazos en cuanto tiene ocasión. Cuando pierde, llora lágrimas espumosas.
description.de: Schützt mit den Scheren seine Schwachstellen und bereitet einen Gegenschlag vor. Verliert es, bläst es Trübsal.
description.it: Protegge con le chele i propri punti deboli e, al momento opportuno, contrattacca con potenti pugni. Quando perde, crolla schiumante al suolo.
description.pt-BR: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
description.ru: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
description.ja: ハサミで　弱点を　ガードしつつ 隙を　うかがい　パンチを　放つ。 負けたほうは　泡を　ふいて　ダウン。

description.fr: Il rêvait d’atteindre le sommet d’un pic enneigé, mais s’est égaré en chemin. Il a dû évoluer pour survivre au froid et a acquis un pelage fourni.
description.en: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
description.es: Tras perderse intentando coronar una alta montaña, desarrolló una capa de pelo para protegerse del frío.
description.de: Es wollte auf eine verschneite Bergspitze, hat sich aber verlaufen. In der Kälte wuchs ihm dann ein Fell und es entwickelte sich weiter.
description.it: Dopo essersi smarrito su una montagna innevata che voleva scalare a ogni costo, si è evoluto sviluppando del pelo per proteggersi dal freddo.
description.pt-BR: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
description.ru: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
description.ja: トップを　目指すはずが　雪山に 迷い登り　寒さに　耐えるうちに 毛が　生えてきて　進化していた。

description.fr: Il réunit ses ailes pour générer du feu. Sa chorégraphie envoûtante noie l’ennemi sous un torrent de flammes.
description.en: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
description.es: Junta las alas y lanza voraces llamas al rival. Su ataque se asemeja a una elaborada coreografía de fuego.
description.de: Schlägt es mit den Flügeln, gibt es Zunder! Mit eleganten Ausfallschritten lässt es dann Feuer auf seine Gegner herabregnen.
description.it: Genera del fuoco congiungendo le ali. Avvolge il nemico con violente fiamme mentre si esibisce in un’elegante coreografia di danza.
description.pt-BR: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
description.ru: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
description.ja: 羽を　打ち合わせて　発火。 華麗な　ステップを　踏みながら 激しい　炎を　浴びせかけるぞ。

description.fr: Il se nourrit du nectar et du pollen des fleurs. Ayant la capacité de percevoir l’aura des choses, il sait quelles fleurs vont bientôt éclore.
description.en: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
description.es: Se alimenta de néctar y polen. Es capaz de detectar los capullos que están a punto de abrirse.
description.de: Es ernährt sich von Blütenstaub und Honig. Da es die Aura von Lebewesen wahrnehmen kann, spürt es, wenn eine Blume bald blühen wird.
description.it: Si nutre di nettare e polline. È in grado di percepire l’aura di tutte le cose intorno a sé e avverte quando un fiore sta per sbocciare.
description.pt-BR: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
description.ru: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
description.ja: 花のミツや　花粉が　餌。 オーラを　感じる　力を　持ち 咲きそうな　花を　見分けている。

description.fr: Il confectionne de petites boules de pollen de diverses natures, certaines lui servant de repas, d’autres à attaquer l’ennemi.
description.en: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
description.es: Fabrica varios tipos de bolas de polen. Algunas se usan como alimento y otras para el combate.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon rollt Blütenstaub zu Kugeln. Manche dieser Pollenknödel dienen als Nahrung, andere setzt es aber auch im Kampf ein.
description.it: Crea delle sfere di polline di vario genere in base alle necessità: alcune gli servono per nutrirsi, altre per lottare.
description.pt-BR: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
description.ru: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
description.ja: 花粉を　丸め　団子を　つくる。 食用　から　戦闘用　まで たくさんの　種類が　あるよ。

description.fr: Comme il s’attache facilement à son Dresseur, on le conseille souvent aux débutants, bien qu’il ait tendance à devenir plus rebelle avec l’âge.
description.en: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
description.es: Su carácter amigable lo convierte en el Pokémon ideal para Entrenadores novatos. Sin embargo, al crecer suele volverse un poco agresivo.
description.de: Dieses sehr zutrauliche Pokémon wird oft frischgebackenen Trainern empfohlen. Mit dem Alter wird es jedoch immer wilder.
description.it: È ritenuto un Pokémon ideale per Allenatori alle prime armi perché si affeziona facilmente. Crescendo, però, tende a diventare aggressivo.
description.pt-BR: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
description.ru: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
description.ja: よく　なつくので　初心者に お勧めのポケモンと　いわれるが 育つと　気性は　荒くなる。

description.fr: Il fait tourner en bourrique ses ennemis à cause de sa vitesse. Outre ses crocs et ses griffes, il peut compter sur le roc acéré de sa crinière.
description.en: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
description.es: Su velocidad desconcierta a sus rivales. Ataca con garras, colmillos y con las piedras afiladas de su melena.
description.de: Irritiert seine Feinde mit schnellen Bewegungen. Als Waffen hat es nicht nur Krallen und Hauer, sondern auch die spitzen Felsen seiner Mähne.
description.it: Confonde l’avversario grazie alla rapidità dei movimenti. Oltre ad artigli e zanne, nella lotta si serve anche delle pietre appuntite della criniera.
description.pt-BR: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
description.ru: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
description.ja: 素早く　動き　敵を　惑わす。 ツメや　キバの　ほか　タテガミの とがった　岩も　武器の　ひとつ。

description.fr: Quand il est dans le pétrin, ses yeux deviennent luisants. Ses semblables accourent alors et forment avec lui un banc de combat.
description.en: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
description.es: Al sentirse amenazado, sus ojos emiten cierto brillo, algo que atrae a otros miembros de su especie, y juntos luchan como un mismo ente.
description.de: Gerät es in Not, tränen seine Augen. Ihr Glänzen lockt Artgenossen an, mit denen es dann im Verbund den Feind angreift.
description.it: Quando è in pericolo, i suoi occhi iniziano a brillare e il luccichio richiama i suoi simili, con cui forma un banco per attaccare il nemico.
description.pt-BR: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
description.ru: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
description.ja: ピンチになると　目が　潤みだし 輝く。　その光に　群れる 仲間と　敵に　立ち向かうのだ。

description.fr: Les épines sur sa tête transpercent et empoisonnent l’ennemi. Ses dix tentacules se chargent ensuite du reste.
description.en: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
description.es: Aturde a su presa con los aguijones venenosos de la cabeza. Cuando esta se debilita, la rodea con sus diez extremidades y la remata.
description.de: Mit seinem Giftstachel am Kopf attackiert es Beute. Ist diese geschwächt, umschlingt es sie mit seinen zehn Tentakeln und gibt ihr den Rest.
description.it: Trafigge e indebolisce le prede con gli aculei avvelenati sulla testa, per poi immobilizzarle con i dieci tentacoli e infliggere il colpo di grazia.
description.pt-BR: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
description.ru: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
description.ja: 頭に　ある　毒トゲで　獲物を ズブリ。　弱ったところを　１０本の 触手で　捕らえ　止めを　刺す。

description.fr: Il arpente le fond des océans du haut de ses douze pattes, en laissant derrière lui une traînée de miettes de Corayon.
description.en: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
description.es: Se arrastra por el lecho marino con sus doce extremidades. Deja siempre una estela de restos de Corsola por donde pasa.
description.de: Kriecht mit seinen zwölf Beinen über den Meeresboden. Es hinterlässt oft etliche Überreste von Corasonn.
description.it: Striscia sui fondali marini con i suoi dodici tentacoli, lasciando dietro di sé una scia di resti di Corsola.
description.pt-BR: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
description.ru: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
description.ja: １２本の足で　海底を　はう。 ドヒドイデの　はったあとには サニーゴのカスが　散らばっている。

description.fr: La boue qui lui colle aux pattes lui sert de semelle antidérapante. Il peut ainsi courir à toute allure avec vigueur et assurance.
description.en: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
description.es: El lodo que impregna sus patas le otorga una fuerte tracción, lo que le permite alcanzar altas velocidades al correr.
description.de: Der ganze Schlamm an seinen Füßen sorgt für die nötige Bodenhaftung, die es für seinen kraftvollen Lauf braucht.
description.it: Il fango attaccato alle zampe gli dà un’aderenza tale da permettergli di lanciarsi in una potente corsa senza rischio di scivolare.
description.pt-BR: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
description.ru: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
description.ja: 足に　まとわりついた　泥が グリップに　なり　力強い 走りを　実現しているのだ。

description.fr: Une fois sèche, la boue qu’il crache reste solide même sous le vent et la pluie. Elle était autrefois très utilisée dans les revêtements muraux.
description.en: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
description.es: El lodo que segrega por la boca se vuelve impermeable al secarse, por lo que solía usarse como capa aislante en las paredes de las casas.
description.de: Der Schlamm, den es ausspuckt, schützt gegen Wind und Wetter, wenn er hart wird. Deshalb hat man früher auch Hauswände damit verstärkt.
description.it: Una volta essiccato, il fango che produce dalla bocca resiste alla pioggia e al vento, tanto che un tempo vi si rivestivano i muri delle case.
description.pt-BR: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
description.ru: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
description.ja: 口から　吐く　泥は　固まると 雨風にも　強いので　昔の 家の　壁には　よく塗られている。

description.fr: Il lui arrive d’aller chercher sa nourriture sur la terre ferme. Sa bulle lui sert alors aussi bien à respirer qu’à protéger sa tête molle.
description.en: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
description.es: Emerge a la superficie para alimentarse. La burbuja con la que se rodea le sirve para respirar y proteger su delicada cabeza.
description.de: Die Futtersuche treibt es an Land. Eine Wasserblase versorgt es mit Atemluft und schützt zugleich seinen weichen Kopf.
description.it: Sale sulla terraferma in cerca di prede. La sua bolla d’acqua gli permette di respirare e protegge la sua testa molle.
description.pt-BR: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
description.ru: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
description.ja: 餌を　求め　地上に　あがる。 水泡を　被るのは　呼吸と 柔らかい　頭を　守るため。

description.fr: Il se bat en donnant des « coups de bulle ». Les plus petits Pokémon peuvent se retrouver piégés à l’intérieur de sa bulle et mourir noyés.
description.en: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
description.es: Propina cabezazos con su burbuja. Los Pokémon de menor tamaño quedan atrapados en su interior y perecen ahogados.
description.de: Es verteilt mit seiner Wasserblase Kopfstöße. Kleine Pokémon werden dabei hineingezogen und ertrinken.
description.it: Usa la bolla d’acqua sulla testa per dare delle testate. I Pokémon di piccola taglia vengono direttamente intrappolati nella bolla e affogano.
description.pt-BR: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
description.ru: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
description.ja: 頭部の　水泡で　ヘッドバット。 小さなポケモンで　あれば　そのまま 水泡に　取り込まれ　溺れ死ぬ。

description.fr: La journée, il passe son temps à flâner au soleil et à faire la sieste. Le soir venu, il part à la recherche d’un lieu plus sûr pour passer la nuit.
description.en: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
description.es: Mientras que de día duerme tranquilamente a la luz del sol, al caer la noche busca un sitio más seguro para dormir.
description.de: Mittags badet es in der Sonne und hält Nickerchen. Nachts muss es sich aber einen sichereren Schlafplatz suchen und zieht los.
description.it: Di giorno dorme sotto il sole, mentre di notte si mette in cerca di un posto più sicuro per continuare a dormire.
description.pt-BR: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
description.ru: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
description.ja: 昼間は　光を浴びて　眠り 夜に　なると　より　安全な 寝床を　探し　歩き出す。

description.fr: Préserver ses couleurs éclatantes requiert un travail titanesque. On trouve tout de même des gens assez fous pour s’y atteler.
description.en: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
description.es: Dedica mucho tiempo y esfuerzo a acicalarse y preservar sus vivos colores. A algunos ejemplares incluso les lleva todo el día.
description.de: Es erfordert viel Arbeit, seine Farbenpracht zu erhalten, doch zum Glück gibt es Passionierte, die den hohen Aufwand nicht scheuen.
description.it: Passano la maggior parte del tempo a curare i colori vivaci del loro corpo, tanto che per alcuni di essi è un piacevole hobby a tempo pieno.
description.pt-BR: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
description.ru: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
description.ja: 鮮やかな　体色を　保つには 非常に　手間が　かかるが　それを 趣味にする　好事家も　いるのだ。

description.fr: Il répand des spores luminescentes qui clignotent autour de lui. Quiconque aperçoit ces lumières tombe dans un sommeil profond.
description.en: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
description.es: Cuando titila, esparce esporas luminosas a su alrededor. Todo aquel que ve esta luz cae en un profundo sueño.
description.de: Es streut blinkende Sporen aus. Jeder, der dieses Licht sieht, schläft fest ein.
description.it: Sparge tutto intorno spore che emettono una luce intermittente. Chi la vede cade profondamente addormentato.
description.pt-BR: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
description.ru: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
description.ja: 点滅しながら　発光する　胞子を あたりに　ばら撒く。　その光を 見た者は　深い眠りに　おちる。

description.fr: Il est risqué de s’aventurer la nuit dans un bois peuplé de Lampignon. Attirés par leur lumière envoûtante, certains n’en sont jamais revenus.
description.en: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
description.es: Es peligroso adentrarse por la noche en un bosque habitado por Shiinotic. Su luz confunde a los caminantes, que terminan perdiéndose.
description.de: Nachts sollte man Wälder meiden, in denen Lamellux leben. Ihr unheimliches Licht raubt jedem die Orientierung.
description.it: Meglio non avventurarsi di notte in un bosco abitato da questi Pokémon, perché le loro luci fanno perdere il senso dell’orientamento.
description.pt-BR: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
description.ru: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
description.ja: 夜中に　マシェードの棲む　森に いくのは　危険。　怪しい光に 惑わされ　二度と　帰れなくなる。

description.fr: Il consume ses fluides corporels pour générer un gaz toxique qui étourdit ses ennemis. Il ne lui reste alors qu’à les achever.
description.en: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
description.es: Aturde a sus oponentes con un gas venenoso que produce al quemar sus fluidos corporales y luego se abalanza sobre ellos.
description.de: Durch Verbrennung von Körperflüssigkeit erzeugt es ein Gas, das Feinde schwindelig und so zu leichten Zielen macht.
description.it: Dalla combustione di fluidi corporei crea un gas velenoso che usa per stordire gli avversari. Ne approfitta poi per attaccarli.
description.pt-BR: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
description.ru: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
description.ja: 体液を　燃やし　毒ガスを　たく。 ガスを　吸った　敵が　フラフラに なったあと　襲いかかるのだ。

description.fr: Curieusement, cette espèce ne compte que des femelles. Ces dernières aiment s’entourer de nombreux admirateurs Tritox mâles.
description.en: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
description.es: Por algún motivo desconocido, solo hay hembras. Suele formarse su propio harén compuesto por Salandit machos.
description.de: Bisher wurden nur Weibchen entdeckt. Sie werden von männlichen Molunk verehrt und leben mit einer Gruppe von ihnen zusammen.
description.it: Sono stati trovati solo esemplari femmina, che sono soliti circondarsi di maschi di Salandit.
description.pt-BR: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
description.ru: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
description.ja: なぜか　♀しか　見つかっていない。 ヤトウモリの♂を　引き連れて 逆ハーレムを　作って　暮らす。

description.fr: Il est à croquer, sauf lorsqu’il s’énerve et frappe à tout va. Dans ce cas, laissez-le tranquille ou vous finirez à coup sûr dans le décor.
description.en: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
description.es: Pese a su aspecto encantador, cuando se enoja, sus pataletas son tan feroces que pueden derribar hasta a un luchador profesional.
description.de: Es sieht sehr süß aus, aber wehe, es wird wütend. Mit seinen Armen wirbelnd haut es selbst den stärksten Wrestler um.
description.it: Tenero all’apparenza, quando si arrabbia agita braccia e gambe con una furia tale da atterrare persino un lottatore di wrestling.
description.pt-BR: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
description.ru: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
description.ja: 愛くるしい　見た目だが　怒って ジタバタする　手足に　ぶつかると プロレスラーでも　吹っ飛ばされる。

description.fr: Sa force physique hors norme le rend assez dangereux. D’ailleurs, les zones qu’il habite sont systématiquement interdites d’accès.
description.en: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
description.es: Es un Pokémon muy peligroso por su fuerza descomunal. Normalmente, se desaconseja penetrar en su hábitat.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon verfügt über immense Muskelkraft und ist äußerst gefährlich. Sein Habitat ist generell Sperrgebiet.
description.it: La sua devastante forza fisica lo rende estremamente pericoloso, tanto che di solito è vietato l’accesso alle zone in cui vive.
description.pt-BR: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
description.ru: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
description.ja: 圧倒的な　筋力を　持つ 非常に　危険な　ポケモン。 生息地は　基本　立ち入り禁止。

description.fr: Une odeur terriblement appétissante émane du corps des Croquine. Alléchés, les Bazoucan rappliquent et les gobent goulument.
description.en: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
description.es: Atraídos por el apetitoso aroma que desprende su cuerpo, los Toucannon los engullen con avidez sin ni siquiera masticar.
description.de: Sein Körper verströmt einen köstlichen Duft, der leider seinen Fressfeind Tukanon anlockt. Dem kommt ein aromatischer Snack höchst gelegen.
description.it: Emana dal corpo un profumino delizioso, che per sua sfortuna spinge i Toucannon a inghiottirlo in un solo boccone.
description.pt-BR: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
description.ru: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
description.ja: 美味しそうな　香りが　体から 漏れ出している。　匂いに　誘われた ドデカバシに　丸呑みに　される。

description.fr: Pour mieux se défendre, il a fait pousser sur son corps un calice assez solide pour résister aux coups de bec des Pokémon oiseaux.
description.en: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
description.es: El cáliz de su cabeza se ha desarrollado y le protege todo el cuerpo. Es tan duro que no le importa que lo picoteen los Pokémon pájaro.
description.de: Seinen Blütenkelch hat es zum Selbstschutz ausgebildet. Er ist so hart, dass selbst das Picken von Vogel-Pokémon es nicht stört.
description.it: Per proteggersi ha sviluppato due enormi foglie sulla testa, così dure da resistere agli attacchi dei Pokémon alati.
description.pt-BR: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
description.ru: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
description.ja: 身を　守るため　ヘタが　発達。 かなりの　硬さで　とりポケモンに 突かれても　全然　平気だ。

description.fr: Spécialiste du coup de pied bien placé, ce Pokémon prend un malin plaisir à savater ses ennemis au sol en riant aux éclats.
description.en: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
description.es: Propinar patadas implacables es su especialidad. Patea a sus oponentes derrotados y proclama su victoria con una gran carcajada.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon ist für seine heftigen Tritte bekannt. Oft tritt es auch noch nach und lacht, um seinen Sieg an die große Glocke zu hängen.
description.it: Tirare calci è la sua specialità. Quando batte un avversario, adora umiliarlo ridendogli in faccia e vantandosi della vittoria.
description.pt-BR: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
description.ru: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
description.ja: 脚を　活かした　蹴りが　得意。 倒した　相手を　足蹴に　して 高笑いで　勝利を　アピール。

description.fr: Sa liane gluante diffuse des nutriments dans les fleurs qu’elle happe. Ces dernières dégagent alors un léger parfum.
description.en: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
description.es: Prende flores en su tallo, que es muy rico en nutrientes. Las flores se revitalizan y desprenden una agradable fragancia.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon sieht aus, als hätte man Blüten an einer nahrhaften Ranke angebracht. Diese blühen auf und sind äußerst wohlriechend.
description.it: Alla sua liana ricca di nutrienti attacca dei fiori che così riprendono vigore, emanando piacevoli fragranze.
description.pt-BR: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
description.ru: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
description.ja: 栄養満点の　ツルに　花を くっつける。　花は　活性化し 香しい　アロマが　漂いだす。

description.fr: Célébré pour son intelligence exceptionnelle, ce Pokémon vous prendra de haut si vous débutez. À réserver aux Dresseurs aguerris.
description.en: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
description.es: Es un Pokémon famoso por su astucia e ingenio. Desprecia a los Entrenadores novatos y prefiere a los más veteranos.
description.de: Es ist als extrem schlaues Pokémon bekannt. Nicht so beliebt bei unerfahrenen Trainern, doch Veteranen wissen es zu schätzen.
description.it: Famoso per la sua intelligenza, questo Pokémon tende a guardare dall’alto in basso gli Allenatori poco esperti e a prediligere i più competenti.
description.pt-BR: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
description.ru: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
description.ja: 非常に　賢いことで　知られる。 未熟な　トレーナーは　見下す ベテラン向けの　ポケモンだぞ。

description.fr: Ils se rassemblent par groupes de vingt. Dans cette formation très soudée, nul ne songerait une seule seconde à abandonner ses alliés.
description.en: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
description.es: Suele ir en grupos de unos veinte ejemplares. Sus miembros permanecen siempre unidos y nunca se abandonan unos a otros.
description.de: Es gründet Gruppen von etwa 20 Exemplaren. Der Zusammenhalt der Gruppe ist extrem stark, kein Kamerad wird jemals im Stich gelassen.
description.it: Si muove in gruppi di circa 20 esemplari che, uniti da un fortissimo legame, sono pronti a tutto per aiutarsi a vicenda.
description.pt-BR: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
description.ru: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
description.ja: ２０匹前後の　グループを　つくる。 その結束は　非常に　固く 絶対　仲間を　見捨てない。

description.fr: De nature poltronne, il prend ses nombreuses pattes à son cou au moindre danger et balaie le sol sur son passage.
description.en: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
description.es: Cuando se asusta, huye despavorido moviendo rápidamente sus múltiples patas. Deja el suelo limpio y pulido allí por donde pasa.
description.de: Es ist so feige, dass es wild mit seinen vielen Füßen herumschlägt und verzweifelt davonläuft. Nach seiner Flucht glänzt der Boden herrlich.
description.it: È un gran fifone e fugge agitando rapidamente le sue numerose zampette. Dopo il suo passaggio, tutto è lindo e pulito.
