description.pt-BR: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
description.ru: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
description.ja: 臆病で　たくさんの　足を ばたつかせ　必死に　逃げまわる。 逃げたあとは　ピカピカ　綺麗。

description.fr: Il fait miroiter ses énormes griffes acérées avant d’attaquer. Elles sont assez puissantes pour fendre en deux l’air comme la mer.
description.en: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
description.es: Gracias a su destreza y sus enormes y afiladas garras, puede cortar hasta el aire y el agua de un solo tajo.
description.de: Mithilfe seiner riesigen, glitzernden Klauen zerteilt es selbst Luft und Salzwasser mit einem Hieb.
description.it: È talmente abile con i suoi enormi artigli affilati da essere in grado di tagliare in due persino le particelle dell’aria e dell’acqua.
description.pt-BR: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
description.ru: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
description.ja: 鋭く　巨大な　ツメで 一閃。　空気や　海水さえ 一刀両断の　腕前。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est né de la rancœur d’un voyageur mort dans l’indifférence, laquelle s’est incarnée dans un pâté de sable.
description.en: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
description.es: Surgió cuando una persona murió abandonada en plena calle y su resentimiento poseyó un montículo de arena apilado por un niño.
description.de: Der Groll eines verstorbenen Reisenden fuhr in einen Sandhügel, den ein Kind gebaut hatte, und brachte dieses Pokémon in die Welt.
description.it: È nato quando della sabbia ammucchiata da un bambino è stata animata dallo spirito risentito di un viandante morto da solo durante un viaggio.
description.pt-BR: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
description.ru: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
description.ja: 行き倒れた者の　怨念が 子どもが　つくった　砂山に 取りつき　誕生　したのだ。

description.fr: Il a possédé un humain pour que ce dernier le remodèle en château de sable, décuplant au passage ses pouvoirs de malédiction.
description.en: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
description.es: Manipulando a la gente ha conseguido transformarse en todo un castillo de arena, lo que ha aumentado su poder maligno.
description.de: Brachte Menschen dazu, den Sandhügel zu einer stattlichen Sandburg auszubauen. Auch seine Flüche haben an Stärke gewonnen.
description.it: Si è evoluto servendosi degli esseri umani per diventare un castello di sabbia, aumentando così la propria forza malefica.
description.pt-BR: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
description.ru: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
description.ja: 人を　操り　砂の山を 砂の城まで　進化　させた。 呪いの　力も　あがっている。

description.fr: Il vit en bord de mer, ou en eaux peu profondes. Ses organes peuvent sortir de son corps pour saisir de la nourriture ou frapper l’ennemi.
description.en: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
description.es: Vive en las playas y en aguas poco profundas. Expulsa sus entrañas para engañar a sus depredadores y librarse de ellos.
description.de: Es lebt an Stränden oder in flachen Gewässern. Im Kampf und zum Schnappen von Beute lässt es seine Organe hervorschnellen.
description.it: Vive nei pressi delle spiagge e in acque poco profonde. Espelle gli organi interni per catturare le prede e attaccare i nemici.
description.pt-BR: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
description.ru: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
description.ja: ビーチなど　浅い　海に　棲む。 身体から　体内器官を　だして 餌を　捕ったり　敵と　戦う。

description.fr: Le lourd masque qu’il porte est un limiteur qui l’empêche d’exprimer toute l’étendue de sa puissance. Il recèle une force mystérieuse.
description.en: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
description.es: La pesada máscara le impide liberar toda su fuerza, que se cree que es extraordinaria.
description.de: Seine schwere Maske unterdrückt seine wahre Macht. In ihm schlummern nämlich besondere Kräfte.
description.it: La pesante maschera che indossa agisce come un freno che gli impedisce di usare la sua vera potenza. Nasconde in sé un potere speciale.
description.pt-BR: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
description.ru: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
description.ja: 重い　制御マスクを　つけており 本来の　能力を　だせない。 特別な　力を　秘めている。

description.fr: La confiance qu’il place en son Dresseur a réveillé ses pouvoirs. Il est à présent capable de changer de type à loisir durant le combat.
description.en: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
description.es: La confianza con su Entrenador ha despertado su potencial. Ahora es capaz de cambiar de tipo a voluntad durante el combate.
description.de: Das Vertrauen zu seinem Trainer weckt seine Kräfte. Es kann seinen Typ im Kampf nach Belieben wechseln.
description.it: La fiducia nel proprio Allenatore gli consente di risvegliare il suo potere nascosto. Durante la lotta può cambiare il suo tipo a piacimento.
description.pt-BR: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
description.ru: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
description.ja: パートナーとの　信頼で　覚醒。 自在に　タイプを　チェンジする 能力を　発揮し　戦う。

description.fr: Il vivait dans la couche d’ozone, avant que sa carapace, devenue trop lourde, ne finisse par le faire chuter sur la terre ferme.
description.en: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
description.es: Vive en la capa de ozono hasta que su caparazón se hace demasiado pesado y cae sin remisión a tierra firme.
description.de: Eigentlich lebt es in der Ozonschicht, doch wenn seine Schale zu schwer wird, stürzt es auf die Erde.
description.it: Vive normalmente nello strato d’ozono, ma quando il guscio esterno si indurisce precipita a terra.
description.pt-BR: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
description.ru: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
description.ja: もともと　オゾン層に　棲んでおり 身体の　殻が　重くなると 地上に　向かって　落ちてくる。

description.fr: Il rejoint et quitte ce monde en dormant. Son existence se déroule comme un rêve paisible. Il dort du sommeil du juste toute sa vie durant.
description.en: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
description.es: Pasa la vida entera sumido en un profundo sueño. Toda su actividad parece reflejar los sueños que tiene en ese momento.
description.de: Es wird schlafend geboren und stirbt schlafend. Sein ganzes Leben ist ein Traum, seine einzige körperliche Aktivität das Umdrehen im Schlaf.
description.it: Trascorre la sua intera esistenza dormendo. Pare che le sue azioni siano determinate da quello che sta sognando.
description.pt-BR: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
description.ru: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
description.ja: 寝たまま　生まれ　寝たまま　死ぬ。 すべての　行動は　みている 夢に　よる　寝相　らしい。

description.fr: Sa carapace est très instable. Si on la heurte par mégarde, elle explose. Le creux sur son ventre est son point faible.
description.en: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
description.es: Posee un caparazón que estalla al contacto. El orificio que se aprecia en su vientre es su punto débil.
description.de: Sein Rückenpanzer ist explosiv, man sollte ihm also niemals auf den Rücken klopfen. Das Loch in seinem Bauch ist seine Schwachstelle.
description.it: Il carapace sulla schiena è esplosivo e, se lo si urta per errore, scoppia. Il suo punto debole è il buco sulla pancia.
description.pt-BR: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
description.ru: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
description.ja: 背中の　甲羅は　爆発物。 うっかり　殴れば　大爆発。 お腹の　穴が　弱点。

description.fr: Les épines de ce Pokémon sont normalement baissées, mais quand il s’énerve, elles se dressent afin de pourfendre ses agresseurs.
description.en: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
description.es: Cuando se siente amenazado, eriza las púas de su lomo para pinchar a quien ose atacarlo.
description.de: Normalerweise liegen seine Stacheln am Rücken an, aber wenn es sich aufregt, stellen sie sich auf und stechen angreifende Gegner.
description.it: Normalmente tiene le spine che ha sulla schiena abbassate, ma se viene infastidito le drizza per trafiggere chi lo attacca.
description.pt-BR: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
description.ru: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
description.ja: 背中の　ハリの　毛は　普段は 寝ている。　興奮すると　逆立ち 襲ってくる　敵を　突き刺すのだ。

description.fr: Sa véritable apparence est inconnue. Les chercheurs qui ont vu sous son déguisement sont littéralement morts de peur.
description.en: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
description.es: Su verdadero aspecto es un misterio total. Un investigador que intentó mirar dentro del saco recibió, literalmente, un susto de muerte.
description.de: Niemand weiß, wie es wirklich aussieht. Ein Forscher, der unter seinen Lumpen blickte, soll sich buchstäblich zu Tode erschreckt haben.
description.it: Nessuno conosce il suo vero aspetto. Pare che uno studioso sia morto di paura dopo aver guardato sotto il panno che lo nasconde.
description.pt-BR: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
description.ru: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
description.ja: 正体不明。　ボロ布の 中身を　みた　とある　学者は 恐怖の　あまり　ショック死した。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il utilise l’appendice sur sa tête pour projeter ses pouvoirs psychiques, il émet un bruit aussi irritant qu’un grincement de dents.
description.en: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
description.es: Cuando la protuberancia que tiene en la cabeza emite poderes psíquicos, se escucha como un ruido de dientes rechinando muy molesto.
description.de: Wenn es über den Fortsatz an seinem Kopf Psycho-Kräfte freisetzt, ertönt in seiner Umgebung ein unangenehmes Zähneknirschen.
description.it: Quando proietta il suo potere psichico dalla protuberanza sulla testa, diffonde tutto intorno un fastidioso rumore di denti che stridono.
description.pt-BR: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
description.ru: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
description.ja: 頭の　突起から　サイコパワーを 放つとき　とても　耳障りな 歯ぎしりの　音が　あたりに　響く。

description.fr: C’est une bonne pâte de nature, mais si par malheur il s’énerve, il peut détruire tout ce qui l’entoure de son souffle puissant.
description.en: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
description.es: Es de naturaleza mansa, pero si se le provoca y monta en cólera, destruye todo lo que le rodea con su aliento devastador.
description.de: Es hat ein freundliches Wesen, aber wenn es zur Weißglut gebracht wird, zerstört es mit einem heftigen Hauch die gesamte Umgebung.
description.it: Ha un’indole gentile, ma se si arrabbia distrugge tutto quello che ha intorno con un soffio devastante.
description.pt-BR: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
description.ru: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
description.ja: 心優しい　性質。　だが 一度　怒りに　かられると　激しい 息吹で　あたりを　破壊　し尽くす。

description.fr: Avec un bon coup d’ancre bien senti, il peut même assommer un Wailord. Son véritable corps est la partie composée de limon.
description.en: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
description.es: Los giros de su enorme ancla son capaces de noquear al mismísimo Wailord de un solo golpe. El alga verde es su verdadero cuerpo.
description.de: Wenn es seinen riesigen Anker schwingt, kann es sogar ein Wailord mit einem Schlag K.O. hauen. Der grüne Seetang ist sein Körper.
description.it: Roteando l’enorme ancora, è capace di mandare KO con un solo colpo persino un Wailord. Il suo vero corpo è composto da alghe verdi.
description.pt-BR: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
description.ru: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
description.ja: でかい　錨を　ブンブン　振り回し ホエルオーさえ　一撃で　ＫＯ。 緑の　モズクが　本体だ。

description.fr: Il communique ses sentiments en frottant ses écailles. Les montagnes peuplées de Bébécaille bruissent d’un écho métallique.
description.en: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
description.es: Comunica sus sentimientos haciendo sonar sus escamas. El ruido metálico producido reverbera en las altas montañas donde habita.
description.de: Es übermittelt seine Gefühle durch das Rasseln seiner Schuppen, wodurch im Hochgebirge, in dem es lebt, ein metallisches Geräusch erhallt.
description.it: Trasmette le sue emozioni scuotendo le squame. Nelle aree montane in cui vive riecheggia spesso un suono metallico.
description.pt-BR: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
description.ru: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
description.ja: ウロコを　叩き　気持ちを　伝える。 ジャラコの　棲む　高山では 金属音が　木霊する。

description.fr: Il se jette sur ses proies en poussant un terrible cri de guerre. Il les déchiquette ensuite avec ses poings écaillés.
description.en: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
description.es: Se lanza sobre su presa entonando un grito de guerra. Golpea al enemigo y lo hace trizas con sus escamas.
description.de: Mit einem Kampfschrei stürzt es sich auf seine Beute und reißt sie mithilfe seiner Schuppen in kleine Stücke.
description.it: Piomba sulla preda con un urlo possente. Le sue squame riducono a fettine i nemici.
description.pt-BR: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
description.ru: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
description.ja: 雄叫びと　ともに　獲物に 飛びかかる。　ウロコの　パンチは 相手を　ズタズタに　引き裂くぞ。

description.fr: Quand il voit un ennemi, il cherche à l’intimider en faisant sonner les écailles de sa queue. Les plus faibles perdent contenance et s’enfuient.
description.en: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
description.es: Al avistar a su enemigo, lo intimida con el tintineo que producen las escamas de su cola. Los más débiles se asustan y huyen.
description.de: Wenn es einen Gegner sieht, rasselt es drohend mit seinen Schwanzschuppen. Schwache Gegner verlieren dadurch die Fassung und fliehen.
description.it: Intimorisce gli avversari con il rumore prodotto dalla vibrazione delle scaglie che ha sulla coda. Sentendolo, i nemici più deboli si danno alla fuga.
description.pt-BR: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
description.ru: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
description.ja: 敵を　見ると　尻尾の　ウロコを ジャラジャラ　鳴らして　いかく。 弱い者は　あわてて　逃げ出す。

description.fr: Gardien de Mele-Mele, il est curieux de tout. Il a le pouvoir d’appeler les nuages orageux pour stocker la foudre dans son corps.
description.en: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
description.es: El espíritu guardián de Melemele, curioso e inquisitivo. Invoca nubes de tormenta y acumula el poder de los rayos en su cuerpo.
description.de: Der neugierige und lebhafte Schutzpatron von Mele-Mele. Es kann Gewitterwolken rufen und Blitze in seinem Körper speichern.
description.it: Protettore di Mele Mele, è un Pokémon dalla vivace curiosità. Attira a sé le nuvole temporalesche per assorbirne la carica elettrica.
description.pt-BR: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
description.ru: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
description.ja: 好奇心旺盛な　メレメレの 守り神。　雷雲を　呼び 雷を　身体に　溜め込む。

description.fr: Pokémon candide mais terriblement cruel, c’est le gardien d’Akala. Il puise son énergie dans le parfum entêtant des fleurs.
description.en: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
description.es: El espíritu guardián de Akala, tan inocente como cruel. La fragancia de las flores constituye su fuente de energía.
description.de: Der arglose, doch unbarmherzige Schutzpatron von Akala. Seine Energie zieht es aus dem lieblichen Duft von Blumen.
description.it: Protettore di Akala, è un Pokémon innocente e spietato al tempo stesso. Il profumo soave dei fiori è la fonte della sua energia.
description.pt-BR: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
description.ru: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
description.ja: 無邪気で　残酷な　アーカラの 守り神。　花の　芳しい 香りが　エネルギーの　源。

description.fr: Il arrache de grands arbres et fait des moulinets avec. Il a le pouvoir de rendre la végétation luxuriante pour ensuite se nourrir de cette force.
description.en: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
description.es: Arranca de cuajo árboles grandes para hacerlos girar. Vuelve exuberante la vegetación y luego absorbe su energía.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon entwurzelt große Bäume und schwingt sie herum. Es lässt Pflanzen üppig gedeihen und absorbiert dann ihre Energie.
description.it: Sradica gli alberi e li fa roteare maneggiandoli abilmente. Fa crescere la vegetazione per poi assorbirne l’energia.
description.pt-BR: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
description.ru: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
description.ja: 大木を　引き抜き　ブンブン 振り回す。　草木を　茂らせて そのエネルギーを　吸収する。

description.fr: Il confond ses ennemis grâce au brouillard et les pousse à s’en prendre à eux-mêmes. Il puise son énergie dans les courants marins.
description.en: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
description.es: Desconcierta al enemigo provocando una espesa niebla que se convierte en su perdición. Las corrientes marinas son su fuente de energía.
description.de: Es führt Gegner mit dichtem Nebel in die Irre und schickt sie so in ihren Untergang. Seine Energie gewinnt es aus der Meeresströmung.
description.it: Avvolge il nemico in una fitta nebbia che lo induce ad attaccare se stesso. Le correnti marine sono la fonte della sua energia.
description.pt-BR: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
description.ru: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
description.ja: 深い霧で　敵を　惑わせ 自滅させる　恐ろしさを　持つ。 海流が　エネルギーの　源。

description.fr: Son corps est composé d’un gaz très volatile. Il croît lentement, en accumulant les poussières atmosphériques au gré de ses déplacements.
description.en: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
description.es: Su cuerpo se compone de una materia gaseosa inestable. Crece poco a poco al acumular las motas de polvo que flotan en el aire.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht aus flüchtigem Gas. Es wächst durch das Sammeln von Staub aus der Luft.
description.it: Il suo corpo è formato da un gas volatile. Cresce lentamente accumulando il pulviscolo presente nell’atmosfera.
description.pt-BR: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
description.ru: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
description.ja: はかない　ガス状の　身体。 大気の　チリを　集めながら ゆっくりと　成長していく。

description.fr: On pourrait le croire mort car il ne bouge pas du tout. Au toucher, il reste tiède. On le surnomme « cocon céleste » depuis l’Antiquité.
description.en: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
description.es: Permanece inmóvil, como si estuviera muerto, aunque al tocarlo se percibe un ligero calor. Antaño se le llamaba Crisálida de las Estrellas.
description.de: Es ist völlig reglos, als wäre es tot. Berührt man es, fühlt es sich jedoch leicht warm an. Vor langer Zeit wurde es „Sternenkokon“ genannt.
description.it: Resta completamente immobile, come se fosse morto, ma al tatto si percepisce un lieve tepore. Nell’antichità era chiamato “Bozzolo di stella”.
description.pt-BR: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
description.ru: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
description.ja: 死んだように　まったく　動かないが 触れると　ほのかに　温かい。 大昔は　星の繭と　呼ばれた。

description.fr: Il viendrait d’un autre monde. Tout son corps émet une puissante lumière qui peut changer la nuit la plus noire en un jour radieux.
description.en: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
description.es: Se cree que proviene de otro mundo. El brillo que emite su cuerpo es tal que puede hacer que la noche más profunda parezca pleno día.
description.de: Es heißt, es komme aus einer anderen Welt. Sein ganzer Körper leuchtet strahlend hell und macht die finsterste Nacht zum Tage.
description.it: Si dice che viva in un altro mondo. Dal corpo emette una luce così accecante da illuminare a giorno anche la notte più buia.
description.pt-BR: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
description.ru: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
description.ja: 別世界に　棲むと　いわれる。 全身から　激しい光を　放ち 闇夜も　真昼のように　照らすのだ。

description.fr: On suppose que c’est l’évolution de Cosmog lorsqu’il s’agit d’une femelle. Son troisième œil apparaît quand il s’envole vers un autre monde.
description.en: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
description.es: Se dice que es la evolución final hembra de Cosmog. Su tercer ojo aparece cuando se traslada a un mundo distinto.
description.de: Es heißt, es sei die weibliche Endstufe der Entwicklungsreihe von Cosmog. Ist sein drittes Auge aktiviert, zieht es in eine andere Welt.
description.it: Si dice che sia l’evoluzione femminile di Cosmog. Quando il suo terzo occhio si manifesta, significa che sta volando verso un altro mondo.
description.pt-BR: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
description.ru: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
description.ja: コスモッグが　進化した　♀だと いわれる。　第３の　眼が　浮かぶとき 別世界へと　飛び去っていく。

description.fr: L’une des mystérieuses Ultra-Chimères. On l’aurait vue parasiter des gens en pleine rue, les rendant extrêmement violents.
description.en: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
description.es: Un Ultraente envuelto en misterio. Se dice que las víctimas a las que posee se vuelven agresivas.
description.de: Eine rätselhafte Ultrabestie. Einigen Berichten zufolge verwandelt sie harmlose Stadtbewohner per Symbiose in äußerst aggressive Menschen.
description.it: Una delle misteriose Ultracreature. Si riportano casi in cui le persone vittime di questo parassita hanno manifestato comportamenti violenti.
description.pt-BR: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
description.ru: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
description.ja: 謎に　包まれた　ＵＢの　一種。 街ゆく　人が　寄生され 暴れだす　姿が　目撃された。

description.fr: Personne ne sait si cette Ultra-Chimère venue d’un autre monde montre ses muscles pour être admirée ou pour intimider ceux qu’elle rencontre.
description.en: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
description.es: Un Ultraente procedente de otro mundo. Se desconoce si exhibe su robusto cuerpo a modo de amenaza o para que lo admiren.
description.de: Eine Ultrabestie aus einer anderen Welt. Niemand weiß, ob sie ihren Körper aus Stolz oder zur Abschreckung stählt.
description.it: È un’Ultracreatura arrivata da un altro mondo. Esibisce i propri muscoli, ma non è chiaro se lo faccia per orgoglio o a scopo intimidatorio.
description.pt-BR: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
description.ru: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
description.ja: 別世界から　現れた　ＵＢ。 自らの　身体を　みせつけてくるが 自慢なのか　いかくなのか　不明。

description.fr: L’une des dangereuses Ultra-Chimères. On l’aurait aperçue en train de courir à une vitesse prodigieuse.
description.en: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
description.es: Uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se dice que ha sido avistado recorriendo la superficie terrestre a velocidades de vértigo.
description.de: Diese bedrohliche Ultrabestie wurde dabei beobachtet, wie sie mit ungeheuerlicher Geschwindigkeit über die Erde hinwegfegt.
description.it: Una delle temibili Ultracreature. È stata avvistata mentre correva a una velocità impressionante.
description.pt-BR: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
description.ru: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
description.ja: 危険なＵＢの　一種。　凄まじい 速度で　大地を　疾走する 姿が　目撃　されている。

description.fr: L’une des mystérieuses Ultra-Chimères. On l’aurait vue émettre une formidable quantité d’électricité autour d’elle.
description.en: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
description.es: Un Ultraente rodeado de misterio. Se dice que su cuerpo desprende descargas eléctricas de inmensa potencia.
description.de: Eine geheimnisvolle Ultrabestie, aus deren Körper furchterregende Mengen an elektrischer Energie strömen.
description.it: Una delle misteriose Ultracreature. È stata vista sprigionare scariche elettriche terrificanti da tutto il corpo.
description.pt-BR: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
description.ru: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
description.ja: 全身から　凄まじい　電撃を ほとばしらせる　光景を　目撃。 謎の　生物　ＵＢの　一種だ。

description.fr: Une Ultra-Chimère qui a traversé l’Ultra-Brèche. On l’aurait aperçue parcourir le ciel à grande vitesse.
description.en: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
description.es: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece haber sido avistado surcando los cielos a velocidades vertiginosas.
description.de: Eine Ultrabestie, die mit extremer Geschwindigkeit durch die Lüfte rast. Sie ist durch die Ultrapforte gekommen.
description.it: Questa Ultracreatura è arrivata attraverso un Ultravarco ed è stata avvistata mentre solcava il cielo ad altissima velocità.
description.pt-BR: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
description.ru: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
description.ja: ウルトラホールから　現れた。 高速で　空を　飛ぶ　姿が 目撃　された　ウルトラビースト。

description.fr: Une Ultra-Chimère venue de l’Ultra-Brèche. Elle ne semble pas agressive, bien que son corps tout entier soit une arme tranchante.
description.en: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
description.es: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Se dice que no es muy agresivo, pero su afilado cuerpo es un arma realmente peligrosa.
description.de: Eine Ultrabestie, die zwar nicht von sich aus anzugreifen scheint, deren rasiermesserscharfer Körper aber eine gefährliche Waffe darstellt.
description.it: Un’Ultracreatura arrivata attraverso un Ultravarco. Non attacca di propria iniziativa, ma il suo corpo affilato è un’arma letale.
description.pt-BR: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
description.ru: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
description.ja: ウルトラホールから　現れた　ＵＢ。 自ら　敵を　襲わないようだが 鋭い　全身は　凶器だ。

description.fr: Une espèce d’Ultra-Chimère. On l’aurait aperçue dévorant des montagnes et des gratte-ciel.
description.en: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
description.es: Se dice que este Ultraente ha sido avistado devorando montañas enteras y tragándose prominentes edificios.
description.de: Eine Ultrabestie, die einigen Berichten zufolge ganze Berge vertilgt und selbst mehrstöckige Gebäude verschlingen kann.
description.it: Stando alle testimonianze, è in grado di divorare intere montagne e di inghiottire edifici in un solo boccone. È una delle Ultracreature.
description.pt-BR: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
description.ru: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
description.ja: 山を　喰らい　削り　ビルを 飲みこむ　姿が　報告　された。 ウルトラビーストの　一種。

description.fr: Une créature endormie sous terre. On suppose qu’il s’agit d’une Ultra-Chimère et qu’elle serait venue d’un autre monde, il y a bien longtemps.
description.en: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
description.es: Se dice que yacía en el interior de la tierra. Se cree que esta criatura, parecida a un Ultraente, vino de otro mundo hace muchísimo tiempo.
description.de: Diese einer Ultrabestie ähnelnde Kreatur ist wohl vor Urzeiten aus einer anderen Welt gekommen und ruhte lange Zeit unter der Erde.
description.it: Pare che questo essere simile a un’Ultracreatura sia giunto da un altro mondo in tempi antichi e sia rimasto a lungo dormiente sottoterra.
description.pt-BR: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
description.ru: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
description.ja: 地下で　眠りに　ついていたようだ。 太古に　別世界から　やってきたと おもわれる　ＵＢらしき　生物。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon a été créé de toutes pièces il y a 500 ans. Il comprend ce qu’on lui dit, mais il n’est pas doué de parole.
description.en: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
description.es: Pokémon artificial creado hace más de 500 años. Es capaz de entender el lenguaje humano, pero carece de la facultad del habla.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon wurde vor über 500 Jahren künstlich erschaffen. Es versteht die Sprache der Menschen, ohne sie selbst zu sprechen.
description.it: È un Pokémon artificiale costruito più di 500 anni fa. Capisce il linguaggio degli esseri umani, ma non è in grado di parlare.
description.pt-BR: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
description.ru: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
description.ja: ５００年以上前に　造られた 人造ポケモン。　人の　言葉を 理解するが　しゃべれない。

description.fr: Il dissimule son apparence aux autres en se tapissant dans l’ombre. Son existence pourrait se révéler n’être qu’une fable.
description.en: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
description.es: Debido a que siempre se ha ocultado en las sombras y no le gusta dejarse ver, su misma existencia es todo un misterio.
description.de: Da es sich im Schatten verbergen und so für menschliche Augen unsichtbar werden kann, war seine Existenz lange bezweifelt worden.
description.it: Si nasconde nelle ombre per sfuggire alla vista degli esseri viventi, e per questo si è dubitato per molto tempo della sua esistenza.
description.pt-BR: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
description.ru: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
description.ja: 影の中に　潜むことが　でき 人前に　姿を　みせないので その存在は　幻　だった。

description.fr: Dans son monde, cette Ultra-Chimère est fort appréciée pour son naturel conciliant, qui fait d’elle un compagnon de voyage idéal.
description.en: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
description.es: En su mundo, este Ultraente se considera tan entrañable como para ser elegido compañero de viaje.
description.de: Diese Ultrabestie wird in der Welt, aus der sie kommt, so gemocht, dass sie oft als Partner für Reisen gewählt wird.
description.it: Un’Ultracreatura talmente socievole da essere spesso scelta come compagno di viaggio nel mondo da cui proviene.
description.pt-BR: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
description.ru: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
description.ja: 異世界に　おいては　旅立ちの パートナーに　選ばれるほど 親しまれている　ウルトラビースト。

description.fr: Son corps contient des hectolitres de poison. Il fait partie de ces créatures que l’on nomme « Ultra-Chimères ».
description.en: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
description.es: Una de las temibles criaturas conocidas como Ultraentes. En su cuerpo almacena cientos de litros de veneno.
description.de: Eines der Lebewesen, die Ultrabestien genannt werden. In seinem Körper bewahrt es Hunderte Liter giftiger Flüssigkeit auf.
description.it: È una delle forme di vita note come Ultracreature. Il suo corpo contiene centinaia di litri di veleno.
description.pt-BR: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
description.ru: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
description.ja: 体内に　数百リットルの 毒液を　ためている。 ＵＢと　呼ばれる　生物の　一種。

description.fr: Il est sorti d’une Ultra-Brèche. Il est composé de plusieurs petites entités qui s’assemblent pour n’en former qu’une seule.
description.en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description.es: Surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece estar compuesto de varias criaturas que se han combinado para formar un solo ser.
description.de: Diese Kreatur kam durch eine Ultrapforte. Sie besteht anscheinend aus mehreren aufeinandergestapelten Wesen.
description.it: È arrivato attraverso un Ultravarco. Sembra essere costituito da più creature impilate che formano una singola unità.
description.pt-BR: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description.ru: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description.ja: ウルトラホールから　出現した。 複数の　生命が　積み上がり １匹を　形成している　ようだ。

description.fr: Il s’approche des gens avec son allure désarticulée et fait subitement exploser sa tête. Ce serait une Ultra-Chimère.
description.en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description.es: Parece ser uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se acerca a la gente contoneándose y hace explotar su propia cabeza súbitamente.
description.de: Dieses Wesen ist vermutlich eine Ultrabestie. Es nähert sich Menschen tänzelnd, nur um dann plötzlich seinen Kopf explodieren zu lassen.
description.it: Sembra che sia un’Ultracreatura. Si avvicina alle persone ondeggiando e fa esplodere la sua testa all’improvviso.
description.pt-BR: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description.ru: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description.ja: クネクネ動いて　人に　近付くと 突然　頭を　爆発させた。 ウルトラビーストの　一種らしい。

description.fr: Il déchiquette son adversaire avec ses griffes chargées d’électricité. Même si sa cible évite l’attaque, elle reçoit un coup de jus.
description.en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description.es: Hace jirones al oponente con sus garras electrificadas. Aunque este esquive los golpes, acaba electrocutado por las descargas.
description.de: Mit seinen elektrisierten Krallen reißt es Gegner in Stücke. Selbst wenn sie ausweichen, werden sie von elektrisch geladenen Funken getroffen.
description.it: Fa a pezzi l’avversario con le unghie cariche di elettricità. Anche se il nemico schiva il colpo, riceve comunque una scarica folgorante.
description.pt-BR: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description.ru: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description.ja: 両手足の　ツメを　帯電させ 相手を　八つ裂き。　かわされても 飛び散る　電撃で　感電させる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon fait fondre le fer et les autres métaux contenus dans le sol pour les intégrer à son corps composé d’acier fondu.
description.en: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
description.es: Su cuerpo está compuesto de acero líquido. Funde las partículas de hierro y otros metales del subsuelo para luego absorberlas.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht aus geschmolzenem Stahl. Es bringt Eisen und andere Metalle im Boden zum Schmelzen, um sie dann zu absorbieren.
description.it: Il suo corpo è composto di acciaio liquefatto. Scioglie il ferro e gli altri metalli presenti nel sottosuolo per assorbirli.
description.pt-BR: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
description.ru: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
description.ja: とろりと　溶けた　鋼の　体。 地中の　鉄分や　金属を 溶かして　吸収する。

description.fr: Autrefois vénéré pour son aptitude à produire du fer, ce Pokémon a mystérieusement ressuscité après 3 000 ans.
description.en: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
description.es: En la antigüedad se le veneraba por su poder de crear hierro. Después de tres milenios, ha regresado misteriosamente.
description.de: Einst wurde es für seine Fähigkeit verehrt, Eisen erschaffen zu können. Nach 3 000 Jahren ist es aus einem unerfindlichen Grund wieder erwacht.
description.it: In passato era venerato perché lo si riteneva capace di generare ferro. È misteriosamente ricomparso dopo 3.000 anni di assenza.
description.pt-BR: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
description.ru: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
description.ja: 鉄を　産み出す　力を　持つと 崇められていた。　３０００年の 時を　経て　なぜか　蘇った。

description.fr: Le rythme qu’il crée en tapant avec son bâton très spécial génère des ondes sonores qui ont le pouvoir de vivifier les plantes.
description.en: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
description.es: Al marcar el ritmo con su baqueta especial, produce unas ondas sonoras capaces de devolver la vitalidad a la flora.
description.de: Der Rhythmus, den es mit seinem besonderen Schlägel erzeugt, verbreitet Schallwellen, die Pflanzen neue Vitalität verleihen können.
description.it: Segnando il ritmo con la sua bacchetta speciale diffonde onde sonore che hanno il potere di rinvigorire fiori e piante.
description.pt-BR: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
description.ru: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
description.ja: 特別な　スティックで　リズムを 刻むと　草花を　元気にする パワーが　音波になって　広がる。

description.fr: Les Badabouin qui parviennent à suivre le rythme le plus effréné avec leurs deux bâtons sont les plus respectés par leurs camarades.
description.en: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
description.es: Los Thwackey que marcan el ritmo más contundente con sus dos baquetas son los más respetados por sus congéneres.
description.de: Je wilder der Beat, den ein Chimstix mit seinen zwei Schlägeln erzeugt, desto mehr wird es von seinen Artgenossen respektiert.
description.it: I Thwackey più rispettati dai propri simili sono quelli in grado di produrre un ritmo forsennato con le due bacchette.
description.pt-BR: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
description.ru: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
description.ja: ２本の　スティックで　激しい ビートを　刻める　バチンキーほど 仲間たちの　尊敬を　集める。

description.fr: Il contrôle le pouvoir de sa souche singulière en tapant en rythme dessus. Il se bat en manipulant des racines.
description.en: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
description.es: Controla los poderes y las raíces de su singular tocón en combate golpeándolo como si fuera un tambor.
description.de: Es kontrolliert die Macht seines speziellen Baumstumpfes durch Trommeln. Im Kampf manipuliert es damit Wurzeln.
description.it: Controlla il potere del suo ceppo speciale usandolo come un tamburo e lotta servendosi delle radici.
description.pt-BR: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
description.ru: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
description.ja: 特別な　切り株の　パワーを ドラミングで　コントロール。 根っこを　操って　戦う。

description.fr: Il court pour augmenter sa température et faire circuler l’énergie incandescente dans son corps. Il peut ainsi déployer toute sa puissance.
description.en: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
description.es: Se pone a correr para elevar su temperatura corporal y propagar la energía ígnea por todo el cuerpo. Desata así su verdadera fuerza.
description.de: Erhöht es durch Rennen seine Körpertemperatur, strömt Feuer-Energie durch seinen Körper. Dann kann es seine wahre Kraft entfesseln.
description.it: Quando corre, la sua temperatura corporea sale pervadendolo di un’energia infuocata che gli permette di scatenare la sua vera potenza.
description.pt-BR: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
description.ru: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
description.ja: 走りまわって　体温を　上げると 炎エネルギーが　体を　巡り 本来の　力を　発揮できる。

description.fr: Son pelage épais lui permet de mieux résister au froid et d’augmenter la température de ses capacités Feu.
description.en: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
description.es: Su suave pelaje lo protege del frío y le permite incrementar todavía más la temperatura de sus movimientos de tipo Fuego.
description.de: Sein flauschiges Fell schützt es vor Kälte und ermöglicht es ihm, noch heißere Feuer-Attacken auszuteilen.
description.it: Grazie alla folta pelliccia resiste al freddo ed è in grado di sferrare mosse infuocate a temperature ancora più alte.
description.pt-BR: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
description.ru: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
description.ja: ふかふかの　体毛で　寒さに 強くなり　さらに　高温の 炎技を　出せるようになった。

description.fr: Il drible avec des pierres pour en faire des ballons enflammés, avant de tirer sur ses adversaires pour les brûler.
description.en: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
description.es: Convierte piedras en balones de fuego dándoles toques y, luego, chuta con fuerza hacia el rival para chamuscarlo.
description.de: Es jongliert kleine Steine mit den Füßen und erschafft daraus einen Flammenfußball. Seine Gegner verbrennt es mit scharfen Schüssen.
description.it: Crea un pallone da calcio infuocato palleggiando con un sasso e poi tira una cannonata contro il nemico per abbrustolirlo.
description.pt-BR: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
description.ru: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
description.ja: 小石を　リフティングして　炎の サッカーボールを　つくる。　するどい シュートで　相手を　燃やす。

description.fr: Quand il a peur, il pleure des larmes contenant une substance lacrymogène d’une puissance équivalente à celle de cent oignons.
description.en: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
description.es: Cuando se espanta, libera unas lágrimas con un factor lacrimógeno equivalente a 100 cebollas para hacer llorar también al rival.
description.de: Hat es Angst, vergießt es Tränen, die Reizstoffe enthalten, welche andere ebenfalls zum Weinen bringen. Sie sind so stark wie 100 Zwiebeln.
description.it: Se si spaventa, produce lacrime con un fattore lacrimogeno cento volte più potente di quello di una cipolla per far piangere anche i nemici.
description.pt-BR: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
description.ru: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
description.ja: 怯えると　玉ねぎ１００個分の 催涙成分を　もつ　涙を 流して　もらい泣き　させる。

description.fr: Il crée des bombes à eau grâce au liquide qu’il sécrète avec la paume de ses mains. Il s’en sert dans les combats où la stratégie prime.
description.en: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
description.es: Crea bolas de agua con el líquido que segrega por las palmas de las manos y las usa en combate de forma estratégica.
description.de: Das Sekret, das aus seinen Handflächen austritt, formt es zu Wasserkugeln. Diese nutzt es im Kampf für taktisch ausgeklügelte Angriffe.
description.it: Lotta in modo strategico servendosi di sfere che crea con l’acqua che fuoriesce dalle sue zampe.
description.pt-BR: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
description.ru: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
description.ja: 手のひらから　出る　水分を 丸めて　つくった　水の　玉を 使い　頭脳戦を　繰り広げる。

description.fr: Il a plus d’un tour dans son sac : il peut tirer des gerbes d’eau du bout de ses doigts et planer dans les airs grâce à ses membranes dorsales.
description.en: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
description.es: Esconde algunos trucos bajo la manga: puede disparar agua por los dedos o planear con las membranas de su espalda.
description.de: Zu seinen vielen geheimen Talenten gehört es, Wasser aus den Fingern zu schießen und mit der Membran am Rücken durch die Lüfte zu segeln.
description.it: Ha vari assi nella manica. Emette getti d’acqua dalle dita e si fa trasportare dal vento grazie alla membrana che ha sulla schiena.
description.pt-BR: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
description.ru: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
description.ja: 多彩な　機能を　隠し持つ。 指から　水を　噴射して 背中の　皮膜で　風に　乗る。

description.fr: On le trouve partout à Galar. S’il n’a pas de Baies en réserve dans ses deux joues, il devient anxieux.
description.en: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
description.es: Este Pokémon se encuentra por todo Galar. No se queda tranquilo hasta que tiene ambos carrillos atiborrados de bayas.
description.de: Es ist überall in der Galar-Region anzutreffen. Hat es keine Beeren, die es in seinen beiden Backen horten kann, wird es unruhig.
description.it: Si trova ovunque a Galar. Se non ha una scorta di bacche dentro le guance, si fa prendere dall’ansia.
description.pt-BR: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
description.ru: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
description.ja: ガラルの　いたるところに　いる。 左右の　ほっぺに　木の実を 蓄えていないと　不安。

description.fr: Il amasse tellement de Baies dans sa queue qu’elles tombent les unes après les autres, mais il est si étourdi qu’il ne s’en rend pas compte.
description.en: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
description.es: Se obceca tanto en acumular bayas en la cola que no se da ni cuenta de cuando tiene demasiadas y se le acaban cayendo.
description.de: Es hortet in seinem Schweif Beeren. Versucht es, zu viele unterzubringen, fallen sie heraus. Da es jedoch nicht allzu clever ist, bemerkt es das nicht.
description.it: Conserva talmente tante bacche nella coda che le perde una dopo l’altra, ma non essendo molto perspicace non se ne rende conto.
description.pt-BR: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
description.ru: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
description.ja: しっぽに　木の実を　溜めこむ。 溜めこみすぎて　ポロポロ　こぼすが 鈍いので　気がつかない。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon brave affronte même les adversaires les plus redoutables. Il devient plus fort à mesure qu’il subit les contre-attaques.
description.en: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
description.es: De naturaleza valiente, planta cara a cualquier rival, por muy fuerte que sea. Los contraataques que recibe le sirven para fortalecerse.
description.de: Es ist von Natur aus sehr mutig und fordert daher jeden noch so starken Feind heraus. Selbst wenn es den Kürzeren zieht, dient dies seinem Training.
description.it: Ha un’indole temeraria che lo porta ad attaccare briga anche con nemici molto forti. Diventa più forte a forza di subire contrattacchi.
description.pt-BR: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
description.ru: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
description.ja: どんな　強敵にも　挑みかかる 勇敢な　性質。　返り討ちに 遭いながらも　鍛えられていく。

description.fr: Il est capable d’utiliser des objets avec ses serres : il peut par exemple saisir et lancer des pierres ou même enrouler une corde autour d’un ennemi.
description.en: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
description.es: Su inteligencia le permite servirse de objetos. Por ejemplo, recoge y lanza piedras con las patas, o utiliza cuerdas para atrapar a su oponente.
description.de: Es weiß Objekte geschickt einzusetzen. So greift und wirft es zum Beispiel kleine Steine mit seinen Krallen oder wickelt Seile um Gegner.
description.it: È in grado di adoperare oggetti. Ad esempio, sa afferrare e scagliare pietre con le zampe o avvolgere il nemico con una corda.
description.pt-BR: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
description.ru: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
description.ja: 足で　小石を　つかんで　投げたり ロープを　敵に　巻きつけるなど 道具を　あつかう　知恵を　もつ。

description.fr: Il n’a aucun rival dans le ciel de Galar. L’aspect intimidant de son corps d’acier noir et lustré inspire la crainte chez ses ennemis.
description.en: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
description.es: No tiene rival en los cielos de Galar. El acero negro y lustroso de su cuerpo intimida a cualquier adversario.
description.de: Niemand wagt es, ihm den Himmel über Galar streitig zu machen. Sein schwarz glänzendes, stählernes Äußeres schüchtert jeden Gegner ein.
description.it: Nei cieli di Galar non ha rivali. La vista del suo corpo di acciaio nero e lucente intimorisce i suoi avversari.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
description.ru: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
description.ja: ガラル地方の　空では　敵なし。 黒光りする　鋼の　姿は 相手を　威圧し　恐れさせる。

description.fr: Comme il passe tout son temps à recueillir des informations, son intelligence est très développée, mais sa force physique laisse à désirer.
description.en: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
description.es: Siempre está recopilando información, por lo que es muy inteligente, aunque su fuerza deja bastante que desear.
description.de: Sensect ist ein schlaues Pokémon, da es immer fleißig Informationen sammelt. Seine Stärke lässt jedoch zu wünschen übrig.
description.it: Sempre impegnato a raccogliere informazioni, ha sviluppato molto la sua intelligenza, ma non ha una grande forza.
description.pt-BR: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
description.ru: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
description.ja: いつも　せっせと　情報を 集めているので　賢い。 ただし　力は　いまいちだ。

description.fr: Il ne bouge presque pas, mais il est bien vivant. On dit qu’il aurait découvert ses pouvoirs psychiques à force de jeûner dans sa coquille.
description.en: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
description.es: Apenas se mueve, pero está vivo. Se cree que adquiere poderes psíquicos mientras permanece recluido en su caparazón sin comer ni beber.
description.de: Obwohl es sich fast nie bewegt, ist es am Leben. Es sollen Psycho-Kräfte in ihm erwacht sein, als es ohne Nahrung in seinem Panzer ausharrte.
description.it: Si muove appena, ma è vivo. Sembra che sviluppi poteri paranormali mentre se ne sta rintanato nel suo guscio senza bere né mangiare.
description.pt-BR: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
description.ru: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
description.ja: ほぼ　動かないが　生きている。 飲まず食わずで　殻に　こもるうち 超能力に　目覚めたらしい。

description.fr: Il est renommé pour son intelligence. Son gros cerveau est un indicateur de la puissance de ses pouvoirs psychiques.
description.en: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
description.es: Este Pokémon es conocido por su inteligencia. El gran tamaño de su cerebro es un indicio de la magnitud de sus poderes psíquicos.
description.de: Es ist allseits als sehr schlaues Pokémon bekannt. Sein großes Gehirn ist ein Indiz dafür, dass es über mächtige Psycho-Kräfte verfügt.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è famoso per la sua intelligenza. Il cervello molto sviluppato è una spia dei suoi fenomenali poteri psichici.
description.pt-BR: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
description.ru: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
description.ja: 賢い　ポケモンとして　有名。 大きな　脳みそは　強力な サイコパワーを　もつ　証し。

description.fr: Il vit en subtilisant la nourriture des autres Pokémon. Grâce à ses coussinets moelleux, il ne fait aucun bruit quand il marche.
description.en: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
description.es: Se sustenta con el alimento que roba a otros Pokémon. Las almohadillas de sus patas son tan blandas que no hace ningún ruido al caminar.
description.de: Es stibitzt Futter, das andere Pokémon gefunden haben. Dank der samtweichen Ballen an seinen Pfoten ist sein Gang lautlos.
description.it: Vive rubando il cibo trovato dagli altri Pokémon. I morbidi cuscinetti plantari rendono i suoi passi silenziosi.
description.pt-BR: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
description.ru: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
description.ja: ほかの　ポケモンが　みつけた　餌を 掠めて　暮らしている。　ふかふかの 肉球は　足音を　たてない。

description.fr: Il marque sa victime pour la suivre à l’odeur. Sitôt qu’elle est distraite, il s’empresse de lui voler ses biens.
description.en: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
description.es: Marca a su presa sin ser advertido. Sigue el olor y, cuando el otro Pokémon baja la guardia, aprovecha para robarle.
description.de: Es markiert heimlich die Beute, auf die es ein Auge geworfen hat. Dann folgt es dem Geruch und stiehlt sie, wenn sich die Gelegenheit bietet.
description.it: Marca di nascosto le prede interessanti, ne segue l’odore per rintracciarle e approfitta di una loro distrazione per rubare nelle loro tane.
description.pt-BR: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
description.ru: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
description.ja: 狙った　獲物は　こっそり マーキング。　においを　辿って 油断　したころ　盗みに　来るぞ。

description.fr: Quand il plante son unique pied pour absorber la lumière du soleil, ses pétales prennent une couleur éclatante.
description.en: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
description.es: Si planta su única extremidad inferior en la tierra y se expone a abundante luz solar, sus pétalos cobran un color vivo.
description.de: Steckt es sein Beinchen fest in den Boden und badet dann ausgiebig im Sonnenlicht, nimmt seine Blüte eine kräftigere Farbe an.
description.it: Quando conficca il suo piede nel terreno e assorbe luce solare in abbondanza, il colore dei suoi petali diventa più intenso.
description.pt-BR: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
description.ru: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
description.ja: 一本足を　地面に　刺して 陽の光を　たっぷり　浴びると 花びらが　鮮やかに　色づく。

description.fr: Les graines de son duvet sont remplies de nutriments. Elles sont emportées par le vent et redonnent vitalité aux plantes et aux Pokémon.
description.en: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
description.es: Las semillas que tiene entre la pelusa son muy nutritivas. Arrastradas por el viento, devuelven la vitalidad a la flora y a otros Pokémon.
description.de: Die Saat seines Wollflaums steckt voller Nährstoffe. Es verstreut sie im Wind und heilt damit Pflanzen und Pokémon.
description.it: I suoi semi lanuginosi, ricchi di sostanze nutritive, vengono trasportati dal vento e donano nuova energia a piante e Pokémon.
description.pt-BR: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
description.ru: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
description.ja: 綿毛の　種は　栄養満点。 風に　乗せて　飛ばして　草木や ポケモンたちを　元気にさせる。

description.fr: Son pelage frisé est doux et rebondi comme un coussin. Une telle toison le protègerait même s’il chutait d’une falaise.
description.en: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
description.es: Su lana rizada es tan acolchada que no se hace daño ni aunque se caiga por un precipicio.
description.de: Sein stark gelocktes Fell hat eine sehr polsternde Wirkung. Selbst eine Klippe hinunterzufallen macht ihm nichts aus.
description.it: Il suo vello riccioluto gli fornisce una perfetta imbottitura. Non si farebbe nulla nemmeno cadendo da un precipizio.
description.pt-BR: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
description.ru: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
description.ja: パーマの　かかった　体毛は 高い　クッション性が　ある。 崖から　落ちても　へっちゃら。

description.fr: La texture de sa laine est si élastique que la surface des tapis fabriqués avec ce matériau est aussi rebondissante que celle d’un trampoline.
description.en: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
description.es: Su lana es muy flexible. Las alfombras tejidas con ella adoptan una textura similar a la de las camas elásticas.
description.de: Spannt man einen aus den elastischen Haaren von Zwollock gewobenen Teppich auf, kann man darauf hüpfen wie auf einem Trampolin.
description.it: I tappeti realizzati con i suoi peli sono talmente elastici che saltandoci sopra si rimbalza come su un trampolino.
description.pt-BR: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
description.ru: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
description.ja: 弾力の　ある　毛で　織った カーペットは　トランポリンみたいで 乗れば　ピョンピョン　跳ねるのだ。

description.fr: Il a pour habitude de mordre tout ce qui lui passe sous les yeux. On raconte qu’il fait cela parce que ses incisives qui poussent le démangent.
description.en: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
description.es: Muerde todo lo que se le ponga por delante. Al parecer, lo hace para aliviar el dolor que siente cuando le crecen los incisivos.
description.de: Es schnappt sofort nach allem, was ihm unterkommt. Der Grund dafür ist anscheinend, dass seine wachsenden Vorderzähne jucken.
description.it: Addenta tutto ciò che gli capita davanti. Sembra che lo faccia d’istinto, a causa del prurito provocato dagli incisivi che stanno crescendo.
description.pt-BR: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
description.ru: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
description.ja: 目の前の　ものに　すぐに　噛みつく 習性。　生えかけの　前歯が 痒いので　噛みついてしまうらしい。

description.fr: De nature très violente, il mord fermement ses proies avec sa mâchoire, assez puissante pour broyer une barre de fer.
description.en: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
description.es: Un Pokémon de temperamento feroz que atenaza a su presa con sus fuertes mandíbulas, capaces de destrozar una barra de hierro.
description.de: Dieses von Natur aus aggressive Pokémon beißt seine Beute mit seinem kräftigen Kiefer, der selbst Eisenstangen zermalmen kann.
description.it: Ha una natura estremamente feroce e addenta le prede con la sua mascella, così potente da poter sbriciolare sbarre di ferro.
description.pt-BR: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
description.ru: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
description.ja: 狂暴な　性質。　鉄棒を 噛み千切る　ほどの　顎の　力で 獲物に　ばくりと　噛みつく。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il court, on peut voir de l’électricité se former à la base de sa queue. Ce Pokémon est très populaire auprès des bergers de Galar.
description.en: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
description.es: Al correr, genera electricidad por la base de la cola. Es muy popular entre los pastores de Galar.
description.de: Beim Rennen erzeugt es Elektrizität in seinem Schwanzansatz. In der Galar-Region erfreut es sich bei Hirten großer Beliebtheit.
description.it: Quando corre produce elettricità dalla base della coda. A Galar è apprezzato soprattutto per l’aiuto che fornisce ai pastori nei pascoli.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
description.ru: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
description.ja: 走る　ときに　しっぽの　根元から 電気を　生み出す。　ガラルでは 牧羊犬として　人気。

description.fr: Il produit de l’électricité puis la transfère dans ses pattes pour mieux courir. Ainsi, il peut foncer pendant trois jours et trois nuits.
description.en: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
description.es: La electricidad que genera y envía a sus patas le ayuda a desplazarse rápidamente. Puede correr sin descanso durante tres días y tres noches.
description.de: Es generiert Strom und lässt ihn zur Unterstützung beim Rennen in seine Beine fließen. Dadurch kann es drei Tage und Nächte ohne Pause rennen.
description.it: Trasferisce alle zampe l’elettricità che produce per aumentarne la resistenza. Può correre per tre giorni interi senza mai fermarsi.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
description.ru: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
description.ja: 電気を　つくって　脚に　送り 走りを　アシスト。　三日三晩 休まず　走れるのだ。

description.fr: On l’a découvert dans une mine il y a 400 ans. Son corps est presque entièrement composé d’une substance identique au charbon.
description.en: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
description.es: Fue descubierto hace aproximadamente 400 años en una mina. Casi la totalidad de su cuerpo presenta una composición igual a la del carbón.
description.de: Es wurde vor circa 400 Jahren in einer Kohlemine entdeckt. Sein Körper besteht fast aus denselben Komponenten wie Steinkohle.
description.it: È stato scoperto più di 400 anni fa in una miniera. Il suo corpo è prevalentemente composto di una sostanza uguale al carbone.
description.pt-BR: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
description.ru: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
description.ja: およそ４００年前に　炭鉱で 見つかった。　体の　ほとんどが 石炭と　同じ　成分。

description.fr: Il produit du charbon dans son corps. Jadis, les habitants de Galar ramassaient ce charbon au sol et s’en servaient pour leurs besoins quotidiens.
description.en: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
description.es: Forma carbón en el interior de su cuerpo. Los antiguos habitantes de Galar lo aprovechaban para sus labores diarias.
description.de: Es produziert Steinkohle in seinem Körper. Die von ihm abfallende Kohle wurde früher in der Galar-Region fürs tägliche Leben genutzt.
description.it: Gli antichi abitanti di Galar usavano il carbone prodotto da questo Pokémon all’interno del suo corpo per le loro necessità quotidiane.
description.pt-BR: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
description.ru: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
description.ja: 体内で　石炭を　つくりだす。 昔の　ガラルでは　落とした 石炭を　生活に　利用した。

description.fr: Il est d’une nature paisible, mais si les humains tentent de piller ses mines, il enrage et brûle tout avec des flammes à 1 500 °C.
description.en: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: Aunque es de carácter sereno, monta en cólera si ve a seres humanos dañando una mina y reduce todo a cenizas con sus llamas a 1500 °C.
description.de: Meist ist es friedfertig, aber wenn Menschen eine Mine zugrunde richten, sieht es rot und verbrennt sie mit 1 500 ºC heißen Flammen.
description.it: Di solito è tranquillo, ma se gli esseri umani danneggiano la sua miniera va su tutte le furie e brucia tutto emettendo fiamme a 1.500 ºC.
description.pt-BR: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ru: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ja: 普段は　穏やかだが　人間が 鉱山を　荒らすと　怒りくるい １５００度の　炎で　焼きつくす。

description.fr: Il vit toujours dans sa pomme. S’il croise un Pokémon oiseau, son prédateur naturel, il se fait passer pour un simple fruit pour se protéger.
description.en: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
description.es: Habita durante toda su vida en el interior de una manzana. Finge ser una fruta para protegerse de los Pokémon pájaro, sus enemigos naturales.
description.de: Es verbringt sein ganzes Leben im Inneren eines Apfels. Um sich vor Vogel-Pokémon, seinen Fressfeinden, zu schützen, imitiert es einen Apfel.
description.it: Passa la vita all’interno di un pomo. Quando si imbatte in Pokémon alati, suoi nemici naturali, si protegge fingendosi un semplice frutto.
description.pt-BR: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
description.ru: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
description.ja: 一生　りんごの　中で　暮らし 天敵の　鳥ポケモンに　出会うと りんごの　振りをして　身を守る。

description.fr: Il a évolué après avoir mangé une pomme acide. Il concentre dans ses joues un liquide si corrosif qu’il peut provoquer des brûlures.
description.en: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
description.es: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana ácida. Las bolsas de las mejillas albergan un fluido cuya extrema acidez llega a provocar quemaduras.
description.de: Nach dem Verzehr eines sauren Apfels hat es sich entwickelt. In den Backentaschen speichert es eine saure Substanz, die zu Verbrennungen führt.
description.it: Si è evoluto dopo aver mangiato una mela aspra. Le sacche sulle guance contengono un liquido estremamente acido che può provocare ustioni.
description.pt-BR: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
description.ru: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
description.ja: すっぱい　りんごを　食べて　進化。 火傷する　ほど　強酸性の 液体を　頬袋に　溜める。

description.fr: Il a évolué après avoir mangé une pomme sucrée. Il attire ses proies, les Pokémon Insecte, en dégageant un parfum mielleux.
description.en: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
description.es: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana dulce. De ahí que el olor que emana para atraer a sus presas, los Pokémon insecto, sea tan agradable.
description.de: Nach dem Verzehr eines süßen Apfels hat es sich entwickelt. Es verströmt einen süßen Duft und lockt damit sein Futter an: Käfer-Pokémon.
description.it: Si è evoluto dopo aver mangiato una mela dolce. Si nutre di Pokémon Coleottero, che attira emanando un dolce profumo dal corpo.
description.pt-BR: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
description.ru: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
description.ja: 甘い　りんごを　食べて　進化。 体から　甘い　においを　だして 餌の　虫ポケモンを　引き寄せる。

description.fr: Il amasse le sable qu’il avale en creusant dans la poche de son cou. Elle peut en contenir jusqu’à huit kilos.
description.en: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
description.es: Almacena la arena que ingiere al perforar hoyos en la saca del cuello, cuya capacidad llega a alcanzar incluso los 8 kg.
description.de: Den Sand, den es beim Graben von Löchern verzehrt, speichert es in einem Beutel in seinem Hals. Dieser kann bis zu 8 kg Sand aufnehmen.
