description.it: Conserva nella sacca del collo la sabbia che ingoia scavando buche. Può accumularne ben 8 kg.
description.pt-BR: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
description.ru: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
description.ja: 穴を　掘りながら　食べた　砂を 首の　袋に　溜めている。 ８キロもの　砂が　入るのだ。

description.fr: Il peut expulser 100 kg de sable de ses narines en compressant tout son corps. Quand il est à court de sable, il a tendance à se dérober.
description.en: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
description.es: Se retuerce para expulsar por los orificios nasales hasta 100 kg de arena. La ausencia de esta mina su ánimo.
description.de: Zieht es seinen ganzen Körper zusammen, kann es 100 kg Sand aus seinen Nasenlöchern feuern. Geht ihm der Sand aus, verliert es den Mut.
description.it: Può rimpicciolire il suo corpo espellendo dalle narici 100 kg di sabbia. Quando esaurisce la sabbia, viene preso dallo sconforto.
description.pt-BR: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
description.ru: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
description.ja: 全身を　縮め　１００キロの 砂を　鼻の　穴から　噴射。 砂が　ないと　弱気に　なるぞ。

description.fr: Il est assez puissant pour terrasser un ennemi d’un seul coup, mais il est tellement nigaud qu’il oublie contre qui il se bat.
description.en: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
description.es: Su colosal potencia le permite machacar al rival de un solo golpe, aunque su carácter despistado lo lleva a olvidarse de su presencia.
description.de: Es ist so stark, dass es seine Gegner mit einem Angriff vernichten könnte, aber zerstreut wie es ist, vergisst es öfters, wen es gerade bekämpft.
description.it: È così potente che può sconfiggere l’avversario in un colpo solo, ma è talmente smemorato che si dimentica perfino con chi stava lottando.
description.pt-BR: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
description.ru: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
description.ja: 相手を　一撃で　打ち負かすほど パワフルだが　忘れっぽいので 戦っている　相手を　忘れる。

description.fr: Sa mâchoire fine et aiguisée fait sa fierté. À peine voit-il le moindre mouvement qu’il fonce dans sa direction.
description.en: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
description.es: Se siente muy orgulloso de su afilada mandíbula. En cuanto detecta el más mínimo movimiento, va directo al objetivo para cargar contra él.
description.de: Sein spitz zulaufender Kiefer ist sein ganzer Stolz. Erblickt es etwas, das sich auch nur ein bisschen bewegt, setzt es geradewegs zum Stoßangriff an.
description.it: Va orgoglioso della sua mandibola appuntita. Appena nota il minimo movimento, parte subito all’attacco.
description.pt-BR: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
description.ru: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
description.ja: 鋭く　尖った　顎が　自慢。 少しでも　動くものを　見つけると 一直線に　突撃する。

description.fr: Sa mâchoire pointue comme une lance est aussi dure que l’acier, et sa chair serait, contre toute attente, succulente.
description.en: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
description.es: Su mandíbula es tan puntiaguda como una lanza y tan dura como el acero. Al parecer, su carne es sorprendentemente deliciosa.
description.de: Sein Kiefer ist spitz wie ein Speer und hart wie Stahl. Außerdem soll Barrakiefa überraschend deliziös sein.
description.it: La sua mandibola è appuntita come una lancia e dura come l’acciaio. Sembra che le sue carni siano incredibilmente deliziose.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
description.ru: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
description.ja: 槍のように　尖った　顎は 鋼の　硬さ。　その　身は 驚くほど　美味しいらしい。

description.fr: Sa peau sécrète les toxines accumulées dans sa poche de poison interne. Quand on le touche, on se fait électrocuter.
description.en: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
description.es: Secreta toxinas por la piel y las almacena en una bolsa de veneno interna. Tocarlo da calambre.
description.de: Das Gift aus dem Giftsack in seinem Körper sondert es über die Haut ab. Berührt man es, bekommt man einen lähmenden Schock verpasst.
description.it: Secerne dalla pelle le tossine contenute nella sua sacca di veleno interna. Provoca a chi lo tocca una sensazione di bruciore.
description.pt-BR: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
description.ru: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
description.ja: 体内の　毒袋に　溜めた 毒素を　皮膚から　分泌。 触ると　ピリピリと　痺れる。

description.fr: Lorsqu’il gratte l’excroissance sur son ventre pour produire de l’électricité, on peut entendre un son similaire à celui d’une guitare.
description.en: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
description.es: Cuando rasga las protuberancias del pecho para generar energía eléctrica, emite un sonido similar al de una guitarra, que reverbera en el entorno.
description.de: Wenn es am Fortsatz an seiner Brust kratzt und dadurch Strom erzeugt, dann erklingt in der Umgebung ein Ton wie von einer Gitarre.
description.it: Quando produce energia elettrica strofinando le protuberanze che ha sul petto, tutt’intorno riverbera un suono simile a quello di una chitarra.
description.pt-BR: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
description.ru: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
description.ja: 胸の　突起を　掻きむしり 電気を　起こすとき　あたりに ギターのような　音が　響く。

description.fr: Il produit de la chaleur grâce au gaz inflammable qu’il emmagasine dans son corps. La partie jaune de son abdomen est particulièrement brûlante.
description.en: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
description.es: Genera calor consumiendo el gas inflamable que almacena en su cuerpo. Los círculos amarillos del abdomen están particularmente calientes.
description.de: Mit dem entzündlichen Gas in seinem Körper erzeugt es Hitze. Die gelben Stellen an seinem Bauch werden besonders heiß.
description.it: Genera calore grazie ai gas combustibili accumulati nel suo corpo. Le parti gialle del suo addome sono particolarmente calde.
description.pt-BR: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
description.ru: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
description.ja: 体に　溜めた　可燃ガスで 発熱。　とくに　お腹の 黄色い　部分が　熱いのだ。

description.fr: Quand il génère de la chaleur, sa température est d’environ 800 °C. Il se sert de son corps comme d’un fouet pour sauter sur ses ennemis.
description.en: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
description.es: Cuando genera calor, su temperatura corporal alcanza aproximadamente los 800 °C. Usa el cuerpo a modo de látigo para lanzarse al ataque.
description.de: Wenn es Hitze erzeugt, beträgt seine Temperatur etwa 800 ºC. Es bewegt seinen Körper wie eine Peitsche, um dann den Gegner anzuspringen.
description.it: Quando genera calore, la temperatura del suo corpo raggiunge gli 800 ºC. Si lancia all’attacco usando il corpo come una frusta.
description.pt-BR: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
description.ru: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
description.ja: 発熱時の　体温は　およそ ８００度。　体を　鞭のように しならせて　跳びかかってくるぞ。

description.fr: Il se rend sur la terre ferme pour se nourrir. Très curieux, son premier réflexe est de frapper tout ce qu’il voit avec ses tentacules.
description.en: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
description.es: Emerge a tierra firme en busca de alimento. Su extrema curiosidad lo induce a golpear con los tentáculos todo lo que entra en su campo visual.
description.de: Zur Futtersuche kommt es an Land. Es ist sehr neugierig, weshalb es alles, was es sieht, zunächst einmal mit seinen Tentakeln haut.
description.it: Si spinge sulla terraferma in cerca di cibo. È molto curioso e colpisce con i tentacoli tutto quello che entra nel suo campo visivo.
description.pt-BR: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
description.ru: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
description.ja: 餌を　求め　地上に　上がる。 好奇心旺盛で　目にしたものは とりあえず　触手で　殴る。

description.fr: Son corps est un amas de muscles. La puissance des prises d’étranglement qu’il exécute avec ses tentacules est saisissante.
description.en: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
description.es: Todo su cuerpo es una mole de puro músculo. Utiliza los tentáculos para ejecutar técnicas de estrangulamiento con una formidable potencia.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht gänzlich aus Muskeln. Die schiere Stärke seines Würgegriffs, bei dem es seine Tentakel einsetzt, ist sagenhaft.
description.it: Il suo corpo è un ammasso di muscoli. È in grado di stritolare con una potenza formidabile grazie ai suoi tentacoli.
description.pt-BR: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
description.ru: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
description.ja: 全身が　筋肉の　塊。 触手を　使って　繰りだす 絞め技の　威力は　凄まじい。

description.fr: On raconte que ce Pokémon est né lorsqu’une âme esseulée a plongé dans un reste de thé noir froid.
description.en: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
description.es: Según se dice, este Pokémon surgió de un alma solitaria que poseyó una taza abandonada llena de un té ya frío.
description.de: Es heißt, eine einsame Seele habe Besitz von einer abgestellten, kalten Tasse Schwarztee ergriffen und sei zu diesem Pokémon geworden.
description.it: Si dice che questo Pokémon sia nato quando un’anima solitaria si è impossessata di una tazza dimenticata piena di tè ormai freddo.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
description.ru: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
description.ja: 残され　冷えきった　紅茶に さみしがりやな　魂が　宿り ポケモンに　なったと　いわれている。

description.fr: Il élit domicile dans des théières antiques. La plupart sont des contrefaçons, mais il lui arrive dans de très rares cas de trouver des originaux.
description.en: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
description.es: Se hospeda en teteras dignas de un anticuario. Las originales son escasísimas, pero existe un gran número de burdas falsificaciones.
description.de: Sie lassen sich in alten Teekannen nieder. Die meisten dieser Kannen sind billige Fälschungen, aber es gibt auch ein paar sehr seltene Originale.
description.it: Prende dimora in una teiera antica. Quelle in circolazione sono quasi tutte contraffatte, ma a volte ne trova una autentica.
description.pt-BR: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
description.ru: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
description.ja: アンティークの　ポットに　棲みつく。 ほとんどが　贋作だが　ごくまれに 真作が　見つかる　ことも。

description.fr: La protubérance sur sa tête lui permet de percevoir les émotions des êtres vivants. Il n’accorde sa confiance qu’aux gens calmes.
description.en: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
description.es: Percibe los sentimientos de los seres vivos con la protuberancia de la cabeza. Solo abre su corazón a quienes muestren un carácter sosegado.
description.de: Mit dem Fortsatz an seinem Kopf kann es die Gefühle von Lebewesen wahrnehmen. Es öffnet nur geruhsam veranlagten Leuten sein Herz.
description.it: Percepisce lo stato d’animo degli esseri viventi tramite la protuberanza sulla testa. Apre il suo cuore solo alle persone di indole pacifica.
description.pt-BR: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
description.ru: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
description.ja: 頭の　突起で　生物の 気持ちを　感じとる。　穏やかな ものにしか　心を　開かない。

description.fr: S’il ressent des émotions trop fortes, il en fera taire la source, quelle qu’elle soit, en utilisant des méthodes assez violentes.
description.en: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
description.es: Silencia a cualquiera que muestre una emoción intensa sin importar de quién se trate y recurre para ello a métodos a cuál más violento.
description.de: Empfindet jemand starke Emotionen, bringt es ihn auf gewaltsame Art zum Schweigen, egal, um wen es sich dabei handelt.
description.it: Se qualcuno esterna emozioni troppo forti, lo affronta immediatamente e lo mette a tacere senza tanti convenevoli.
description.pt-BR: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
description.ru: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
description.ja: 強い　感情を　もつ　ものは それが　誰であれ　黙らせる。 その手段は　じつに　乱暴。

description.fr: Il éloigne les autres êtres vivants en émettant des ondes psychiques pouvant donner des maux de tête épouvantables.
description.en: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
description.es: Para mantener alejados a los demás seres vivos, emana a su alrededor ondas psíquicas cuya potencia es capaz de provocar jaquecas.
description.de: Die starken Psycho-Kräfte, die es ausstrahlt, rufen Kopfschmerzen hervor. So hält es andere Lebewesen von sich fern.
description.it: Tiene alla larga gli esseri viventi che si trovano nei paraggi emettendo onde psichiche così forti da far venire il mal di testa.
description.pt-BR: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
description.ru: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
description.ja: 頭痛になるほどの　サイコパワーを 周囲に　放って　ほかの 生物を　遠ざけているのだ。

description.fr: Pour se refaire une santé, il hume l’énergie négative que les humains et les Pokémon dégagent quand ils sont irrités.
description.en: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
description.es: Con el fin de revitalizarse, inhala por la nariz la energía negativa que desprenden tanto personas como Pokémon cuando están descontentos.
description.de: Es wird kräftiger, indem es die von unzufriedenen Menschen und Pokémon ausgestoßene negative Energie einatmet.
description.it: Recupera le forze inalando dal naso l’energia negativa emessa da persone e Pokémon quando sono irritati.
description.pt-BR: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
description.ru: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
description.ja: 人や　ポケモンが　嫌がる　ときに 発する　マイナスエネルギーを 鼻から　吸いこみ　元気になる。

description.fr: Sa technique de combat consiste à faire semblant de se prosterner devant son adversaire pour le transpercer avec ses cheveux aiguisés.
description.en: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
description.es: Su estrategia consiste en postrarse ante el rival y fingir una disculpa para ensartarlo con el mechón que tiene en la espalda, afilado cual lanza.
description.de: Es nutzt eine Taktik, bei der es sich niederwirft und vorgibt, sich zu entschuldigen, nur um dann mit seinem speerartigen Haar zuzustoßen.
description.it: Nella lotta si prostra fingendo di chiedere pietà e infilza il nemico con il ciuffo di capelli appuntito come una lancia che gli parte dalla nuca.
description.pt-BR: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
description.ru: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
description.ja: 土下座して　謝る　振りをして 槍のように　尖った　後ろ髪で 突き刺してくる　戦法を　使う。

description.fr: Il enroule ses cheveux autour de son corps pour augmenter sa masse musculaire, ce qui lui donne assez de force pour enserrer un Mackogneur.
description.en: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
description.es: Cuando enrolla sus cabellos por todo el cuerpo, aumenta su potencia muscular. Posee una fuerza capaz de someter a Machamp.
description.de: Wickelt es seine Haare um den ganzen Körper, verstärkt dies seine Muskelkraft. Das macht es so stark, dass es sogar Machomei bezwingen könnte.
description.it: Se avvolge il corpo con i capelli, la sua potenza muscolare aumenta. La sua forza gli permette di immobilizzare a terra anche Machamp.
description.pt-BR: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
description.ru: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
description.ja: 髪の毛を　全身に　巻きつけると 筋力が　アップ。　カイリキーを ねじ伏せる　パワーを　発揮する。

description.fr: Il possède une puissance vocale remarquable. On appelle Blocage sa technique qui consiste à intimider l’ennemi avec son cri guttural.
description.en: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
description.es: La potencia de su voz es realmente pasmosa. La técnica que usa para intimidar al rival mientras grita recibe el nombre de Obstrucción.
description.de: Es verfügt über eine beeindruckende Stimmkraft. Sein von Schreien begleitetes Drohverhalten nennt man auch „Abblocker“.
description.it: Ha una potenza vocale impressionante. Quando assume la tipica posa intimidatoria e si mette a urlare, si dice che sta facendo “sbarramento”.
description.pt-BR: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
description.ru: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
description.ja: 凄まじい　声量を　もつ。 シャウトとともに　威嚇するさまは ブロッキングと　呼ばれている。

description.fr: La fourrure sur sa tête s’est endurcie et a pris la forme d’un casque en fer. Il est de nature très bagarreuse.
description.en: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
description.es: El pelo de la cabeza se le ha endurecido hasta el punto de parecer un yelmo de hierro. Posee un temperamento muy combativo.
description.de: Die Haare auf seinem Kopf haben sich zu etwas verhärtet, das an einen eisernen Helm erinnert. Es ist von Natur aus kriegerisch veranlagt.
description.it: La pelliccia sulla testa si è indurita ed è diventata simile a un elmetto di ferro. Ha una natura molto combattiva.
description.pt-BR: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
description.ru: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
description.ja: 頭の　体毛が　硬質化して 鉄の　ヘルメットのように　なった。 とても　好戦的な　性質。

description.fr: Son énergie spectrale accrue s’est répandue hors de sa coquille. Il protège l’âme de son noyau avec son corps spirituel.
description.en: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
description.es: Su energía espiritual ha aumentado hasta hacerlo desprenderse de su base caliza. Protege el alma del núcleo con su cuerpo espectral.
description.de: In ihm wuchs eine mysteriöse Kraft und so löste es sich von seinem Panzer los. Sein geisterhaftes Ektoplasma schützt die Seele im Kern.
description.it: Un accumulo di energia misteriosa lo ha separato dal suo guscio. Protegge l’anima contenuta nel suo nucleo in una sorta di ectoplasma.
description.pt-BR: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
description.ru: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
description.ja: 霊力が　高まり　殻から 解き放たれた。　霊体で 核の　魂を　守っている。

description.fr: Seuls les Canarticho ayant survécu à de nombreux combats atteignent ce stade d’évolution. Si son poireau se flétrit, il se retire du champ de bataille.
description.en: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
description.es: Los ejemplares que superan numerosos combates evolucionan y adoptan esta forma. Abandonan el terreno de combate en cuanto el puerro se seca.
description.de: Porenta, die viele Schlachten überstanden haben, entwickeln sich zu Lauchzelot. Verwelkt seine Lauchstange, zieht es sich vom Kämpfen zurück.
description.it: Gli esemplari con tante lotte alle spalle si evolvono assumendo questa forma. Se il suo gambo si secca, abbandona il campo di lotta.
description.pt-BR: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
description.ru: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
description.ja: 歴戦を　生き抜いた　ものが この姿に　進化する。　ネギが 枯れるとき　戦場を　去る。

description.fr: Véritable virtuose des claquettes, il se donne en spectacle en dansant d’un pas léger tout en jonglant avec sa canne de glace.
description.en: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
description.es: Es un bailarín consumado de claqué. Agita su bastón de hielo mientras exhibe su destreza con gráciles pasos.
description.de: Dieser begnadete Stepptänzer schwingt einen aus Eis geformten Gehstock und gibt mit leichtem Fuß seinen Tanz zum Besten.
description.it: È un maestro del tip tap. Fa roteare il suo bastone di ghiaccio mentre si esibisce in leggiadri passi di danza.
description.pt-BR: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
description.ru: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
description.ja: タップダンスの　達人。 氷で　できた　ステッキを　振り 軽やかな　ステップを　披露する。

description.fr: Les motifs antiques qui ont été gravés en y incorporant une puissante malédiction ont aspiré l’âme de Tutafeh avant de prendre vie.
description.en: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
description.es: Una poderosa maldición pesa sobre esta antigua imagen grabada, que ha cobrado vida tras adueñarse del alma de Yamask.
description.de: Eine antike Malerei, die mit einem mächtigen Fluch versehen wurde, nahm die Seele eines Makabaja auf und erwachte zum Leben.
description.it: Un antico disegno afflitto da una potente maledizione ha preso vita, imprigionando l’anima di Yamask.
description.pt-BR: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
description.ru: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
description.ja: 強い　呪いを　こめて　描かれた 古代の　絵が　デスマスの 魂を　取り込み　動きだした。

description.fr: Son corps de crème s’est composé à partir de particules au parfum sucré flottant dans l’air.
description.en: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
description.es: Su cremoso cuerpo surgió a partir de la unión de partículas odoríferas de dulces aromas presentes en el aire.
description.de: Sein Körper besteht aus Sahne. Es entstand aus einer Ansammlung süßer Geruchspartikel in der Luft.
description.it: Il suo corpo è fatto di panna. È nato dall’unione di particelle di profumo dolce disperse nell’aria.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
description.ru: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
description.ja: クリームで　できた　体を　もつ。 空気中の　甘い　香りの 成分が　集まって　生まれた。

description.fr: Il offre aux Dresseurs auxquels il accorde toute sa confiance des Baies décorées avec de la crème.
description.en: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
description.es: Obsequia bayas decoradas con nata a aquellos Entrenadores en los que confía.
description.de: Es macht einem Trainer, dem es vertraut, mit Beeren samt Sahnedekoration eine Freude.
description.it: Agli Allenatori di cui si fida regala bacche decorate con la panna.
description.pt-BR: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
description.ru: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
description.ja: 信頼する　トレーナーには クリームで　デコレーションした 木の実を　ふるまって　くれるのだ。

description.fr: C’est une entité unique composée d’un chef et de cinq cadets. Ces derniers obéissent sans sourciller à leur supérieur hiérarchique.
description.en: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
description.es: Este Pokémon consta de cinco subalternos y un líder, cuyas órdenes obedecen sin rechistar.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon besteht aus fünf Untergebenen und einem Anführer. Die Befehle des Anführers werden nie in Frage gestellt.
description.it: Questo Pokémon è formato da un capo e da cinque sottoposti che obbediscono ciecamente ai suoi ordini.
description.pt-BR: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
description.ru: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
description.ja: ヘイチョーと　呼ばれる　１匹と ヘイと　呼ばれる　５匹で　ひとつ。 ヘイチョーの　命令は　絶対。

description.fr: Il libère de l’électricité depuis la pointe de ses épines, et se nourrit des algues accrochées aux rochers en les arrachant avec ses dents aiguisées.
description.en: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
description.es: Libera electricidad por la punta de las púas. Con sus afilados dientes raspa las algas pegadas a las rocas para ingerirlas.
description.de: Aus den Spitzen seiner Stacheln setzt es Elektrizität frei. Mit seinen scharfen Zähnen schabt es Algen von Steinen ab und frisst sie.
description.it: Sprigiona elettricità dalla punta dei suoi aculei. Usa i denti affilati per raschiare dalle rocce le alghe di cui si nutre.
description.pt-BR: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
description.ru: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
description.ja: 棘の　先から　電気を　放つ。 鋭い　歯で　岩に　ついた 海藻を　こそいで　食べる。

description.fr: Il crache un fil gelé qu’il utilise pour s’accrocher à une branche : il dort ainsi en imitant une stalactite.
description.en: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
description.es: Teje un hilo gélido que le permite aferrarse a las ramas y simula ser un carámbano mientras duerme.
description.de: Es spinnt einen eiskalten Faden, mit dem es sich an einen Ast hängt. Dabei tut es so, als wäre es ein Eiszapfen, um in Ruhe schlafen zu können.
description.it: Si assicura a un ramo con il filo gelido che produce dalla bocca e dorme fingendosi un ghiacciolo.
description.pt-BR: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
description.ru: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
description.ja: 冷気の　混ざった　糸を　吐く。 糸で　体を　枝に　巻きつけ 氷柱の　振りをして　眠るのだ。

description.fr: La température de ses ailes est de - 180 °C. Quand il vole, ses écailles gelées tombent sur le paysage comme des flocons de neige.
description.en: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.es: La temperatura de sus alas es de -180 °C. Sobrevuela el campo esparciendo sus gélidas escamas, como si de nieve se tratase.
description.de: Seine Flügel sind -180 ºC kalt. Während es über Felder und Berge fliegt, verstreut es mit Kälte versetzten Flügelstaub, der wie Schnee aussieht.
description.it: La temperatura delle sue ali è di -180 ºC. Sorvola pianure e montagne lasciando cadere le sue scaglie gelide come fossero fiocchi di neve.
description.pt-BR: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ru: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
description.ja: はねの　温度は　マイナス１８０度。 冷気を　込めた　りんぷんを　雪の ように　ふりまき　野山を　飛ぶ。

description.fr: Il se tient immobile au milieu des plaines et passe son temps à observer la course du soleil dans le ciel. Son jeu de jambes est phénoménal.
description.en: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
description.es: Pasa el tiempo observando inmóvil el recorrido del sol sobre las extensas praderas que habita. Se especializa en técnicas de ágiles patadas.
description.de: Es verweilt auf weitläufigen Wiesen und beobachtet den Lauf der Sonne. Dynamische Trittangriffe sind sein Spezialgebiet.
description.it: Trascorre le giornate nelle grandi praterie osservando immobile il passaggio del sole. Le mosse basate sui calci sono la sua specialità.
description.pt-BR: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
description.ru: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
description.ja: 大草原の　中で　たたずみ 陽の　傾きを　眺めて　暮らす。 ダイナミックな　蹴り技が　得意。

description.fr: Originaire d’une contrée polaire, ce Pokémon a débarqué dans la région ballotté par les flots. Il garde toujours la tête froide.
description.en: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
description.es: La corriente lo ha transportado hasta aquí desde un lugar sumamente gélido. Utiliza el hielo para mantener la cara refrigerada en todo momento.
description.de: Es kam von einem extrem kalten Ort, indem es sich treiben ließ und schließlich angespült wurde. Es kühlt unablässig sein Gesicht mit Eis.
description.it: È arrivato da un luogo freddissimo trasportato dalla corrente. Mantiene sempre fredda la testa servendosi del ghiaccio.
description.pt-BR: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
description.ru: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
description.ja: とても　寒い　場所から　流れ 流されて　やってきた。　氷で 顔を　つねに　冷やして　いるのだ。

description.fr: Il peut sentir les émotions d’autrui avec ses cornes. Le mâle reste aux côtés de son Dresseur pour s’occuper de lui, à l’image d’un domestique.
description.en: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
description.es: Percibe las emociones del objetivo con los cuernos de la cabeza. Los machos están atentos a cualquier cosa que necesite su Entrenador.
description.de: Mit den Hörnern auf seinem Kopf erfasst es die Gefühle seines Gegenübers. Männchen kümmern sich wie Bedienstete um ihren Trainer.
description.it: Le corna sulla testa gli permettono di percepire lo stato d’animo degli altri. Il maschio segue il suo Allenatore ovunque e si prende cura di lui.
description.pt-BR: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
description.ru: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
description.ja: 頭の　ツノで　相手の　気持ちを 感じとる。　オスは　従者の ように　主のそばで　世話を焼く。

description.fr: Il a toujours un petit creux. Il grignote les graines qu’il a mises dans ses sortes de poches pour produire de l’électricité.
description.en: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
description.es: Siempre tiene hambre. Se nutre de las semillas que guarda en una suerte de bolsillos para generar electricidad.
description.de: Dieses immerzu hungrige Pokémon frisst Samen, die es in seinen beutelartigen Taschen verwahrt, und produziert so Elektrizität.
description.it: Ha costantemente fame. Si nutre dei semi che tiene nelle sue tasche per produrre elettricità.
description.pt-BR: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
description.ru: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
description.ja: いつも　お腹を　すかせている。 ポケットの　ような　袋に　入れた タネを　食べて　電気を　つくる。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon est assez costaud pour porter des charges de cinq tonnes sans problème. Il utilise sa trompe pour creuser le sol.
description.en: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
description.es: Su constitución fornida le permite transportar sin inmutarse cargas de 5 toneladas. Utiliza la trompa para excavar la tierra.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon verfügt über eine Stärke, mit der es problemlos fünf Tonnen stemmen kann. Es nutzt seinen Rüssel, um in der Erde zu graben.
description.it: È un Pokémon molto forte, capace di trasportare facilmente carichi di cinque tonnellate. Usa la proboscide per scavare la terra.
description.pt-BR: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
description.ru: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
description.ja: ５トンの　荷物を　もっても 平気な　力持ち　ポケモン。 鼻を　使って　土を　掘る。

description.fr: Sa peau verte résiste bien à l’eau. Il s’est installé dans la région il y a longtemps et a travaillé en coopération avec les Hommes.
description.en: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
description.es: Su piel verdosa es resistente al agua. Proviene de tierras lejanas y presta ayuda a las personas en la realización de ciertos trabajos.
description.de: Seine grüne Haut ist wasserresistent. Es kam vor langer Zeit aus einer anderen Region und verrichtete mit den Menschen Arbeiten.
description.it: La sua pelle verde è resistente all’acqua. Originario di un’altra regione, è giunto a Galar in passato per lavorare insieme agli esseri umani.
description.pt-BR: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
description.ru: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
description.ja: 緑の皮膚は　水にも　強い。 昔　ほかの土地から　やってきて 人と　いっしょに　働いた。

description.fr: Jadis, la partie inférieure de son corps musclé le rendait invincible, mais il s’est éteint après avoir mangé toutes les plantes dont il se nourrissait.
description.en: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
description.es: La robustez de su tren inferior lo hacía invencible en la antigüedad, pero se extinguió tras comerse todas las plantas de las que se nutría.
description.de: Dank seines kräftigen Unterkörpers war es in der Urzeit unbesiegbar, doch es fraß seine Pflanzennahrung restlos auf und starb daher aus.
description.it: Nell’antichità era invincibile grazie alla possente parte inferiore del corpo, ma si è estinto perché ha mangiato tutte le piante di cui si nutriva.
description.pt-BR: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
description.ru: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
description.ja: 古代では　たくましい　下半身で 無敵だったが　餌の　植物を 食べつくしてしまい　絶滅した。

description.fr: Quand la partie supérieure de son corps, couverte de glace, frissonne, il produit de l’électricité. Il éprouve de grandes difficultés à marcher.
description.en: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
description.es: La parte superior del cuerpo está congelada y, al temblar, genera electricidad. Camina con suma dificultad.
description.de: Durch das Zittern seines gefrorenen Oberkörpers entsteht Elektrizität. Das Laufen fällt ihm äußerst schwer.
description.it: La parte superiore del suo corpo è ghiacciata e quando trema produce elettricità. Cammina con estrema difficoltà.
description.pt-BR: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
description.ru: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
description.ja: 氷漬けの　上半身が 震えると　電気が　つくられる。 歩くことが　非常に　苦手。

description.fr: La force de ses pattes et de ses mâchoires le rendait presque invincible, mais à trop chasser ses proies, celles-ci ont disparu, et lui avec.
description.en: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
description.es: Su excelente capacidad motriz y la fuerza de su mandíbula lo hacían antaño invencible, pero dar caza a todas sus presas propició su extinción.
description.de: Dank der enormen Kraft seiner Beine und seines Kiefers war es in der Urzeit unbesiegbar, doch es fing seine Beute restlos weg und starb daher aus.
description.it: Anticamente era invincibile grazie all’incredibile potenza delle sue gambe e delle sue mascelle, ma si è estinto dopo aver esaurito tutte le prede.
description.pt-BR: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
description.ru: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
description.ja: ずば抜けた　脚力と　顎の 力で　古代では　無敵だったが 獲物を　獲り尽くし　絶滅した。

description.fr: Il gèle les alentours pour capturer ses proies, mais comme sa bouche est sur le dessus de sa tête, il a beaucoup de mal à les manger.
description.en: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
description.es: Atrapa a sus presas congelando su entorno, pero la ubicación de la boca encima de la cabeza le genera dificultades para deglutirlas.
description.de: Es fängt seine Beute, indem es seine Umgebung einfriert, doch da sich sein Maul oben auf seinem Kopf befindet, ist Fressen für es sehr umständlich.
description.it: Cattura le prede congelando l’ambiente circostante, ma avendo la bocca sopra la testa fatica a inghiottirle.
description.pt-BR: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
description.ru: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
description.ja: 周囲を　凍りつかせて　獲物を 捕まえるが　口が　頭の 上に　あるので　食べづらい。

description.fr: Son corps, semblable à du métal poli, allie légèreté et solidité. Malheureusement, il rouille facilement.
description.en: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
description.es: Su cuerpo, similar a un metal pulido, es tan ligero como robusto. Sin embargo, tiene el defecto de que se oxida con facilidad.
description.de: Sein an aufpoliertes Metall erinnernder Körper ist nicht nur leicht, sondern auch robust. Er hat jedoch den Nachteil, schnell zu rosten.
description.it: Il suo corpo simile a metallo lucidato è leggero e resistente, ma ha il difetto di arrugginire facilmente.
description.pt-BR: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
description.ru: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
description.ja: 磨きあげた　金属の　ような 体は　軽いうえに　硬いが 錆びやすいのが　欠点なのだ。

description.fr: Revenu à la vie sous forme de Pokémon Spectre, il erre au-dessus de la mer dans laquelle il vivait autrefois.
description.en: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
description.es: Habitaba los mares en tiempos inmemoriales. Ha revivido en forma de Pokémon de tipo Fantasma para vagar por su antigua morada.
description.de: In der Urzeit lebte es im Meer. Nun ist es als Geister-Pokémon wiedererwacht und irrt rastlos durch seinen früheren Lebensraum.
description.it: Abitava i mari in tempi antichi. È rinato sotto forma di Pokémon di tipo Spettro e vaga per quella che un tempo era la sua dimora.
description.pt-BR: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
description.ru: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
description.ja: 古代の　海で　暮らしていた。 ゴーストポケモンとして　よみがえり かつての　すみかを　さまよっている。

description.fr: Il vole à une vitesse de 200 km/h et se bat aux côtés d’un Fantyrm, dont il prend soin jusqu’à son évolution.
description.en: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
description.es: Vuela a una velocidad de 200 km/h. Lucha junto a un Dreepy, al que cuida hasta el momento de su evolución.
description.de: Beim Fliegen ist es bis zu 200 km/h schnell. Es kämpft gemeinsam mit Grolldra und kümmert sich bis zu dessen Entwicklung um es.
description.it: Vola a una velocità di 200 km/h. Lotta assieme a Dreepy e se ne prende cura fino a quando non si evolve.
description.pt-BR: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
description.ru: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
description.ja: 飛行速度は　時速２００キロ。 ドラメシヤと　いっしょに　戦い 無事に　進化するまで　世話をする。

description.fr: Il vit en compagnie de Fantyrm qui logent dans les trous de ses cornes. Quand il passe à l’attaque, il les propulse à la vitesse du son.
description.en: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
description.es: Vive en compañía de Dreepy, a los que hospeda en el interior de sus cuernos. Los dispara a velocidad supersónica en combate.
description.de: Es transportiert Grolldra in den Löchern an seinen Hörnern. Kommt es zum Kampf, schießt es diese mit Mach-Geschwindigkeit ab.
description.it: Vive assieme ai Dreepy, che ospita all’interno dei buchi sulle sue corna. Quando lotta li espelle alla velocità del suono.
description.pt-BR: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
description.ru: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
description.ja: ツノの　穴に　ドラメシヤを　入れて 暮らす。　戦いになると　マッハの スピードで　ドラメシヤを　飛ばす。

description.fr: Également surnommé « héros légendaire », ce Pokémon absorbe du métal et se change en arme pour se battre.
description.en: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description.es: Este Pokémon está considerado como un héroe de leyenda. Absorbe el metal para transformarlo y emplearlo como armamento.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon gilt als legendärer Held. Es nimmt Metall auf, wandelt dies in eine Waffe um und kämpft damit.
description.it: È conosciuto come “l’eroe della leggenda”. Assorbe il metallo e lo trasforma per armarsi durante la lotta.
description.pt-BR: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description.ru: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description.ja: 伝説の　英雄と　呼ばれる ポケモン。　金属を　取り込み 武具に　変化させ　戦う。

description.fr: Ce Pokémon sauva autrefois Galar en joignant ses forces à celles du roi des Hommes. Il absorbe du métal quand il passe au combat.
description.en: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
description.es: Este Pokémon se erigió en salvador de Galar, tras unir fuerzas con un rey de los hombres. Absorbe el metal para utilizarlo en combate.
description.de: Dieses Pokémon vereinte seine Kräfte mit einem Menschenkönig und rettete die Galar-Region. Es nimmt Metall in sich auf und kämpft damit.
description.it: Ha salvato Galar unendo le forze con il re degli uomini. Assorbe il metallo e se ne serve per lottare.
description.pt-BR: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
description.ru: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
description.ja: 人の王と　力を　あわせ ガラルを　救った　ポケモン。 金属を　取り込み　戦う。

description.fr: Il devient actif en absorbant l’énergie qui émerge du sol de Galar grâce au noyau situé sur sa poitrine.
description.en: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
description.es: Se alimenta de la energía que brota de la tierra de Galar absorbiéndola por el núcleo del pecho.
description.de: Indem der Kern in seinem Brustkorb die Energie absorbiert, die aus dem Boden der Galar-Region strömt, wird es aktiv.
description.it: Si alimenta attraverso il nucleo sul suo petto, con cui assorbe l’energia emanata dalla terra della regione di Galar.
description.pt-BR: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
description.ru: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
description.ja: 胸の　コアが　ガラル地方の 大地から　涌きだす　エネルギーを 吸収して　活動している。

description.fr: Il suit un entraînement rigoureux pour parfaire ses techniques. La forme de son évolution dépend des capacités qu’il a assimilées.
description.en: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description.es: Perfecciona su técnica mediante una estricta disciplina. Según la corriente marcial que siga, adoptará una forma u otra al evolucionar.
description.de: Durch rigoroses Training perfektioniert es seine Kampftechnik. Diese bestimmt, welche Form Dakuma nach der Entwicklung annimmt.
description.it: Affina le sue mosse sottoponendosi a duri allenamenti. La forma assunta dopo l’evoluzione cambia a seconda delle mosse padroneggiate.
description.pt-BR: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description.ru: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description.ja: 厳しい　鍛錬を　積み　技を 磨く。　体得した　技によって 進化したときの　姿が　変わる。

description.fr: Adepte des techniques pouvant mettre K.O. en un seul coup, il se jette sur son adversaire et le frappe de son poing robuste.
description.en: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
description.es: Su estilo de lucha se basa en abatir a sus rivales de un solo golpe. Se abalanza sobre ellos con su puño cincelado por el entrenamiento.
description.de: Es ist darauf spezialisiert, Gegner mit nur einem Treffer zu bezwingen, indem es sie schlagartig anfällt und einen fokussierten Hieb austeilt.
description.it: Il suo credo è sconfiggere l’avversario con un colpo solo. Si lancia sul nemico e lo colpisce con un pugno potenziato al massimo dall’allenamento.
description.pt-BR: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
description.ru: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
description.ja: 一撃必殺が　信条。 相手の　懐に　飛びこみ 鍛えられた　拳を　叩きこむ。

description.fr: Ils vivent en groupe dans la jungle, où les autres Pokémon les craignent à cause de leur nature agressive.
description.en: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
description.es: Viven en manada en la selva. Debido a su marcada agresividad, son muy temidos por otros Pokémon selváticos.
description.de: Zarude leben gruppenweise in dichten Wäldern und werden von den anderen Pokémon dort gefürchtet, da sie sehr aggressiv sind.
description.it: Vive in branco nella giungla. È temuto dagli altri Pokémon della foresta perché estremamente aggressivo.
description.pt-BR: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
description.ru: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
description.ja: 群れを　つくり　密林で　暮らす。 とても　攻撃的で　森にすむ ポケモンたちから　恐れられている。

description.fr: Son corps est un véritable concentré d’énergie électrique. On raconte que si on lui retire ses anneaux, sa puissance cachée se libère.
description.en: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
description.es: Su cuerpo entero es energía eléctrica. Por lo visto, quitarle los anillos que lleva libera su poder oculto.
description.de: Es besteht aus gebündelter elektrischer Energie. Werden die Ringe an seinem Körper entfernt, setzt das angeblich seine verborgenen Kräfte frei.
description.it: È un agglomerato di energia elettrica. Si dice che rimuovere gli anelli che ha attorno al corpo liberi la sua potenza latente.
description.pt-BR: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
description.ru: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
description.ja: 電気エネルギーの　塊。 体の　リングを　外すと　秘めた 力が　解き放たれるらしい。

description.fr: Une théorie stipule que ses bras ont la forme de la tête d’un Pokémon Dragon des temps anciens, mais aucune preuve ne l’atteste.
description.en: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
description.es: Cierta teoría afirma que la forma de sus brazos representa la cabeza de un Pokémon dragón ancestral, aunque esto no ha podido verificarse.
description.de: Einer unbestätigten Theorie zufolge sind seine Arme wie der Kopf eines urzeitlichen Drachen-Pokémon geformt.
description.it: Si ipotizza che le sue braccia abbiano la forma della testa di un antico Pokémon di tipo Drago, ma non esistono prove certe.
description.pt-BR: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
description.ru: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
description.ja: 腕の　形は　古代の　ドラゴン ポケモンの　頭という　学説も あるが　証明されていない。

description.fr: Violent au point de s’emparer de tout ce qu’il désire par la force, ce Pokémon est capable de libérer un puissant air glacial de ses sabots.
description.en: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description.es: Libera un potente vaho gélido por las pezuñas. Un ser violento que no duda en tomar a la fuerza todo cuanto desea.
description.de: Aus seinen Hufen verströmt es eisige Kälte. Dieses ungestüme Pokémon nimmt sich alles, was es will, mit roher Gewalt.
description.it: Rilascia una potente aria gelida dagli zoccoli. È impetuoso e prende con la forza tutto ciò che vuole.
description.pt-BR: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description.ru: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description.ja: 蹄から　強力な　冷気を 放つ。　欲しいものは　なんでも 力尽くで　奪う　暴れん坊。

description.fr: Il se sert de tous ses sens pour se repérer, sauf celui de la vue. Un coup de ses sabots suffirait à séparer l’âme du corps de sa cible.
description.en: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description.es: Examina su entorno con todos los sentidos, salvo la vista. Se dice que sus coces son capaces de robarle el alma a quien las recibe.
description.de: Um sein Umfeld zu erkunden, nutzt es all seine Sinne – bis auf den Sehsinn. Wer von Phantoross getreten wird, verliert angeblich seine Seele.
description.it: Sonda l’area circostante con tutti i suoi sensi, esclusa la vista. Si narra che chi subisce i suoi calci venga privato dell’anima.
description.pt-BR: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description.ru: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description.ja: 視覚　以外の　五感を　使い 様子を　探る。　蹴られたものは 魂を　抜かれてしまうという。

description.fr: Doté de pouvoirs de guérison et d’abondance, ce Pokémon miséricordieux régnait sur Galar il y a fort longtemps.
description.en: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
description.es: Un Pokémon muy compasivo agraciado con el poder de la curación. Reinó en Galar en tiempos remotos.
description.de: Ein warmherziges Pokémon, das über heilende und segnende Kräfte verfügt. In längst vergangenen Zeiten herrschte es über Galar.
description.it: Portatore di rigogliosità e dotato di poteri curativi, questo Pokémon compassionevole regnò su Galar in tempi antichi.
description.pt-BR: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
description.ru: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
description.ja: 癒しと　恵みの　力を　もつ 慈愛に　満ちた　ポケモン。　はるか むかし　ガラルに　君臨していた。
